items.src: Aquarium applicants need a marine biology qualification as well as work experience, a referee's recommendation and a completed application form.
items.para: Alongside work experience, a referee's reference and a completed application form, aquarium job candidates must possess a credential in marine biology.
items.note: 此处两者都指通过专业学习取得的资格证明。

items.src: Residents must stay indoors during the emergency drill, rather than outside their houses, beneath trees or next to walls.
items.para: For the emergency exercise, residents must avoid waiting outside homes, under trees or beside walls and remain inside buildings instead.
items.note: 两者都表示在建筑物内部，而非室外。

items.src: Leila expected the winter harvest to ease her anxiety rather than disappoint or scare her, but its abundance continued to amaze her.
items.para: The winter harvest's abundance continued to astonish Leila, who had expected it to reassure her rather than disappoint or frighten her.
items.note: 两者都表示使人感到非常惊奇。

items.src: Free scanner updates come from its maker for five years after purchase, not from the shop, importing company or distribution firm.
items.para: For five years after purchase, the scanner's manufacturer supplies free updates, rather than its retailer, importer or distributor.
items.note: 此处两者都指生产该产品的制造商。

items.src: Editors identified rushed reporting as the source of errors, complaints as their sign and lost trust as their result, but fact-checking as the solution.
items.para: Editors identified fact-checking as the remedy for errors, rushed reporting as their cause, complaints as a symptom and lost trust as a consequence.
items.note: 此处两者都指解决问题的办法。

items.src: Researchers first expected no difference, yet tired volunteers forgot symbols while rested participants remembered them; therefore, the team linked sleep with recall.
items.para: Researchers initially expected no difference; however, tired volunteers forgot symbols; meanwhile, rested participants remembered them; consequently, the team linked sleep with recall.
items.note: 两者都表示因此，引出前述事实带来的结论。

items.src: Several cooperatives claim that hedges improve soil, although advisers question this, opponents reject it and independent researchers cannot yet verify it.
items.para: Although advisers doubt and opponents deny that hedges improve soil, several cooperatives assert this, while independent researchers cannot yet confirm it.
items.note: 此处两者都表示声称某事属实，但尚未获独立证实。

items.src: Navigation practice gave Amara confidence in exploring unfamiliar trails, reducing her worry without diminishing her desire to learn or her eagerness.
items.para: Amara's anxiety decreased after navigation practice built her self-assurance about exploring unfamiliar trails, while her curiosity and enthusiasm remained undiminished.
items.note: 此处两者都指对自身能力的信心。

items.src: Monastery records describe a mild winter with little rain, windy conditions and persistent cloud cover, allowing chapel roof repairs to continue.
items.para: Chapel roof repairs could continue thanks to winter weather described in monastery records as relatively warm, dry, windy and consistently cloudy.
items.note: 此处两者都表示冬季较暖、不严寒。

items.src: Festival volunteers secured the shared tent against strong winds with thick rope, rejecting metal wire, linked chain and flat strapping.
items.para: Rejecting metal wire, linked chain and flat strapping, festival volunteers used thick cord to fasten the communal tent against powerful winds.
items.note: 此处两者都指用于固定帐篷的绳索。

items.src: Visitors found the canyon awesome rather than merely pretty, although the nearby caves seemed unremarkable and the waterfall let them down.
items.para: Visitors considered the canyon breathtaking, not merely attractive, although the nearby caves seemed ordinary and the waterfall disappointing.
items.note: 此处都表示令人惊叹的，而非仅仅好看。

items.src: Nadia chooses comic training stories rather than solemn warnings because new waiters remember amusing incidents better than scary or emotionally touching accounts.
items.para: New waiters remember funny incidents better than frightening or moving accounts, so Nadia uses these training stories instead of serious warnings.
items.note: 此处都指故事滑稽有趣，能逗人发笑。

items.src: Despite mining's contraction, manufacturing's move overseas and tourism's shutdown, the development of island fisheries has created boatbuilding jobs over the past decade.
items.para: Island fisheries' growth has generated boatbuilding jobs over the last ten years, despite mining's decline, manufacturing's relocation overseas and tourism's closure.
items.note: 此处都指渔业的发展壮大。

items.src: Leila practises every evening for her solo next week; although she felt confident last month, she is currently anxious about it.
items.para: Despite feeling confident last month, Leila is anxious at present about her solo next week and practises every evening.
items.note: 都表示目前，区别于过去、将来或频率。

items.src: Researchers compared bacterial survival in a freezing chamber with survival in rooms that were mildly chilly, fairly warm and very hot.
items.para: To compare bacterial survival, researchers used slightly cool, moderately warm and intensely hot rooms alongside an extremely cold chamber.
items.note: 此处都表示极其寒冷的，程度很强。

items.src: Before the tour, the guide gives a summary of the sculptor's career, leaving evaluation, a dated sequence and a full life story to books.
items.para: Books supply a critique, a chronology and a full biography of the sculptor; the guide provides only a career overview before the tour.
items.note: 都指概括主要内容的简要介绍。

items.src: Beginners can rent inexpensive climbing gear from the club instead of buying top-quality equipment or used items that cost more than they should.
items.para: Rather than purchasing premium equipment or overpriced second-hand items, beginners can hire low-cost climbing gear from the club.
items.note: 都表示价格低廉，不表示质量差或二手。

items.src: A rural clinic employs an agent to negotiate medicine purchases with a vendor, while a delivery worker transports orders to each buyer.
items.para: While a courier takes medicine orders to each customer, a rural clinic hires a representative to negotiate purchases with a supplier.
items.note: 此处都指受雇代表诊所洽谈采购的人。

items.src: Fishing boats now use the city's old port, while freighters use a cargo facility, yachts a leisure basin, and damaged vessels a repair yard.
items.para: Freighters use the terminal, yachts the marina and damaged vessels the shipyard, whereas fishing boats now use the city's old harbour.
items.note: 此处都指供渔船停泊作业的港口。

items.src: Unlike dependable, speedy but simple programs with fixed exercises, our intelligent tutoring software detects individual errors and automatically chooses suitable practice.
items.para: Our smart tutoring software identifies individual mistakes and automatically selects appropriate practice, unlike reliable, fast but basic programs offering fixed exercises.
items.note: 此处都表示软件能分析错误并智能选择练习。

items.src: After searching for jobs, former factory workers entered a council scheme offering paid employment rather than volunteering or training for trades.
items.para: Following job hunting, former factory workers joined a council scheme offering paid work rather than voluntary work or vocational training.
items.note: 两者都指有报酬的工作。

items.src: Leila packs suncream to protect her skin outdoors, alongside a hydrating skin product, a bar of soap and hair cleanser.
items.para: Alongside moisturiser, a bar of soap and shampoo, Leila packs sunscreen to shield her skin when she goes outside.
items.note: 此处两者都指保护皮肤的防晒霜。

items.src: Engineers developed a waterproof sensor case that also protects against impacts and high temperatures but does not fully exclude dust.
items.para: Although not dustproof, the sensor housing developed by engineers is watertight, shockproof and heatproof.
items.note: 两者都表示不透水、能阻止水进入。

items.src: Coastal residents supply birdsong recordings for our wildlife programme, while producers alter the audio, keep copies and transmit the finished material.
items.para: Our wildlife producers edit, store and broadcast birdsong recordings that coastal residents provide for the programme.
items.note: 此处两者都指为节目提供录音素材。

items.src: Arithmetic contestants must multiply in the final round, after rounds in which they add, subtract and divide, without using calculators.
items.para: Without calculators, arithmetic contestants must calculate sums, calculate differences and calculate quotients in earlier rounds, then calculate products in the final round.
items.note: 做乘法就是计算乘积。

items.src: Garden volunteers collect fallen branches, separate them by size and chop them into small pieces before stacking them for faster decay.
items.para: To speed decay, garden volunteers gather up fallen branches, sort them by size and cut up the wood into small pieces before they pile up everything.
items.note: 此处两者都指把树枝切成小块。

items.src: Ana's diary describes sadness at leaving her relatives, worry about the journey, thankfulness for their hospitality and eagerness to return home.
items.para: Alongside anxiety about travelling, gratitude for her relatives' hospitality and excitement about returning home, Ana records sorrow at leaving them in her diary.
items.note: 此处两者都指与亲戚离别时的悲伤。

items.src: Nineteenth-century visitors arriving by rail could hire a horse-drawn cab to the royal gardens instead of taking a ferry or public coach.
items.para: Instead of a ferry or omnibus, nineteenth-century visitors arriving by train could hire a horse-drawn taxi to the royal gardens.
items.note: 此处都指出租载客的马车。

items.src: Older readers can concentrate better in the centre's quiet room, while its lounge lets them unwind, recall past experiences or drift into fantasies.
items.para: The centre's lounge allows older readers to relax, reminisce or daydream, whereas its quiet room helps them focus better on reading.
items.note: 此处两者都指集中注意力阅读。

items.src: Although the guide found the ravine dark and depressing, its bridge unremarkable and its huts ugly, she called the frozen waterfall gorgeous.
items.para: The guide described the frozen waterfall as stunning, despite judging the surrounding ravine gloomy, its bridge ordinary and its huts unattractive.
items.note: 此处两者都表示景色美得令人惊叹。

items.src: The keeper feeds each starfish before checking the sea urchin, then examines the sea cucumber beside the brittle star.
items.para: Before inspecting the sea urchin, the keeper feeds each sea star, then examines the sea cucumber next to the brittle star.
items.note: 两者都指海星，而非其他相似海洋动物。

items.src: Bakery sales showed incredible growth after years of consistent, limited and easily anticipated increases, the market analyst reported.
items.para: The analyst reported that years of steady, modest and predictable increases in bakery sales had given way to amazing growth.
items.note: 此处都表示增长惊人、令人惊叹。

items.src: Caring for her brother was Amina's responsibility, not something she chose, but she considered it an honour rather than an imposition.
items.para: Amina saw caring for her brother as a privilege rather than a burden, although it was her duty, not her choice.
items.note: 此处指必须承担的职责，而非自主选择。

items.src: Researchers found that the beetle's shiny wing covers reflected more light than its lustreless legs, which had uneven surfaces and raised lines.
items.para: Researchers found the beetle's dull legs, with their rough, ridged surfaces, reflected less light than its glossy wing covers.
items.note: 此处都指表面有光泽、能反光。

items.src: Kenji placed a giant wooden fish beside a tiny boat and a space-saving lighthouse model with a narrow tower.
items.para: Beside a miniature boat and a compact lighthouse model with a slender tower, Kenji placed an enormous wooden fish.
items.note: 此处都表示物体体积巨大。

items.src: An excited scream from the youngest runner followed a spectator's encouraging shout, a teammate's sharp intake of breath and the coach's low moan.
items.para: After a spectator's cheer, a teammate's gasp and the coach's groan, the youngest runner let out an excited shriek.
items.note: 两者都指尖锐响亮的叫声。

items.src: The trial found this medicine's powerful effect contrasted with another treatment's gentle, short-lived effect, although both treatments worked slowly.
items.para: The trial found both treatments had a gradual effect, but this medicine's effect was strong while the other's was mild and brief.
items.note: 此处都指药物作用强，而非起效快。

items.src: The square's speakers broadcast poetry instead of ordinary prose writing or theatrical works, with explanatory remarks following each reading.
items.para: Rather than prose or drama, verse is broadcast through the square's speakers, and commentary follows each reading.
items.note: 此处都指诗歌这种文学形式。

items.src: The tutor called skipping safety training foolish, explaining that attending was prudent and careful, even though participation was not compulsory.
items.para: Although attendance was optional, the tutor described attending safety training as sensible and cautious, and skipping it as unwise.
items.note: 此处都表示不明智、缺乏判断力。

items.src: Visitors must put each coat on a hanger rather than a hook attached to the wall, a rail of wood or a shelf.
items.para: Rather than using a wall-mounted hook, wooden rail or storage shelf, visitors must place each coat on a shoulder-shaped frame.
items.note: 此处指托住衣服肩部的衣架。

items.src: Meera replaced the wooden bead beside her pendant, but left its central jewel and the necklace's silver fastening untouched.
items.para: The pendant's central gem and the necklace's silver clasp remained untouched when Meera replaced the wooden bead beside the hanging ornament.
items.note: 此处指镶嵌的宝石，而非整件饰物。

items.src: Beside a seabed diagram and a navigation map, the display shows a camera image above a chart recording water depth.
items.para: A camera picture appears above a depth chart on the display, with a seabed diagram and a navigation map beside it.
items.note: 此处指相机拍摄的图像。

items.src: The station's target of five hundred new listeners exceeds its predicted total but remains below both its permitted maximum and previous record.
items.para: Although below both its limit and previous record, the station's goal of five hundred new listeners is higher than its forecast.
items.note: 指希望达到的目标，不是预测或上限。

items.src: After posing a question and offering a clue, the tutor waited for Amina's response before explaining the puzzle's solution.
items.para: The tutor's explanation of the puzzle's solution followed Amina's answer to a question for which the tutor had supplied a hint.
items.note: 此处指对导师所提问题的回答。

items.src: Unlike plastic bags, seaweed bags decay within weeks alongside shells, irrespective of sunlight, rather than remaining intact.
items.para: Together with shells, seaweed bags decay within weeks in contrast to plastic bags, regardless of sunlight, instead of remaining intact.
items.note: 用于对比，表示与塑料袋不同。

items.src: Mountain guides use their summer income to cover business costs, increase their saved funds and repay outstanding loans before winter arrives.
items.para: Before winter arrives, mountain guides cover business expenses, add to their savings and repay debts using their summer earnings.
items.note: 此处指向导通过工作获得的收入。

items.src: Excavations suggest that residents cooked outdoors, ate inside their homes, stored grain below ground and slept on an upper floor.
items.para: Residents apparently ate indoors and slept upstairs, but cooked outside and stored grain underground, as evidence from excavations suggests.
items.note: 指在户外，与室内或地下等位置相区别。

items.src: Tomas distinguished his nightmare about trains from an enjoyable fantasy, a memory from childhood and a fear he experienced while awake.
items.para: Neither a pleasant fantasy nor a childhood memory, Tomas's frightening dream about trains was also distinct from his waking fear.
items.note: 指睡眠中令人恐惧的梦，不是清醒时的恐惧。

items.src: Researchers wear woollen underwear beneath their knitted pullovers, with waterproof coats and insulated hand coverings providing further protection against the coastal cold.
items.para: Waterproof jackets and insulated gloves provide extra protection against coastal cold for researchers wearing knitted sweaters over woollen undergarments.
items.note: 指穿在外层衣物里面的内衣。

items.src: New employees leave the entrance crowd to join a queue for passes, then form a circle for instructions before departing in twos.
items.para: After leaving the entrance crowd, new employees wait in a line for passes, gather in a circle for instructions, then depart in pairs.
items.note: 此处指依次等候领取通行证的队伍。

items.src: Island bakeries welcomed a decrease in shipping costs after months of rising prices and unpredictable changes, hoping charges would then remain steady.
items.para: After months of increase and unpredictable fluctuation in shipping costs, island bakeries welcomed a decline and hoped for stability.
items.note: 两者均指数量或费用的下降。

items.src: Maya's encouraging comment about my singing eased my anxiety more than her enquiry, her directions, or her pledge to help.
items.para: My anxiety eased most after Maya's encouraging remark about my singing, rather than her question, instruction, or promise of help.
items.note: 两者在此均指对歌唱表现作出的评价。

items.src: Researchers assessed the risk of an explosion rather than its seriousness or origin, stressing that an accident was not inevitable.
items.para: Rather than its severity or cause, researchers assessed the danger of an explosion, stressing that an accident was not a certainty.
items.note: 两者在此均指爆炸发生的危险。

items.src: Although the painter's brother was handsome, the portrait made him appear less stylish, less powerfully built, and older than he really was.
items.para: The portrait made the painter's good-looking brother seem less elegant, less muscular, and less youthful than he actually was.
items.note: 两者均形容男子外貌英俊。

items.src: The swimming coach changed the training schedule without altering how long sessions lasted, how often they occurred, or how demanding they were.
items.para: Although session duration, frequency, and intensity remained unchanged, the swimming coach revised the training timetable.
items.note: 两者均指训练活动的时间安排。

items.src: The pharmacist corrected an address error to avoid holding up delivery, prompting a customer to complain, or causing the order to be cancelled.
items.para: To prevent a delivery delay, a customer complaint, or an order cancellation, the pharmacist corrected a mistake in the address.
items.note: 两者均指地址中需要纠正的差错。

items.src: An eighty-storey office skyscraper stands beside a building containing apartments and a retail complex, opposite a building used for storage.
items.para: Opposite a warehouse, an eighty-storey office high-rise stands beside an apartment block and a shopping centre.
items.note: 此处八十层的高层大楼即摩天大楼。

items.src: Adult learners blamed tiredness for their poor afternoon recall, although they were interested in the lesson, felt calm, and had eaten enough.
items.para: Despite having no boredom, anxiety, or hunger, adult learners recalled little that afternoon and blamed fatigue.
items.note: 两者均指需要休息的疲劳状态。

items.src: Residents found the introduction a little unclear, the examples somewhat helpful, and the layout reasonably neat, but the housing application questions terribly confusing.
items.para: Housing application questions were extremely confusing to residents, although the introduction was slightly unclear, examples moderately helpful, and layout fairly neat.
items.note: 两者在此均表示程度极高。

items.src: Amir is a follower of the repair movement, but he neither established nor directs it, and he does not speak against it.
items.para: Neither a founder nor a leader of the repair movement, Amir is a supporter rather than a critic.
items.note: 两者在此均指某项运动的拥护者。

items.src: Technicians first examine damaged cables, then mend them with conductive gel if possible, substituting new ones only when they must throw the originals away.
items.para: After they inspect damaged cables, technicians repair them with conductive gel where possible; otherwise, they replace the cables and discard the originals.
items.note: 两者都指修复损坏的物品。

items.src: Authentic recordings are the series' main attraction; free access is a small advantage, excessive length its greatest weakness, and education its primary aim.
items.para: The series' central purpose is education; its chief appeal is authentic recordings, its minor benefit free access, and its greatest drawback excessive length.
items.note: 两者都指最主要的吸引力。

items.src: Volunteers must register their names on the official list, verify their details, amend any errors, and affirm everything is accurate before the experiment starts.
items.para: Before the experiment begins, volunteers must record their names on the official list, check their details, correct any errors, and confirm everything is accurate.
items.note: 此处两者都指在正式名单上登记。

items.src: Tomorrow's beach survey requires collectors to choose a label, number it, and attach it to each waste bag after taking off any old label.
items.para: For tomorrow's beach survey, collectors must remove any old label from each waste bag, select a new one, mark it with a number, and fasten it.
items.note: 两者都指把标签固定到袋子上。

items.src: Ferry passengers must assemble at the eastern terminal, embark there, depart at midnight, and come back to that terminal the next morning.
items.para: After passengers gather at the eastern terminal and board the ferry there, they must leave at midnight and return to that terminal the following morning.
items.note: 此处两者都指启程离开。

items.src: New household accounts improved historians' understanding of medieval finance, increased their interest and certainty, and reduced their bewilderment about conflicting evidence.
items.para: Conflicting evidence caused historians less confusion after new household accounts improved their knowledge of medieval finance and increased both their curiosity and confidence.
items.note: 此处两者都指对中世纪财务的认识。

items.src: Residents have the option of communal dining without any duty to participate, although some prefer company and plan to attend.
items.para: Despite some residents' preference for company and intention to attend, communal dining remains a choice rather than an obligation.
items.note: 两者都表示可以自主选择的机会。

items.src: Walkers must use the pavement beside the woodland road, not the bicycle lane or vehicle carriageway, to protect rare plants on the grassy roadside strip.
items.para: To protect rare plants on the verge beside the woodland road, walkers must use the sidewalk rather than the cycle lane or roadway.
items.note: 此处两者都指道路旁的人行道。

items.src: The manager called the apprentices' final joints marvelous, contrasting them with satisfactory early sketches, inconsistent carving, and badly executed initial assembly.
items.para: Although the apprentices' early sketches were adequate, their carving uneven, and their initial assembly poor, the manager judged their final joints excellent.
items.note: 两者都表示极其出色，而非仅仅合格。

items.src: For bakery loans, a detailed plan is a requirement, not merely advice; experience helps, but neither ensures approval.
items.para: Experience offers an advantage when bakeries seek loans; a detailed plan is a prerequisite, not a recommendation, and neither provides a guarantee of approval.
items.note: 此处两者都指必须满足的先决条件。

items.src: Rapid breathing made the anxious workshop participants dizzy and short of breath, while the worried instructor felt completely worn out.
items.para: The tense instructor felt exhausted, while anxious workshop participants became light-headed and breathless because they were breathing rapidly.
items.note: 此处均指呼吸过快引起的头晕。

items.src: The supervisor distinguished cheating in the science contest from accidental mistakes, legitimate teamwork and a strong desire to win.
items.para: Unintentional errors, fair cooperation and competitive ambition were distinguished by the supervisor from dishonest rule-breaking in the science competition.
items.note: 此处指竞赛中为获利而不诚实地违规。

items.src: Preparing costumes for three simultaneous productions caused designers considerable stress and bodily tiredness, despite their artistic fulfilment and pride in their work.
items.para: Despite creative satisfaction and personal pride, designers experienced considerable mental strain and physical fatigue from preparing costumes for three productions simultaneously.
items.note: 此处均指工作造成的精神压力。

items.src: Monday's practice saw the captain absent for physiotherapy, the goalkeeper arriving after the start, and defenders arriving punctually or ahead of schedule.
items.para: The goalkeeper was late and defenders were on time or early for Monday's practice, but the captain was not present because of physiotherapy.
items.note: 此处均表示没有到场参加训练。

items.src: For this workout, adequate water is essential, stretching helps, music is a matter of choice, and supplements are not needed.
items.para: Music is optional and stretching beneficial for this workout, whereas adequate water is vital and supplements are unnecessary.
items.note: 均表示必不可少，而非仅仅有益。

items.src: Residents frustrated by the closure were delighted when the gardens reopened, although worried gardeners seemed astonished by the announcement.
items.para: Although anxious gardeners seemed amazed by the announcement, residents previously frustrated by the closure were thrilled when the gardens opened again.
items.note: 此处均表示花园重开带来的极大喜悦。

items.src: The technician connected a microphone to the recorder to capture speech, positioned a camera for filming, and tested a speaker for playback.
items.para: With a mike connected to the audio recorder for speech capture, the technician positioned a video camera for filming and tested a loudspeaker for playback.
items.note: 后者是麦克风的口语名称，两者指同一设备。

items.src: The council hired a magician rather than a performer of juggling tricks, comedy routines or acrobatics to entertain families at the opening.
items.para: To entertain families at the opening, the council chose an illusionist instead of a juggler, comedian or acrobat.
items.note: 此处均指以魔术戏法娱乐观众的表演者。

items.src: Meal planning produced major savings, unlike the small reductions from coupons, insignificant gains from loyalty points and medium savings from switching shops.
items.para: Coupons produced modest reductions, loyalty points negligible gains and switching shops moderate savings, whereas meal planning generated substantial savings.
items.note: 此处均表示节省的幅度很大。

items.src: Visitors had an opportunity to operate the exhibition's robot, but no duty or guaranteed right to participate; some had no plans to try.
items.para: Despite having no obligation or guaranteed entitlement to operate the exhibition's robot, visitors had a chance to try, although some had no intention of participating.
items.note: 此处指可以尝试操作机器人的机会。

items.src: Editors use independent checks to identify, amend, and communicate false health claims and to prevent their publication in the magazine.
items.para: To stop false health claims reaching print, magazine editors use independent checks to detect, correct, and report them.
items.note: 这里指阻止虚假健康信息被刊登。

items.src: Initially nervous but sure of his solution, Ravi became mad when his partner dismissed it, leaving their observer feeling let down.
items.para: His partner's dismissal made Ravi angry and their observer disappointed, although Ravi had initially been anxious yet confident about his solution.
items.note: 这里表示因方案被否定而生气，未必暴怒。

items.src: After questioning at a police station, the factory owner appeared before a judge and was sent to jail, not an immigration holding facility.
items.para: The factory owner was sent to prison, not an immigration detention centre, after questioning at a police station and an appearance in court.
items.note: 此处两者均指关押人的监狱。

items.src: Campers considered isolation a positive feature, missing drinking water a disadvantage, storms a potential danger, and arranging transport their most urgent task.
items.para: For campers, transport arrangements were the priority, while isolation was a benefit, absent drinking water a drawback, and storms a risk.
items.note: 指缺少饮用水这一不利之处。

items.src: Experts considered the coin genuine, but its distinctive, little-known design was familiar to Mira from an earlier excavation.
items.para: Mira found the coin's distinctive but obscure design recognisable from a previous excavation, although experts regarded the coin as authentic.
items.note: 因先前见过而熟悉，能够认出。

items.src: Residents found the festival marvellous despite its disorganised opening, whereas last year's event had seemed unremarkable and failed to meet expectations.
items.para: Unlike last year's ordinary and disappointing event, this year's festival was wonderful in residents' eyes, despite a chaotic opening.
items.note: 表示居民认为节日活动极好。

items.src: Foxes retreat underground; similarly, lizards enter burrows, while camels simultaneously avoid sunlight, choosing shade as an alternative and thus preventing overheating.
items.para: Camels avoid sunlight, choosing shade instead and therefore preventing overheating; meanwhile, foxes retreat underground, and lizards likewise enter burrows.
items.note: 引出蜥蜴与狐狸相似的避暑行为。

items.src: The studio manager wanted fashionable uniforms that would also suit official occasions, resist wear, and feel pleasant throughout long shifts.
items.para: Besides being formal and durable, the uniforms the studio manager wanted needed to be comfortable throughout long shifts and trendy.
items.note: 指服装符合当下流行趋势，时髦。

items.src: Consultants advise bakers to build emergency savings, while lenders insist on insurance, allow early repayments, and prohibit borrowing beyond agreed limits.
items.para: Lenders require insurance, permit early repayments, and forbid borrowing beyond agreed limits, whereas consultants recommend that bakers build emergency savings.
items.note: 指建议面包师采取储备应急资金的行动。

items.src: Leila initially expected and secretly wished for friendship, but the reality of joining the choir was less frightening than her weeks of fear suggested.
items.para: Despite initial expectations and private hopes of friendship, Leila had prolonged fears for weeks before joining the choir; the actual experience proved less frightening.
items.note: 指实际加入合唱团的经历，而非事前想象。

items.src: The lecturer explained dolphin calls using recordings collected by a research helper, processed by a laboratory worker, and selected by a visiting student.
items.para: Recordings collected by a research assistant, processed by a laboratory technician and selected by a visiting student helped the university instructor explain dolphin calls.
items.note: 此处指在大学授课的教师。

items.src: The potter said her lifestyle changed after moving, although her material comfort, earnings source, and residential address remained unchanged after that initial move.
items.para: The potter's standard of living, source of income and place of residence stayed unchanged after her initial move, although her way of life changed.
items.note: 指整体生活方式，而非收入或居住地点。

items.src: Boxing officials weigh competitors, note newcomers' heights, and confirm finalists' identities before permitting anyone to compete.
items.para: Before boxing officials give clearance to compete, they determine the mass of competitors, record the height of newcomers and verify the identity of finalists.
items.note: 指测定参赛者的体重。

items.src: Clinic appointments are limited because just one specialist works there, but patients find their timing adaptable, their prices manageable, and their duration substantial.
items.para: Patients find clinic appointments flexible, affordable and lengthy, but their number is restricted because the clinic employs only one specialist.
items.note: 此处指预约名额数量受到限制。

items.src: The gallery uses direct sunlight through uncovered windows by day, electric lamps after dusk, and mirror reflections, while excluding illumination from the moon.
items.para: While excluding moonlight, the gallery uses direct daylight through uncovered windows by day, artificial lighting after dusk, and reflected light from mirrors.
items.note: 此处指从窗户直接照入的日光。

items.src: Science fair winner Amina received a silver trophy and money; every entrant received a printed certificate, while the runner-up received a bronze medal.
items.para: Every science fair entrant received a printed certificate; winner Amina received a silver prize cup and cash award, while the runner-up received a bronze medal.
items.note: 此处指作为获胜奖品颁发的奖杯。

items.src: Flood volunteers deserve recognition for protecting residents, although they neither pursue nor anticipate praise and rarely obtain any public thanks.
items.para: Flood volunteers neither seek nor expect praise and rarely receive public thanks, although they merit recognition for keeping residents safe.
items.note: 指因保护居民的付出而应得认可。

items.src: Walking groups can improve mental wellbeing and bodily fitness while encouraging interpersonal connections, without requiring participants to make any monetary contribution.
items.para: Without requiring any financial contribution, walking groups can encourage social connections while improving psychological wellbeing and physical fitness.
items.note: 指心理方面的，与身体或经济方面有别。

items.src: Technicians recommend backing up photographs, insist on password protection, allow personal storage devices, and urge users not to share their accounts.
items.para: Technicians require password protection and permit personal storage devices; they also advise backing up photographs but discourage sharing accounts.
items.note: 表示建议采取某行动，而非强制要求。

items.src: The programme opens with a welcome and pauses midway; its final section contains interviews with coastal musicians followed by a recap.
items.para: After an introduction and a midway interval, the programme's final part features interviews with coastal musicians followed by a summary.
items.note: 此处指节目中包含访谈的一个部分。

items.src: Lena confirmed her hotel booking after paying, but later requested its cancellation and asked for her money back.
items.para: After making a payment, Lena confirmed her hotel reservation; she subsequently requested a cancellation and a refund.
items.note: 两者都指酒店预订。

items.src: A fisherman using a rod watched a seaman help an underwater swimmer ashore while a lifeguard waited nearby.
items.para: While a lifeguard waited nearby, an angler watched a sailor help a diver reach the shore.
items.note: 此处明确用钓竿捕鱼，指垂钓者。

items.src: Our expedition was unforgettable and pleasant to remember, although recalling details was difficult and confusing it with other trips was easy.
items.para: Our expedition was impossible to erase from memory but difficult to recall in detail, easy to confuse with others, and pleasant to think back on.
items.note: 两者都表示无法从记忆中抹去。

items.src: Theatre managers arrange dates and advertise new shows with posters, while actors practise them before performing them publicly.
items.para: Actors rehearse new shows before they stage them publicly, while theatre managers schedule the productions and promote them through posters.
items.note: 此处都指通过海报宣传演出。

items.src: Friendship was a benefit of the cooking club, although noise was a disadvantage, injuries were possible, and membership required payment.
items.para: The cooking club involved a cost and a risk of injury; noise was a drawback, but friendship was an advantage.
items.note: 两者都指参加活动带来的好处。

items.src: Visitors found the palace impressive rather than commonplace, while also noting its visually appealing interior and useful layout.
items.para: Besides noting its attractive interior and practical layout, visitors considered the palace remarkable rather than ordinary.
items.note: 此处都表示宫殿令人赞叹。

items.src: The costume workshop had plenty of fabric but few needles, too little thread, and more ribbon than it needed.
items.para: Despite limited needles and insufficient thread, the costume workshop held ample fabric and excessive ribbon.
items.note: 两者在此都表示布料数量充足。

items.src: Customers praised the market's variety and the excellence of its goods, but criticised limited stock and prices beyond their budgets.
items.para: Despite complaints about insufficient quantity and poor affordability, customers praised the market's diversity and the quality of its goods.
items.note: 两者都指市场所售商品的多样性。

items.src: Patients must chew food thoroughly before swallowing it, even when they cannot detect flavours, to help their bodies break it down.
items.para: Even patients unable to taste food must masticate it thoroughly before they swallow it, helping their bodies digest it.
items.note: 两者都指用牙齿咀嚼食物。

items.src: The report stated the experiment's purpose before describing its procedure and findings, then acknowledged a weakness in the study.
items.para: Before discussing the method and results, the report explained the experiment's aim; it subsequently acknowledged a limitation.
items.note: 两者都指实验希望达成的目标。

items.src: The exhibition examines river pollution from textile dyes rather than bank erosion, while a separate gallery covers floods and prolonged dry spells.
items.para: Rather than erosion, river contamination caused by textile dyes is examined in the exhibition, with flooding and drought covered in a separate gallery.
items.note: 此处均指染料造成的河水污染。

items.src: Sunday's runners must pass the curve, pedestrian crossing and traffic circle before turning left at the junction beside the stadium.
items.para: For Sunday's runners, the required left turn is at the intersection beside the stadium, after passing the bend, pedestrian crossing and roundabout.
items.note: 此处均指道路相交的路口。

items.src: Following a questionnaire study, a pilot test and a formal check, the clinic launched a vaccination campaign to attract more parents.
items.para: To attract more parents, the clinic began a vaccination drive after completing a survey, a trial and an inspection.
items.note: 此处均指有组织的疫苗接种推广活动。

items.src: Residents were initially worried but optimistic about saving their cinema; after planners ignored their objections, they remained bitter rather than accepting the outcome.
items.para: Initially anxious but hopeful about saving their cinema, residents remained resentful rather than resigned after planners disregarded their objections.
items.note: 此处均指因意见遭无视而心怀怨愤。

items.src: Learners begin by studying an individual world, then its planetary system and its galaxy, before examining how the universe has expanded.
items.para: Before examining the expansion of the cosmos, learners study a planet, then its solar system and finally the galaxy containing it.
items.note: 两者均指包含全部空间与天体的宇宙。

items.src: Helicopter crews had to find and calm villagers stranded by flooding, then rescue them from rooftops before medics could provide treatment.
items.para: Before medics could treat villagers stranded by flooding, helicopter crews had to locate and reassure them, then save them from rooftops.
items.note: 此处均指将受困村民救离险境。

items.src: Mina sanded the dry, pressure-resistant shelf until its surface was smooth, though it would remain dull unless varnished.
items.para: The shelf, dry to touch and hard under pressure, became free from roughness through Mina's sanding but would stay dull without varnish.
items.note: 此处指打磨后表面质地平滑、没有粗糙感。

items.src: Because signals could disrupt testing, the laboratory would ban wireless devices rather than allow them, limit their use or merely advise against them.
items.para: Rather than permit wireless devices, restrict their use or merely discourage them, the laboratory would prohibit them because their signals could disrupt testing.
items.note: 两者均指正式禁止，而非限制或劝阻。

items.src: A plumber replaced the leaking supply tube beneath the basin, then checked the tap and cleared the blocked wastewater outlet.
items.para: After replacing the leaking pipe beneath the sink, a plumber checked the faucet before clearing the blocked drain.
items.note: 两者均指控制出水的水龙头。

items.src: The lecturer described questioning assumptions as protection against financial errors, not merely an alert, a correction after failure or an assurance of success.
items.para: Questioning assumptions, the lecturer explained, offers a safeguard against financial errors, not merely a warning, a remedy after failure or a guarantee of success.
items.note: 此处均指帮助防范财务错误的保护措施。

items.src: Footage of displaced families stirred pity rather than indignation or fright among viewers, whose distress later eased when emergency housing arrived.
items.para: Viewers felt sympathy, not anger or fear, after watching footage of displaced families; the subsequent arrival of emergency housing brought relief.
items.note: 此处指对受灾家庭的同情。

items.src: Mara placed a bunch of grapes beside some loosely heaped apples, with pears lined up behind and plums covering the tray beneath.
items.para: Above a layer of plums covering the tray, Mara set a cluster of grapes beside a pile of apples, ahead of a row of pears.
items.note: 此处指连在一起的一串葡萄。

items.src: Medieval merchants considered travelling together sensible, travelling alone dangerous, hiring guards expensive, and carrying extra weapons needless on this route.
items.para: For this route, medieval traders judged solo travel risky and guards costly; group travel was wise, while extra weapons were unnecessary.
items.note: 此处表示做法明智、合乎实际。

items.src: Similar venue names confuse newcomers, while friendly greetings ease their worries, long queues irritate them, and high fees deter them from returning.
items.para: Friendly greetings reassure newcomers, but similar venue names puzzle them; long queues annoy them, and high fees discourage them from returning.
items.note: 此处指使新来者困惑、弄不明白。

items.src: An athlete asked her trainer about the revised race route while an official enforcing the rules explained the change to a watching fan.
items.para: A referee explained the revised race route to a spectator while a sportsperson questioned her coach about it.
items.note: 此处指参加体育运动的运动员。

items.src: Rain flooded the cellar storeroom and winds threatened the roof terrace, so potters moved their outdoor demonstrations into the building's enclosed exhibition hall.
items.para: With underground storage flooded and the rooftop terrace unsafe from wind, potters transferred their open-air demonstrations to an indoor exhibition hall.
items.note: 两者在此均表示演示活动原本在露天环境中进行。

items.src: Analysts found rising umbrella sales during drought curious rather than expected, but considered the figures believable rather than deceptive.
items.para: Although analysts considered the figures plausible rather than misleading, they found rising umbrella sales during drought strange rather than predictable.
items.note: 此处表示现象奇怪、不同寻常。

items.src: Amira wrote nightly to her sweetheart abroad, but contacted a close companion, a family member, and a workmate only once a month.
items.para: Amira contacted a close friend, a relative, and a colleague only monthly, whereas she wrote to her beloved overseas every night.
items.note: 此处指有恋爱关系的爱人。

items.src: Researchers preferred the station's cosy reading room to its cold laboratory, windy corridor, and poorly ventilated office when relaxing after work.
items.para: After work, researchers favoured the station's snug reading room over its chilly laboratory, draughty corridor, and stuffy office for relaxation.
items.note: 此处表示房间温暖舒适。

items.src: The theatre raised each assistant's weekly wage but left their annual reward, travel subsidy, and retirement income unchanged.
items.para: Each theatre assistant's annual bonus, travel allowance, and pension remained unchanged, although their weekly pay increased.
items.note: 此处指每周定期领取的工资。

items.src: The guide said cannon fire would scare visitors, not merely irritate or excite them, so staff would need to ease their fears.
items.para: Staff would need to reassure visitors because, the guide said, cannon fire would frighten them rather than merely annoy or excite them.
items.note: 两者都表示使人感到害怕。

items.src: Slow progress might disappoint patients expecting instant recovery, although therapists could soothe them, lift their spirits and encourage further effort.
items.para: Therapists could calm down, cheer up and motivate patients expecting immediate recovery, although slow progress might let down those patients.
items.note: 两者都指未达到期待而使人失望。

items.src: Residents were annoyed by overnight advertising lights, anxious about sleep and taken aback by the brightness, but their distress eased when screens went dark.
items.para: When advertising screens finally went dark, residents felt relieved; overnight illumination had left them irritated by the lights, worried about sleep and surprised by the brightness.
items.note: 两者都指受到滋扰而感到恼怒。

items.src: Research into bilingual mathematics teaching prompted staff to debate differing views and consequently suggest a classroom experiment, which the college then conducted.
items.para: A staff debate followed the study of bilingual mathematics teaching, leading to a proposal for a classroom trial that the college subsequently conducted.
items.note: 此处两者都指对教学方法的系统研究。

items.src: The college converted an unused dormitory into leased workspaces for extra income, while keeping employee flats and a classroom building unchanged.
items.para: Staff apartments and a teaching block remained unchanged while the college turned an empty student residence into rental offices to earn additional income.
items.note: 此处两者都指供学生居住的宿舍楼。

items.src: Hana found carrying groceries upstairs tiring and cumbersome, but unlike waiting in queues or lifting heavy furniture, it was neither boring nor painful.
items.para: Hana found carrying groceries upstairs fatiguing and awkward, but neither tedious like queueing nor painful like lifting heavy furniture.
items.note: 两者都表示使人疲倦，不强调筋疲力尽。

items.src: Engineers established a relation between heat and battery failure, rejected chance, and noted matching casing designs but contrasting battery sizes.
items.para: Besides a similarity in casing design and a difference in battery size, engineers established a link between heat and battery failure, ruling out coincidence.
items.note: 此处两者都指两个现象之间的联系。

items.src: A newspaper seller thanked a regular buyer while the stock provider and delivery agent unloaded bundles beside his roadside stall.
items.para: As the supplier and distributor unloaded newspaper bundles beside the roadside stall, its vendor thanked a regular customer.
items.note: 此处两者都指售卖报纸的人。

items.src: Her teammates felt anxious and thrilled, but controlled breathing kept the goalkeeper calm before the penalty, although she lacked confidence in success.
items.para: Before the penalty, controlled breathing kept the goalkeeper composed but not confident of success, whereas her teammates were nervous and excited.
items.note: 两者都指面对压力时保持镇静。

items.src: Finding rubbish across the restored wetland left Mei depressed, not mildly anxious or furious, although she retained guarded optimism about another cleanup.
items.para: Mei remained cautiously hopeful about another cleanup, but rubbish across the restored wetland made her deeply unhappy rather than slightly worried or very angry.
items.note: 此处两者都指十分沮丧，并非临床诊断。

items.src: The writer found the cliff tour brilliant, although the transport was merely adequate, the lunch unremarkable and the souvenir shop a disappointment.
items.para: Although transport was only acceptable, lunch ordinary and the souvenir shop disappointing, the writer judged the cliff tour excellent.
items.note: 此处表示极好的，是高度肯定的评价。

items.src: Mill workers organised a protest for shorter hours after their written appeal failed, choosing public action over talks or stopping work.
items.para: After their petition failed, mill workers chose a demonstration for shorter hours rather than negotiation or a strike.
items.note: 此处指为表达诉求而举行的公开抗议活动。

items.src: Each prisoner may receive a guest in the jail classroom while an officer watches, but the jail director must approve every visit.
items.para: With the warden's approval, each inmate may meet a visitor in the jail classroom under a guard's supervision.
items.note: 此处两者都指监狱中被关押的人。

items.src: Tall reeds surround the pond, while paths run across the meadow, hedges split the orchard and vegetable plots lie beside the garden.
items.para: Paths cross the meadow and hedges divide the orchard; tall reeds encircle the pond, while vegetable plots adjoin the garden.
items.note: 两者都表示从四周围住某处。

items.src: Vineyard managers seek seasonal workers, teach them harvesting skills and give them wages because they rely on them to gather grapes before frost.
items.para: Because vineyard managers depend on seasonal workers to harvest grapes before frost, they look for suitable people, train them and pay them.
items.note: 两者都表示依赖他人完成某事。

items.src: After charging traders twice, the manager agreed to apologize, clarify the error and return their money rather than claim he was not responsible.
items.para: Rather than deny responsibility for charging traders twice, the manager agreed to explain the error, say sorry and issue refunds.
items.note: 两者都表示向他人道歉。

items.src: Participants had to arrange cards by colour and determine their number before they could transfer them between boxes without mixing their order.
items.para: Before participants could move cards between boxes, they had to sort them by colour and count them, but could not shuffle them.
items.note: 此处表示把卡片从一个盒子移到另一个。

items.src: A blue dot marks midnight temperatures on the chart, while a broken line, tinted strip and red X indicate other measurements.
items.para: Other measurements appear as a dashed line, shaded band and red cross; midnight temperatures are indicated by a blue spot on the chart.
items.note: 此处指图表中表示测量值的小圆点。

items.src: Gallery records showed steady growth in attendance after months of falling numbers, followed by uneven changes and finally a period without change.
items.para: Following months of decline, gallery attendance records showed a steady increase, then fluctuation and finally stability.
items.note: 此处两者都表示参观人数的增长。

items.src: The retired swimmer gave some tips and a caution before sharing a tale of her first victory, then responded to an enquiry.
items.para: After offering advice and a warning, the retired swimmer shared a story about her first victory before answering a question.
items.note: 此处指对个人获胜经历的讲述。

items.src: The clinic previously offered individual appointments alone; groups run currently, weekend sessions will begin shortly, and home visits will follow afterwards.
items.para: Groups run now at the clinic, which formerly offered only individual appointments; weekend sessions will start soon, with home visits following later.
items.note: 两者都表示以前，与现在或将来相对。

items.src: The previous city architect designed the library; her present successor employs an interim assistant while training the next architect.
items.para: The current city architect employs a temporary assistant and trains the future architect, whereas the former city architect designed the library.
items.note: 此处都指以前担任该职位的。

items.src: Volunteer tutors greet arriving learners personally, teach them basic phrases, evaluate their pronunciation, and finally dismiss them after the evening lesson.
items.para: Before volunteer tutors instruct learners in basic phrases, assess their pronunciation and finally dismiss them after the evening lesson, they personally welcome them on arrival.
items.note: 此处都指在学员到来时迎接他们。

items.src: Residents read a brochure about repair grants before submitting a completed application, receiving written approval, and obtaining a payment receipt.
items.para: Before submitting a completed application form, receiving an approval letter and obtaining a payment receipt, residents read an information booklet about repair grants.
items.note: 此处指介绍维修补助信息的小册子。

items.src: Mei watched a ladybird eating an aphid on her basil plant while a butterfly flew above it and an ant crawled beneath it.
items.para: A butterfly flew above Mei's basil and an ant crawled below it as she watched a ladybug feeding on an aphid on the plant.
items.note: 两者都是瓢虫，分别为英式和美式名称。

items.src: The technician's examination revealed cracked propellers, making repairs impossible and requiring new parts to be fitted before performance tests could begin.
items.para: Repair proved impossible after the technician's inspection revealed cracked propellers, so replacement was necessary before performance testing could begin.
items.note: 此处都指查看部件是否存在损坏的检查。

items.src: Maya is responsible for checking forecasts, may present them, and has offered to archive them, but must not alter them.
items.para: Although Maya has permission to present forecasts and has volunteered to archive them, she has a duty to check them and is forbidden to alter them.
items.note: 此处都表示承担某项工作的职责。

items.src: Participants remembered approximately twelve faces, precisely eight names, no fewer than four addresses, and no more than six dates in the experiment.
items.para: The experiment found that participants recalled exactly eight names, at least four addresses, roughly twelve faces, and at most six dates.
items.note: 两者都表示数量大约如此，并非精确值。

items.src: Conservationists planted a corridor between two forests rather than a disconnected patch, an edge area, or a clearing, enabling mammals to travel safely.
items.para: To enable safe mammal travel, conservationists planted a connecting strip between two forests rather than an isolated patch, a boundary zone or an open clearing.
items.note: 此处指连接两片森林、供动物通行的地带。

items.src: Island walkers enjoyed gentle coastal winds after a short shower, while mainland travellers faced a hurricane following a dry storm carrying dust.
items.para: Following a dry dust storm, mainland travellers faced a violent tropical cyclone; island walkers enjoyed a mild coastal breeze after a brief rain shower.
items.note: 此处指具有猛烈风力的热带气旋。

items.src: The watchman's warning about the unstable harbour wall interrupted a merchant's instruction, a sailor's plea for help and a builder explaining damage.
items.para: A merchant's instruction, a sailor's request for help and a builder's explanation of damage were interrupted by the watchman's alert about the unstable harbour wall.
items.note: 此处都指提醒人们注意危险的信息。

items.src: Older residents retell childhood stories at the festival, while younger volunteers record them in writing before dramatizing and discussing them.
items.para: Younger volunteers write down childhood stories that older residents repeat at the festival, before they act out and talk about those stories.
items.note: 指把童年故事再讲一遍。

items.src: A technician connects a digital player through an amplifier to a studio loudspeaker for monitoring bird calls, while a microphone records visitors' reactions.
items.para: A recording microphone captures visitors' reactions while a technician connects a digital player through an audio amplifier to a studio monitor to check bird calls.
items.note: 指将电信号转成可听声音的扬声设备。

items.src: Amina noted a similarity between the filing systems, but her report also described how they differed, what had improved and how they were linked.
items.para: Besides describing a difference, an improvement and a connection between the filing systems, Amina's report noted a resemblance between them.
items.note: 此处都指两个系统之间的相似之处。

items.src: The bakery owner felt confident that summer sales would rise, while her assistant merely hoped so and two partners expressed doubt and anxiety respectively.
items.para: Her assistant was merely hopeful and two partners were doubtful and worried respectively, but the bakery owner felt sure that summer sales would increase.
items.note: 此处都表示有把握，相信销量会增长。

items.src: Mountain scenery calmed Mei more than the animals, plants or changing weather she observed from her cabin.
items.para: From her cabin, Mei found the mountain landscape more soothing to observe than the wildlife, vegetation or shifting weather.
items.note: 此处都指眼前的自然风景。

items.src: Though cooling begins once temperatures rise, the enzyme stays active since insulation retains heat, except if the power fails.
items.para: Because insulation retains heat, the enzyme remains active although cooling starts when temperatures rise, unless the power fails.
items.note: 两者都引导让步从句，表示虽然。

items.src: The theatre offers keep-fit classes alongside lessons in vocal technique, reading scripts and making costumes, helping older actors maintain stamina.
items.para: Older actors receive help maintaining stamina through the theatre's fitness classes, offered alongside voice-training lessons, script-reading sessions and costume-making workshops.
items.note: 此处作定语，指保持身体健康的锻炼。

items.src: Before the gymnastics tournament, a circus performer juggled while the trainer briefed competitors, a judge checked scores and the host introduced teams.
items.para: A coach briefed competitors, a judge checked scores and an announcer introduced teams while a circus entertainer juggled before the gymnastics competition.
items.note: 此处都指为观众表演节目的艺人。

items.src: Parents learn to recognize dehydration symptoms at the health workshop, then practise noting them down, tracking changes and explaining them to nurses.
items.para: After learning to identify dehydration symptoms at the health workshop, parents practise how to record them, monitor changes and describe symptoms to nurses.
items.note: 此处都指识别出脱水症状。

items.src: Workers chose sticky sheets rather than smooth plastic for the library stairs, which were slippery near the entrance and rough elsewhere.
items.para: The library stairs were slippery near the entrance but rough elsewhere; workers selected tacky sheets instead of smooth plastic.
items.note: 两者都指表面有黏性，能黏住东西。

items.src: Mastering unfamiliar sounds requires considerable effort even when learners are naturally gifted, receive specialist instruction, and trust their own abilities.
items.para: Neither natural talent, expert guidance nor self-confidence removes the need for considerable hard work when learners master unfamiliar sounds.
items.note: 此处指掌握技能所需付出的努力。

items.src: Warehouse staff separate goods for sale from operational equipment, wrapping materials, and discarded rubbish before counting the stock each evening.
items.para: Before each evening's stock count, warehouse workers set operational equipment, packaging and waste apart from merchandise available for purchase.
items.note: 两者都指供出售的商品。

items.src: Our current rota assigns separate kitchen days, unlike versions from last year, suggested for autumn, or kept for emergencies.
items.para: Unlike versions used last year, proposed for autumn or reserved for emergencies, our rota in use now assigns separate kitchen days.
items.note: 此处指目前正在使用的安排。

items.src: Secret recordings left the engineer shocked, his manager anxious about lawsuits, his assistant embarrassed about recommending the app, and its rival feeling relieved.
items.para: While his manager felt worried about lawsuits, his assistant embarrassed about recommending the app, and its rival relieved, secret recordings left the engineer appalled.
items.note: 此处结合厌恶语境，指震惊且反感。

items.src: The presenter felt exhausted after recording interviews all night, contrasting with her alert producer, mildly drowsy assistant and rather fidgety guest.
items.para: Following overnight interview recording, the presenter felt worn out; her producer was wide awake, her assistant slightly sleepy and her guest quite restless.
items.note: 两者都指非常疲倦、筋疲力尽。

items.src: Puzzle participants reported greater enjoyment together than alone, with reduced irritation over mistakes, fewer feelings of tedium during pauses, and less worry about scores.
items.para: Compared with solving puzzles alone, group sessions reportedly gave participants more pleasure, less frustration over mistakes, less boredom during pauses and less anxiety about scores.
items.note: 两者都指活动带来的愉悦和乐趣。

items.src: Volunteers expressed a firm belief in oyster restoration's benefits, alongside wishes for funding, uncertainty about timing, and distrust of developers' motives.
items.para: Alongside hope for funding, doubt about timing and suspicion of developers' motives, volunteers expressed a firm conviction that restoring oysters would bring benefits.
items.note: 在坚定这一修饰下，两者都指确信的观念。

items.src: Once the airport opens, operators expect arrivals to explode, mainland visits to decline dramatically, fares to stay constant, and hotel prices to vary slightly.
items.para: Operators predict fares will remain steady and hotel prices fluctuate slightly once the airport opens, while arrivals surge dramatically and mainland visits fall sharply.
items.note: 此处是比喻用法，指数量迅速大幅增长。

items.src: The merchant recorded his intention to open a workshop, uncertainty about costs, anxiety about failure, and a recollection of his apprenticeship.
items.para: Alongside a memory of his apprenticeship, the merchant recorded doubt about costs and fear of failure, as well as his plan to open a workshop.
items.note: 两者都指准备做某事的打算。

items.src: Kitchen staff follow strict hygiene rules, while delivery schedules allow adjustments, training sessions are voluntary, and penalties for lateness are mild.
items.para: Flexible delivery schedules and optional training accompany stringent hygiene rules in the kitchen, where penalties for arriving late remain lenient.
items.note: 此处两者都指卫生规定要求严格。

items.src: Walkers found the waterfall's sudden roar frightening rather than merely unexpected, although the guide's thrilling stories and comforting voice helped.
items.para: The guide's exciting stories and reassuring voice helped walkers who found the waterfall's sudden roar scary rather than merely surprising.
items.note: 两者都表示令人害怕，不一定达到极度恐惧。

items.src: Her mentor's instructions remain precious to the restorer because they are practical, even though copies are neither scarce nor costly.
items.para: Although copies are neither rare nor expensive, their useful guidance makes her mentor's instructions treasured by the restorer.
items.note: 此处指因个人意义而珍爱，并非价格昂贵。

items.src: The baker requested financial advice about loan repayments after receiving guidance on contracts, machinery repairs, and supervising employees.
items.para: After receiving legal guidance on contracts, technical help with machinery repairs, and managerial advice on supervising employees, the baker requested money-related guidance on loan repayments.
items.note: 两者都表示与钱财及其管理有关。

items.src: Uncertain attendance partly explained Rina's anxiety; heat contributed nothing, while her sister's lateness arose wholly from traffic and her father's absence solely from illness.
items.para: Traffic entirely explained her sister's lateness and illness exclusively explained her father's absence; attendance uncertainty explained Rina's anxiety to some extent, heat not at all.
items.note: 表示部分程度或原因，而非全部；也可能是主要原因。

items.src: This apparatus supposedly provides cooling but basically transfers heat; although reversible in theory, it cannot run backwards in practice.
items.para: Despite theoretically reversible operation, the device cannot practically run backwards; it ostensibly provides cooling but essentially transfers heat.
items.note: 此处表示从根本功能来说。

items.src: Painters stored poisonous pigments away from easily ignited solvents and metal-eating cleaners, while keeping materials posing no danger on open shelves.
items.para: Harmless materials occupied open shelves, while painters kept toxic pigments separate from flammable solvents and corrosive cleaners.
items.note: 两者都指有毒、能够损害健康。

items.src: Our rowing club wears old-fashioned jackets rather than trendy ones for ceremonial dinners, saving its informal shirts for practice.
items.para: Casual shirts are reserved for practice, while our rowing club chooses dated rather than fashionable jackets for formal dinners.
items.note: 此处指款式过时，而不只是遵循传统。

items.src: A dry cough offers a clue about dust exposure, but doctors need tests before identifying the illness, explaining its cause, or verifying their suspicions.
items.para: Doctors need tests for diagnosis, explanation of the cause, and confirmation of their suspicions; a dry cough merely provides an indication of dust exposure.
items.note: 此处指帮助推断的迹象，并非确证。

items.src: The sculptor corrected the bald scholar's portrait because it showed him clean-shaven and grey-haired, although he actually had a thick beard.
items.para: Showing a scholar without scalp hair and actually thickly bearded as clean-shaven and grey-haired was an error, so the sculptor corrected his portrait.
items.note: 此处专指头上没有头发，不指没有胡须。

items.src: The introductory course simply covers shaping, whereas intermediate lessons focus chiefly on decoration, mentioning glazing quickly before advanced classes explore it fully.
items.para: Glazing receives attention briefly in intermediate lessons and thoroughly in advanced classes; beginners study only shaping, while intermediate teaching concentrates mainly on decoration.
items.note: 此处表示仅仅，限定课程涉及的内容。

items.src: The council announced a definite reopening date, replacing its tentative proposal, although its favoured date preceded the earliest possible completion of repairs.
items.para: Despite its preferred date preceding the earliest possible repair completion, the council announced a confirmed reopening date to replace its tentative proposal.
items.note: 此处指日期已经确定，而非暂定或期望的日期。

items.src: The woollen scarf needs a gentle wash rather than forceful scrubbing or lengthy soaking, but it still requires complete rinsing.
items.para: Although thorough rinsing remains necessary, the wool scarf requires a mild wash instead of vigorous scrubbing or prolonged soaking.
items.note: 此处指清洗力度轻柔，而非时间长或清洗彻底。

items.src: A comedian joked about household robots at the exhibition after an illusionist and a vocalist performed, while the host introduced each act.
items.para: With a presenter introducing each act, the exhibition featured a magician and a singer before a comic made jokes about domestic robots.
items.note: 两者都指以逗人发笑为职业的喜剧演员。

items.src: The dorm houses the campus radio studio, while the cafeteria, gymnasium and classroom building lack enough space for broadcasting equipment.
items.para: Unlike the dining hall, sports centre and teaching block, which lack sufficient equipment space, the student residence accommodates the campus radio studio.
items.note: 此处指供学生居住的宿舍楼。

items.src: Interviews revealed a trend towards checking assumptions among experienced players, alongside a liking for caution and plans to practise, but no obligation to compete.
items.para: Experienced players reported a preference for caution and an intention to practise; interviews showed a tendency to check assumptions but no requirement to compete.
items.note: 此处指群体表现出的行为倾向，而非意愿或要求。

items.src: The charity hopes to convince farmers to protect nesting sites after briefing them and seeking their views, rather than ordering them to cooperate.
items.para: Rather than instruct farmers to cooperate, the charity hopes to inform and consult them, then persuade them to protect nesting sites.
items.note: 此处指说服他人采取行动，而非告知、咨询或命令。

items.src: Mountain excursion guests must leave the entrance area, pass the stairwell and sitting room, then wait in the hallway outside the breakfast room.
items.para: After leaving the lobby and passing the stairwell and lounge, mountain trip guests must wait in the corridor outside the breakfast room.
items.note: 两者都指建筑内部连接房间的走廊。

items.src: Archaeological evidence suggests coastal people would scrape residue from hides, pull them taut and slice them before using bone needles to sew winter clothing.
items.para: Archaeological findings suggest coastal communities would scrape, stretch and cut hides before using bone needles to stitch garments for winter.
items.note: 两者都指用针线缝合材料、制作衣物。

items.src: The tool library aims to reduce household spending through equipment loans, while its budgeting app helps families work out, track and forecast expenses.
items.para: Its budgeting app helps families calculate, monitor and predict expenses, while the tool library aims to lower household spending by lending equipment.
items.note: 此处指降低开支金额，而非计算、监测或预测。

items.src: Leila used her coastal fieldwork journal to write a scientific report, but neither her life story nor her practical handbook included those personal entries.
items.para: Leila drew on her coastal fieldwork diary for a scientific report, although those personal entries appeared in neither her biography nor her guide.
items.note: 此处指记录个人经历与感受的日记。

items.src: After teaching the carpenters and alerting them to risks, the manager succeeded in persuading them to test the tool, then asked about their experience.
items.para: The manager succeeded in convincing the carpenters to test the tool after instructing and warning them, subsequently questioning them about their experience.
items.note: 指成功说服他人采取某项行动。

items.src: The producer called the wildlife discussion lively rather than boring, although its opening was conducted formally and its final exchange was strained.
items.para: Despite a formal opening and a tense final exchange, the wildlife discussion was animated rather than dull, the producer said.
items.note: 形容讨论热烈活跃、充满生气。

items.src: Ravi was willing to admit his nervousness before his stage debut rather than reject or hide it, but he could not account for it.
items.para: Unable to explain his nervousness before his stage debut, Ravi was nevertheless willing to acknowledge it rather than deny or conceal it.
items.note: 此处指承认自己确实感到紧张。

items.src: The geologist requested neat rows of samples, not tightly packed or irregular ones, and rejected the assistant's suggestion of widely dispersed groups.
items.para: Rejecting the assistant's suggestion of scattered groups, the geologist requested orderly rows of samples rather than crowded or uneven ones.
items.note: 此处指样本排列整齐、有条理。

items.src: The sculptor uses rough surfaces to communicate unease, not to conceal or overstate it, leaving critics to examine the feeling in detail.
items.para: Leaving critics to analyse the feeling, the sculptor employs rough surfaces to convey unease rather than hide or exaggerate it.
items.note: 此处指通过艺术作品传达不安感。

items.src: Medieval officials would debate market rules behind closed doors and authorize them before they would announce them in public and later ensure compliance.
items.para: Before medieval officials would publicly declare market rules and subsequently enforce them, they would privately discuss and formally approve them.
items.note: 指公开宣布，使有关规定为人所知。

items.src: Yesterday's radio ad for free dental checks followed the news summary and weather prediction but preceded the list of upcoming programmes.
items.para: Yesterday, a radio promotional message offered free dental checks after the news bulletin and weather forecast but before the programme schedule.
items.note: 指宣传免费牙科检查服务的广告信息。

items.src: Residents preferred an open-air cinema that would remain permanently, but the council approved only a short-term one and rejected the enclosed alternative.
items.para: The council rejected the indoor alternative and approved only a temporary outdoor cinema, although residents had wanted a permanent one.
items.note: 指设在户外、没有建筑围合的露天影院。

items.src: Recorded market conversations are a course feature supporting its speaking aim, while compulsory attendance helps learners gain confidence, an important advantage.
items.para: A characteristic of the course, recorded market conversations support its speaking objective; the attendance requirement helps learners gain confidence, an important benefit.
items.note: 指课程本身的特点，而非目标或益处。

items.src: Factory managers blamed sickness rather than tiredness for falling output, although workers also reported feeling stressed and bored.
items.para: Although workers reported stress and boredom, managers attributed the factory's declining production to illness rather than fatigue.
items.note: 此处指工人患病，而非疲劳或其他状态。

items.src: The journalist interviewed flood survivors while her colleague photographed them, then sent their material to the editor for the newsreader's evening broadcast.
items.para: After interviewing flood survivors alongside a photographer taking pictures, the reporter forwarded their material to the editor for the presenter's evening news broadcast.
items.note: 此处指采访并报道新闻的记者。

items.src: Supervisors warn workers about dangerous heat, explain evacuation procedures, calm frightened newcomers and commend those who follow safety rules.
items.para: Supervisors calm frightened newcomers and praise those following safety rules; they also alert workers to dangerous heat and instruct them in evacuation procedures.
items.note: 此处指提醒工人注意危险。

items.src: Investigators consider the recordings' disappearance a mystery, not a proven accident or confirmed theft, but agree it was no mistaken alarm.
items.para: Investigators reject a false alarm but regard the recordings' disappearance as an unexplained event, not an established accident or verified theft.
items.note: 此处指原因尚未查明的事件。

items.src: Before climbing, participants consulted a guidebook about equipment rather than a catalogue of products for sale, then checked their route map and completed a booking form.
items.para: Before climbing, participants checked a route map and completed a booking form after consulting an instruction manual about equipment rather than a sales catalogue.
items.note: 此处指提供装备相关指导的手册。

items.src: Amina found comfort in restoring the wetland after the flood, although sorrow and anger persisted alongside pride in what she achieved.
items.para: Although grief and anger persisted alongside pride in her achievements, restoring the wetland after the flood gave Amina solace.
items.note: 此处指在痛苦中获得的精神慰藉。

items.src: Researchers noted contrasting ages but comparable incomes among tourists, and found a link between stay length and spending that they considered nonaccidental.
items.para: Despite an age difference and income similarity among tourists, researchers found a connection between stay length and spending, which they judged no coincidence.
items.note: 此处指停留时长与消费之间的联系。

items.src: Diners praised the stew's strong flavour and pleasant smell, although they disliked its pale appearance and found it unpleasantly gritty.
items.para: Despite disliking its pale colour and gritty texture, diners praised the stew for its powerful taste and pleasant aroma.
items.note: 此处指食物的味道，区别于香气和口感。

items.src: Residents requested an informal discussion rather than a closed session, but agreed that it should be short and well organised.
items.para: Although residents agreed the discussion should be brief and orderly, they wanted a relaxed gathering rather than a private one.
items.note: 此处指讨论气氛随意、不拘礼节。

items.src: An unknown bird appeared beside the pond yesterday; researchers could not establish whether it was uncommon, seasonally travelling or physically hurt.
items.para: Researchers could not determine whether the unidentified bird seen beside the pond yesterday was rare, migratory or injured.
items.note: 此处指尚未辨明种类的鸟。

items.src: The manager was initially irritated about missing tools, then guilty after wrongly blaming an apprentice, who felt embarrassed but finally relieved.
items.para: Initially annoyed about missing tools, the manager became remorseful after unfairly blaming an apprentice; the apprentice was embarrassed but eventually relieved.
items.note: 此处指因错怪他人而感到内疚、懊悔。

items.src: The restaurant owner replaced a glass flower vase with an aquarium near the entrance, leaving the caged bird habitat and exhibition cupboard unchanged.
items.para: Near the restaurant entrance, a fish tank replaced a glass vase, while the owner kept the bird cage and display cabinet unchanged.
items.note: 此处指供鱼生活、供人观赏的鱼缸。

items.src: Leila's trainer and fellow team member offered encouragement before her competitor admitted feeling nervous, while the match official checked the court.
items.para: Before her rival confessed to feeling nervous, Leila received encouragement from her coach and teammate, while the referee inspected the court.
items.note: 此处指在比赛中与她争胜的对手。

items.src: After the laboratory exercise, volunteers breathe slowly while stretching their legs, then drink some water and give their muscles a rest.
items.para: Following the laboratory exercise, volunteers stretch their legs while they inhale and exhale slowly, then swallow some water and rest their muscles.
items.note: 指吸入并呼出空气，即呼吸。

items.src: Theatre managers log and contrast booking figures to predict attendance, but these figures cannot account for every change in audience preferences.
items.para: To forecast attendance, theatre managers record and compare booking figures, although these numbers cannot explain every shift in audience preferences.
items.note: 指根据现有信息预测未来的情况。

items.src: Festival volunteers will greet spectators and escort them to seats, while acrobats entertain them with comic routines and calm any worried children.
items.para: Acrobats will amuse spectators with comic routines and reassure worried children, while festival volunteers welcome spectators and guide them to their seats.
items.note: 此处指通过滑稽表演逗观众开心。

items.src: The sleep specialist requested honest, thorough accounts of evening habits rather than brief summaries, assuring patients that their reports would remain private.
items.para: Requesting truthful, detailed descriptions of evening habits instead of concise summaries, the sleep specialist assured patients that their reports would remain confidential.
items.note: 指叙述真实，不撒谎或隐瞒事实。

items.src: Market traders yell above construction noise while children sing, laugh at a wrong note, then whisper requests to try again.
items.para: Children sing a song, laugh at a wrong note, then whisper requests to try again, while market sellers shout above construction noise.
items.note: 指提高音量大声喊叫。

items.src: Direct sunlight can damage microscope parts, so technicians shield them with covers, remove dirt regularly, and exchange worn components for new ones.
items.para: Technicians protect microscope parts with covers because direct sunlight can harm them; they also clean the parts regularly and replace worn components.
items.note: 此处指使显微镜部件受到损坏。

items.src: Police received permission to arrest the contractor rather than merely interrogate or watch him, but could free him if evidence proved insufficient.
items.para: Officers could apprehend the contractor, not merely question or monitor him, but were permitted to release him if evidence proved insufficient.
items.note: 此处指警方依法将嫌疑人拘捕。

items.src: Mei earns a living repairing clothes, putting some money aside and using the rest to repay loans and cover household costs.
items.para: Repairing clothes provides Mei with an income, part of which becomes savings while the remainder pays off debt and meets household expenses.
items.note: 此处指通过工作获得的谋生收入。

items.src: Visitors found the robot's pronunciation amusing and its navigation admirable, although its instructions puzzled them and its repeated warnings irritated them.
items.para: Although the robot's instructions were confusing and its repeated warnings annoying, visitors considered its pronunciation funny and its navigation impressive.
items.note: 此处都表示令人觉得好笑。

items.src: For the food waste report, the crew chose a carton of apples rather than a timber crate, paper sack or plastic serving tray.
items.para: Rejecting a wooden crate, paper bag and plastic tray, the crew selected a cardboard box of apples for the report on food waste.
items.note: 此处指盛放苹果的纸板箱。

items.src: Leila was grateful for her colleague's correction, embarrassed by her mistake, relieved that it was caught, but worried about the deadline.
items.para: Embarrassed by her mistake and anxious about the deadline, Leila nevertheless felt thankful for her colleague's correction and relieved that the error was caught.
items.note: 此处表示因同事帮助纠错而心怀感激。

items.src: Biologists expect damaged protected reefs to recover within twenty years, while unprotected reefs may shrink, deteriorate or remain unchanged.
