items.para: Unprotected reefs may decrease in size, worsen in condition or remain unchanged; biologists predict damaged protected ones will return to health within two decades.
items.note: 此处指受损珊瑚礁恢复健康状态。

items.src: Residents regard decorating bridges with festival lanterns as a centuries-old tradition, not an official rule, recent invention or passing fashion.
items.para: Decorating bridges with festival lanterns is, residents believe, a centuries-old custom, not a regulation, recent innovation or temporary trend.
items.note: 此处指延续数百年的习俗。

items.src: Scribes could crease parchment into sections or wind it into cylinders, but used knives to cut it rather than tear it.
items.para: Scribes used knives to slice parchment instead of trying to rip it, although they could also fold it into sections or roll it into cylinders.
items.note: 此处都指通过拉扯将材料撕开。

items.src: The association keeps welcome speeches brief to allow more socialising, while encouraging a relaxed, friendly style without a prepared script.
items.para: To leave more time for socialising, the association encourages informal, welcoming and unscripted welcome speeches, while ensuring they remain short.
items.note: 此处都表示讲话持续时间短。

items.src: Researchers mounted the camera on a solid metal pole, with a hollow pipe protecting its wire and an angled bracket securing its base.
items.para: An angled bracket secured the base of the solid metal rod supporting the researchers' camera, while a hollow tube protected its cable.
items.note: 此处指支撑相机的细长金属杆。

items.src: Hana's handmade bowls are unique and available to buy, but she cannot guarantee that every piece is flawless.
items.para: Although Hana's bowls are made by hand, one of a kind and available for sale, they are not guaranteed to be free from defects.
items.note: 此处都表示独一无二，没有完全相同的另一件。

items.src: Mina put the package of pottery inside a wooden shipping box, tucked a separate envelope beside it, and used a bag for padding.
items.para: Using a sack as padding, Mina placed the parcel containing pottery in a wooden crate with a separate envelope beside it.
items.note: 两者在此都指装有物品、用于寄送的包裹。

items.src: Workshop participants may disagree, but personal criticism is forbidden; giving suggestions is advisable, although explaining any objection is compulsory.
items.para: Although suggestions are recommended, explanations of objections are required at the workshop, where disagreement is permitted but personal criticism is prohibited.
items.note: 两者都表示规则不允许，即被禁止。

items.src: Researchers first suspected heat, began testing without delay, and failed several times before they eventually identified the chemical responsible for coral bleaching.
items.para: Having initially suspected heat and immediately begun testing, researchers repeatedly failed before finally identifying the chemical that caused coral bleaching.
items.note: 两者都表示经历一段过程后终于发生。

items.src: Before tonight's concert, tests excluded deterioration through use, harm during transport and external signal disruption, identifying an internal fault as the amplifier's buzzing source.
items.para: An internal defect caused the amplifier's buzzing: tests before tonight's concert ruled out wear, transport damage and external interference.
items.note: 两者在此都指设备内部的缺陷或故障。

items.src: The climbing club received a parcel containing six replacement helmets with a letter, one day after a postcard and a catalogue arrived.
items.para: A day after receiving a postcard and a catalogue, the climbing club got a package containing six replacement helmets, accompanied by a letter.
items.note: 两者都指装有物品并寄送的包裹。

items.src: Beneath the leaflet's section title, the opening sentence of its first paragraph explains the phrase 'sleep hygiene' as habits supporting restful sleep.
items.para: The expression 'sleep hygiene' means habits supporting restful sleep, as the leaflet explains beneath its heading in the first sentence of its opening paragraph.
items.note: 两者在此都指表达特定意思的短语。

items.src: Despite earlier optimism, residents felt upset rather than reassured when the council announced a year-long garden closure, but maintained outward composure.
items.para: Previously hopeful, residents were distressed rather than reassured by the council's announcement of a year-long garden closure, although they remained visibly calm.
items.note: 两者在此都表示因坏消息而难过、烦恼。

items.src: After each presentation, tutors give individual feedback alongside broadly applicable advice about collective goals, while classmates submit comments without revealing their names.
items.para: Classmates submit anonymous comments after each presentation, while tutors provide personal feedback and general advice concerning shared goals.
items.note: 两者在此都表示针对某个学习者个人的。

items.src: The old licensing system was hardly automated; officials described its replacement as totally digital, but testing showed only partial, not even predominant, digitisation.
items.para: Replacing a barely automated licensing system, the new version was called entirely digital by officials, although tests found it partly, not mostly, digitised.
items.note: 两者都表示完全，而非部分或大部分。

items.src: Bakers display fresh loaves in the window each Saturday, keep extras out back, sell some to shoppers and take the rest to nearby cafés.
items.para: Each Saturday, bakers store spare fresh loaves out back, show others in the window, sell some to shoppers and deliver the remainder to nearby cafés.
items.note: 两者在此都指把面包展示给人看。

items.src: Visitors feel inquisitive before our astronomy sessions, but identifying their first constellation brings pleasure rather than feelings of frustration or worry.
items.para: Identifying their first constellation gives visitors enjoyment rather than frustration or anxiety, although curiosity precedes our astronomy sessions.
items.note: 此处指认出星座带来的愉悦感。

items.src: Festival visitors waited on the sidewalk while police closed the road to vehicles and directed pedestrians from the crossing towards the pedestrian bridge.
items.para: Police closed the roadway and guided pedestrians from the crossing towards the footbridge, while festival visitors waited on the pavement.
items.note: 此处指道路旁供行人使用的人行道。

items.src: Volunteers practised beforehand, repeated names without delay, began forgetting them shortly after hearing them, and returned for another test the following day.
items.para: Having practised beforehand, volunteers repeated names immediately but began forgetting them soon after hearing them; a day later, they returned for another test.
items.note: 此处表示听到后不久，强调间隔很短。

items.src: Maya chose secondhand chairs rather than recently manufactured ones, accepting minor damage because completely renovated examples exceeded her budget.
items.para: Because fully restored chairs exceeded her budget, Maya chose slightly damaged, previously owned ones rather than newly made alternatives.
items.note: 两者都表示曾由他人拥有，即二手的。

items.src: Our guide reported steady progress on canal repairs after lengthy planning, despite a brief scheduling setback, but said the work was not finished.
items.para: Following lengthy preparation, canal repairs showed steady advancement despite a brief delay, our guide reported, although completion had not yet been achieved.
items.note: 此处指修复工程向完成目标取得的进展。

items.src: Weavers left because of poverty, not the loss of regular jobs, anxiety about further losses, or expectations of higher wages elsewhere.
items.para: Neither hope of better wages elsewhere, fear of further losses nor loss of steady employment drove weavers away; inability to afford necessities did.
items.note: 此处的贫困指无力负担基本生活必需品。

items.src: An official festival schedule replaced the committee's tentative draft, while volunteers removed obsolete posters and warned visitors against unchecked timetables circulating online.
items.para: Volunteers removed outdated posters and warned visitors against unverified online timetables as an authorised festival schedule replaced the committee's provisional draft.
items.note: 此处指经负责机构正式批准的。

items.src: Registration for the bird survey ends Friday, leaving time to teach volunteers and assign observation sites before the deadline for dropping out.
items.para: Friday's deadline for bird survey enrolment allows time for volunteer training and observation site allocation before the final date for withdrawal.
items.note: 此处指报名参加调查的登记手续。

items.src: Engineers found the robot's usual scent mild and sugary, but motor overheating produced a disgusting smell unlike the recognisable odour of warm plastic.
items.para: Whenever its motor overheated, the robot emitted a revolting smell unlike warm plastic's familiar odour, replacing the faint, sweet scent engineers normally detected.
items.note: 两者都形容气味令人强烈反感、恶心。

items.src: Flour prices affect bakery profits, which accountants calculate and economists forecast, while customer reviews reveal satisfaction rather than financial performance.
items.para: Economists predict bakery profits and accountants measure them, but flour prices influence those profits, whereas customer reviews reflect satisfaction rather than financial performance.
items.note: 此处指面粉价格对利润产生影响。

items.src: Calmness gives negotiators an advantage after a reversal, helping them break a deadlock and reach a settlement involving concessions.
items.para: After a setback, negotiators gain an edge through calmness, which helps them overcome a stalemate and reach a compromise.
items.note: 此处两者都指谈判中的有利地位。

items.src: Volunteers found the laboratory smell unpleasant despite its low intensity and recognisable character, although testing showed it caused no harm.
items.para: Testing showed the laboratory odour was harmless, but volunteers described it as disagreeable despite finding it faint and familiar.
items.note: 两者都表示气味令人不快。

items.src: Within the museum's holdings, curators assign geometrically decorated bowls to one category, rather than matching two by size or arranging them chronologically.
items.para: Curators place geometrically patterned bowls from the museum collection in one group, rather than forming a size-matched pair or a chronological sequence.
items.note: 此处指依据共同装饰特征划分的类别。

items.src: Amina hesitated when introducing herself; the captain greeted her warmly, while the secretary responded formally and politely and another member showed obvious impatience.
items.para: Amina introduced herself with some hesitation; the secretary responded with formal politeness, another member with obvious impatience, but the captain greeted her in a friendly manner.
items.note: 此处指以友好热情的方式打招呼。

items.src: Following a rehabilitation specialist's advice, the yoga instructor asks a helper to fetch a chair for someone attending class with back pain.
items.para: On a therapist's advice, the assistant is asked by the yoga teacher to fetch a chair for a participant with back pain.
items.note: 此处两者都指教授瑜伽的老师。

items.src: A retired sportsman designed the park's gentle exercise route for older residents, consulting a team trainer, a game official and a club fan.
items.para: After consulting a team coach, a match referee and a club supporter, a retired male athlete designed the park's gentle fitness route for elderly residents.
items.note: 此处指男性运动员，保留男性含义。

items.src: Each van carries a load of donated textbooks from library supplies, covering each school's assigned share while leaving some books for emergencies.
items.para: With an emergency reserve retained, each van carries a consignment of donated textbooks from library stock sufficient for every school's allocation.
items.note: 此处指车辆实际运载的货物。

items.src: Every Friday morning, a messenger delivered orders copied by an office worker and sealed by an administrative aide to the island's chief official.
items.para: Orders copied by a clerk and sealed by a secretary reached the island governor via a courier every Friday morning.
items.note: 此处两者都指递送书面指令的人。

items.src: The residents' association will check and condense its recycling survey findings today, then publish them online tomorrow before storing the original records.
items.para: Before they release the recycling survey findings online tomorrow and archive the original records, residents' representatives will verify and summarise those findings today.
items.note: 此处两者都指向公众公布调查结果。

items.src: Technicians identify each laboratory tablet by scanning its tag, rather than reading an etched mark, checking its security closure or examining its display.
items.para: Each laboratory tablet is identified by technicians scanning a label, not by examining a screen, checking a seal or reading an engraving.
items.note: 此处指用于识别设备的附加标签。

items.src: Seabirds shown in a documentary fly in loops above the sea, pause in midair, then dive into the water before sailing away with fish.
items.para: Before they glide away with fish, seabirds in the documentary circle over the sea, hover momentarily and plunge into the water.
items.note: 此处都指从空中迅速扎入水中。

items.src: Mira puts her stuff in a drawer before checking laboratory apparatus, shared consumables and experimental specimens for her reasoning task.
items.para: Before checking the laboratory equipment, shared supplies and experimental samples for her reasoning task, Mira stores her belongings in a drawer.
items.note: 这里指个人物品，而非设备、耗材或样本。

items.src: Researchers found litter discarded by beach visitors trapped among coastal roots alongside marine algae, washed-up wood and deposited sand.
items.para: Among coastal roots, researchers discovered seaweed, driftwood and sandy sediment together with rubbish that visitors had discarded on the beach.
items.note: 这里都指游客随手丢弃的垃圾。

items.src: Leaking fuel could pollute the lake, so crews planned to remove contaminants, strain the water and kill germs before restoring drinking supplies.
items.para: Before restoring drinking supplies, crews planned to clean, filter and disinfect the water because leaking fuel could contaminate the lake.
items.note: 这里都指使湖水受到污染。

items.src: Archaeologists gently brushed soil off the fragile Roman bowl; their supervisor worked quickly nearby, recording measurements precisely and identifying fragments with complete confidence.
items.para: Archaeologists brushed soil off the fragile Roman bowl with little force; nearby, their supervisor recorded measurements at high speed with great precision, identifying fragments with complete confidence.
items.note: 这里指用力很小、动作轻柔，不只是小心。

items.src: Volunteers give newcomers a leaflet about weekly community meals, display a wall notice, and request a completed application before issuing an admission pass.
items.para: Volunteers display a poster and distribute a flyer about weekly community meals to newcomers, requiring a completed form before providing a ticket.
items.note: 这里都指介绍社区活动的传单。

items.src: Mei's vegetable basket is medium-sized, unlike the rejected baskets, which were excessively bulky, narrow or shallow for her kitchen.
items.para: Unlike the rejected kitchen baskets, which were far too bulky, much too narrow or rather too shallow, Mei's vegetable basket is neither big nor small.
items.note: 表示大小适中，即既不大也不小。

items.src: Apprentice bakers gain knowledge from demonstrations, put it into practice while baking, assess it through quizzes and pass it on to classmates.
items.para: Demonstrations help apprentice bakers acquire knowledge, which they apply while baking, test through quizzes and share with classmates.
items.note: 这里指获得知识，而非运用、检验或分享知识。

items.src: Traders can display goods despite dazzling lamps, scattered shadows or twilight, but darkness during power cuts prevents sales.
items.para: Despite glare from lamps, patches of shade or fading evening light, traders can display goods; the absence of light during outages prevents sales.
items.note: 这里指没有光亮的状态，而非阴影或暮色。

items.src: Leila found the village streets recognisable, the welcome customary and the routine unsurprising, but felt an odd mixture of excitement and sadness.
items.para: An unusual mixture of excitement and sadness struck Leila, although the village streets were familiar, the welcome conventional and the routine predictable.
items.note: 这里表示不寻常、令人觉得奇怪。

items.src: Lemon juice is an essential ingredient in this dressing, not a decoration, a replacement for vinegar, or something served alongside the salad.
items.para: Neither a garnish nor an accompaniment to the salad, lemon juice is an essential dressing component, not a substitute for vinegar.
items.note: 此处指制作调味汁所用的组成成分。

items.src: The artist left the middle panel blank for visitors' imagined images, while making the others multicoloured, covered with patterns, or rough to touch.
items.para: Visitors could imagine images on the empty middle panel; the artist made the remaining panels colourful, patterned, or textured.
items.note: 此处指画板没有画面内容，留给观众想象。

items.src: Mill workers gardened during their leisure after factory shifts shortened, although the time they spent travelling and sleeping remained unchanged.
items.para: After working hours shortened, mill workers gardened in their free time, while their travel time and sleeping hours remained unchanged.
items.note: 指不受工作等事务占用的闲暇时间。

items.src: Omar was initially willing but anxious and reliant on help; practice with the nurse made him prepared to change his daughter's bandage alone.
items.para: Practice with the nurse left Omar ready to change his daughter's dressing alone, whereas previously he had been willing but nervous and dependent.
items.note: 指练习后已做好独立操作的准备。

items.src: A review found crossings poorly lit despite recent lamp fitting and routine servicing, prompting officials to arrange the removal and renewal of faulty lights.
items.para: Despite recent installation and regular maintenance, an assessment revealed inadequate lighting at crossings, leading officials to order replacement of faulty lamps.
items.note: 此处指检查照明状况并作出评估。

items.src: Geography pupils measured traffic noise beside the highway between two towns, then compared readings from a minor street, an agricultural track and a walking path.
items.para: After measuring traffic noise beside the main road connecting two towns, geography pupils compared readings from a side street, farm track and footpath.
items.note: 此处指连接两座城镇的主要公路。

items.src: The chamber used a survey to ask traders about flour costs and profits, rather than checking accounts, predicting trends or running tests.
items.para: To learn about flour costs and profits, the chamber conducted a poll of traders, not an audit, a forecast or an experiment.
items.note: 此处指通过向商贩提问来收集信息的调查。

items.src: These wool blankets soak up water and hold moisture, but they require cold washing water because they cannot withstand high temperatures.
items.para: Although these wool blankets absorb water and retain moisture, they need cold water for washing because they cannot tolerate high temperatures.
items.note: 指冷水是清洗这些羊毛毯的必要条件。

items.src: The engineers' attitude towards automated inspections improved after software found several hidden cracks, although their understanding, practical background and technical skill remained unchanged.
items.para: Finding several concealed cracks improved the engineers' outlook on automated inspections, but the software left their knowledge, experience and expertise unchanged.
items.note: 此处指工程师对自动检测的评价和看法。

items.src: The crew chose the lighthouse as their filming location, using the harbour as headquarters, the cafe for gathering and the warehouse for equipment.
items.para: Using the harbour as their base, the cafe as meeting point and the warehouse as storage facility, the crew chose the lighthouse as their filming site.
items.note: 此处指实际进行拍摄的地点。

items.src: Researchers recorded each volunteer's native tongue separately from their accent, vocabulary and writing system to distinguish language background from communication habits.
items.para: To distinguish linguistic background from communication habits, researchers separately recorded each volunteer's accent, vocabulary, script and native language.
items.note: 此处指所使用的语言，而非口音或文字体系。

items.src: Each recycling bin carries a green label listing accepted plastics beneath the centre's emblem, while a barcode links to a separate announcement.
items.para: Below the centre's logo, each recycling container has a green tag listing accepted plastics; its barcode links to a separate notice.
items.note: 此处指附在容器上、提供分类信息的标签。

items.src: Ferry passengers can borrow a trolley without payment to carry their luggage case, rucksack and picnic hamper from the island terminal.
items.para: A suitcase, backpack and picnic basket can all be carried from the island terminal on a cart that ferry passengers may borrow free.
items.note: 此处指用于搬运行李的推车。

items.src: With construction due the following week, archaeologists had to rush the excavation rather than delay its start, stop it temporarily or call it off.
items.para: Construction was scheduled for the next week, so archaeologists had to hurry the excavation rather than postpone, suspend or cancel it.
items.note: 此处指赶快进行挖掘，加快工作速度。

items.src: The charity provides temporary accommodation for flood victims, while partner organisations arrange travel to shelters, meals and medical treatment.
items.para: Partner organisations arrange transport to shelters, food and healthcare for flood victims, whereas the charity supplies temporary housing.
items.note: 此处指为受灾者提供的临时住处。

items.src: I regret removing the tree, despite taking pride in clearing the path, fearing further damage and supporting the council's safety plan.
items.para: Although I feel proud of clearing the path, worry about further damage and approve of the council's safety plan, I feel sorry about removing the tree.
items.note: 此处指对自己已经做过的事感到后悔。

items.src: Mina helped the apprentice through kindness, not sorrow for his difficulties; her practical assistance went beyond good manners and was not required by her job.
items.para: Beyond mere politeness, Mina's practical help for the apprentice expressed consideration, not pity for his difficulties, and fulfilled no job obligation.
items.note: 此处指通过实际帮助表现出的体贴关怀。

items.src: Visitors follow a small watercourse past a still basin to reach the waterfall, avoiding the turbulent stretch farther upstream.
items.para: To reach the cascade, visitors follow a stream past a pool, keeping away from the rapids farther upstream.
items.note: 此处指水流从高处跌落形成的瀑布。

items.src: Ravi described the chilled chilli sauce as spicy rather than sugary, acidic or briny, saying its flavour reminded him of family celebrations.
items.para: Ravi said the chilled chilli sauce tasted hot, not sweet, sour or salty, and that its flavour reminded him of family celebrations.
items.note: 此处指辣椒带来的辛辣味，而非温度高。

items.src: Pupils compared how corks float and stones sink, then watched river leaves move bankwards as bubbles travelled upwards through the water.
items.para: Pupils compared corks that stay on the surface and stones that drop to the bottom, then watched river leaves drift bankwards as bubbles rise through the water.
items.note: 此处指物体保持在水面上，不沉入水底。

items.src: The potter chose plain bowls rather than brightly coloured ones, rejecting both those buffed to a shine and those bearing patterns.
items.para: Rejecting polished and patterned bowls, the ceramic artist selected undecorated ones instead of colourful alternatives.
items.note: 此处指没有图案等装饰的。

items.src: The coach examined evening training's effect on sleep, rather than its intended goal, how long sessions lasted, or how often they occurred.
items.para: The purpose, duration, and frequency of evening training were not investigated; the coach instead studied its impact on sleep.
items.note: 此处指训练对睡眠产生的影响。

items.src: Families arrived early because sunshine was forecast, but despite heavy rain, the festival continued outdoors rather than moving into the hall.
items.para: Festivities continued outdoors in spite of heavy rain instead of moving into the hall; families had arrived ahead of schedule because of predicted sunshine.
items.note: 两者均表示尽管存在不利条件，事情仍然发生。

items.src: Visitors can enter the museum's model spaceship, but its models of an underwater vessel, a passenger plane and a rescue helicopter remain closed.
items.para: Unlike the closed submarine, passenger aircraft and rescue helicopter models, the museum's model spacecraft is open for visitors to enter.
items.note: 此处均指用于宇宙航行的飞船。

items.src: Learners receive instant feedback from the software, while tutors send comments later and provide reports every week and summaries every month.
items.para: Unlike tutors' delayed comments, weekly reports and monthly summaries, the software's immediate feedback reaches learners without waiting.
items.note: 均指无需等待、立即提供的。

items.src: Before checking grain standards, purchase costs and supply prospects, the ministry used census figures to calculate the quantity needed for emergency reserves.
items.para: Census data helped the ministry calculate the amount of grain required for emergency stocks before assessing its quality, price and availability.
items.note: 此处均指所需粮食的数量。

items.src: Mei feared climbing might injure her brother, whereas he worried about feeling scared, becoming exhausted and looking foolish in front of spectators.
items.para: Climbing might frighten, exhaust or embarrass Mei's brother before spectators, he worried, while Mei feared it might hurt him.
items.note: 此处均指使身体受到伤害。

items.src: Researchers complain about laboratory noise but endorse the proposed repairs, ask for help with equipment and suggest improvements to the schedule.
items.para: Researchers express agreement with proposed repairs, request assistance with equipment and offer advice on scheduling, but express dissatisfaction with laboratory noise.
items.note: 此处指对实验室噪声表达不满。

items.src: Painting conservation is a profession requiring advanced training, not something pursued casually for pleasure, short-term employment or unpaid service.
items.para: Painting conservation requires advanced training as a specialist career, rather than being a casual hobby, temporary job or voluntary role.
items.note: 此处指需要专门知识和训练的职业。

items.src: Researchers observe how volunteers react when unexpected evidence challenges old beliefs, without asking them to anticipate, explain or learn that evidence by heart.
items.para: Volunteers need not predict, interpret or memorise unexpected evidence challenging established beliefs; researchers simply observe how they respond to it.
items.note: 此处均指对意外的新证据作出反应。

items.src: The rough outdoor paving, in contrast to smooth indoor tiles, feels hard underfoot and becomes slippery when wet.
items.para: Unlike the smooth indoor tiles, the outdoor paving has an uneven surface; it feels hard underfoot and becomes slippery when wet.
items.note: 此处指表面凹凸不平，而非光滑。

items.src: Your ticket's departure time is incorrect rather than obsolete, while the route description lacks clarity and the safety instructions omit details.
items.para: Although the route description is unclear and the safety instructions are incomplete, your ticket's departure time is wrong, not outdated.
items.note: 此处表示信息有误，不是过时或不完整。

items.src: Grain arrived a month beforehand; craftsmen now repair walls; meanwhile, families store it before winter starts, with inspections scheduled for next week.
items.para: Following delivery a month earlier, families now store grain before winter begins; craftsmen repair walls at the same time, with inspections scheduled the following week.
items.note: 表示两件事在同一时间发生。

items.src: The meal programme's aim is friendship; shared lunches provide the means, better nutrition is an added advantage, and food is the largest cost.
items.para: Using shared lunches as its method, the meal programme has friendship as its objective, improved nutrition as an additional benefit, and food as its greatest expense.
items.note: 指希望实现的目标，而非方法、益处或费用。

items.src: Visitors seeking terrific views bypassed the unremarkable harbour and disappointing woodland, but avoided the mountain because its scenery looked scary.
items.para: Avoiding the mountain's frightening scenery, visitors seeking excellent views bypassed the ordinary harbour and disappointing woodland.
items.note: 此处表示极好的，带有强烈赞赏意味。

items.src: Mei mainly repairs costumes, sometimes advises designers about fabric, seldom sews new garments, and does not ever handle ticket sales.
items.para: Besides occasionally advising designers on fabric, Mei mostly mends costumes; she rarely makes new garments and never sells tickets.
items.note: 表示工作以此为主，并非偶尔或从不做。

items.src: The bakery retained all its staff despite rising flour prices; ingredient providers raised charges, buyers paid more, and proprietors accepted smaller profits.
items.para: Despite higher flour costs, the bakery kept all its employees; suppliers increased charges, customers paid more, and owners accepted reduced profits.
items.note: 指机构雇用的全体员工。

items.src: After courteously thanking the interviewer, Amira strongly opposed the criticism, discussed her mistakes with caution, and unwillingly agreed to another interview.
items.para: Having thanked the interviewer politely, Amira opposed the criticism firmly; she then addressed her mistakes cautiously before reluctantly accepting another interview.
items.note: 此处强调反对态度坚决，而非礼貌或勉强。

items.src: Volunteers found rainfall relaxing but alarms unsettling, while rapid drumming increased their alertness and repeated tapping annoyed them during the experiment.
items.para: Experiment volunteers described rapid drumming as stimulating and repeated tapping as irritating, whereas rainfall was soothing and alarms were disturbing.
items.note: 表示令人平静、缓解紧张。

items.src: The curator remains uncertain about the painter's identity, distrusts the seller, wants to learn about the painting's history, and feels assured about its age.
items.para: Still curious about the painting's history and suspicious of the seller, the curator is confident about its age but unsure who painted it.
items.note: 表示尚无把握，不能确定。

items.src: Weighted rings sink to the pool bottom during practice, while hollow balls stay afloat, bubbles move upwards, and loose ribbons move with currents.
items.para: Practice equipment behaves differently: hollow balls float, bubbles rise, and loose ribbons drift with currents, while weighted rings descend to the pool bottom.
items.note: 此处都指在水中向下沉至池底。

items.src: Herb trade funds the clinic's free consultations, whereas cultivation and collection, dehydration and packaging, and testing and grading generate no income for it.
items.para: Growing and harvesting, drying and packing, and testing and grading herbs earn the clinic nothing; buying and selling them funds its free consultations.
items.note: 都指商品的买卖活动。

items.src: After visits to a police station, a trial chamber, and a probation bureau, trainees toured a prison where egg collectors served six months.
items.para: Trainees toured a jail housing egg collectors serving six months after visiting a police station, a courtroom, and a probation office.
items.note: 此处都指关押服刑人员的监狱。

items.src: Researchers described vent feeding networks as complex and easily disrupted, unlike the unchanging, separate systems observed nearer the coast.
items.para: Compared with the stable, isolated systems nearer the coast, vent feeding networks were intricate and fragile, researchers reported.
items.note: 都指内部结构和联系复杂。

items.src: Keeping coastal stations operating will require the ministry to chase additional research grants rather than distribute reserves, take loans, or put money aside.
items.para: To keep coastal stations operating, the ministry must pursue additional research grants; it cannot simply borrow money, save funds or allocate reserves.
items.note: 此处都指积极争取研究经费。

items.src: Our communal laundry occupies the third storey in the building's eastern section, not its underground space or the area on top.
items.para: Neither the basement nor the roof houses our shared laundry; it occupies the third floor of the building's east wing.
items.note: 都指建筑物中的楼层。

items.src: We use a microscope to measure each crystal's width, then its longest dimension and depth, before calculating how much space it occupies.
items.para: Before calculating each crystal's volume, we measure its breadth, followed by its length and thickness, using a microscope.
items.note: 都指物体横向的宽度。

items.src: Our producer found the microphones incredibly sensitive, only a little expensive, medium in weight, and reasonably easy to install.
items.para: Only slightly expensive, moderately heavy, and fairly easy to install, the microphones were extremely sensitive, our producer found.
items.note: 此处都表示程度极高。

items.src: Participants recalled childhood gardens through the perfume of roses, rather than the petals' hue, surface feel, or outline, in our memory experiment.
items.para: Our memory experiment found that neither the petals' colour, texture, nor shape prompted childhood garden memories; the scent of roses did.
items.note: 此处都指玫瑰散发的花香。

items.src: Residents considered garden smoke merely disagreeable, some calling it innocuous or even helpful, but the environmental survey found prolonged exposure unhealthy.
items.para: The environmental survey found prolonged garden smoke exposure harmful, although residents regarded the smoke as merely unpleasant, some even calling it harmless or beneficial.
items.note: 此处都指长期接触烟雾有损身体。

items.src: Visitors found the guide's talk rather dull but rich in information, while his assistant's presentation was amusing but difficult to understand.
items.para: Visitors judged the guide's talk informative but rather boring, whereas his assistant's presentation was entertaining but confusing.
items.note: 此处指讲解枯燥，不能引起兴趣。

items.src: Our guide will give an explanation of how the heating worked, then demonstrate it, show a schematic drawing, and briefly recap everything.
items.para: Our guide will offer an account of how heating worked, followed by a demonstration of it, show a diagram, then give a brief summary of everything.
items.note: 此处指说明供暖系统如何运作的讲解。

items.src: Guests must reserve seats in advance, pay when they arrive, collect refreshments at the interval, and return their badges after the festival.
items.para: Festival guests must pay on arrival after reserving seats beforehand, collect refreshments during the interval, and return their badges after the festival.
items.note: 指在相关活动开始之前提前办理。

items.src: Initially optimistic but nervous, the volunteers were disappointed by the low puffin count, yet reassured that none of the chicks were injured.
items.para: The low puffin count left the initially hopeful but anxious volunteers feeling let down, yet relieved that no chicks were injured.
items.note: 指结果未达到预期而感到失望。

items.src: Employees use the pottery workshop's newsletter for monthly news, consult its handbook for instructions and product directory for prices, then complete its feedback form.
items.para: Workshop employees consult the manual for instructions and catalogue for prices, read the monthly bulletin for news, then complete the questionnaire.
items.note: 此处指每月提供工坊消息的简报。

items.src: Customers consider our delivery fee reasonable, not exorbitant or insignificant, although it fluctuates according to the distance travelled.
items.para: Although variable with distance, our delivery fee is considered fair by customers, rather than excessive or negligible.
items.note: 此处指收费公道，不过分昂贵。

items.src: Managing daily tasks alone made Meera more independent and sure of herself, but no more outgoing and still careful about unfamiliar situations.
items.para: Meera became more self-reliant and confident through handling daily tasks alone, though she was no more sociable and stayed cautious in unfamiliar situations.
items.note: 指能自行处理生活事务，不依赖他人。

items.src: The mineral samples must remain below freezing throughout testing, although they may become cloudy, appear dry, and seem brittle to the touch.
items.para: Although they may turn cloudy, look dry, and feel brittle, the mineral samples must stay below freezing throughout the tests.
items.note: 指持续保持原有的状态。

items.src: The theatre displays a wall advertisement, sells show guides, checks admission passes, and gives visitors a flyer advertising discounted family tickets.
items.para: Visitors receive a leaflet advertising discounted family tickets; the theatre also displays a poster, sells a programme, and checks each ticket.
items.note: 此处指宣传演出优惠的传单。

items.src: Our coach encourages calm dialogue about training concerns after matches, rather than lecturing, simply delivering news, or letting players quarrel.
items.para: After matches, our coach favours a calm discussion of training concerns over a lecture, an announcement, or an argument between players.
items.note: 此处指双方交换看法的讨论交流。

items.src: Nurses planted a fragrant bush beneath a large tree, removing a climbing plant while leaving the boundary hedge intact.
items.para: Beneath a large tree, nurses planted a fragrant shrub and removed a vine, but preserved the hedge marking the boundary.
items.note: 两者都指灌木，而非乔木或藤本植物。

items.src: An initially slow river rise became sudden, disrupting the museum's consistent evacuation pace and forcing a short-lived closure.
items.para: The museum's steady evacuation pace was disrupted when a gradual river rise became abrupt, forcing a temporary closure.
items.note: 此处都表示变化突然发生，而非缓慢发展。

items.src: Sewing learners chose a zipper for their pouch design because buttons left gaps, cord closures loosened, and metal catches snagged fabric.
items.para: Because buttons left gaps, drawstring closures loosened, and metal clasp fastenings snagged fabric, sewing students selected a sliding fastener for their pouch design.
items.note: 两者都指通过滑动装置开合的拉链。

items.src: Visitors found the garden charming rather than imposing, although its entrance looked unremarkable and its shaded benches seemed discouraging.
items.para: Despite an ordinary entrance and uninviting shaded benches, the garden struck visitors as delightful rather than imposing.
items.note: 此处都表示令人喜爱、使人愉悦的。

items.src: Silence helps Leila focus on measurements rather than think back on mistakes, guess about results, or brood over criticism.
items.para: Leila finds that silence makes it easier to concentrate on measurements rather than reflect on mistakes, speculate about results, or dwell on criticism.
items.note: 此处都指将注意力集中于测量数据。

items.src: Engineers prefer face-to-face workshops to internet sessions because physical demonstrations are easier, although independently paced courses include previously filmed tutorials.
items.para: Although self-paced courses include prerecorded tutorials, engineers favour in-person workshops over online sessions because physical demonstrations are easier.
items.note: 两者都指参与者亲自在场、当面进行。

items.src: Editors rejected two matching accounts and retained various perspectives for one documentary, despite receiving many similar descriptions of the festival.
items.para: Despite numerous similar festival descriptions, editors kept several different perspectives for a single documentary and rejected two identical accounts.
items.note: 此处表示若干种不同的，而非仅指数量多。

items.src: Our workshop will use a quiet campsite rather than shared budget accommodation, with a woodland cabin and outdoor eating space nearby.
items.para: Near a woodland lodge and picnic area, a quiet campground will host our workshop instead of a hostel.
items.note: 此处两者都指供人露营的场地。

items.src: Frequent wetland checks replaced occasional visits, while annual surveys continued and a one-off assessment followed cattle exclusion.
items.para: Wetland monitoring shifted from occasional visits to often repeated checks, while yearly surveys continued and a once-only assessment followed cattle exclusion.
items.note: 指检查经常重复进行，不仅是间隔有规律。

items.src: Farmland gradually yielded to rocky hills; rain then started abruptly, lingered briefly, and returned repeatedly during our journey.
items.para: On our journey, farmland yielded to rocky hills little by little; rain then began all at once, lasted for mere moments, and returned again and again.
items.note: 两者都表示一点一点地、逐渐地变化。

items.src: Eighteenth-century letters contrast casual gatherings with formal ceremonies, noting that both were restricted to invited guests and conducted without disorder.
items.para: Letters from the eighteenth century describe private, orderly events restricted to invited guests, distinguishing informal gatherings from ceremonial occasions.
items.note: 此处指聚会非正式、不拘礼节。

items.src: Kitchen volunteers work fixed hours, whereas delivery drivers have adjustable schedules; both groups work brief shifts that suit families.
items.para: Although both groups work short, convenient shifts for families, kitchen volunteers have set hours while delivery drivers have flexible schedules.
items.note: 此处指工作时间已确定且不变。

items.src: Some birds pretend to be injured rather than hide or directly protect their nests, allowing their chicks to get away from danger.
items.para: To let their chicks escape danger, some birds feign injury instead of trying to conceal themselves or defend nests.
items.note: 指假装受伤，并非真的受到伤害。

items.src: Workshop employees wash dirt off metal panels, remove corrosion and old colour layers, then apply a protective finish.
items.para: Before applying a protective coating to metal panels, workshop staff wash away grime and remove rust and old paint.
items.note: 此处指金属表面需要洗去的污垢。

items.src: Southern cooperatives earned more from corn exports this year because demand rose, while overseas sales of rice, barley and wheat remained unchanged.
items.para: Rising demand for maize increased southern cooperatives' export earnings this year, although wheat, barley and rice exports stayed at their previous levels.
items.note: 此处指玉米，而非其他谷物。

items.src: The voluntary organization runs conversation groups for retirees with municipal funding, medical centre training and review by an independent panel.
items.para: With funding from the council, training from a clinic and review by an independent committee, the voluntary association runs conversation groups for retirees.
items.note: 此处指开展活动的志愿团体。

items.src: Managers suggest single tests and forecast savings, but chemists insist that samples undergo two tests and reject claims that one suffices.
items.para: Chemists demand that samples undergo two tests and deny that one suffices, while managers propose single tests and predict savings.
items.note: 此处指坚决要求，而非建议或预测。

items.src: Visitors pay before the session, initially watch a pottery demonstration while assistants clean brushes, and afterward decorate a small bowl.
items.para: Having paid beforehand, visitors initially watch a pottery demonstration; assistants meanwhile clean brushes, and visitors later decorate a small bowl.
items.note: 此处指观看示范之后。

items.src: A researcher recorded runners' pulse rates for a study while a trainer guided warm-ups, a nurse treated injuries and a match official enforced rules.
items.para: While a coach guided warm-ups, a nurse treated injuries and a referee enforced rules, an investigator recorded runners' pulse rates for a study.
items.note: 此处指开展研究并记录数据的研究人员。

items.src: Blue circles represent foods on the nutrition chart, whose columns classify them by type, bars contrast calcium levels and numbers order them by price.
items.para: Columns group foods by type, bars compare calcium levels and numbers rank foods by price on the nutrition chart, where blue circles stand for foods.
items.note: 此处指图中符号代表某类事物。

items.src: Riverside streets become rather quiet after sunset, while temperatures fall a little, traffic becomes exceptionally light, and shops empty entirely.
items.para: After sunset, slightly cooler temperatures accompany extremely light traffic and completely empty shops, while riverside streets become quite quiet.
items.note: 两者在此都表示相当程度，而非极其或完全。

items.src: Furniture students progress from basic lectures on theory to practical workshops repairing chairs, before attempting courses designed for experienced restorers.
items.para: Before taking advanced courses, furniture students repair chairs in hands-on workshops, having first attended introductory lectures covering theoretical material.
items.note: 两者都指通过亲自动手操作来学习的。

items.src: Councillors described better drainage as a crying need, rejecting suggestions that it was merely a future aspiration, provisional idea, or nonessential upgrade.
items.para: Better drainage was an urgent requirement, councillors insisted, not a long-term ambition, tentative proposal, or optional improvement as others had suggested.
items.note: 两者都表示亟须满足的迫切需求。

items.src: Our laboratory for food analysis adjoins rooms for storing samples and holding staff meetings, while a room for treating patients occupies another building.
items.para: A medical treatment room occupies another building; our scientific testing room for food adjoins the sample storage room and staff meeting room.
items.note: 此处指用于科学检测食品的实验室。

items.src: Coding mentors help teach beginners, evaluate their progress, and fix their mistakes, but also encourage these learners whenever repeated failures undermine their confidence.
items.para: Besides helping to instruct beginners, assess their progress, and correct their mistakes, coding mentors hearten these learners whenever repeated failures damage their confidence.
items.note: 两者在此都指鼓舞他人，使其恢复信心。

items.src: Reviewers called the explorer's six-week island survival an unbelievable achievement, rather than the expected, unremarkable, or unsatisfactory outcome some readers had anticipated.
items.para: Some readers had anticipated a predictable, ordinary, or disappointing outcome, but reviewers described the explorer's six-week survival on an island as astonishing.
items.note: 两者在此都表示令人极其惊叹的。

items.src: Researchers gave their initial explanation a slim chance of proving correct, judging its prospects neither middling nor strong, but not entirely nonexistent either.
items.para: Neither moderate nor high, the likelihood that the researchers' initial explanation would prove correct was judged low, although it was not zero.
items.note: 两者在此都表示可能性很小，但并非为零。

items.src: Organisers authorised the beach cleanup planned for Saturday morning, while moving the picnic to a later date and calling off the concert.
items.para: The beach cleanup scheduled for Saturday morning was approved by organisers, while the picnic was postponed and the concert cancelled.
items.note: 两者在此都表示活动已安排在某个时间举行。

items.src: Alongside trains running each day, guided walks every week, and lectures each month, the mountain railway offers an annual photography excursion in October.
items.para: October brings the mountain railway's yearly photography excursion, supplementing its daily trains, weekly guided walks, and monthly lectures.
items.note: 两者都表示每年一次的。

items.src: The pharmacist explained that this painkiller relieves headaches rather than inducing sleep, fighting bacterial infections, or increasing alertness like the other three medicines.
items.para: Unlike the sedative, antibiotic, and stimulant, which respectively induce sleep, fight bacterial infections, and increase alertness, this analgesic relieves headaches, the pharmacist explained.
items.note: 两者都指用于缓解疼痛的药物。

items.src: Festival organisers question applicants before they select volunteers, who then receive instruction and work under the organisers' oversight.
items.para: Before they choose volunteers, festival planners interview applicants; afterwards, they train the successful candidates and supervise their work.
items.note: 此处指从申请者中挑选志愿者。

items.src: Despite contrasting soils and comparable rainfall, our woodland survey found a connection between fallen trees and beetle diversity that was not accidental.
items.para: Our forest survey found a nonaccidental relationship between fallen trees and beetle diversity, despite a soil difference and rainfall similarity, ruling out coincidence.
items.note: 此处指倒木与甲虫多样性之间的关联。

items.src: A central pottery workshop shares a van with a neighboring bakery, whose coastal branch serves distant villages.
items.para: With its coastal branch supplying distant villages, a bakery nearby shares a van with a pottery workshop in a central location.
items.note: 此处指面包店位于陶艺作坊附近。

items.src: Two furniture firms plan to combine purchasing operations rather than enlarge them, divide them, or shut them down.
items.para: For their purchasing operations, the plan agreed by two furniture firms is to merge them, not expand, separate or close them.
items.note: 此处指将两家公司的采购业务合并。

items.src: Leila considers the garden ideal for rehearsal, the lounge merely adequate, the kitchen inappropriate, and the attic awkward to use.
items.para: For rehearsal, Leila finds the lounge merely acceptable, the kitchen unsuitable, and the attic inconvenient, but the garden perfect.
items.note: 此处指花园非常适合排练，是理想场所。

items.src: Mara packed her nightgown beneath her robe, leaving her underdress and underskirt hanging in the wardrobe at home.
items.para: Leaving her slip and petticoat hanging in the wardrobe at home, Mara packed her nightdress underneath her dressing gown.
items.note: 两词都指睡觉时穿的睡裙。

items.src: Before painting, the artist filled a bucket rather than a washbowl with water, reserving a pitcher and glass pot for paint.
items.para: A jug and glass jar were reserved for paint, while the artist filled a pail, not a basin, with water before painting.
items.note: 此处两词都指用来装水的桶。

items.src: The coach called poor footwork the source of instability, swaying its sign, falling its result, and balance practice its solution.
items.para: For instability, the coach identified swaying as a symptom, falling as a consequence, balance practice as a remedy, and poor footwork as the cause.
items.note: 此处指造成身体不稳的原因。

items.src: Patients found the nurses' explanations comforting and the scan free of pain, but described waiting as stressful and travelling home as exhausting.
items.para: Although patients described waiting as anxiety-inducing and travelling home as exhausting, they found the nurses' explanations reassuring and the scan painless.
items.note: 此处指等待让患者产生焦虑。

items.src: City measurements prove that tree shade reduces summer temperatures; earlier models merely forecast this effect, while preliminary observations hinted at it without challenging it.
items.para: Earlier models predicted cooling from tree shade, and preliminary observations suggested rather than questioned it; city measurements conclusively establish this summer temperature reduction.
items.note: 此处指通过测量证据确凿地证实。

items.src: Children clean the classroom and reposition its furniture before they decorate it with paper butterflies, while teachers check the finished room.
items.para: Teachers inspect the finished classroom after children clean it, rearrange its furniture, and adorn it with paper butterflies.
items.note: 两者都指添加饰物，使环境更美观。

items.src: Reserve rules make shell collecting illegal, encourage photography, discourage swimming, and allow diving only when someone supervises it.
items.para: Photography is officially encouraged, swimming is generally discouraged, and diving is permitted with supervision, but collecting shells is against the law under reserve rules.
items.note: 指违反法律，而非仅不受鼓励或受到限制。

items.src: Although the kettle's appearance has changed considerably, its basic function, the amount it holds, and its efficiency in using energy remain unchanged.
items.para: The kettle retains its basic purpose, storage capacity, and energy efficiency despite considerable changes to its outward look.
items.note: 指物品的外观，不是功能、容量或能效。

items.src: Yesterday's trial showed that the translator worked perfectly and quickly without human help, although it occasionally paused while processing speech.
items.para: Despite operating with occasional pauses yesterday, the translator processed speech at high speed, without human assistance and without error in the trial.
items.note: 此处指运行毫无差错，不表示速度或自主性。

items.src: The producer demanded proper checks of historical claims before release, rejecting initial reviews that had been shallow and hurried.
items.para: Having rejected preliminary reviews as superficial and rushed, the producer required adequate checks of historical claims before release.
items.note: 此处指核查充分到位，达到应有标准。

items.src: The tutor combines private thought with dialog between partners to expose reasoning flaws, then provides teaching before students practise their presentations.
items.para: Reflection and conversation between partners help reveal reasoning flaws; the tutor then offers instruction before students begin rehearsal for their presentations.
items.note: 指参与者之间的对话交流。

items.src: The guide speaks softly beside nesting birds, but delivers safety instructions slowly and distinctly before departure, summarising them in few words.
items.para: Beside nesting birds, the guide talks quietly; before departure, they deliver safety instructions slowly and clearly, summarising them briefly.
items.note: 此处指说话音量轻，不指语速或时长。

items.src: The centre's boat display is permanent, whereas its photo exhibition lasts briefly, its garden show opens seasonally, and its craft exhibits change often.
items.para: The centre's photo exhibition is only temporary, its garden show strictly seasonal, and its craft exhibits frequently replaced, but its boat display is there to stay.
items.note: 指会一直保留，而非临时或定期更换。

items.src: Medieval town records describe archers practising before a public skill display, then entering a contest for a silver cup awarded at a formal celebratory ceremony.
items.para: Archery practice before a public demonstration and a subsequent competition for a silver cup presented at a formal celebratory ceremony feature in medieval town records.
items.note: 指以获胜为目标的比赛。

items.src: Organisers published the agreed festival timetable instead of the first suggestion, the version still causing disagreement, or the option later removed from consideration.
items.para: Organisers published the mutually accepted festival schedule, rejecting the initially proposed timetable, the still disputed version, and the subsequently withdrawn option.
items.note: 指已获各方共同接受、商定的。

items.src: Unlike the photograph, prose account and table of measurements, the diagram in the guide illustrates water movement between an oak's roots and leaves.
items.para: Water movement between an oak's roots and leaves is illustrated by the guide's schematic drawing, unlike its photograph, written description and data table.
items.note: 此处指解释树木水分流动过程的示意图。

items.src: Vineyard workers are reminded that moisturising products, insect repellents and cleansing lotions cannot replace sunblock when they pick grapes in afternoon sunshine.
items.para: For grape picking in afternoon sunshine, vineyard workers receive reminders that sunscreen cannot be replaced by moisturiser, insect repellent or cleansing lotion.
items.note: 两者在此均指涂抹于皮肤的防晒产品。

items.src: Leila stores her entire scarf inventory in a bedroom closet rather than a drawer, trunk or set of shelves, avoiding commercial storage fees.
items.para: To avoid commercial storage fees, Leila keeps all her scarf stock in a bedroom cupboard rather than a drawer, storage chest or shelving unit.
items.note: 此处两者都指卧室里用于储物的柜子。

items.src: Mina revised the heading above the booklet's breathing exercise but left the image label, introductory paragraph and final summary unchanged.
items.para: The booklet's picture caption, opening paragraph and closing summary remained unchanged, although Mina revised the section title above its breathing exercise.
items.note: 此处指呼吸练习上方的章节标题。

items.src: Ancient pollen measurements provide the basis for the rainfall reconstruction, while flood concerns motivate it, scarce funding restricts it, and a map results.
items.para: Flood concerns supply motivation, scarce funding creates a limitation, and a map is the outcome; ancient pollen measurements provide the rainfall reconstruction's foundation.
items.note: 此处指重建降雨情况所依据的证据基础。

items.src: Our theatre will employ three costume makers for the summer festival after interviewing them, then provide training and oversee their work.
items.para: After staff interview three costume makers, our theatre will hire them for the summer festival, then train them and supervise their work.
items.note: 此处两者都指雇用人员从事工作。

items.src: The archery coach said sight helps judge distance, hearing detects instructions, balance maintains posture, and coordinated movement guides an arrow's release.
items.para: The archery coach linked coordination to releasing arrows, balance to posture, and hearing to receiving instructions, adding that vision helps estimate distance.
items.note: 此处两者都指看见事物的视觉能力。

items.src: Technicians will install automatic doors at the clinic, examine them for faults, alter their settings if necessary, and keep them working afterward.
items.para: For the clinic, technicians will fit automatic doors, then inspect them for faults, adjust their settings if necessary, and maintain them afterward.
items.note: 此处指将自动门安装到位以供使用。

items.src: Repeated advertising announcements annoy nearby residents rather than scare or puzzle them, although the same messages entertain some shoppers on the street.
items.para: Repeated advertising announcements amuse some shoppers on the street, but irritate nearby residents rather than frighten or confuse them.
items.note: 两者都指使人感到烦躁，而非恐惧或困惑。

items.src: Dance applicants must attend a check-up in their first week; this does not replace their fitness test, vaccination visit or physiotherapy appointment.
items.para: A fitness assessment, vaccination appointment and physiotherapy session remain necessary for dance applicants, alongside the medical examination they must attend in their first week.
items.note: 此处指评估身体健康状况的医学检查。

items.src: Housing staff felt stressed rather than physically drained or disheartened as applications increased, but became calm again when extra workers arrived.
items.para: Rising applications left housing employees under strain rather than exhausted or discouraged, though additional workers helped them feel relaxed again.
items.note: 此处指因工作负担而感到心理压力大。

items.src: Mina found cooking with her daughter enjoyable despite its tiring nature, and considered it instructive for her daughter even when tasks became repetitive.
items.para: Although cooking together was tiring and sometimes repetitive, Mina found it pleasant herself and considered it educational for her daughter.
items.note: 两者都指活动令人愉快、带来乐趣。

items.src: Researchers tested sweat for chemical changes after exercise, choosing it over samples from the mouth or bladder because collecting blood required needles.
items.para: Because blood collection required needles, researchers chose perspiration rather than saliva or urine to test for chemical changes after exercise.
items.note: 两者均指皮肤排出的汗液。

items.src: The producer requested one particular recording, rejecting a chance selection or a typical example, and insisted that her choice was final.
items.para: Rejecting a random selection and a representative example, the producer requested a specific recording and stressed that her choice was not provisional.
items.note: 此处指明确指定的某一个，而非随意选择。

items.src: An initial assumption can lead researchers towards false conclusions, while unexpected results may bewilder them, repeated checks comfort them, and interruptions divert their attention.
items.para: Unexpected results may confuse researchers, repeated checks reassure them, and interruptions distract them, while a starting assumption can guide them towards false conclusions.
items.note: 此处指将研究者引向某种结论。

items.src: Some coastal hotels ignore turtle warnings, while others challenge their validity, misunderstand their meaning, or follow them by switching off beach lights.
items.para: Some coastal hotels question or misinterpret turtle warnings; others disregard them, whereas still others obey them by turning off beach lights.
items.note: 两者都指不理会、不加以重视。

items.src: Leila regularly visited village markets for fresh food, stopped at bakeries now and then, seldom entered restaurants, and avoided roadside stalls entirely.
items.para: For fresh food, Leila visited village markets frequently, bakeries occasionally, and restaurants rarely, but she never stopped at roadside stalls.
items.note: 此处指经常发生，而非按固定间隔发生。

items.src: Engineers considered fortress repairs urgent because the settlement was exposed, although restoration would be expensive and difficult, while decorative improvements remained a choice.
items.para: Restoring the fortress would be costly and complicated but, engineers believed, was pressing because the settlement was exposed; decorative improvements, however, remained optional.
items.note: 两者均指事情紧迫，需要尽快处理。

items.src: With volunteers guiding them, children shorten ribbons, double them over, and fasten them to hats before detaching them after the parade.
items.para: Guided by volunteers, children trim and fold ribbons in half before they secure them to hats, then remove them once the parade ends.
items.note: 此处均指把丝带牢固地固定在帽子上。

items.src: A squirrel's tail helps it maintain balance on a narrow branch as it advances, before it reverses direction and leaps to the ground.
items.para: Using its tail to remain steady on a narrow branch, a squirrel proceeds to move forward, turn around and jump down to the ground.
items.note: 此处均指保持身体平稳，避免失去平衡。

items.src: The workshop prioritised security over ease of access and convenience, installing electronic locks to prevent theft rather than protect workers' privacy.
items.para: To prevent theft, the workshop installed electronic locks, prioritising protection over accessibility and convenience rather than safeguarding workers' privacy.
items.note: 此处指防止盗窃的安全保障。

items.src: A retailer's personality can matter more to customers than physical looks, professional knowledge or reputation, the business adviser explained.
items.para: The business adviser explained that customers can value a retailer's character more than appearance, expertise or reputation.
items.note: 此处指人的性格，而非外貌、专长或声誉。

items.src: The chess captain accepted defeat in the final after an opening win and a tied match, never considering withdrawal.
items.para: Following an opening victory and a draw, the chess captain accepted a loss in the final without ever contemplating withdrawal.
items.note: 此处指比赛失利，不是平局或退赛。

items.src: Researchers estimated the glacier's retreat from a single shot, rejecting a hand-drawn view, a geographical chart and a schematic illustration as insufficiently accurate.
items.para: A sketch, a map and a diagram lacked sufficient accuracy, so researchers used one photograph to estimate how far the glacier had retreated.
items.note: 此处指用相机拍摄的照片。

items.src: The exhibition traces woodblock printing's global influence, showing how a village craft expanded across its region and country before reaching other continents.
items.para: Tracing woodblock printing's worldwide influence, the exhibition follows its development from a local craft through regional and national expansion to other continents.
items.note: 指遍及世界的，而非地方、地区或全国的。

items.src: The coach's complaint about missing evening sessions accompanied compliments for staff, a proposal for weekend training and an apology for arriving late.
items.para: Alongside praise for staff, a suggestion for weekend training and an apology for lateness, the coach expressed a grievance about absent evening sessions.
items.note: 此处指对缺少晚间训练的不满。

items.src: Clinic records show increasing demand for sleep consultations despite declining attendance, unchanged fees and staffing levels that vary from week to week.
items.para: Despite falling attendance, stable fees and fluctuating staffing levels, clinic records indicate rising demand for sleep consultations.
items.note: 指需求正在增长，与下降、稳定或波动不同。

items.src: Archaeologists will inspect the marketplace before they dig beneath it for medieval foundations, then take pictures of any remains and repair them.
items.para: Before archaeologists excavate beneath the marketplace for medieval foundations, they will survey it; only after excavation will they photograph and restore any remains.
items.note: 此处指挖掘地下以寻找遗迹。

items.src: The college cafeteria serves vegetarian lunches made in an adjoining cooking area, using ingredients from its storage room and bread from a nearby bakehouse.
items.para: An adjoining kitchen prepares vegetarian lunches for the college canteen, drawing ingredients from its storeroom and bread from a nearby bakery.
items.note: 此处指供应学院师生用餐的食堂。

items.src: Council rules require factories to separate waste liquid from fine dry particles, thick muddy residue and broken masonry before dispatching it for treatment.
items.para: Before sending waste fluid for treatment, factories must separate it from powder, sludge and rubble under council rules.
items.note: 此处指液态废物，与粉末、污泥和碎石区分。

items.src: Mei hums the tune while her teacher assesses its rhythmic pattern, accompanying chords, and speed for tomorrow's performance.
items.para: While Mei hums the melody, her teacher evaluates its rhythm, harmony, and tempo in preparation for the following day's performance.
items.note: 此处曲调就是哼唱的旋律，不是节奏或速度。

items.src: Engineers programmed a backward movement after obstacle detection, rather than movement towards the front, to either side, or vertically upwards.
items.para: After obstacle detection, the engineers' program specified rearward motion rather than forward, sideways, or upward movement.
items.note: 两者均指朝后方的移动方向。

items.src: Climbers recorded faster breathing at higher altitudes, but reported no changes in food digestion, blood flow, or sweating.
items.para: Faster respiration was recorded by climbers at higher altitudes, but they reported no changes in digestion, circulation, or perspiration.
items.note: 两者都指空气进出肺部的呼吸过程。

items.src: Participants viewed each photograph equally long and remembered a celebrity better than a good friend, an unknown individual, or a remote family member.
items.para: With equal viewing time per photograph, participants recalled a famous person better than a close friend, an unfamiliar stranger, or a distant relative.
items.note: 名人指广为人知的人，不等于私人熟人。

items.src: Ecologists found frog losses related to pesticide exposure, not necessarily resulting from it, confined to rice fields, or unaffected by rainfall.
items.para: Frog declines were not necessarily caused by pesticide exposure, restricted to rice fields, or independent of rainfall, though ecologists found them linked to that exposure.
items.note: 两者表示存在联系，并不必然表示因果。

items.src: Our paper map was legible, inexpensive, and lightweight, but recent street renaming made it useless for navigating the old town.
items.para: Recent street renaming left our paper map of no help around the old town, although easy to read, cheap to buy, and light to carry.
items.note: 此处无用指地图无法帮助辨路。

items.src: Nineteenth-century diaries distinguish the annual harbour carnival, featuring masked dancers and brass bands, from commercial exhibitions, athletic competitions, and worship gatherings.
items.para: Featuring masked dancers and brass bands, the annual harbour street festival appears in nineteenth-century diaries as distinct from a trade fair, sports contest, or religious service.
items.note: 此处指有面具舞者和铜管乐队的街头庆典。

items.src: Amina selected the upside-down photograph for correction, leaving those displayed the right way up, at an angle, or on their sides untouched.
items.para: Leaving the upright, tilted, and sideways photographs untouched, Amina chose the inverted image as the one to correct.
items.note: 两者均指图片上端朝下的倒置状态。

items.src: Rangers carry gasoline for their motorboat, while the truck burns diesel fuel, the lamps consume paraffin, and the stove runs on bottled propane.
items.para: Their truck burns diesel, their lamps consume kerosene, and their stove runs on bottled propane, while rangers carry petrol for their motorboat.
items.note: 两者都指汽油，分别常用于美式和英式英语。

items.src: Maya identified the pond creature as an insect, rejecting her classmates' suggestions that it was aquatic vegetation, a fungal organism, or a bacterium.
items.para: Although her classmates suggested a plant, fungus, or bacterial cell, Maya identified the animal from the pond as an insect.
items.note: 此处生物特指动物，与植物、真菌和细菌相区别。

items.src: The bakery owner must copy the spreadsheet before editing, then delete obsolete prices, revise current figures, and keep the original formulas.
items.para: Before editing, the bakery owner must copy the spreadsheet; the subsequent required tasks are to remove outdated prices, update current figures, and retain original formulas.
items.note: 此处两者都指从表格中删除数据。

items.src: Our workshop makes recognising anxiety the starting stage, followed by a middle breathing stage, a concluding review, and a later optional discussion.
items.para: Our workshop progresses from an initial anxiety recognition stage through an intermediate breathing stage to a final review, with a subsequent optional discussion.
items.note: 两者都表示过程最初的阶段。

items.src: Besides measuring sea temperatures, researchers collect plankton before sunrise, despite rough seas, instead of counting fish.
items.para: Before dawn, scientists gather plankton in addition to measuring ocean temperatures, despite choppy waters, rather than counting fish.
items.note: 两者都表示除某项活动外还做另一项。

items.src: Curator Amira will split the photographs into three groups by decade, label each group, and exhibit them separately rather than merge them.
items.para: Instead of choosing to combine the photographs, curator Amira will divide them into three groups by decade, label each group, and display them separately.
items.note: 两者都指把照片划分成若干组。

items.src: The cycling club considered helmets essential, repairs money well spent, and debt burdensome, but regarded a private pool as a luxury.
items.para: For the cycling club, a private pool was a nonessential treat, helmets a basic necessity, repairs a practical investment, and debt a financial burden.
items.note: 两者都指令人享受但并非必需的事物。

items.src: The nurse said rehabilitation would involve daily stretching, omit running, advise swimming, and take the place of medication.
items.para: As the nurse explained, rehabilitation would replace medication and include daily stretching; it would exclude running but recommend swimming.
items.note: 此处表示康复方案包含每日拉伸。

items.src: Bench placement can influence visit length without completely controlling it, while researchers use sensors to time visits and models to forecast their duration.
items.para: Researchers measure visit length with sensors and predict it using models; bench placement can affect that length without completely being able to determine it.
items.note: 两者都表示产生影响，并非完全决定。

items.src: The teacher used the ceramic bird as a decoration, not for lessons, holding papers down, or rewarding pupils.
items.para: Instead of serving as a teaching aid, a paperweight, or a prize, the ceramic bird was used by the teacher as an ornament.
items.note: 两者都指用于美化环境的装饰品。

items.src: A ministry team handles grant management, while other departments provide the money, assess the scheme, and publicise it.
items.para: Funding, evaluation, and promotion of the grant scheme fall to other departments, while a ministry team takes responsibility for its administration.
items.note: 两者都指组织处理项目事务的管理工作。

items.src: I returned the gardening gloves because their fingers were too tight, although their cuffs were loose and the material was neither rigid nor thick.
items.para: Despite loose cuffs and material that was neither stiff nor thick, the gardening gloves were too close-fitting around my fingers, so I returned them.
items.note: 两者都指紧贴身体，此处表示手套过紧。

items.src: A sailor secured ropes while a harbour guide directed the vessel, an underwater worker checked its hull, and a passenger watched the rope work.
items.para: While a pilot guided the ship and a diver inspected its hull, a passenger watched a seafarer secure the ropes.
items.note: 两者在此都指在船上工作的海员。

items.src: The well-dressed merchant lends a coat to his shabbily clothed assistant, who remains informally dressed despite now being bundled against the cold.
items.para: A coat lent by the elegantly attired merchant leaves his shabbily clothed assistant warmly wrapped but still casually attired.
items.note: 两者都表示衣着考究、穿戴雅致。

items.src: A grown-up must accompany the teenage participant to climbing practice, while the family's baby and child just learning to walk stay home.
items.para: The family's infant and toddler stay home, while an adult must accompany the teenager to climbing practice.
items.note: 两者作名词时都指成年人。

items.src: Surveyors found a hidden pipe behind reeds; it was clogged rather than physically harmed, and removing the vegetation left it openly visible.
items.para: Removing reeds left the concealed pipe exposed; surveyors had found it behind this vegetation and established that it was blocked rather than damaged.
items.note: 两者在此都表示被遮挡而看不见。

items.src: Cable-car noises can frighten visitors, although guides' explanations may ease their worries, repeated announcements may irritate them, and jokes may entertain them.
items.para: Guides' explanations may reassure visitors, repeated announcements may annoy them, and jokes may amuse them, although cable-car noises can scare them.
items.note: 两者都是及物动词，表示使人害怕。

items.src: The buyer inspected the porcelain before paying its owner, while the middleman arranged transport with the person responsible for delivery.
items.para: While the broker arranged transport with the carrier, the purchaser examined the porcelain before paying the seller.
items.note: 两者都指购买商品的人。

items.src: Engineers use aerial photographs to identify damaged road sections before examining them on site, determining their dimensions, and carrying out repairs.
items.para: Before they inspect road sections on site, measure them, and repair the damage, engineers use aerial photographs to pinpoint the affected sections.
items.note: 两者在此都指准确找出受损路段。

items.src: Maya paid the walk's fee, contributed extra money voluntarily, and left security for borrowed binoculars, receiving her admission money back when rain cancelled everything.
items.para: After paying the walk's charge, making a donation, and leaving a deposit for borrowed binoculars, Maya received an admission refund because rain cancelled everything.
items.note: 两者在此都指参加活动需支付的费用。

items.src: Leila wanted to consider the relocation proposal's recommendations rather than reject the proposal outright, delay deliberation, or immediately follow its recommendations.
items.para: Faced with the relocation proposal, Leila preferred to weigh up its recommendations, not rule out the proposal, put off deliberation or immediately act on it.
items.note: 两者在此都表示认真考虑、权衡方案。

items.src: Unusually high promised returns made Sara uncomfortable, although her brother felt assured, her sister felt enthusiastic, and her cousin showed no interest.
items.para: Although her brother felt confident, her sister was excited, and her cousin remained indifferent, Sara felt uneasy about the unusually high promised returns.
items.note: 两者在此都表示心里不安。

items.src: Hikers passed a shallow rocky refuge and a tight mountain corridor before exploring a cave beside a disused mine shaft.
items.para: After passing a shallow rock shelter and narrow mountain passage, hikers explored a natural underground chamber beside an abandoned mining shaft.
items.note: 此处指天然形成的地下洞穴。

items.src: Our laboratory will explore how temperature affects algae growth, documenting and releasing the results rather than forecasting them.
items.para: Our laboratory will investigate temperature's effects on algae growth rather than predict the results, then record and publish its findings.
items.note: 此处指研究、探究温度产生的影响。

items.src: The photographer will edit the captions for clarity before translating them, producing paper copies and putting them on show.
items.para: To make the captions clearer, the photographer will revise them first, then translate, print and display them.
items.note: 此处指修改现有文字，使表达更清楚。

items.src: The coach insists athletes must recover fully, not merely partly, before training again, whether recovery happens rapidly or little by little.
items.para: Whether athletes recover quickly or gradually, their coach insists they must recover completely rather than partially before resuming training.
items.note: 此处表示完全恢复，而非只恢复一部分。

items.src: Guests are able to swim and permitted to borrow bicycles, but they ought to rest regularly and are required to obey safety rules.
items.para: Although guests can swim and may borrow bicycles, they should take regular breaks and must follow safety rules.
items.note: 此处表示建议应该做，而非能力、许可或强制。

items.src: Servers cover each table with cloth, place mats beneath plates and drinks on small protective pads, then give each guest a linen napkin.
items.para: Once a tablecloth covers each table, a placemat supports each plate and a coaster holds each drink, servers give every guest a linen serviette.
items.note: 两者都指用餐时使用的餐巾。

items.src: Amina's tutor called her brave, not rash, for giving her first presentation despite feeling nervous and initially being reluctant to begin.
items.para: Although anxious and initially hesitant, Amina gave her first presentation, leading her tutor to describe her as courageous rather than reckless.
items.note: 此处指虽然害怕，仍有勇气采取行动。

items.src: The application system is obviously confusing, not just potentially difficult, despite claims that it is simple and expectations that it is probably reliable.
items.para: Although supposedly simple and likely reliable, the application system is clearly confusing, rather than possibly difficult.
items.note: 此处表示结论显然成立，而非推测或传闻。

items.src: Soup preparation takes roughly forty minutes, with precisely ten for chopping, no fewer than twenty for simmering and no more than five for washing.
items.para: With exactly ten minutes for chopping, at least twenty for simmering and at most five for washing, soup preparation takes approximately forty minutes.
items.note: 此处表示时间大约为该数值，并非精确值。

items.src: Our coding club's monthly get-together lets members chat about games after practical training, a formal talk and a contest in programming.
items.para: Following a training workshop, formal lecture and programming competition, our coding club holds its monthly informal gathering for members to chat about games.
items.note: 此处指供成员轻松交谈的非正式聚会。

items.src: The editor instructed reporters to check sources first; secondly, revise headlines; simultaneously, assistants would prepare photographs; lastly, everyone would review the layout.
items.para: Reporters were instructed by the editor to verify sources first and revise headlines next; meanwhile, assistants would prepare photographs; finally, everyone would review the layout.
items.note: 此处表示按顺序接着进行第二项工作。

items.src: The rowing club pays for boat transportation to the lake, but not for keeping boats there, servicing them, or checking their condition.
items.para: Boat storage, maintenance and inspection are excluded from the rowing club's payments, which cover only delivery to the lake.
items.note: 此处都指将船只运送到湖边。

items.src: Although experts predicted deterioration or instability after pesticide restrictions, river tests showed an improvement in water quality rather than the expected absence of change.
items.para: River tests following pesticide restrictions revealed progress in water quality, not expected stagnation, despite experts having predicted either decline or fluctuation.
items.note: 两者在此均指水质向好的方向变化。

items.src: Our guide will define accessibility, illustrate it, challenge its usefulness and suggest substitutes for the term before we leave for the island.
items.para: Before our island departure, our guide will explain the meaning of accessibility, give examples of it, question the usefulness of it and recommend alternatives to the term.
items.note: 指说明一个术语的含义。
