items.src: Yesterday's spotlight incident interrupted rehearsal; the stoppage resulted from neither a planned break, a routine safety check nor an evacuation drill.
items.para: Yesterday's rehearsal stopped because of an unexpected event involving a spotlight, not a scheduled interruption, safety inspection or practice evacuation.
items.note: 此处指聚光灯引发的意外事件。

items.src: Visitors praised the richness of sporting traditions at the festival, rather than their widespread appeal, high status or ancient origins.
items.para: What festival visitors praised about the sporting traditions was their diversity, rather than their popularity, prestige or antiquity.
items.note: 此处指体育传统丰富多样，而非声望或历史悠久。

items.src: Nurses assessed the thermometer's reliability through consistently accurate readings, rather than its ease of transport, low cost or responsiveness to tiny changes.
items.para: Consistently accurate measurements helped nurses assess the thermometer's dependability, rather than its portability, affordability or sensitivity to tiny changes.
items.note: 指仪器持续准确工作的可靠性。

items.src: Planners relate shop closures to rising rents; their report also forecasts and records closures but offers no explanation for rent increases.
items.para: Their report does predict and document shop closures but does not explain rent increases; planners link the closures to rising rents.
items.note: 此处指把商店倒闭与租金上涨联系起来。

items.src: College examiners enforce kitchen safety rules strictly, rejecting selective application, occasional enforcement and a forgiving approach to protect trainee chefs.
items.para: To protect trainee chefs, college examiners enforce kitchen safety rules rigorously, never selectively, occasionally or leniently.
items.note: 指严格执行规则，不宽松、不打折扣。

items.src: Budget cuts threaten document preservation at the archives, rather than merely postponing it or making it harder, although they do not stop it entirely.
items.para: Although budget cuts do not prevent document preservation at the archives, they endanger it rather than merely delay or complicate it.
items.note: 指使保存工作面临危险，并非已经完全阻止。

items.src: The baker recommended a ten-minute interval before slicing cooled bread, without specifying how long baking lasted or when it began and ended.
items.para: Without specifying baking's duration, starting time or finishing time, the baker recommended a ten-minute gap before slicing the cooled bread.
items.note: 此处指切面包前等待的时间间隔。

items.src: A monster appearing in the headset made some volunteers shiver, while others recoiled, became motionless, or cried out in fear.
items.para: Volunteers reacted differently to the headset monster: some began to flinch, freeze, or scream, while others started to tremble with fear.
items.note: 此处指因恐惧而不由自主地发抖。

items.src: The producer said website graphics clarified election results, while titles introduced topics, written analyses explained trends, and audio clips supplied interviews.
items.para: Headlines introduced topics, written commentaries explained trends, and audio recordings supplied interviews; the producer said the website's visuals made election results clearer.
items.note: 此处指帮助传达信息的图像材料。

items.src: Retired engineer Mei treats puzzle solving as a pastime, not an obligation or paid profession, and avoids competitions.
items.para: For retired engineer Mei, solving puzzles is neither a duty nor an occupation but a hobby; she avoids taking part in a contest.
items.note: 此处指闲暇时为获得乐趣而做的活动。

items.src: The new expressway split the wetland, cutting otters off from feeding grounds; the train line, walking trail and bicycle route had not.
items.para: Otters lost access to feeding grounds when the new motorway divided the wetland; the railway, footpath and cycleway had not split it.
items.note: 此处两者都指供机动车高速行驶的公路。

items.src: Guests value the mountain lodge's quietness above its freedom from observation, physical ease and spotless condition, because traffic noise never reaches the valley.
items.para: Traffic noise never reaches the valley, so guests prize the mountain lodge's tranquillity more than its privacy, comfort or cleanliness.
items.note: 此处指没有交通噪声干扰的宁静。

items.src: The guide described the royal wedding as a public affair, distinguishing it from the private practice session, celebratory gathering and ceremonial march.
items.para: The royal wedding was a public event, the guide explained, distinguishing it from the private rehearsal, reception and procession.
items.note: 此处指一场活动，而非私情或事务。

items.src: Editors chose a chatty style for the community newsletter, rejecting stiff language, specialist terminology and jokes to make project reports welcoming.
items.para: To make community project reports welcoming, newsletter editors preferred a conversational style over alternatives that were formal, technical or humorous.
items.note: 此处指像日常交谈一样轻松自然的文风。

items.src: Researchers distinguished lasting woodland damage from short-lived effects, instant responses and repeated symptoms when assessing the consequences of drought.
items.para: Assessing drought consequences, researchers separated temporary effects, immediate responses and recurrent symptoms from enduring damage to the woodland.
items.note: 此处指损害持续很长时间，而非反复出现。

items.src: The costume designer handles multiple projects simultaneously; her assistant manages a single project, the intern has zero assignments, and their manager reviews every commission.
items.para: While her assistant manages one project and the intern has no assignments, the costume designer handles several projects concurrently; their manager reviews all commissions.
items.note: 此处表示同时处理好几个项目。

items.src: After foreign buyers discovered island baskets, analysts called production growth spectacular, rejecting descriptions suggesting limited gains, inconsistent progress or slow expansion.
items.para: Analysts rejected modest, uneven and gradual as descriptions of production growth after foreign buyers discovered island baskets, calling it exceptionally impressive instead.
items.note: 此处指增长极为显著，令人惊叹。

items.src: A resident helped a guest find village accommodation, while someone travelling to work gave a sightseer directions to the station.
items.para: A commuter directed a tourist to the station, while an inhabitant helped a visitor find accommodation in the village.
items.note: 两者都指在某地居住的人。

items.src: Researchers chose to gamble on the sensor rather than await evidence about it, reject its use, or look for alternatives.
items.para: Researchers declined to seek alternatives to the sensor, rule out using it, or wait for evidence on it, choosing to take a chance on it.
items.note: 两者都表示冒险选择或尝试某物。

items.src: Some families inhabit these valleys, while traders cross them, newcomers establish homes nearby, and younger people relocate farther away.
items.para: Traders travel through the valleys that some families live in, while newcomers settle near them and younger people move beyond them.
items.note: 两者都表示居住于某个地方。

items.src: The skaters create their routines, rehearse them before competitions, present them to judges, and then make changes after receiving feedback.
items.para: Before competitions, the skaters practise routines they design themselves; they then perform them for judges and revise them in response to feedback.
items.note: 此处两者都指为正式表演事先排练。

items.src: Patients on the town's fringe travel to its central district for treatment, while researchers compare pollution inside the town and around it.
items.para: Treatment requires patients from the town's outskirts to visit its centre, while researchers compare pollution in its interior with pollution in its surroundings.
items.note: 此处两者都指城镇的外围地带。

items.src: The architect stressed the craziness of the shopping centre proposal, whereas the council focused on its cost, complicated design, and novelty.
items.para: Council members focused on the shopping centre proposal's expense, complexity, and originality, whereas the architect emphasised its absurdity.
items.note: 此处两者都指提议荒唐、不合情理。

items.src: These historians portray astronomers as careful observers, commend their patience, challenge their assumptions, and draw comparisons with modern researchers.
items.para: These historians compare astronomers with modern researchers and praise their patience; they also question their assumptions and depict them as careful observers.
items.note: 两者都表示描绘或描述人物形象。

items.src: The regulator distinguished bankrupt firms from financially stable ones, warning that businesses earning profits could still have considerable debts.
items.para: Businesses could be profitable yet heavily indebted, the regulator warned, distinguishing insolvent firms from financially stable ones.
items.note: 此处两者都表示无力偿还债务的。

items.src: Amina attributed losing her keys to misfortune, rejecting suggestions that inadequate preparation, carelessness, or someone deliberately interfering had caused the loss.
items.para: Rejecting poor planning, careless behaviour, and deliberate interference as explanations for her lost keys, Amina blamed bad luck.
items.note: 两者都指遭遇不顺的坏运气。

items.src: The engineer rejected the prototype because it was imperfect, not because it used obsolete technology, remained incomplete, or departed from conventional designs.
items.para: An unconventional design, outdated technology or an unfinished state did not explain the engineer's rejection of the prototype; being flawed did.
items.note: 两者都表示存在缺陷、不够完善的。

items.src: The pottery association's representative explained traditional glazing, while a consultant guided the festival coordinator and a translator assisted overseas visitors.
items.para: An adviser guided the festival organiser, and an interpreter helped foreign visitors, while the pottery association's spokesperson explained traditional glazing.
items.note: 此处指代表陶艺协会发言的人。

items.src: Puzzle solutions that were clear at first often became confusing, while seemingly clear answers were not always truly clear or clear throughout.
items.para: Apparently clear puzzle answers were not always genuinely or consistently clear, while initially clear solutions often became confusing.
items.note: 表示表面看来如此，实际未必。

items.src: Researchers revised the wording of recycling notices because readers found them confusing, preserving their visual arrangement, text length and friendly manner of addressing readers.
items.para: Readers found the recycling notices confusing, so researchers revised their phrasing while retaining their layout, length and friendly tone.
items.note: 指表达信息时使用的措辞。

items.src: Our initial island stop is the fishing village, followed by the lighthouse and finally the harbour, which we explored on an earlier visit.
items.para: We explored the harbour on a previous visit; this island tour's first stop is the fishing village, its next the lighthouse and its final the harbour.
items.note: 指本次行程顺序中的第一个。

items.src: Architecture trainees examine the library's exterior before its internal spaces, then compare its supporting base with the structure covering the building.
items.para: Before comparing the library's foundation with its roof, architecture trainees examine its outside and then its interior.
items.note: 此处指图书馆建筑的外部。

items.src: Volunteers made the festival successful with imaginative activities that participants could afford and easily join, encouraging cooperation rather than rivalry.
items.para: The festival succeeded because volunteers offered affordable, accessible and creative activities that were cooperative rather than competitive.
items.note: 两者都形容活动有创意、富于想象力。

items.src: Tourists may scare reef animals or drive them from their habitat, but stepping on coral can harm them, whereas keeping away can safeguard them.
items.para: Keeping away can protect reef animals; tourists may frighten or displace them, while stepping on coral can injure them.
items.note: 此处指使珊瑚礁中的动物身体受伤。

items.src: Amira detected a peculiar but weak smell in the flour store, unlike the disagreeable yet recognisable odour near the bakery bins.
items.para: Beside the bakery bins was an unpleasant but familiar odour, whereas Amira noticed a faint yet unusual smell in the flour store.
items.note: 此处形容气味奇怪、不寻常，而非浓烈。

items.src: After three consecutive nights reporting, the journalist requested leave because of exhaustion, not an urgent need for food or water or aching muscles.
items.para: Extreme tiredness, rather than severe hunger, intense thirst or muscle pain, prompted the journalist to request leave after reporting for three nights in succession.
items.note: 指极度疲劳，而非饥饿、口渴或肌肉疼痛。

items.src: The handbook identifies oversensitivity to criticism as a characteristic of anxiety, then discusses its origins, its effects and ways to relieve it.
items.para: After identifying oversensitivity to criticism as a feature of anxiety, the handbook discusses its cause, consequences and treatments.
items.note: 指焦虑的典型特征，不是病因、后果或疗法。

items.src: Although funds are scarce, technicians can preserve coral until June arrives provided that temperatures stay stable, because the laboratory has reliable equipment.
items.para: Technicians can preserve coral until June arrives on condition that temperatures remain constant, although funds are scarce, because the laboratory has dependable equipment.
items.note: 两者均引出某事得以实现的条件。

items.src: Amina's drawings are relatively simple beside her bronze sculptures, but their colours are exceptionally vivid, their proportions intentionally distorted, and their outlines invariably sharp.
items.para: With extremely vivid colours, deliberately distorted proportions and consistently sharp outlines, Amina's drawings remain comparatively simple beside her bronze sculptures.
items.note: 两者都表示与其他事物相比而言。

items.src: Archers watch flags flap as weather vanes turn, nearby trees rock from side to side, and clouds move slowly across the sky.
items.para: While weather vanes rotate, nearby trees sway and clouds drift across the sky, archers observe flags flutter.
items.note: 此处都指旗帜随风反复飘动。

items.src: Nurses said this sensor merely records sleep; others chiefly monitor breathing, measure pulse too, and go so far as to detect disorders.
items.para: Other devices mainly monitor breathing, also measure pulse and even detect disorders, whereas this sensor only records sleep, nurses explained.
items.note: 两者都表示仅仅，限定设备的功能。

items.src: The chief architect chose to resign for personal reasons instead of remaining in office, being temporarily absent, or transferring to another department.
items.para: For private reasons, the chief architect decided to step down rather than stay on, take leave or change departments.
items.note: 两者都指主动辞去所任职位。

items.src: Missing documents led to the college's rejection of Leila's scholarship application, rather than acceptance, a fresh review, or a delay in deciding.
items.para: Instead of approval, reconsideration or postponement, Leila's scholarship application received a refusal from the college because documents were missing.
items.note: 此处都指不接受申请的决定。

items.src: Customs dogs locate concealed fruit by its scent, without relying on its colouring, how it feels, or how it tastes.
items.para: Without relying on the colour, texture or flavour of concealed fruit, customs dogs locate it by its smell.
items.note: 此处都指水果散发的气味。

items.src: Karim's neighbours considered his refusal of a reward for returning the wallet noble, not foolish, motivated by self-interest, or lacking honesty.
items.para: To his neighbours, Karim's refusal of payment for returning the wallet seemed honourable rather than foolish, selfish or dishonest.
items.note: 两者都赞扬行为品德高尚、值得尊敬。

items.src: The engineer's comments imply that the battery is unreliable, without attempting to reject or establish this claim or account for the failures.
items.para: Without attempting to deny or confirm the claim or explain the failures, the engineer's comments suggest that the battery is unreliable.
items.note: 两者都指没有明说而间接暗示。

items.src: A loose microphone cable caused a brief interruption to the live interview, but neither delayed its start, prevented it altogether, nor ended it early.
items.para: The live interview suffered a brief stoppage from a loose microphone cable, not a delayed start, a cancellation or an early ending.
items.note: 此处指采访进行中的短暂中断。

items.src: Researchers compared memory under arctic conditions with results from mountainous, moderately warm and low-latitude tropical environments, finding the poorest recall in the far north.
items.para: Comparisons of memory across alpine, temperate, tropical and northern polar environments revealed the poorest recall in the last category, researchers found.
items.note: 此处指北极地区特有的环境条件。

items.src: Surveyors recorded a marked decline in beach litter, contrasting with a small harbour reduction that developed slowly and lasted only briefly.
items.para: Unlike the slight, gradual and temporary reduction in harbour waste, the decline in beach litter was clearly noticeable, surveyors reported.
items.note: 此处表示下降幅度明显、可察觉。

items.src: Opening the tunnel was a milestone rather than ordinary work, although a small reversal meant year-round valley travel remained a far-off aim.
items.para: Despite a minor setback leaving year-round valley travel a distant goal, opening the tunnel was a major step rather than a routine task.
items.note: 此处指发展过程中已经迈出的重要一步。

items.src: Archaeologists assigned an approximate age using pottery because the inscription's date was wrong and the maps gave unclear boundaries rather than exact ones.
items.para: Pottery supplied a rough age for archaeologists, since the inscribed date was erroneous and mapped boundaries were vague rather than exact.
items.note: 此处都表示年代大致确定，但并不精确。

items.src: Residents wanted to be truly included in decisions, not merely included in name, to a limited extent or for a short time.
items.para: Being nominally, partially or temporarily included in decisions was not enough for residents, who wanted to be genuinely involved.
items.note: 此处表示真正参与，而非仅有表面形式。

items.src: We examine the coastline and divide it into sections, then assign volunteers separate sections while keeping one area for training.
items.para: After we inspect and subdivide the coastline, we allocate separate sections to volunteers but reserve one area for training.
items.note: 此处表示把各段海岸分配给志愿者负责。

items.src: Managers keep unchecked fabric batches briefly, then examine them carefully before they reject defective ones and authorise satisfactory ones without delay.
items.para: Managers temporarily store unchecked fabric batches; once they carefully inspect them, they immediately approve satisfactory ones and refuse to accept defective ones.
items.note: 此处表示拒绝接收不合格的布料。

items.src: Temple visitors can worship or examine holy writings, appreciate devotional art and listen to cultural talks without taking part in religious observances.
items.para: Temple visitors can perform religious devotions or, without religious participation, study sacred texts, admire religious artwork and attend cultural lectures.
items.note: 此处指进行敬神活动，不仅限于祈祷。

items.src: An evaluation followed the choir programme's initial plan and delivery, confirming anxiety benefits and supporting a subsequent increase in its scale.
items.para: Following the choir programme's proposal and implementation, an assessment confirmed its anxiety benefits and supported later expansion.
items.note: 此处指对合唱项目实际效果的评估。

items.src: Leaving samples unlabelled remains a violation: a request for special permission, a proposed rule change and an explanation of requirements provide no authorisation.
items.para: Neither a requested exemption, a proposed amendment nor a clarification of requirements authorises leaving samples unlabelled, which remains a breach.
items.note: 此处指违反规定，而非获准例外或修改规定。

items.src: An inspection revealed cracks in the wooden sculptures, so museum staff postponed repairs and washing until they had agreed on protective measures.
items.para: Museum staff delayed restoration and cleaning until agreeing on a plan for preservation, because an examination had revealed cracks in the wooden sculptures.
items.note: 此处指检查雕塑状况，以发现问题。

items.src: Runners use the stadium's prominent clock to check times, while its controls are discreet, its wiring hidden, and the entrance clock ornamental.
items.para: Runners check times using the stadium's conspicuous clock, whose controls are unobtrusive and wiring concealed, whereas the entrance clock is decorative.
items.note: 此处两者都表示显眼、容易被看到。

items.src: Village nurses use nearly a quarter of their earnings for patient travel, drawing on reserves while awaiting expense repayments rather than charitable gifts.
items.para: While awaiting reimbursements rather than donations, village nurses draw on savings, spending almost a quarter of their wages on travel to patients.
items.note: 此处指护士通过工作获得的工资收入。

items.src: The curator chose a modern lamp as a replacement for the broken original, not an extra exhibit, a replica, or a reserve.
items.para: Selected by the curator, the modern lamp was a substitute for the broken original, not an addition, a copy, or a backup.
items.note: 此处指接替原物用途的替代品。

items.src: Matching errors in three essays made the tutor suspicious and her assistant surprised and let down; the explanations gave neither any reassurance.
items.para: Neither felt reassured by the explanations: matching errors in three essays left the assistant surprised and disappointed, but the tutor distrustful.
items.note: 此处指因可能存在不诚实行为而起疑。

items.src: Permit applicants must follow a fixed sequence of checks, although they may choose when checks occur, their length, and how often they repeat.
items.para: Although permit applicants may choose the timing, duration, and frequency of checks, they must complete them in a prescribed order.
items.note: 此处指各项检查进行的先后顺序。

items.src: Tests found the budget towels inferior in absorbency despite their greater tear resistance and gentler texture, while their price was also lower.
items.para: Although stronger and softer, the budget towels proved poorer in absorbency in tests; they were also cheaper.
items.note: 此处指吸水性能较差，而非价格较低。

items.src: Leila had earlier postponed installation; another delay therefore worried her, but she eventually decided to install the update anyhow before her afternoon meeting.
items.para: Having previously postponed installation, Leila was consequently worried by another delay; nevertheless, she eventually decided to install the update before her afternoon meeting.
items.note: 此处表示尽管有阻碍，仍决定这样做。

items.src: The editor described checking another source as a guideline, not an obligation, and separately banned anonymous quotations without allowing exceptions.
items.para: Besides imposing a prohibition on anonymous quotations with no exemption, the editor called checking another source a recommendation rather than a requirement.
items.note: 此处指建议遵循的指导意见，并非强制要求。

items.src: The memory research team plans to recruit two psychologists and develop their skills instead of advancing existing staff or removing anyone from employment.
items.para: Rather than promote existing staff or dismiss anyone, the memory research team plans to hire two psychologists and train them.
items.note: 此处指招聘心理学家加入研究团队。

items.src: Guests choose these cabins for their luxurious interiors and generous space, although their isolated location and functional kitchens also appeal.
items.para: Besides their spacious rooms, these cabins attract guests with opulent interiors, while their secluded setting and practical kitchens offer additional appeal.
items.note: 两者都形容内部装饰奢华、富丽。

items.src: Horizon watching can ease seasickness but cannot always stop its onset or remove it completely, whereas reading may make it worse.
items.para: Reading may worsen seasickness, whereas watching the horizon can relieve it without necessarily being able to prevent or eliminate it.
items.note: 两者都指减轻不适，并不保证完全消除。

items.src: Port engineers decided to tackle warehouse flooding with new drains rather than merely forecast it, track its progress or disregard it.
items.para: New drains were the port engineers' chosen way to address warehouse flooding, which they would not simply ignore, monitor or predict.
items.note: 两者都指采取行动处理问题。

items.src: This play's villain is a landlord, while a nurse plays the heroic role, a tenant suffers, and a shopkeeper merely watches.
items.para: A nurse is the hero and a tenant the victim in this play, with a shopkeeper as bystander and a landlord as evildoer.
items.note: 两者都指剧中作恶的反面人物。

items.src: Once woodland fungi have been gathered, preserved and measured, their classification depends on microscopic spore features rather than cap colour.
items.para: Microscopic spore features, not cap colour, determine woodland fungi's categorisation following collection, preservation and measurement.
items.note: 两者都指依据特征将样本归入不同类别。

items.src: Our pottery trainees learn handle shaping through imitation of the expert's movements, not merely watching them, discussing them or judging their effectiveness.
items.para: Handle shaping is learned by our pottery trainees through copying the expert's movements, not merely through observation, discussion or evaluation of them.
items.note: 两者都指照着他人的动作去做。

items.src: The cooperative sells juice directly to shops by the barrel, fills tasting jugs and serving bottles, and stores reserves in a tank.
items.para: Besides filling each tasting jug and serving bottle, the cooperative stores reserve juice in a tank and sells directly to shops by the cask.
items.note: 两者在此都指储装和销售果汁的大桶。

items.src: Stories naming unfamiliar feelings can broaden children's emotional vocabulary, while quizzes evaluate it and check recall, and rigid word lists may limit it.
items.para: Quizzes assess emotional vocabulary and test recall, while stories naming unfamiliar feelings can expand children's vocabulary, which rigid word lists may restrict.
items.note: 两者都指扩大所掌握词汇的范围。

items.src: Genetic comparisons revealed these wolves' descent, while tracking documented their seasonal movements, breeding records described offspring production, and annual counts measured continued survival.
items.para: Tracking documented these wolves' migration, breeding records described reproduction, and annual counts measured survival, while genetic comparisons revealed their ancestry.
items.note: 两者在此都指狼群的血统与祖先来源。

items.src: The sculptor placed a hollow bronze sphere at the installation's core, lamps around its boundary, a bench behind it and signs where visitors enter.
items.para: Signs mark the installation's entrance, lamps line its perimeter, and a bench stands at its rear; the sculptor placed a hollow bronze sphere at its centre.
items.note: 两者在此都指装置作品的中心位置。

items.src: The coach gave brief, firmly delivered but vague pacing instructions, unlike her detailed safety advice, leaving runners uncertain about their starting speed.
items.para: Although her safety advice was detailed, the coach's pacing guidance was brief and firm but unclear, leaving runners unsure how fast to start.
items.note: 此处指指示不明确，使人不知如何执行。

items.src: Amira's sincere thanks to her nurse were courteous and understated, whereas her sister expressed gratitude with much greater enthusiasm.
items.para: Amira offered her nurse polite and restrained but genuine thanks, while her sister's expression of gratitude was much more enthusiastic.
items.note: 此处指感激发自内心，而非仅仅客套。

items.src: Autumn floodwaters can overwhelm drains, block channels, harm pumps and demolish walls when storms wash debris through urban streets.
items.para: When storms wash debris through urban streets, autumn floodwaters can overload drains, obstruct channels, damage pumps and destroy walls.
items.note: 此处指超过排水设施的处理能力。

items.src: Our visiting lecturer uses a cane rather than a wheeled chair or a frame for walking, although he also wears a knee support.
items.para: Although our guest lecturer wears a knee brace, he walks with a walking stick rather than using a walking frame or wheelchair.
items.note: 此处指辅助行走的手杖。

items.src: Residents can enrol online in the council's free budgeting course, study beforehand, and cancel their places later without ever making a payment.
items.para: Residents need not pay for the council's budgeting course and can prepare beforehand, register online, or withdraw later.
items.note: 此处指正式报名参加课程。

items.src: The leak damaged Ravi's kitchen floor severely but not beyond repair, while the cupboards suffered minor damage and the walls only surface damage.
items.para: Ravi's cupboards were slightly damaged and his walls superficially affected by the leak, whereas his kitchen floor was seriously, though not irreparably, damaged.
items.note: 此处强调损坏程度严重，但未必无法修复。

items.src: The exhibition explains satellite applications in agriculture and forest management, but excludes their use in catching fish or extracting minerals.
items.para: Satellite uses in fishing and mining are excluded from the exhibition, which instead explains their applications in farming and forestry.
items.note: 此处指农业生产这一产业。

items.src: The station initially received sponsorship but later lost it; consequently, its weekly science programme was halved from its previous length of sixty minutes.
items.para: Sponsorship supported the station at first but ended later on; as a result, its weekly science show, sixty minutes until then, was halved.
items.note: 此处引出前述事件造成的结果。

items.src: Researchers replaced their primitive decision model with a more complex one that predicted choices correctly and adapted readily to changing conditions.
items.para: Compared with the rudimentary decision model it replaced, the researchers' new version was more sophisticated, accurate in predicting choices, and flexible under changing conditions.
items.note: 此处指模型简单粗糙、尚不完善。

items.src: Repeated seedling deaths in the polluted wetland drove volunteers beyond worry, irritation at setbacks, and disappointment into despair about restoring the habitat.
items.para: As seedlings repeatedly died in the polluted marsh, volunteers' anxiety, frustration, and disappointment gave way to hopelessness about restoring the habitat.
items.note: 此处指对修复栖息地彻底失去希望。

items.src: Builders plan to conserve the fountain with protective covers, rather than repair its damage, install a replacement, or move it elsewhere.
items.para: Covers are the builders' planned means to protect the fountain, which they do not intend to relocate, replace, or restore.
items.note: 此处指保护原有喷泉，使其免受损害。

items.src: A newspaper correspondent, accompanied by a photographer and guide, sent weekly expedition accounts to London while his editor remained at home.
items.para: While his editor stayed home, the newspaper reporter sent weekly expedition accounts to London, accompanied by a photographer and guide.
items.note: 此处指随考察队向报社发稿的记者。

items.src: Residents found the puppet show's ending hilarious, although its opening stirred deep emotions, its middle caused some fear, and its songs raised only smiles.
items.para: The puppet show was deeply moving initially and rather frightening midway; residents found its songs slightly amusing but its ending extremely funny.
items.note: 表示极其好笑，而非仅有一点趣味。

items.src: Expert technical guidance, media attention, and formal approval supported the wetland survey, but only corporate sponsorship enabled another year of research.
items.para: Corporate financial backing alone enabled another year of wetland research, although the survey also benefited from technical advice, publicity and official permission.
items.note: 此处指使调查得以继续的企业资金支持。

items.src: Costume makers chose elastic fabric that regained its shape for waistbands, rejecting stiff cloth despite its gentle texture and resistance to wear.
items.para: Rejecting rigid cloth despite its soft feel and durable construction, costume makers selected stretchy fabric that recovered its shape for waistbands.
items.note: 指布料能伸展并恢复原状的弹性。

items.src: After the fire, the lender showed mercy by waiving penalties, not merely expressing concern, tolerating delays, or offering generous loans.
items.para: Following the fire, the lender's leniency meant cancelling penalties, beyond sympathy for losses, patience with delays, or generosity in lending.
items.note: 此处指免除罚款所体现的宽大处理。

items.src: The experiment's restriction on discussion time hindered exploration; researchers refused extra time but maintained the original allowance without cutting it.
items.para: Exploration suffered because of the experiment's discussion time limit; researchers rejected an extension but kept the initial allocation without a reduction.
items.note: 此处指对讨论时长设定的限制。

items.src: After the meteor made the astronomer exclaim, his assistant requested quiet speech or silence so the presenter could keep talking.
items.para: To let the presenter continue talking, the assistant requested that the astronomer speak softly or remain silent after the meteor caused him to cry out.
items.note: 指因惊讶等强烈情绪突然喊出声。

items.src: The orchestra used modified instruments outdoors to resist humidity, while damaged ones were fixed, inaccurate ones adjusted in pitch, and unusable ones exchanged.
items.para: Damaged instruments were repaired, inaccurate ones retuned, and unusable ones replaced; for outdoor playing, the orchestra used instruments adapted to resist humidity.
items.note: 此处指为适应户外湿度而改装过的。

items.src: Maya had practically exhausted her water; Ben had finished his, Jo had drunk some, and Leo had taken only a sip.
items.para: Ben's water was completely gone, whereas Maya's was almost exhausted; Jo's supply was partly depleted, and Leo's was barely diminished.
items.note: 此处表示几乎耗尽，但尚未完全用完。

items.src: A cargo aircraft departed before the airliner, while a privately owned jet and an armed forces plane remained beside the runway.
items.para: After a cargo plane departed, a commercial passenger aircraft took off; a private jet and a military aircraft stayed beside the runway.
items.note: 此处指用于商业客运的飞机。

items.src: Bark keeps this soil moist rather than saturated, whereas the uncovered patch becomes dry and breaks easily into small pieces.
items.para: Beneath its bark covering, this soil stays damp rather than waterlogged, whereas the uncovered patch becomes dry and crumbly.
items.note: 都指微湿，既非干燥也非湿透。

items.src: Trainees must grasp the explanation of sensor failures, not merely learn it by heart or recite it, before challenging it.
items.para: Before they question the explanation of sensor failures, trainees must understand it rather than merely memorise or repeat it.
items.note: 此处指理解解释，而非背诵或复述。

items.src: The clerk admitted concealing the application out of spite, not to escape blame, secure advancement, or act on sincere concern.
items.para: Neither from genuine concern nor to gain promotion or to avoid blame did the clerk hide the application; she admitted acting from petty malice.
items.note: 指因恶意而故意使别人难受。

items.src: Chores were Arun's duty, and fatigue hindered him, but choosing dinner provided an incentive; a cleaner room was the result.
items.para: Choosing dinner was a spur for Arun despite fatigue being an obstacle; chores were an obligation, and a cleaner room was a consequence.
items.note: 指促使人采取行动的激励因素。

items.src: After casting a ballot, each voter received a receipt from an election administrator while a monitor watched and a contender waited outside.
items.para: An observer watched an official give each elector a receipt after they cast their ballot, while a candidate waited outside.
items.note: 此处指已投下选票的选民。

items.src: Amina's rival for the sculpture prize was a coastal ceramic artist, while her project partner helped an adjudicator greet the exhibition's financial backer.
items.para: Amina's collaborator helped a judge welcome the exhibition's sponsor, while a coastal ceramic artist was her competitor for the sculpture prize.
items.note: 都指争夺同一奖项的竞争对手。

items.src: Mei was knowledgeable about memory errors, whereas her inquisitive assistant sounded self-assured and convincing despite having little training.
items.para: Although her curious assistant sounded confident and persuasive despite limited training, Mei was well-informed about memory errors.
items.note: 指对某一领域掌握丰富知识。

items.src: Researchers replaced a long coastal report that lacked specifics with a detailed version, keeping it factually correct and easy to read.
items.para: The revised coastal report was rich in specifics, accurate and readable, replacing an earlier version that was lengthy but lacked particulars.
items.note: 指包含丰富的具体信息，而不只是篇幅长。

items.src: Our guide described the ancient spring as sacred to pilgrims, the basin as used for rituals, and both as legally safeguarded.
items.para: Both the ceremonial basin and the ancient spring are legally protected, our guide explained, but pilgrims regard the spring as holy.
items.note: 此处指在宗教上被视为神圣的。

items.src: The teacher will darken the classroom for the astronomy film, then increase its lighting, lower its temperature, and let fresh air inside.
items.para: After using the astronomy film, the teacher will brighten, cool, and ventilate the classroom, but first she will dim it.
items.note: 此处指调暗教室，使光线变弱。

items.src: My cousins tease me playfully at community lunches, while other guests criticise me, advise me, or praise me.
items.para: Community lunch guests find fault with me, give advice to me, or offer praise to me; my cousins playfully make fun of me.
items.note: 此处指善意地拿别人开玩笑。

items.src: The turtle charity appointed Leila as its ambassador, not as a campaign director, an adviser on finances, or an assistant to researchers.
items.para: Leila became the turtle charity's public representative, rather than being appointed as a research assistant, campaign manager, or financial adviser.
items.note: 此处指代表慈善机构对外宣传的人。

items.src: Staff proposed moving the briefing elsewhere, delaying it, or holding it again, but the manager intends only to shorten it.
items.para: The manager intends only to abbreviate the briefing that staff proposed to relocate, postpone, or repeat.
items.note: 此处指缩短简报会的持续时间。

items.src: Mira's wicked tricks on her brother in the comedy are harmless, never showing cruelty, a desire to hurt, or a wish for revenge.
items.para: Neither cruel, malicious, nor vindictive, Mira's mischievous tricks on her brother in the comedy never hurt anyone.
items.note: 此处指淘气爱恶作剧，并非邪恶。

items.src: Our picnic survived a little drizzle, powerful wind, and dense fog, but a sudden downpour finally forced everyone to leave.
items.para: Sudden heavy rain finally drove everyone away from our picnic after we had stayed through light drizzle, strong wind, and thick fog.
items.note: 指雨势很大的降雨，即大雨。

items.src: By calling her colleague an incompetent fool, the researcher intended to insult him, not calm his fears, courteously correct him, or enthusiastically commend him.
items.para: The researcher intended to verbally offend her colleague, not verbally reassure, politely correct, or warmly praise him, by calling him an incompetent fool.
items.note: 此处指用不尊重的话故意冒犯别人。

items.src: Visitors' movements generate musical sounds in the gallery installation, while separate controls make those sounds louder, deform their waveforms, and capture them.
items.para: Separate controls amplify, distort, and record musical sounds in the gallery installation, while visitors' movements produce them.
items.note: 此处指产生音乐声音，而非处理已有声音。

items.src: Our guide said the manuscript cases protected adequately against damp, although not perfectly, rejecting claims that protection was only marginal or inconsistent.
items.para: Rejecting claims that the manuscript cases protected barely or unevenly against damp, our guide said they protected sufficiently, though not completely.
items.note: 指保护程度足够，但不一定完全。

items.src: The hospital's visiting rabbits are tame, rather than cautious around people, hostile to unfamiliar visitors, or keen to escape handling.
items.para: Neither eager to avoid handling nor aggressive toward unfamiliar visitors, the hospital's visiting rabbits are comfortable with human contact rather than wary of human contact.
items.note: 此处指动物习惯并能安然接受人类接触。

items.src: Library visitors need assistance operating borrowing machines, not merely guidance or authorization, although staff must also oversee their use.
items.para: Although supervision by librarians is also required, visitors need help using borrowing equipment rather than just advice or permission.
items.note: 此处指操作设备时所需的实际帮助。

items.src: Children chose the carousel instead of the big wheel or racing coaster, then walked past the slide on their way home.
items.para: Before passing the slide on their walk home, children picked the merry-go-round over the Ferris wheel and roller coaster.
items.note: 两者都指供人乘坐的旋转木马。

items.src: Bridge inspectors must be qualified in civil engineering; extensive experience, self-confidence and readiness to start immediately cannot substitute for this requirement.
items.para: Being highly experienced, personally confident and immediately available cannot replace the requirement for bridge inspectors to be professionally certified in civil engineering.
items.note: 此处指持有土木工程领域的专业资格。

items.src: Relocating our washing machine greatly reduced bedroom noise; padding helped a little, repairs helped briefly, and lubrication improved matters over time.
items.para: Padding reduced our bedroom noise slightly, repairs helped temporarily, and lubrication helped gradually, whereas moving the washing machine reduced it considerably.
items.note: 两者都表示程度很大，此处指噪声大幅减少。

items.src: Engineers use sensors to identify pollution and models to forecast its spread, but design filters to combat it rather than merely quantify it.
items.para: Filters are designed by engineers to counter rather than merely measure pollution, while sensors detect it and models predict its spread.
items.note: 此处都指采取措施对抗空气污染。

items.src: An engineer used a calculation after measuring the tank, then compared the result with earlier figures before forecasting future water demand.
items.para: Following a measurement of the tank, an engineer performed a computation, then made a comparison with earlier figures before producing a prediction of water demand.
items.note: 两者都指通过数学运算求得数值。

items.src: Participants had to declare their views before the debate, but could subsequently rethink their position, argue for it or retract it.
items.para: Although participants could later reconsider, defend or withdraw their position, they were required to announce their views before the debate.
items.note: 此处都指公开表明自己的观点。

items.src: Auditors identified fraud involving invented sales, rather than a bookkeeping mistake or careless administration, after investigating a disagreement over contractual obligations.
items.para: After investigating a contractual dispute, auditors uncovered financial deception involving fictitious sales, not an accounting error or administrative negligence.
items.note: 此处指通过虚构销售进行的财务欺诈。

items.src: Mechanics blamed the ferry delay on a faulty engine, not its loud operation, obsolete design or excessive load.
items.para: The ferry's engine was not merely noisy, outdated or overloaded: mechanics attributed the delay to its being defective.
items.note: 两者都指有故障、不能正常运作的。

items.src: The settlement was essentially a market town, though it resembled a fortress, held formal city status and briefly served as a military base.
items.para: Outwardly fortress-like and officially a city, the settlement was fundamentally a market town, although it temporarily served as a military base.
items.note: 两者都指本质上，而非外观、名义或暂时用途。

items.src: Volunteers inspect donated bicycles before washing them, making minor adjustments to the brakes, and replacing any tyres that cannot be repaired.
items.para: Before volunteers clean donated bicycles, slightly adjust their brakes, and replace irreparable tyres, they carefully examine the bikes.
items.note: 指仔细查看，以检查状况。

items.src: Our guide will prepare a hot beverage while hikers finish lunch, sharing some biscuits but saving their cake for dessert later.
items.para: While hikers finish their midday meal and share a biscuit snack, saving cake for dessert later, our guide will make a hot drink.
items.note: 指供饮用的饮料，而非食物。

items.src: New carpenters receive verbal instructions before reading rules and watching demonstrations, with hands-on training reserved for the afternoon.
items.para: Before reading written rules and watching visual demonstrations, new carpenters receive spoken instructions; practical training follows in the afternoon.
items.note: 此处指用口头语言传达的。

items.src: Despite rising sales revenue, the cooperative needed finance to purchase refrigerators without increasing its spending or adding to what it owed.
items.para: To buy refrigerators without higher expenditure or additional debt, the cooperative needed funding despite growth in its sales income.
items.note: 此处指为购买设备筹措的资金。

items.src: Participants imagined the bridge's destruction in a flood, rather than slight damage or a brief shutdown, before considering how it might ultimately be rebuilt.
items.para: Before considering its eventual reconstruction, participants pictured a flood causing the bridge's complete loss, not minor damage or temporary closure.
items.note: 此处指桥梁被彻底毁坏而不复存在。

items.src: Psychologists classified fear as an emotion, distinguishing it from recollections of storms, convictions about danger, and plans to seek shelter.
items.para: Unlike a memory of storms, a belief about danger, or an intention to seek shelter, fear was classified by psychologists as a feeling.
items.note: 指恐惧等内心体验到的情绪。

items.src: The potter will supervise apprentices at work, but the manager will hire them, evaluate their progress, and give prizes for excellent results.
items.para: The manager will recruit apprentices, assess their progress, and reward excellent results with prizes, while the potter will oversee them as they work.
items.note: 指监督他人的工作过程。

items.src: The vaulter's broad grin replaced her earlier scowl, while her coach responded with a brief wink followed by a small nod.
items.para: Her coach offered a quick wink followed by a slight nod as the vaulter's earlier deep frown gave way to a wide smile.
items.note: 指嘴角大幅上扬、咧嘴微笑的表情。

items.src: Recovered patients may resume the interrupted exercises, but those still feeling dizzy should delay them, reduce their duration, or give them up altogether.
items.para: Patients still feeling dizzy should postpone, shorten, or abandon the interrupted exercises, whereas those who have recovered may restart them.
items.note: 指活动中断后重新开始。

items.src: The architect credited teamwork for the garden's success, explaining that rivalry and disputes had faded once engineers and gardeners stopped working separately.
items.para: Engineers and gardeners abandoned separate work, and competition and disagreement faded; the architect attributed the garden's success to their collaboration.
items.note: 指为实现共同目标而相互合作。

items.src: Critics called the static photography curriculum old-fashioned, but the college retained it for another year, considering it adaptable and original.
items.para: The college retained its unchanged photography curriculum for another year, considering it flexible and innovative despite critics describing it as outdated.
items.note: 此处指课程内容保持不变。

items.src: Before selling imported spices, each trader must register and name the business providing supplies, the intended buyer, and the original grower.
items.para: Registration requires each merchant to identify the supplier, customer and producer before offering imported spices for sale.
items.note: 两者均指从事商品买卖的商人。

items.src: Families can readily obtain dried lentils nearby, buy them inexpensively, and cook them rapidly, making this ingredient convenient for weekday meals.
items.para: Dried lentils suit weekday family meals because households can obtain them easily, shop locally, buy cheaply, and cook quickly.
items.note: 此处指获取时不费力、没有困难。

items.src: Investigators recorded the circumstances surrounding each sensor failure before separately examining what caused it, how it manifested itself, and what followed.
items.para: Before separately examining the causes, symptoms and consequences of each sensor failure, investigators recorded the surrounding conditions.
items.note: 此处指故障发生时的周围条件。

items.src: The producer broadcast submitted songs in a random sequence instead of sorting them by title, recording date or subject.
items.para: Instead of alphabetical, chronological or thematic ordering, a haphazard sequence was used by the producer to broadcast the submitted songs.
items.note: 此处均指没有系统安排的播放次序。

items.src: Participants willingly revised their conclusions after reluctantly reviewing evidence and hesitantly questioning assumptions, although they had attended the workshop because they were forced.
items.para: Having reluctantly reviewed evidence and hesitantly questioned assumptions, participants voluntarily revised their conclusions, although they had attended the workshop under compulsion.
items.note: 此处指自愿修改结论，而非受到强迫。

items.src: The conservation team's comprehensive water survey replaced an initial, narrowly focused assessment, while a separate report examined the pollution findings in depth.
items.para: A preliminary, selective assessment gave way to the conservation team's complete water survey, while a separate detailed report examined the pollution findings.
items.note: 此处强调调查覆盖全面，而非仅仅细致。

items.src: Our increasingly popular cycling tours remain equally affordable, unlike progressively costlier rail holidays, whose appeal has grown only marginally.
items.para: Our cycling tours are more and more popular but just as affordable, unlike less and less affordable rail holidays, which are only slightly more appealing.
items.note: 表示程度随时间越来越高。

items.src: Fortress builders chose to drag stones along timber tracks with ropes rather than raise them, turn them over repeatedly, or shove them.
items.para: Ropes were used by fortress builders to pull stones along timber tracks; they chose not to lift, roll or push them.
items.note: 结合沿木轨移动的语境，指沿表面拖拉。

items.src: Volunteers are capable of explaining forms and happy to help, but attendance is optional and few are expected to come tomorrow.
items.para: Although volunteers are willing to help and able to explain forms, they are not required to attend, and few are likely to come tomorrow.
items.note: 表示具备做某事的能力，不指意愿或义务。

items.src: Researchers assign sequential numbers to turtle nests and enter the corresponding numbers on maps, checking for absent or repeated identifiers.
items.para: Researchers check maps for missing or duplicated identifiers after recording matching numbers for turtle nests labelled in consecutive order.
items.note: 指地图上的编号与巢穴编号相对应。

items.src: Mei was eager to learn restoration but unprepared to handle antiques, unwilling to work alone, and frightened of damaging valuable wood.
items.para: Although not ready to handle antiques, reluctant to work alone, and afraid of damaging valuable wood, Mei was keen to learn restoration.
items.note: 都表示热切想做某事，而非准备就绪。

items.src: Economists describe the island's recovery as delicate despite consistent progress, warning that it is neither fast nor finished.
items.para: Despite steady progress, the island's recovery remains fragile, economists warn, and it is neither rapid nor complete.
items.note: 此处指经济复苏脆弱，容易受到冲击。

items.src: Counsellors favour a plan to inspect and then modernize the booking system with newer software over proposals to stop operating it or sell it.
items.para: A plan to check and then update the booking system with newer software is what counsellors favour over proposals to shut down or sell it.
items.note: 此处指采用较新软件，使系统跟上时代。

items.src: Researchers issued a declaration endorsing an in-house recommendation for free access to findings; that recommendation resulted from a private appeal citing a secret report.
items.para: A private request citing a confidential report prompted an internal proposal for free access to findings, which researchers endorsed in a public statement.
items.note: 此处指正式公开说明研究结果的获取政策。

items.src: Our gallery celebrates the diversity of mountain weaving techniques rather than their intricacy, widespread appeal, or long history.
items.para: Mountain weaving techniques feature in our gallery for their variety, not for their complexity, popularity or age.
items.note: 都指编织技法种类丰富、多种多样。

items.src: After reviewing an approximate costing, the club accepted a builder's bid for roof repairs, requesting a bill before payment and proof afterward.
items.para: The club accepted a builder's offer for roof repairs after reviewing an estimate, requesting an invoice before payment and a receipt afterward.
items.note: 此处指承包商提出的工程报价。

items.src: Despite optimism about herbal tea, the researcher remained doubtful of its benefits, neither assured of success nor disappointed with the trial.
items.para: The researcher remained unsure of herbal tea's benefits despite being hopeful, feeling neither confident of success nor disappointed with the trial.
items.note: 都表示对草药茶是否有效仍不确定。

items.src: Visitors can find, enumerate and identify familiar buildings from the tower, while roof colours help them distinguish public buildings from private homes.
items.para: Roof colours help visitors differentiate public buildings from private homes, while the tower lets them locate, count and recognize familiar buildings.
items.note: 都指辨别公共建筑与私人住宅的区别。

items.src: For overnight trips, teachers lock away children's medication but keep wound coverings, walking aids, and temperature gauges accessible for immediate use.
items.para: Teachers keep bandages, crutches, and thermometers accessible for immediate use on overnight trips, while children's medicine is locked away.
items.note: 此处都指用于治疗的药物，而非医疗器具。

items.src: Council grants usually support libraries, chiefly fund repairs and partly cover staffing, but this grant was created specifically for rural collections.
items.para: This grant was designed expressly for rural collections; council grants generally support libraries, primarily finance repairs and partially cover staffing.
items.note: 此处表示专门为乡村馆藏这一用途而设。

items.src: Pressing the handle makes the basket spin rapidly, while a loose base can slip sideways, sway backwards and forwards, or jump repeatedly.
items.para: A loose base may slide sideways, rock back and forth, or bounce repeatedly, whereas pressing the handle causes the basket to rotate rapidly.
items.note: 此处指篮筐绕中心快速旋转。

items.src: Engineers tested voice commands versus touch controls, then tested both together, gestures as a replacement for touch, and voice alone.
items.para: Engineers evaluated spoken commands against touch controls, then voice alongside touch, gestures instead of touch, and voice without touch.
items.note: 此处表示将两种控制方式进行对比。

items.src: Microphone replacement produced a noticeable but short-lived improvement in interview sound, although engineers found the replacement surprising and expensive.
items.para: Engineers considered the microphone upgrade unexpected and costly, with an obvious but temporary improvement in interview audio.
items.note: 此处表示声音改善明显可察觉。

items.src: Participants' performance was dependent on concentration, connected with practice, unconnected with age, and vulnerable to fatigue in the reasoning experiment.
items.para: Although unrelated to age, participants' performance in the reasoning experiment was reliant on concentration, associated with practice and susceptible to fatigue.
items.note: 此处表示表现取决于专注程度。

items.src: Community involvement is the project's central pillar, while limited funding hinders progress, publicity motivates volunteers, and wetland recovery remains the ultimate goal.
items.para: With wetland recovery as its objective, the project has community involvement as its central support, limited funding as an obstacle, and publicity as volunteers' incentive.
items.note: 此处将社区参与比作项目的核心支撑。

items.src: Autumn travellers face a lower probability of snow-related road closures, although their length, seriousness and financial burden remain unchanged.
items.para: Snow-related road closures retain their duration, severity and cost, but travellers in autumn face a smaller chance of encountering them.
items.note: 此处指遭遇封路的可能性。

items.src: The guide described Roman baths as therapy for existing joint pain, distinguishing this from identifying disease, avoiding illness, or restoring lost mobility.
items.para: Roman baths provided treatment for existing joint pain, the guide explained, distinguishing this use from diagnosis, prevention and rehabilitation.
items.note: 此处指缓解已有关节疼痛的治疗。

items.src: Researchers documented the kitchen's impact on elderly residents' friendships, distinguishing observed changes from its intended aim, expected outcomes and proposed reasons for success.
items.para: Separating purpose, prediction and explanation from observed results, researchers recorded the shared kitchen's effect on friendships among elderly residents.
items.note: 此处指公共厨房对人际关系产生的影响。

items.src: The ongoing turtle study requires weekly beach visits, unlike the finished whale survey, paused seal project and proposed dolphin census.
items.para: Weekly beach visits are required for the continuing turtle study, unlike the completed whale survey, suspended seal project and planned dolphin census.
items.note: 此处表示海龟研究仍在进行，尚未结束。

items.src: An applicant's certificate may be newly issued, suitable and striking, but the restoration workshop still checks whether it is authentic before hiring.
items.para: Before employing an applicant, the restoration workshop checks whether their certificate is genuine, even if it is recent, relevant and impressive.
items.note: 都指证书真实而非伪造，不等于新近或出色。

items.src: Our grain-price report adopts the perspective of small bakery owners, using their forecasts and chief concerns to explain their proposed solutions.
items.para: Using bakery owners' expectations and priorities to explain their recommendations, our report examines grain prices from these small business owners' viewpoint.
items.note: 都指看待问题的立场或视角。

items.src: Her brother's repeated interruptions irritate Mina during family meals, although they neither scare nor bewilder her and have long ceased to seem unexpected.
items.para: Mina is used to her brother's interruptions over family meals: they annoy her but no longer surprise her and neither frighten nor confuse her.
items.note: 都指使人烦躁或不快，而非害怕或困惑。

items.src: Initially inquisitive about warmer seawater, the researchers became concerned about coral larvae's development, losing their earlier assurance but retaining some optimism.
items.para: The researchers grew worried about coral larvae's development in warmer seawater; previously curious and confident, they nevertheless remained somewhat hopeful.
items.note: 此处指对可能出现的问题感到担心。

items.src: The sculptor sincerely thanked the volunteers, speaking readily and enthusiastically rather than merely politely after their careful work enabled the installation.
items.para: After volunteers' careful work enabled the installation, the sculptor thanked them from the heart, without hesitation and with great enthusiasm, not merely out of courtesy.
items.note: 都指发自内心，而不只是出于礼貌。

items.src: Our coaching course retains its scope despite reduced depth, faster teaching and shorter duration, covering injury prevention and race planning but excluding equipment repair.
items.para: Our course retains its range of topics—injury prevention and race planning, not equipment repair—despite reduced depth of coverage, shorter course duration and faster teaching pace.
items.note: 此处指课程涵盖的主题范围，而非深度或时长。

items.src: Every spectator at the charity tennis match received the same heart-health leaflet as each player, coach and official involved.
items.para: Each person competing, person coaching and person officiating at the charity tennis match received a heart-health leaflet identical to that given to every person watching.
items.note: 指观看比赛的人，而非选手、教练或裁判。

items.src: A bakery became the rooftop garden festival's main sponsor, paying most costs while a charity coordinated activities and volunteers provided equipment and space.
items.para: A charity was event organiser and volunteers acted as equipment supplier and venue provider; the bakery became principal financial backer, paying most rooftop garden festival costs.
items.note: 此处指提供资金支持的赞助者。

items.src: Reviewers may legitimately question or doubt applicants, but the college's training distinguishes such responses from prejudice and seeks to reduce open antagonism.
items.para: College training separates bias from legitimate criticism or mistrust of applicants while also aiming to reduce overt hostility among reviewers.
items.note: 都指不公正的先入之见，不等于合理质疑。

items.src: The commissioner called the deliberate destruction of inspection records disgraceful, rejecting claims that it was merely negligent, required or capable of justification.
items.para: Rejecting descriptions of the deliberate destruction of inspection records as merely careless, necessary or defensible, the commissioner condemned it as shameful.
items.note: 都指可耻、应受道德谴责的。

items.src: Their home's tragic destruction made the neighbours' reassuring support especially important, although the frightening fire and shocking evacuation also upset the siblings.
items.para: The neighbours' comforting support mattered especially after the heartbreaking destruction of the siblings' home, although the frightening blaze and shocking evacuation also distressed them.
items.note: 此处指家园被毁令人深感悲痛。

items.src: Despite its useful portability, the scanner's brief battery life remains a drawback; daily charging is necessary, and a planned upgrade should help.
items.para: Portability is a benefit, but short battery life is a disadvantage; daily charging remains a requirement, and a planned upgrade should bring improvement.
items.note: 指产品现有的不利之处或缺点。

items.src: You must rip the coloured paper by hand for this collage, not double it over or cut its edges, before sticking pieces onto cardboard with adhesive.
items.para: Before you glue the pieces onto cardboard for this collage, you must tear the coloured paper manually, not fold or trim it.
items.note: 指用手撕开纸张，而非折叠或裁剪。

items.src: Our flexible team revised its approach because of new evidence, while its determined leader encouraged careful members to make firmer decisions.
items.para: Our adaptable team changed its approach in response to fresh evidence, while its persistent leader encouraged cautious members to become more decisive.
items.note: 指能根据新情况灵活调整方法。

items.src: Novice climbers may identify altitude sickness and track its symptoms yet underestimate its seriousness, whereas worried companions sometimes overstate the danger.
items.para: Worried companions sometimes exaggerate the danger, whereas novice climbers may recognise altitude illness and monitor its symptoms yet underrate its severity.
items.note: 指把疾病的严重程度看得过低。

items.src: Residents' irritation gave way to eager expectation as their requested garden took shape, then satisfaction and pride in their own contribution once it opened.
items.para: Opening of their requested garden brought residents contentment and pride in their contribution, following frustration and then anticipation as the project took shape.
items.note: 指愿望实现后产生的满足感。

items.src: Paired practice reduced adult learners' anxiety about classroom speaking and their self-conscious discomfort, while increasing their self-assurance and eagerness to participate.
items.para: Adult learners gained confidence and enthusiasm for participation through paired practice, which lessened their worry about speaking in class and their embarrassment.
items.note: 指对课堂发言感到担忧不安。

items.src: Amina's coordinator praised her commitment to the food bank, noting that her productive working style, tolerance of delays and willingness to give supported it.
items.para: Efficiency, patience and generosity supported Amina's dedication to the food bank, for which her coordinator praised her.
items.note: 指对食物救济站持续投入的精神。

items.src: The chairwoman opened the wildlife society's meeting after its deputy, treasurer and minute-taker arrived, announcing a new seabird survey.
items.para: Once the deputy leader, financial officer and recording secretary arrived, the wildlife society's female presiding officer opened the meeting and announced a new seabird survey.
items.note: 此处指主持会议的女性负责人。

items.src: The apprentice performed reasonably well on repairs but very badly on polishing; her supervisor excelled at both and assembled cabinets with barely any errors.
items.para: Her supervisor repaired and polished exceptionally well and assembled cabinets almost perfectly, whereas the apprentice handled repairs fairly well but polished very poorly.
items.note: 表示表现还算不错，并非非常出色。

items.src: Although buying is less costly and simpler, renting bakery equipment is preferable because it involves less risk when demand fluctuates.
items.para: Renting bakery equipment is more desirable because it is safer when demand fluctuates, although buying is cheaper and easier.
items.note: 两者均指比较之下更可取。

items.src: Older residents associate bread smells with childhood, remember family meals clearly, distinguish familiar recipes carefully, but sometimes mistake one bakery for another.
items.para: Older residents vividly recall family meals and mentally link bread smells with childhood; they carefully distinguish familiar recipes but occasionally confuse different bakeries.
items.note: 此处指在头脑中将两件事联系起来。

items.src: Milk proteins suffered damage from excessive storage heat, whereas abnormally cold, mildly warm and constant-temperature storage conditions caused no damage.
items.para: Unusually low, moderately warm and perfectly stable storage temperatures left milk proteins unharmed, whereas unreasonably high temperatures damaged them.
items.note: 此处指储存温度高得超过合理程度。

items.src: Artists must evaluate alternative materials and choose suitable ones before they specify their selections in proposals and calculate approximate costs.
items.para: Before artists precisely state their material choices in proposals and estimate costs, they must evaluate alternatives and select suitable ones.
items.note: 指明确、准确地说明所选材料。

items.src: Players should watch goalkeepers carefully and confront them directly during practice, but deceive them with false signals rather than merely divert their attention briefly.
items.para: Players should closely observe and directly challenge goalkeepers during practice, but use false signals to deliberately mislead them, not simply briefly distract them.
items.note: 指有意制造错误印象，使对方受骗。

items.src: Despite easier controls, poor fit on small arms remains the monitor's limitation; portability remains an advantage, while regular battery replacement remains necessary.
items.para: The monitor's portability remains a benefit and regular battery replacement a requirement; easier controls represent an improvement, but poor fit on small arms remains a drawback.
items.note: 此处指设备在实际使用中的不足。

items.src: Shopkeepers and planners initially worked together and exchanged views, but market redevelopment caused conflict that ended only when both sides made concessions.
items.para: Despite initial cooperation and consultation between shopkeepers and planners, market redevelopment triggered serious disagreement, which ended only through compromise.
items.note: 此处指双方之间的严重分歧或冲突。

items.src: Trainees were punctual despite minor bus delays; tutors arrived excessively early, while the examiner was running far later than planned.
items.para: Although buses were slightly late, trainees were on time; tutors were too early, and the examiner was well behind schedule.
items.note: 指按约定时间到达，不迟到。

items.src: Before the ceremony citizens felt nervous; finishing formalities brought relief, receiving certificates inspired pride in their achievement, and family applause made them joyful.
items.para: Families' applause left citizens delighted; they had been anxious before the ceremony, relieved when formalities ended, and proud of their achievement while receiving certificates.
items.note: 指充满喜悦，强调强烈的快乐。

items.src: Residents praised Mina's handling of noise complaints after they were lodged, although some were later retracted and others dismissed.
items.para: Following submission, Mina's management of noise complaints earned residents' praise, despite the later withdrawal of some and rejection of others.
items.note: 此处指对投诉的处理与管理。

items.src: Earlier sensors drained batteries quickly, but this model uses little electricity; hence, batteries last a year while engineers simultaneously test durability.
items.para: Previously, sensors exhausted batteries rapidly; nevertheless, this model consumes little power, and therefore batteries last a year; meanwhile, engineers test durability.
items.note: 两者都引出前述原因造成的结果，表示因此。

items.src: Listeners adore the programme's funny interviews and respect its careful research, although they merely put up with advertisements and resent interruptions.
items.para: Although audiences tolerate advertisements and resent interruptions, they deeply love the show's humorous interviews and admire its thorough research.
items.note: 此处表示非常喜爱，而非仅仅认可或容忍。

items.src: Interruptions frustrate puzzle solvers by blocking progress, whereas unclear clues bewilder them, helpful hints ease their worries, and small successes encourage further effort.
items.para: Unclear clues confuse puzzle solvers, helpful hints reassure them, and small successes motivate them, whereas interruptions annoy them by preventing progress.
items.note: 此处指进展受阻而感到恼火，原因由上下文补足。

items.src: Although valley farmers compete for customers and cultivate plots independently, they cooperate on wetland restoration rather than abandon the project.
items.para: Valley growers work together to restore wetlands rather than withdraw from the project, although they compete for customers and work independently cultivating plots.
items.note: 两者都指为了共同目标一起协作。

items.src: Opening the kitchen window fully can make its frame strike the pot, scrape its paint, crush a leaf, or knock it off the ledge.
items.para: The kitchen window frame can hit the pot, scrape its paint, crush a leaf, or dislodge it from the ledge when opened fully.
items.note: 此处指窗框撞到花盆，即发生撞击。

items.src: Medieval engineers planned the stone bridge before they constructed it without metal supports; later workers checked it and fixed cracks.
items.para: After they designed the stone bridge, medieval engineers built it without metal supports; subsequently, other workers inspected it and repaired cracks.
items.note: 此处指用材料建成桥梁，且保留过去时。

items.src: Coastal households once grew, then stabilised; analysts predicted fluctuating sizes, but they began to shrink as adults moved inland for permanent jobs.
items.para: Coastal households used to expand, then remain stable; analysts predicted sizes would fluctuate, but they began to become smaller as adults moved inland for permanent jobs.
items.note: 两者都指规模变小，此处指家庭成员数量减少。

items.src: This rare fern thrives in shady spots beneath trees, not sunny patches, wind-protected corners, or waterlogged hollows elsewhere in the garden.
items.para: Unlike garden locations exposed to sunlight, sheltered from wind, or saturated with water, spots beneath trees sheltered from sunlight support this rare fern's growth.
items.note: 此处指阳光被遮挡，而不是避风或积水。

items.src: Laboratory staff receive free vaccination against hepatitis before exposure, while tests for possible infection, confirmation of disease, and care for illness cost extra.
items.para: The laboratory charges staff for hepatitis screening, diagnosis, and treatment, but provides free immunisation before exposure.
items.note: 此处均指通过接种疫苗获得免疫保护。

items.src: Bowls sold for twelve pounds apiece, pairs of cups for twenty and twelve-plate sets for sixty, bringing two hundred pounds overall.
items.para: Sales brought two hundred pounds altogether: bowls sold for twelve pounds each, cups for twenty per pair and plates for sixty per dozen.
items.note: 两者都表示每个，说明单件物品的价格。

items.src: Birdsong reduced participants' anxiety considerably, whereas music helped only a little, breathing exercises worked slowly, and reassurance provided short-lived relief.
items.para: Whereas music helped slightly, breathing exercises worked gradually, and reassurance helped temporarily, birdsong eased participants' anxiety substantially.
items.note: 两者均表示程度很大，而非速度或持续时间。

items.src: The laboratory blackout caused chaos rather than momentary doubt or a controlled evacuation, although the director expected only a small disturbance.
items.para: Despite the director expecting only minor disruption, the laboratory blackout produced complete confusion rather than brief uncertainty or an orderly evacuation.
items.note: 此处指完全混乱，不是短暂疑惑或轻微干扰。

items.src: The carpenter rearranged a line of loose boards into a stack beside some tied sticks and two matching shelves.
items.para: Beside a bundle of sticks and a pair of matching shelves, the carpenter converted a row of loose boards into a pile.
items.note: 此处指上下叠放的一堆，而非一排或一捆。

items.src: The rowing coach chose sophisticated sensors over easily transported models because advanced technology mattered more than exceptional toughness or unusually low prices.
items.para: Prioritising advanced technology, the rowing coach selected technologically advanced sensors over highly portable models, valuing neither exceptionally durable nor remarkably affordable equipment as much.
items.note: 此处指技术先进，而非便携、耐用或便宜。

items.src: The tenant reported dampness to the person renting him the flat, while the building's maintenance worker showed a guest upstairs.
items.para: While the caretaker escorted a visitor upstairs, the renter told his landlord about dampness in the flat.
items.note: 指租住房屋的人，不是房东、管理员或访客。

items.src: Assessing historic bridges demands expertise in traditional engineering; hands-on experience, broad familiarity with architecture, and individual eagerness cannot substitute for that knowledge.
items.para: Neither practical experience, general awareness of architecture, nor personal enthusiasm can replace the specialist knowledge of traditional engineering needed to assess historic bridges.
items.note: 此处指专业知识，不等于经验、常识或热情。

items.src: Geography students compared temperatures at the mountain's summit with readings from its low hillsides, a gap between peaks, and the valley bottom.
items.para: Readings from the lower slopes, a mountain pass, and the valley floor were compared by geography students with temperatures at the mountain's highest point.
items.note: 指山的最高点，而非山坡、山口或谷底。

items.src: The proposed inheritance law would tax inherited wealth rather than wages, while everyday costs and unpaid liabilities would remain outside its scope.
items.para: Living expenses and outstanding debts would remain outside the proposed inheritance law, which would tax inherited assets and possessions rather than earned income.
items.note: 此处指拥有的资产和财物，不限于金融资产。

items.src: Efficient kitchen bulbs brought a reduction in electricity costs, not the rise, repeated swings, or eventual levelling off that neighbours had predicted.
items.para: Neighbours had predicted an increase, fluctuation, or eventual stabilisation in electricity costs, but efficient kitchen bulbs produced a decrease instead.
items.note: 指费用下降，而非上升、波动或趋于稳定。

items.src: Engineers explained that network speeds vary with conditions, rejecting claims that they invariably rise, invariably fall, or stay unchanged throughout every test.
items.para: Rejecting claims that network speeds always increase, always decrease, or remain constant throughout every test, engineers explained that speeds change with conditions.
items.note: 指随条件变化，不限定升降方向，也非保持不变。

items.src: Although journalists may comment and earn rewards encouraging investigations, correcting errors is an obligation, not simply something they prefer doing.
items.para: Reporters have permission to comment and possible rewards as an incentive to investigate, but correcting mistakes is a duty rather than a preference.
items.note: 此处指必须履行的责任，而非个人选择。

items.src: Paper stored near the heater suffered from heat and dryness, but moisture blurred the puzzle diagrams on another sheet, which also collected dust.
items.para: Dampness blurred another sheet's puzzle diagrams, and dust accumulated there, while paper beside the heater suffered from heat and dryness.
items.note: 此处指纸张含水而产生的潮湿状态。

items.src: The nurse described recovery times as variable despite identical ankle treatments, explaining that rehabilitation was short, progress consistent, and discharge dates easy to predict.
items.para: Despite identical ankle treatments, recovery times were not uniform, the nurse explained, although rehabilitation was brief, progress steady, and discharge dates predictable.
items.note: 此处指不同患者的康复时间并不一致。

items.src: Our guide was self-assured when leading, careful near cliffs, outgoing with strangers, and thoughtful in arranging frequent breaks for walkers struggling on steep paths.
items.para: By arranging frequent breaks for walkers struggling on steep paths, our guide was considerate, while also confident when leading, cautious near cliffs, and sociable with strangers.
items.note: 此处指体贴他人，照顾他人的实际需要。

items.src: The historian explained that the fortress's carved faces aimed to terrify attackers, not just surprise them slightly, win their admiration, or momentarily bewilder them.
items.para: Carved fortress faces were intended to intensely frighten attackers, not slightly startle, merely impress, or briefly confuse them, the historian explained.
items.note: 指使人极度害怕，强于轻微惊吓。

items.src: The survey found shared gardens increased meeting frequency and the likelihood of neighbours becoming friends, without affecting how long or how close friendships became.
items.para: Friendship duration and strength were unaffected, but the survey found communal gardens increased meeting frequency and the probability of neighbours becoming friends.
items.note: 此处指邻居成为朋友的可能性。

items.src: Each spring, the wildlife centre broadcasts live eagle footage online while capturing it, cutting highlights, and preserving those clips for future research.
items.para: Every spring, the wildlife centre records live eagle footage and transmits it online, while it edits highlights and archives those clips for future research.
items.note: 此处指向观众播送实时影像。

items.src: New technicians must apply for and obtain a safety certificate through practical training, show it before laboratory work, and extend its validity annually.
items.para: Before laboratory work, new technicians must present a safety certificate, which they must first request and acquire through practical training, then renew annually.
items.note: 此处指通过培训取得安全证书。

items.src: The pottery workshop achieved outstanding first-year profits despite merely acceptable sales, weak exports, and ordinary productivity, according to its accountant.
items.para: Its accountant described the pottery workshop's sales as satisfactory, exports as poor, and productivity as average, yet its first-year profits were exceptional.
items.note: 此处指出色、远超一般水平。

items.src: Listeners called the fictional ruler's food ban evil rather than merely unwise or self-centred, contrasting it with his earlier just rationing policy.
items.para: Contrasting his earlier fair rationing policy with the food ban, listeners judged the fictional ruler's decision wicked, not merely foolish or selfish.
items.note: 此处指蓄意伤害他人的邪恶，而非仅仅愚蠢。

items.src: Our investigation linked pond pollution to farm chemicals, confirming our forecast and prompting both advice on prevention and an alert to farmers.
items.para: Our prediction was confirmed by an inquiry linking pond pollution to farm chemicals, which prompted both a recommendation for prevention and a warning to farmers.
items.note: 两者都指为查明事实而进行的调查。
