items.src: Visitors find the sculpture garden agreeable rather than fashionable, although its familiar layout is less impressive than its unusual artworks.
items.para: Although its unusual artworks are more impressive than its familiar layout, visitors consider the sculpture garden pleasant rather than fashionable.
items.note: 此处都指令人愉快，而非时髦或壮观。

items.src: The captain asks players to paraphrase instructions, not learn them by heart, express them in another language, or give only their main points.
items.para: Players are asked by the captain to reword the instructions while preserving their meaning, not memorize, translate, or summarize them.
items.note: 指保留原意，用不同措辞重新表达。

items.src: Three rural clinics replaced their competitive relationship with an alliance to share nurses, rejecting both unification and a complete break in relations.
items.para: Rejecting both a merger and complete separation, three rural clinics ended their rivalry by forming a partnership to share nursing staff.
items.note: 两者都指为共同目标建立的合作关系。

items.src: The ranger judged the nesting conditions unsatisfactory, not merely short-lived, and said drainage could make them good enough but never perfect.
items.para: Drainage could make nesting conditions acceptable but never ideal, said the ranger, who considered them inadequate rather than merely temporary.
items.note: 此处都指条件未达到所需标准。

items.src: The college will equip each group with a microscope before teaching its use, overseeing their pond surveys, and evaluating their work.
items.para: Before staff train students to use the microscope, supervise their pond surveys, and assess their work, the college will provide each group with one.
items.note: 此处指为各组提供所需的显微镜。

items.src: The ministry replaced its outdated filing system, which was also prone to failure and expensive to operate, with a more resource-efficient alternative.
items.para: A more efficient alternative replaced the ministry's obsolete filing system, which had also proved unreliable and costly to run.
items.note: 此处都指系统已过时，不再适用。

items.src: Mei expects her lemon tree to blossom and increase in height this spring, produce lemons in summer, and lose some foliage in winter.
items.para: Mei expects her lemon tree to bear fruit in summer and shed leaves in winter, after it begins to produce flowers and grow taller this spring.
items.note: 两者都指植物开花，而非结果或长高。

items.src: The ambitious charity founder would negotiate concessions but disliked handing over responsibility, while her deputy feared negative judgments.
items.para: The charity founder was eager to succeed and willing to compromise but reluctant to delegate, whereas her deputy was afraid of criticism.
items.note: 此处指有抱负，渴望取得成功。

items.src: Tomorrow's documentary features a sound restoration specialist explaining repairs to a learner, a hobbyist, and someone whose knowledge covers many fields.
items.para: A trainee, an amateur, and a generalist will hear an expert in sound restoration explain repair methods in tomorrow's documentary.
items.note: 两者都指在特定领域具有专门知识的人。

items.src: Although minor errors were harmless and criticism was helpful, ignoring contradictory evidence proved fatal, rather than merely damaging, to the team's theory.
items.para: Disregarding conflicting evidence was ruinous, not merely harmful, to the team's theory, whereas small mistakes were harmless and criticism was beneficial.
items.note: 此处指毁灭性的，足以使理论彻底失败。

items.src: Maya, a novelist, asked a reviewer of literature to assess her manuscript before consulting a writer of short stories and an editor of magazines.
items.para: Before consulting a short-story writer and a magazine editor, Maya, an author of long fiction, asked a literary critic to assess her manuscript.
items.note: 指创作长篇小说的作者。

items.src: Ravi's eyesight had deteriorated, although he could still hear clearly, remember details accurately, and remain steady on his feet.
items.para: Despite retaining good hearing, an accurate memory, and reliable balance, Ravi had experienced a decline in his vision.
items.note: 两者都指看见事物的能力，即视力。

items.src: Despite a stronger clasp, a mended strap, and added ornamentation, the helmet retained a design flaw that left the wearer's neck exposed.
items.para: A design defect still exposed the wearer's neck despite the helmet's clasp improvement, strap repair, and added decoration.
items.note: 都指设计中存在的缺陷。

items.src: Library records distinguish overdue books from lost, damaged, and reserved copies, so staff can send borrowers the appropriate reminder.
items.para: Missing, reserved, and damaged copies require different reminders from books that are late, so library staff distinguish these categories in their records.
items.note: 此处指图书超过规定归还期限。

items.src: A ranger will lead visitors through woodland, instruct them in tree identification, assess their knowledge, and oversee their bark collection.
items.para: Visitors will have a ranger to guide them through woodland, teach them tree identification, test their knowledge, and supervise their bark collection.
items.note: 此处指教授辨认树木的知识或技能。

items.src: Before cutting shapes and stitching them into costumes, the maker will flatten storage wrinkles with a heated press, then fold the unused fabric.
items.para: The maker will smooth out storage creases using a hot press, cut out shapes, sew together costumes, then fold up the unused fabric.
items.note: 此处都指将存放造成的褶皱弄平。

items.src: After providing a price estimate and receiving the café's purchase request, the supplier will send an invoice upon delivery and a receipt after payment.
items.para: The supplier will issue a bill upon delivery and a receipt after payment, having first provided an estimate and received the café's order.
items.note: 都指列明应付费用、要求付款的账单。

items.src: Leila was initially startled and puzzled, but these feelings became disappointment and then fury when she learned her colleague had deliberately stolen her work.
items.para: Learning that her coworker had deliberately stolen her work transformed Leila's initial surprise and confusion into disappointment, followed by intense anger.
items.note: 指极度愤怒，强于一般的失望或惊讶。

items.src: Amara's reign followed her princesshood and exile but preceded her retirement, and astronomers compiled the kingdom's first star catalogue while she ruled.
items.para: Following life as a princess and time in exile, Amara's time on the throne saw astronomers compile the kingdom's first star catalogue before her retirement.
items.note: 此处指君主在位统治的时期。

items.src: Pottery students poke a stick into soft clay, turn it to widen the hole, pull it out, and raise it for inspection.
items.para: To make a wider hole, pottery students push a stick into soft clay, rotate it, withdraw it, and lift it for inspection.
items.note: 此处指把工具戳入软黏土。

items.src: Climbers must detach the lamp from its helmet bracket, check it, and pack it carefully rather than merely reposition it.
items.para: Rather than simply adjust the lamp, climbers must remove it from its helmet bracket, inspect it, and pack it carefully.
items.note: 指将灯从连接着的头盔支架上拆下。

items.src: Patients who stare at bright screens may develop temporary eye discomfort, unlike those who look briefly, avert their gaze, or shut their eyes.
items.para: Unlike patients who glance briefly at bright screens, look away, or close their eyes, those who look fixedly at them may develop temporary eye discomfort.
items.note: 指目光固定地盯着看，而非短暂一瞥。

items.src: Museum displays examine how expanding cities affect mankind while also changing habitats for wild animals, farm animals, and plants.
items.para: Alongside habitat changes for wildlife, livestock, and vegetation, the museum's displays examine the effects of urban expansion on humanity.
items.note: 指作为整体的全体人类。

items.src: Maya's dance movements were graceful but lacked vigour, whereas Leo's were accurate yet rigid, according to their instructor.
items.para: Their instructor described Leo's dance movements as precise but stiff, while Maya's were elegant rather than energetic.
items.note: 形容舞蹈动作优美雅致。

items.src: Residents called the fixed permit fee unreasonable because it exceeded average monthly earnings, rejecting officials' claims that it was low and affordable.
items.para: Officials described the fixed permit charge as modest and affordable, but residents considered it excessive because it exceeded average monthly earnings.
items.note: 此处指收费高得不合理。

items.src: This bakery voucher remains valid until Friday evening and can change owners, but cannot be refunded or used after that deadline.
items.para: Transferable but not refundable, this bakery voucher remains redeemable until Friday evening and cannot be used once expired.
items.note: 指优惠券尚在有效期内，可以兑换使用。

items.src: Laboratory staff prohibit wireless connections, allow wired access, monitor downloads, and limit external transfers to protect confidential research data.
items.para: To safeguard confidential research data, laboratory staff permit wired access, ban wireless connections, restrict external transfers, and monitor downloads.
items.note: 指通过规定明确禁止某种行为。

items.src: The presenter called the sailor's survival a miracle, rejecting suggestions that it was merely luck, an ordinary rescue, or an invented story.
items.para: Neither a matter of luck, a routine rescue, nor a fabricated story satisfied the presenter, who called the sailor's survival an inexplicable wonder.
items.note: 此处指似乎无法用自然规律解释的奇迹。

items.src: Our research team plans to establish a discussion group rather than assume control of, enter, or enlarge an existing one.
items.para: An existing discussion group is not something our research team plans to take over, join, or expand; it intends to set up a new one.
items.note: 指新建讨论小组，而非加入或扩大现有小组。

items.src: Restoration managers agree on goals and criteria before work begins, then compare measured outcomes with earlier predictions.
items.para: Before restoration starts, managers establish standards and goals; afterwards, they compare results with previous estimates.
items.note: 指用于评估或判断的标准。

items.src: Passengers' slight worry became mounting irritation as the ferry stalled, then panic at a crash, and finally great relief when everyone proved unharmed.
items.para: A ferry breakdown brought mild concern, then growing frustration; a crash triggered sudden overwhelming fear, followed by immense relief when nobody proved injured.
items.note: 指突然产生、难以控制的强烈恐惧。

items.src: Parents considered the spelling penalties severe, although teachers called them merciful, just, and uniformly applied across classes.
items.para: Teachers described the spelling penalties as lenient, fair, and consistent across classes, but parents regarded them as harsh.
items.note: 形容处罚严厉，而非宽松、公平或一致。

items.src: The village hall's function is to host mediation, although its fitness for this use, seating limit, and benefit remain uncertain.
items.para: With its suitability, capacity, and benefit still uncertain, the village hall nevertheless has a clear purpose: hosting mediation.
items.note: 指建筑所承担的用途或作用。

items.src: Foxes have presumably moved uphill; tracks confirm their presence there, reports suggest cubs accompanied them, and their return remains possible.
items.para: Foxes probably moved uphill; tracks show they are certainly there, cubs reportedly accompanied them, and they could possibly return.
items.note: 表示根据线索推测某事很可能属实。

items.src: The supervisor was beloved and broadly admired, often commended for patient teaching, but sometimes disliked for imposing strict deadlines.
items.para: Although occasionally resented for strict deadlines, the supervisor was deeply cherished, widely respected, and frequently praised for patient teaching.
items.note: 指深受他人喜爱和珍视。

items.src: Repeated satellite failures made island broadcasting impractical, not merely expensive or hazardous, while an existing recording made another trip needless.
items.para: An existing recording made another trip unnecessary; repeated satellite failures rendered island broadcasting unworkable rather than merely costly or risky.
items.note: 指在实际条件下行不通。

items.src: Volunteers left the exposed camping area, passed a neighbouring settlement and a solitary farm dwelling, then returned to their compound.
items.para: Returning to their enclosed complex, volunteers departed the open campsite and went past a nearby village and an isolated farmhouse.
items.note: 指有围界的建筑群，而非单栋房屋。

items.src: A fictional film shows criminals trailing a scientist, issuing threats, and deciding to kidnap him before eventually setting him free.
items.para: Criminals eventually release a scientist in a fictional film, but first they follow him, threaten him, and decide to abduct him.
items.note: 指非法将他人劫走并拘禁。

items.src: Two animated clay figures reduce their speed but still collide on a bridge, then separate and reverse direction.
items.para: Two animated clay figures slow down on a bridge but crash together nonetheless, after which they move apart and turn back.
items.note: 指运动中的物体相撞。

items.src: The club sells merchandise rather than providing paid assistance, using net gains from sales alongside donated money to purchase new helmets.
items.para: New helmets are funded by donations and profits from the club's sales of goods, rather than from providing services.
items.note: 两者都指供出售的商品，而非服务或收入。

items.src: Strong evening coffee can disrupt sleep even when it neither postpones its onset nor reduces its duration, despite claims that it makes sleep better.
items.para: Despite claims that strong evening coffee can improve sleep, it can disturb sleep even when it does not delay or shorten it.
items.note: 此处指干扰正常睡眠，不只是推迟或缩短睡眠。

items.src: Besides defining building reuse, the report presents the warehouse conversion as an instance of success, explains its causes, and forecasts similar outcomes.
items.para: Using the warehouse conversion as an example, the report offers a definition of building reuse, an explanation of its success, and a prediction of similar outcomes.
items.note: 两者都指说明某类现象的具体事例。

items.src: Unlike languages already lost, the threatened village language still has speakers, but it lacks the broad use and security of the national language.
items.para: The national language is widespread and stable, whereas the village language is endangered but not extinct, since it still has speakers.
items.note: 指语言面临消失危险，但尚未消失。

items.src: A low electrical buzz followed the switch's snap, then a short electronic tone sounded before the siren's howl sent residents into shelters.
items.para: Residents entered shelters when the siren's wail followed a brief beep, which came after an electrical hum and the earlier switch click.
items.note: 此处两者都指警报器响亮而持续的长鸣。

items.src: After repairing the seal, the technician rated performance satisfactory rather than outstanding, noting that previously it had been weak and variable.
items.para: The technician judged the machine's previously poor and inconsistent performance acceptable, though not excellent, after repairing its seal.
items.note: 两者都表示达到要求、可以接受，并非十分出色。

items.src: Long battery life is the sensor's chief benefit; its compactness matters less, its accuracy surprised designers, and future savings remain only a possibility.
items.para: Compactness is a minor benefit, accuracy an unexpected one, and future savings a potential one, but long battery life is the sensor's main benefit.
items.note: 两者都表示最主要、最重要的。

items.src: Unable to capture the guest's voice, the producer decided to halt the interview, restart it after repairs, and lengthen it by ten minutes.
items.para: Because he could not record the guest's voice, the producer decided to stop the interview, resume it after repairs, and extend it by ten minutes.
items.note: 两者都指使正在进行的活动停止。

items.src: Unlike lakes formed by nature, man-made reservoirs result from construction, yet both categories include lasting bodies of water and ones that soon disappear.
items.para: Both permanent and temporary bodies of water occur among natural lakes and artificial reservoirs, although only the latter result from construction.
items.note: 两者都指由人建造而非自然形成的。

items.src: The ecologist considered eliminating all orchard insects absurd, not merely dangerous or expensive, rejecting the farmer's claim that this was a workable solution.
items.para: Although the farmer called eliminating all orchard insects practical, the ecologist judged it ridiculous rather than simply risky or costly.
items.note: 两者都表示荒谬、不合情理，语气强于有风险。

items.src: Passengers felt anger and disappointment over ferry cancellations, while doubts about safety prompted concern rather than relief.
items.para: Passengers felt worry rather than relief about safety, while cancelled ferry services provoked anger and disappointment.
items.note: 此处指对安全风险的担忧。

items.src: Archaeologists gather and mark food samples before they analyse them to identify ancient crops, then keep them for future research.
items.para: To identify ancient crops, archaeologists collect and label food samples, carefully examine them, and then store them for later research.
items.note: 此处指仔细研究样本以辨认古代作物。

items.src: Market rules make hygiene training compulsory and refresher sessions voluntary, encourage mentoring, and ban unsupervised practice for new cooks.
items.para: For new market cooks, mentoring is recommended and unsupervised practice is prohibited, while hygiene training is mandatory and refresher sessions are optional.
items.note: 两者都表示规定必须参加，而非自愿。

items.src: Villagers consider the holy forest legally safeguarded, the nearby grove accursed, and the clearing nonreligious in character.
items.para: Villagers regard the forest as sacred and protected by law, but the nearby grove as cursed and the clearing as secular.
items.note: 此处指村民认为森林具有宗教上的神圣性。

items.src: Hana felt surprise, then embarrassment rather than frustration after misnaming her manager, and finally felt relieved when he laughed kindly.
items.para: Misnaming her manager brought Hana surprise followed by awkwardness, not frustration, but his kind laughter gave her relief.
items.note: 此处指叫错经理名字后产生的尴尬感。

items.src: Furniture demand grew rapidly after magazine coverage, but production increased little, prices rose by degrees, and shortages were not permanent.
items.para: After magazine coverage, furniture production increased slightly and prices rose gradually; demand grew quickly, but shortages persisted only temporarily.
items.note: 此处表示需求增长速度快，而非幅度或持续时间。

items.src: Participants found symbol recall challenging but fun, whereas copying symbols bored them, and matching pairs remained within their abilities.
items.para: Although copying symbols was tedious and matching pairs was manageable, participants found recalling symbols difficult but enjoyable.
items.note: 此处指回忆符号有难度、考验能力。

items.src: Ice crystals sparkle in reflected candlelight while the flames waver and nearby embers shine steadily, then lose brightness as they cool.
items.para: Candle flames flicker as ice crystals glitter in their reflected light; nearby embers glow but fade as they cool.
items.note: 两者都指反射光线形成细小闪光。

items.src: Visitors may examine sculptures but must beware of low beams, avoid fragile screens, and listen carefully to their guide in the attic.
items.para: Inside the attic, visitors must watch out for low beams, keep away from fragile screens and pay attention to their guide, but may look closely at sculptures.
items.note: 此处表示留意并提防低矮横梁造成的危险。

items.src: Rowing coaches decided to embrace video feedback rather than merely try it briefly or evaluate it cautiously, while decisively refusing automated scoring.
items.para: While choosing to firmly reject automated scoring, rowing coaches decided to willingly adopt video feedback, not merely briefly test or carefully assess it.
items.note: 此处指主动接受并采用视频反馈。

items.src: Swimming exhausted Mara, yet improved her stamina; furthermore, she slept better, so she continued training, since stopping would mean losing these benefits.
items.para: Swimming exhausted Mara; however, her stamina increased; additionally, her sleep improved; consequently, she continued training, knowing she would otherwise lose these benefits.
items.note: 两者都用于引出补充信息。

items.src: Housing changes from scattered cottages to regularly spaced terraces, then a dense cluster of flats, before ending in loosely arranged villas.
items.para: After widely spaced cottages and evenly distributed terraces come closely packed flats, followed finally by loosely grouped villas.
items.note: 此处都指建筑物排列紧密。

items.src: Interpreting trainees consider accent recordings desirable, daily practice indispensable, expensive headphones needless, and overseas training unworkable on their limited budgets.
items.para: For interpreting trainees with limited budgets, overseas training is impractical and expensive headphones unnecessary, while daily practice is essential and accent recordings worth having.
items.note: 此处指值得拥有，而非必不可少。

items.src: Residents were optimistic before applying and worried while waiting, but without an appeals panel, rejection left them helpless rather than accepting their fate.
items.para: Without an appeals panel, rejected residents felt powerless, not resigned, although they had been hopeful before applying and anxious while awaiting decisions.
items.note: 两者都指无力改变所处的境况。

items.src: With one bathroom, waiting is inevitable, although showers are voluntary, arguments improbable, and lateness avoidable if the family gets up early.
items.para: If the family rises early, lateness is preventable; with a single bathroom, showers are optional and arguments unlikely, but waiting remains unavoidable.
items.note: 两者都表示无法避免、必然发生。

items.src: Researchers used reflective paint to brighten the chamber; blinds would reduce light, screens would shield windows, and diffusers would reduce harsh reflections.
items.para: Although blinds would darken the chamber, screens would shade windows and diffusers would soften reflections, researchers used reflective paint to lighten the chamber.
items.note: 此处指使空间变得更明亮。

items.src: Retired divers highlight past dangers and clarify their causes, whereas managers compare safety procedures across decades and minimise the significance of earlier failures.
items.para: Managers compare safety procedures across decades and downplay earlier failures, while retired divers emphasise past dangers and explain their causes.
items.note: 两者都表示突出强调某事。

items.src: Leila rejected the team's risk-averse, orthodox approach and proposed a bold solution, which her tutor praised as adventurous rather than rash.
items.para: Her tutor praised Leila's daring solution as adventurous, not reckless, after she rejected the team's cautious, conventional approach.
items.note: 此处指敢于冒险、突破常规。

items.src: Biologists distinguish the odds of future fish survival from guaranteed survival, while examining how often past deaths occurred and how uncertain their estimates remain.
items.para: Future fish survival's likelihood is distinguished from a guarantee of survival by biologists also examining the frequency of past deaths and uncertainty in their estimates.
items.note: 此处都表示鱼存活的可能性。

items.src: Despite rivalry for customers and disputes about prices, cooperation between guides and hosts reduced visitors' reliance on camping equipment.
items.para: Visitors' dependence on camping gear decreased through collaboration between guides and hosts, despite competition for customers and disagreement over prices.
items.note: 两者都指为共同目标开展协作。

items.src: Records show a fraction of harbour warehouses survived, most collapsed, about fifty percent were rebuilt, and all were eventually replaced.
items.para: Records concerning harbour warehouses document a large majority collapsing, a small proportion surviving, roughly half being rebuilt, and the entire group eventually being replaced.
items.note: 此处指整体中占比很小的一部分。

items.src: Kitchen volunteers show flexibility when switching duties, patience with delays, efficiency when serving meals, and dependability through regular attendance.
items.para: Regular attendance demonstrates kitchen volunteers' reliability, while delays reveal their patience, meal service their efficiency, and changes of duty their adaptability.
items.note: 此处指面对职责变化时的适应能力。

items.src: Gentle breezes bend willow branches, stronger winds shake them, and sudden gusts whip them sideways but rarely break them.
items.para: Sudden gusts jerk willow branches sideways but seldom snap them, whereas gentle breezes bend them and stronger winds shake them.
items.note: 此处指使树枝突然猛烈地移动。

items.src: After repeated double bookings, the manager chose to criticize the system rather than endorse it, withhold judgment, or merely inquire about it.
items.para: The manager rejected opportunities to give approval to, reserve judgment on, or ask questions about the system, choosing to find fault with it after double bookings.
items.note: 此处指指出系统的问题，表达批评。

items.src: The economist called the income forecast nonsense, not merely conjecture or overstatement, although the mayor presented it as established truth.
items.para: The mayor presented the income forecast as fact, but the economist dismissed it as rubbish rather than mere speculation or exaggeration.
items.note: 此处指被认为荒谬无稽的说法。

items.src: Choir members estimate their anxiety before rehearsals, record their ratings, compare successive scores, and explain any changes to the conductor.
items.para: Before rehearsals, singers roughly assess their anxiety and write down their ratings; they then compare successive scores and explain any changes to the conductor.
items.note: 此处指对焦虑程度作大致判断。

items.src: A film critic praised the documentary's director for employing an animation artist instead of someone conducting interviews to explain difficult theories.
items.para: Employing an animator rather than an interviewer to explain difficult theories earned the documentary's director praise from a film reviewer.
items.note: 此处指对电影作出评价的影评人。

items.src: The guide called the handmade collection notable rather than ordinary, while stressing that its pieces were neither valuable nor very old.
items.para: Although its pieces were neither valuable nor ancient, the handmade collection was remarkable rather than ordinary, the guide explained.
items.note: 此处指不同寻常、值得特别注意。

items.src: Junior rowers compete close by, reserves race throughout the country, and seniors travel overseas each spring instead of staying in their own country.
items.para: Each spring, senior rowers travel abroad rather than remain at home, while juniors compete nearby and reserves race nationwide.
items.note: 此处指出国，到国外去。

items.src: Weekly clinic groups help bereaved adults distinguish sorrow over a friend's death from self-blame, angry feelings, and worry about the future.
items.para: Bereaved adults attending weekly clinic groups learn to distinguish grief over a friend's death from guilt, anger, and anxiety about the future.
items.note: 此处指失去朋友后的悲伤与哀痛。

items.src: Her diary contrasted a weekend excursion to riverside gardens with an exploratory journey, a sea passage and her daily journey to work.
items.para: Contrasting a weekend outing to gardens beside the river with an expedition, a voyage and her daily commute, her diary compared different travel experiences.
items.note: 此处都指休闲性质的短途出游。

items.src: Candidates must activate their tablets, reduce the volume and configure the keyboard before they disable notifications for the language test.
items.para: Before candidates turn off notifications for the language test, they must switch on their tablets, turn down the volume and set up the keyboard.
items.note: 此处都指关闭通知功能。

items.src: Retired council workers recall the courthouse debate, recount its arguments and exchange views on its outcome, but cannot envisage a similar meeting today.
items.para: Although retired council workers cannot imagine a similar meeting today, they remember the courthouse debate, describe its arguments and discuss its outcome.
items.note: 此处都指记得过去发生的事情。

items.src: Leila's magnificent birthday cake stood inside its undecorated box, its multicoloured icing supporting finely crafted sugar flowers.
items.para: Inside a plain box stood Leila's spectacular birthday cake, whose colourful icing supported delicate sugar flowers.
items.note: 此处都形容蛋糕极其出色、令人赞叹。

items.src: After feeling worried about lost files and relieved by their recovery, researchers expressed appreciation for the technician's help and respect for her skill.
items.para: Researchers expressed gratitude for the technician's help and admiration for her skill after anxiety over lost files gave way to relief at their recovery.
items.note: 此处都指对他人帮助的感谢。

items.src: Editors consider checking every listener's story a burden, not a desirable opening, an ordinary obligation or a slight nuisance.
items.para: For editors, verifying every listener's account represents a demanding responsibility rather than a welcome opportunity, a routine duty or a minor inconvenience.
items.note: 此处指费力且令人感到负担的职责。

items.src: The puzzle was very complex and excessively long, but participants were sufficiently attentive to identify an assumption that was nearly invisible.
items.para: Participants were attentive enough to identify an almost invisible assumption, although the puzzle was very complex and overly long.
items.note: 两者都表示程度达到所需标准。

items.src: Strong winds make the recycling centre's panels vibrate, but they neither bow outwards, sway sideways nor slip downwards.
items.para: Although the recycling centre's panels do not bend outward, swing sideways or slide down, strong winds make them shake rapidly.
items.note: 此处指在强风中快速反复振动。

items.src: A cheerful lad carried our luggage while his younger sister fetched cups and their father watched their mother prepare tea.
items.para: While their mother made tea and their father watched, a cheerful boy carried our luggage and his younger sister fetched cups.
items.note: 此处两者都指男孩。

items.src: After storms destroyed their coastal homes, fishing families chose to migrate inland rather than reconstruct their houses, commute or go back later.
items.para: Fishing families chose to relocate inland, not rebuild, commute or return later, after storms destroyed their homes on the coast.
items.note: 此处都指迁往别处居住。

items.src: This community favours burial over burning the dead, while grieving families gather afterwards to honour the deceased through shared memories.
items.para: Families gather for mourning and remembrance after interment, which this community prefers to cremation.
items.note: 两者都指将遗体埋入地下。

items.src: Small birds benefit from the nest's warmth overnight, but excessive heat, severe cold and abrupt drops in temperature can harm them.
items.para: Although extreme heat, bitter cold and sudden chills can harm small birds, the nest's moderate heat benefits them overnight.
items.note: 此处指鸟巢内温和的热度。

items.src: Workshop access is restricted to trained staff, whereas tours require reservations, lectures welcome everyone, and archive visits need supervision.
items.para: Tours are available only by reservation, lectures open to all visitors, archive visits allowed only under supervision, and workshop access permitted only for trained employees.
items.note: 两者都表示仅允许受过培训的员工进入。

items.src: The accountant considered phone alerts a distraction rather than helpful reminders, welcome motivation or practical assistance while checking invoices.
items.para: While checking invoices, the accountant found phone alerts neither a useful reminder, a welcome incentive nor a practical aid, but an unwanted diversion.
items.note: 两者都指使注意力偏离当前任务的事物。

items.src: Following an examination, the technician recommended a small adjustment to the machine's settings rather than replacing it or taking it away.
items.para: After inspection, the technician advised against replacement or removal of the machine, recommending a small alteration to its settings instead.
items.note: 此处都指对机器设置作出改动。

items.src: The balloon's squeak made several children giggle, while others drew startled breaths, cried fearfully or shouted happily during the demonstration.
items.para: Several children began to laugh softly in little bursts at the demonstration's squeaking balloon, while others began to gasp in surprise, cry with fright or cheer with delight.
items.note: 指发出一阵阵轻轻的咯咯笑声。

items.src: The sculptor's dispute with the gallery owner over lighting ended after talks produced mutual concessions, allowing them to work together again.
items.para: Negotiation led to a compromise over lighting, ending the sculptor's disagreement with the gallery owner and enabling renewed cooperation.
items.note: 两者都指双方在某事上意见不合。

items.src: The coach attributed the beginners' silence to confusion about the rules, not boredom, anxiety about failing or declining self-belief.
items.para: The coach explained that beginners' silence reflected lack of understanding of the rules, not lack of interest, fear of failure or loss of confidence.
items.note: 此处都指对规则缺乏理解。

items.src: Hana's physiotherapist advised her to press lightly rather than firmly, moving her hands at a slow pace and maintaining uniform pressure.
items.para: Hana was advised by her physiotherapist to move her hands slowly, apply pressure evenly and press gently rather than firmly.
items.note: 此处都指轻轻用力，施加较小压力。

items.src: Engineers confirmed that the panels were secure, properly aligned, equally spaced and entirely level before allowing pedestrians into the square.
items.para: Before permitting pedestrians to enter the square, engineers confirmed the panels were correctly aligned, firmly attached, evenly spaced and completely level.
items.note: 此处都指面板固定牢靠、不易松脱。

items.src: Planning helps trainee chefs cope with examination pressure, rather than merely predict it, escape it, or pretend it does not exist.
items.para: With planning, trainee cooks can manage examination stress rather than simply anticipate, avoid or ignore it.
items.note: 此处指应对并处理压力，而非回避或忽视。

items.src: Her cleverness shaped the shelter design; she waited patiently for approval, presented it confidently, and persisted despite rejection.
items.para: She showed patience awaiting approval, confidence presenting her shelter design, and persistence after rejection; the design itself reflected her ingenuity.
items.note: 此处指设计中解决问题的巧思。

items.src: The family locks away its gardening gear but leaves packets for sowing, plant food, and decomposed organic material on open shelves.
items.para: Seeds, fertiliser, and compost remain on open shelves, whereas the family keeps its gardening equipment locked away.
items.note: 此处统指园艺用具，不指种子或肥料。

items.src: Researchers need continuous footage of the reef, not occasional clips, late transmissions, or recordings played faster than normal.
items.para: Intermittent clips, delayed transmissions, and accelerated playback cannot meet the researchers’ need for uninterrupted footage of the reef.
items.note: 指录像持续不断，没有中断。

items.src: Shipping records helped producers locate the harbour before they travelled there, charted its layout, and described it in their documentary.
items.para: Shipping documents enabled producers to find the harbour; they subsequently did visit it, map its layout, and describe it in their documentary.
items.note: 此处指借助资料找到具体地点。

items.src: Amina became skilled at analysing arguments through practice, while her self-assured partner remained eager to learn but lacked experience.
items.para: Although her confident partner was still enthusiastic but inexperienced, practice made Amina proficient at analysing arguments.
items.note: 指通过练习具备了熟练分析的能力。

items.src: The coastal project makes yarn from discarded nets, while nearby workshops turn old cordage, cloth, and decorative strips into bags.
items.para: Nearby workshops make bags from old rope, fabric, and ribbon, while the coastal project converts discarded nets into thread.
items.note: 此处指供编织使用的线，而非布或绳。

items.src: Festival accommodation is scarce: hotels have no vacancies, although campsites remain affordable and buses can be found throughout the island.
items.para: Buses are widely available and campsites reasonably priced, but festival accommodation is in short supply, with hotels fully booked.
items.note: 指住宿供应不足，并不等于所有住宿都订满。

items.src: Spectators began to applaud when the violinist finished; some proceeded to shout approval or blow whistles, and the performer began bending forward in acknowledgment.
items.para: Once the violinist finished, spectators began to clap; some proceeded to cheer or whistle, and the performer began to bow.
items.note: 此处指拍手鼓掌，不是欢呼或吹口哨。

items.src: Volunteers found feast preparations hectic and physically draining but emotionally satisfying, whereas the meal itself was exceptionally calm.
items.para: Although the feast itself was unusually peaceful, volunteers found its preparations emotionally rewarding but physically exhausting and frantically busy.
items.note: 指十分忙碌而且忙乱，不只是令人疲惫。

items.src: Locating seabird nests was the survey's objective, but researchers debated their approach, their findings and which concern deserved precedence.
items.para: Researchers debated the method, outcome and priority of their survey, whose goal was to locate seabird nests.
items.note: 此处两者都指调查希望实现的目标。

items.src: An engineering firm trains recruits for six weeks through its training division, with support from a professional society and a research centre.
items.para: Supported by a professional association and a research institute, an engineering company provides six weeks of recruit training through its training department.
items.note: 此处两者都指经营工程业务的公司。

items.src: Analysts expect winter grain prices to descend gradually as harvest supplies arrive, while meat becomes dearer, milk stays unchanged and fruit varies.
items.para: Meat prices rise, milk prices remain stable and fruit prices fluctuate, while analysts expect grain prices to go down gradually as harvest supplies arrive in winter.
items.note: 此处两者都表示价格下降。

items.src: Our theatre group will purchase flowers and hire costumes for opening night, but take props on loan and give them back afterwards.
items.para: For opening night, our theatre group will borrow props and return them afterwards, but buy flowers and rent costumes.
items.note: 两者都指付钱买下物品。

items.src: The lecturer will toss the foam ball upwards and then catch it cautiously, before gripping it securely and rolling it gently.
items.para: Before proceeding to firmly hold and gently roll the foam ball, the lecturer will lightly throw it upwards and carefully catch it.
items.note: 此处两者都指轻轻抛出。

items.src: Inspectors attributed navigation problems to the absence of road signs, rather than signs being obscured, wrongly positioned or too far apart.
items.para: Inspectors concluded that navigation problems resulted from a complete lack of road signs, not poor visibility, inaccurate placement or excessive spacing.
items.note: 此处指路标完全不存在，而非数量不足。

items.src: Running the ice rink is costly rather than economical, yet ticket revenue makes it profitable while admission remains reasonably priced.
items.para: Although admission is affordable and ticket revenue keeps the rink profitable, operating it is expensive rather than economical.
items.note: 此处两者都表示运营费用高。

items.src: Two guidebooks contained identical exercise sheets, but their covers differed slightly, their diagrams resembled each other overall, and their advertisements had no connection.
items.para: The guidebooks' covers were slightly different, diagrams broadly similar and advertisements entirely unrelated, although their enclosed exercise sheets were exactly the same.
items.note: 两者都表示完全相同，而非仅仅相似。

items.src: Harbour residents were hospitable towards visitors despite speaking little, whereas hill villagers distrusted strangers and town residents showed no concern for them.
items.para: Unlike suspicious hill villagers and indifferent town residents, harbour residents were welcoming towards visitors, although reserved in conversation.
items.note: 此处两者都表示对来访者热情友好。

items.src: Leila remained uninterested in programming, unlike her eager brother, while her cousin was unsure about trying it and her father actively opposed it.
items.para: Her brother was enthusiastic about programming, her cousin hesitant and her father hostile, but Leila remained indifferent to it.
items.note: 此处两者都表示对编程不感兴趣。

items.src: A rice sack is equivalent to three honey jars but outweighs them; beans cost less than rice, while tea costs more.
items.para: Beans are worth less than rice and tea more valuable than rice; a rice sack is equal in value to, but heavier than, three honey jars.
items.note: 这里表示交换价值相等，而非重量相同。

items.src: Although both fabrics share a colour, absorbency is their main distinction; the seller also explains cotton's benefit and linen's drawback.
items.para: The seller explains cotton's advantage and linen's weakness; despite their similarity in colour, the fabrics' main difference is absorbency.
items.note: 这里指两种面料之间的差别。

items.src: Engineers can turn, angle, or lower the drone's camera manually, but only the new software can stabilize it in strong winds.
items.para: Only the new software can steady the drone's camera in strong winds, although engineers can manually rotate, tilt, or lower it.
items.note: 这里指使相机平稳，减少晃动。

items.src: The nurse advised us to examine the grazed knee, bathe it gently with clean water, remove any moisture, and apply a dressing.
items.para: Following the nurse's advice, we should inspect the scraped knee, wash it gently with clean water, then dry and cover it.
items.note: 这里指用清水轻轻清洗受伤部位。

items.src: After submitting her membership request and obtaining parental consent, Maya signed a two-year training contract with the club and received proof of payment.
items.para: Maya submitted her application, obtained parental permission, and signed a binding agreement to train with the club for two years before receiving a receipt.
items.note: 这里指规定训练义务的有约束力的协议。

items.src: Forecasters consider summer shortages in the valley probable but not certain after three dry winters; flooding has little chance, though it cannot be ruled out.
items.para: Summer shortages in the valley are likely but not certain after three dry winters, forecasters say; they consider flooding doubtful but not impossible.
items.note: 两者均表示很可能发生，但并非确定。

items.src: Palace guides attended a meeting about tour arrangements and an English class before holding a rehearsal of their English tour, followed by a formal evaluation.
items.para: A planning meeting and a language lesson preceded the palace guides' practice session for their English tour, which was followed by a formal assessment.
items.note: 这里指正式导览前的演练。

items.src: Unclear symbols made the historian cautious about dating the tablets, although she remained interested; her assistant felt certain, while the impatient director wanted results.
items.para: Her assistant was confident and the director impatient for results, but unclear symbols left the curious historian careful about dating the tablets.
items.note: 这里指因担心判断出错而保持谨慎。

items.src: The chair agreed unwillingly to hear recycling complaints and listened attentively, then waited without irritation while her deputy checked figures with little noise.
items.para: Having reluctantly agreed to hear recycling complaints, the chair listened carefully, then waited patiently while her deputy quietly checked figures.
items.note: 这里指集中精神、认真留意地听。

items.src: Decades with elephants gave the ranger wisdom about retreating; her physical courage, rapid responses, and extensive knowledge alone could not guide that decision.
items.para: Physical courage, quick reactions, and broad knowledge alone could not determine when to retreat; the ranger relied on good judgement gained over decades with elephants.
items.note: 这里指长期经验形成的良好判断力。

items.src: The architects will construct and examine their bridge models before they exhibit them to visiting engineers, then put them away afterward.
items.para: The architects will first assemble and inspect their bridge models, then display them to visiting engineers and finally store them.
items.note: 此处指向参观者公开展示模型。

items.src: The bakery's cheaper delivery packaging kept biscuits crisp rather than crumbly, while its cakes were soft and its sweets required prolonged chewing.
items.para: Although its cakes were soft and sweets chewy, the bakery used cheaper delivery packaging that kept biscuits crunchy rather than crumbly.
items.note: 此处指饼干保持酥脆的口感。

items.src: Researchers reduced the lamps' brightness but kept their colour warmth, beam orientation and flickering frequency unchanged, after which participants reported feeling calmer.
items.para: Participants reported feeling calmer after researchers lowered the lamps' light intensity without changing their colour temperature, beam direction or flicker rate.
items.note: 此处指灯光的强度，即明亮程度。

items.src: Our laboratory recorded how many samples it had, tested a selected portion and froze the remainder for later analysis, with none exceeding our requirements.
items.para: After recording the total, our laboratory tested a subset of the samples and froze the rest for later analysis; there was no surplus.
items.note: 指取出一部分后剩下的其余部分。

items.src: For her living sculpture, the artist will gather sunflower seeds and immerse them in water before she can sow them, then moisten the soil.
items.para: The artist will collect and soak sunflower seeds for her living sculpture; afterward, she will plant them and water the soil.
items.note: 此处指把向日葵种子播入土中。

items.src: The club replaced real grass with artificial turf that was hardwearing but unable to decompose naturally, because daily training damaged the original surface.
items.para: Daily training damaged the club's natural grass, so it installed synthetic turf that was durable but not biodegradable.
items.note: 此处指人工制造的，而非天然生长的。

items.src: Older patients found group walks appealing and free from danger, although the activity required effort and was already well known to them.
items.para: Although group walking was demanding and familiar, older patients considered it attractive and safe.
items.note: 此处指活动有吸引力，让人愿意参加。

items.src: Festival volunteers will collect and sort the maps before they distribute them to visitors, then put any unused copies into storage.
items.para: Festival volunteers will hand out maps to visitors after they pick up and sort through them, then pack away any unused copies.
items.note: 此处指把地图分发给到访者。

items.src: The tutor expects courtesy and truthfulness from seminar participants, along with self-assurance when speaking, but does not expect them to share identical opinions.
items.para: Seminar participants are expected to show politeness, honesty and confidence when speaking, but their tutor does not expect agreement.
items.note: 此处指对他人有礼貌、保持尊重。

items.src: The ministry's report presents gross fishing licence revenue alongside net figures and values corrected for inflation, but excludes forecasts.
items.para: Projected figures are excluded from the ministry's report, which presents pre-deduction fishing licence revenue alongside post-deduction figures and inflation-adjusted values.
items.note: 此处指尚未扣除费用等项目的收入。

items.src: Meera learned to admit rather than hide her cooking anxiety, but evening practice helped her conquer it, not merely lessen it.
items.para: Evening practice helped Meera overcome rather than merely reduce her cooking anxiety, which she learned to acknowledge instead of conceal.
items.note: 此处指克服恐惧，而非仅减轻或掩饰。

items.src: The technician requires absolute silence throughout recording, so reducing noise partly, briefly, or at intervals will not suffice.
items.para: Partial noise reduction, temporary quiet, and intermittent pauses are insufficient: the technician needs complete silence throughout recording.
items.note: 此处表示完全无声，而非暂时或部分安静。

items.src: The broadcaster prioritises tracking audience figures throughout the year over predicting future totals, contrasting regional numbers, or releasing statistics publicly.
items.para: For the broadcaster, monitoring audience figures throughout the year takes priority over forecasting future totals, comparing regional numbers, or publishing statistics publicly.
items.note: 此处指全年持续监测听众数据。

items.src: Confusing instructions caused a hold-up in the experiment, but researchers neither cancelled nor restarted it, and they did not extend the session.
items.para: Researchers avoided cancellation, a restart, and an extension of the session despite a delay in the experiment caused by confusing instructions.
items.note: 此处指实验因说明不清而受到耽搁。

items.src: The conservation group's spokesman confirmed Sunday's cleanup to the journalist conducting interviews, while its volunteer organiser consulted its campaign leader.
items.para: Sunday's cleanup was confirmed to the press interviewer by the conservation group's male press representative while its volunteer coordinator consulted its campaign director.
items.note: 此处指获授权代表该团体发言的男性。

items.src: Guided walking holidays made the mountain village prosperous, whereas nearby settlements remain impoverished, economically troubled, or merely able to meet their own needs.
items.para: Nearby settlements remain poor, struggling, or merely self-sufficient, but guided hiking holidays have made the mountain village wealthy.
items.note: 此处指经济富裕，而不只是能够自给。

items.src: The exhibition distinguishes slavery, which treated people as legal property, from paid work, confinement in prison, and compulsory military service.
items.para: Unlike employment, imprisonment, or conscription, bondage in the exhibition's account involved treating people as legal property.
items.note: 此处指人被作为合法财产占有的奴役状态。

items.src: The analyst described population growth as rapid rather than gradual, while noting that its pace was consistent in towns but irregular in villages.
items.para: Population growth was steady in towns but uneven in villages; the analyst characterised the overall increase as swift rather than gradual.
items.note: 此处表示增长迅速，不是稳定或不均匀。

items.src: Island folklore says a goddess guarded the forest, while a human queen, a priestess serving the temple, and a woman predicting events honoured her.
items.para: A mortal queen, a temple priestess, and a female prophet honoured the female deity who guarded the forest in island folklore.
items.note: 此处指女性神祇，而非凡人宗教人物。

items.src: The bakery manager was pessimistic about the sales target, unlike her hopeful deputy, undecided accountant, and uninterested assistant.
items.para: Concerning the sales target, her deputy was hopeful, her accountant uncertain, and her assistant indifferent; the bakery manager, however, was gloomy.
items.note: 此处表示预期目标无法达成的悲观态度。

items.src: Small seafood exporters consider refrigeration crucial and decorative packaging dispensable, although they acknowledge that such packaging offers some benefit rather than being useless.
items.para: Small seafood exporters regard decorative packaging as helpful but optional, not pointless, whereas refrigeration is essential.
items.note: 两者均指至关重要、不可或缺的。

items.src: Researchers initially hoped to firmly substantiate the claim, but used diaries to demolish it instead of scrutinising it carefully or making minor adjustments.
items.para: Researchers originally hoped to strongly support the claim, but used diaries to conclusively disprove it rather than carefully examine or slightly revise it.
items.note: 此处指用证据彻底驳倒某个观点。

items.src: The centre's manager hired a consultant to recommend entrance improvements, a contractor to implement them, and an inspector to check their safety.
items.para: An expert adviser, building contractor and safety inspector were hired by the centre manager to recommend entrance improvements, implement them and check safety, respectively.
items.note: 指受聘提供专业建议的顾问。

items.src: Mina can operate the lighting desk at rehearsals after technicians fit it and fix any faults, with the director checking it beforehand.
items.para: Technicians will install the lighting desk and repair any faults; the director will inspect it before Mina can use it at rehearsals.
items.note: 此处指操作设备以控制灯光。

items.src: Rafael wants a companion for long runs, not someone to train him, compete against him, or simply watch him enthusiastically.
items.para: Neither a personal coach, a race rival, nor an enthusiastic spectator meets Rafael's need for a running partner on lengthy runs.
items.note: 此处指陪自己一起跑步的同伴。

items.src: Patients were initially slightly anxious, then furious about cancellations; staff felt profound disappointment, while the exhausted doctor felt real relief at resting.
items.para: Cancellations left previously slightly worried patients extremely angry; staff were deeply disappointed, but the exhausted doctor was genuinely relieved to rest.
items.note: 两者均表示极其愤怒，而非担心或失望。

items.src: These insects hold young leaves with their legs and pierce them with sharp mouthparts to extract liquid without folding or ripping them.
items.para: To extract liquid, these insects grip young leaves with their legs and puncture them with sharp mouthparts, but do not fold or tear them.
items.note: 两者均指用尖锐部位刺破表面。

items.src: Organisers rejected delaying, abandoning, or cutting short the evening course and decided to extend it by two weeks for additional speaking practice.
items.para: For extra speaking practice, organisers decided to lengthen the evening course by two weeks, rejecting proposals to postpone, cancel, or shorten it.
items.note: 此处指延长课程的持续时间。

items.src: The country's recession followed rapid growth and a long period without growth, prompting bridge spending that continued into the subsequent slow economic revival.
items.para: Following rapid expansion and prolonged stagnation, the country's economic downturn prompted bridge spending, which continued into the subsequent gradual recovery.
items.note: 两者均指经济活动下降的衰退阶段。

items.src: Aisha could describe the fault but refused to guess its cause, testing cables to determine it before explaining it.
items.para: Before proceeding to explain the cause, Aisha tested cables to establish it, refusing to guess despite being able to describe the fault.
items.note: 此处指通过测试查明并确认原因。

items.src: The report separated the testing aim, method and forecast from its actual outcome: the discovery that underwater sensors failed in cloudy water.
items.para: Discovering underwater sensor failure in cloudy water was testing's actual result; the report distinguished this from the testing purpose, procedure and prediction.
items.note: 此处指测试实际产生的结果，而非目标或预测。

items.src: Our producer removes interview noise with a small gadget rather than software, an acoustic barrier or a full-sized mixing desk.
items.para: Instead of a computer program, acoustic screen or full-sized mixing console, our producer uses a small device to remove interview noise.
items.note: 指具有特定实用功能的小装置。

items.src: Decision diaries increased participants' consciousness of personal biases without changing how much they accepted, denied or worried about those biases.
items.para: Participants' acceptance, denial and concern about personal biases remained unchanged, although keeping decision diaries increased their awareness of those biases.
items.note: 此处指对自身偏见的觉察，不指接受或担忧。

items.src: Unlike staff safety regulations, wildlife protection guidelines and visitor limits, visitor etiquette requires photographers to seek permission before photographing volunteers.
items.para: Permission to photograph volunteers is required by rules for visitors' polite behaviour, not rules for staff safety, guidelines for wildlife protection or limits on visitor numbers.
items.note: 指游客应遵守的礼貌行为规范。

items.src: Passengers heard the waterfall's roar above the engine's shrill whistling, the wheels' repeated rattling and the subdued conversation inside their carriage.
items.para: The engine's high whistle, wheels' rhythmic clatter and conversation's quiet murmur were overshadowed by the waterfall's loud, deep sound, which passengers heard inside their carriage.
items.note: 指瀑布发出的低沉巨响。

items.src: Mountain barriers gave the medieval valley comparative peace, but this peace was neither absolute nor everlasting and did not extend across the country.
items.para: Peace in the medieval valley was relative because of mountain barriers, rather than complete, permanent or nationwide.
items.note: 表示相对而言，并非完全或绝对。

items.src: Residents funded repairs to restore the damaged communal oven rather than exchange it, take it away or upgrade its technology.
items.para: Repairs financed by residents would recondition the damaged communal oven, not modernise, remove or replace it.
items.note: 此处指修复旧烤炉，使其恢复正常功能。

items.src: Inspectors found beetles in the ship's commercial cargo, not in travellers' luggage, food for the crew or equipment intended for emergencies.
items.para: Passenger baggage, crew provisions and safety equipment contained no beetles; inspectors found them instead in the ship's commercial freight.
items.note: 指船舶运输的货物，不指旅客行李或船用物资。

items.src: Bakery workers needed intense heat for baking, medium heat for proving dough and slight warmth for storage, where overnight heat loss was insignificant.
items.para: Bakery workers required moderate heat for proving dough but extreme heat for baking; storage needed mild warmth, with negligible overnight heat loss.
items.note: 形容热度极强，而非温和或轻微。

items.src: Investigators established that the shopkeeper was innocent of altering records and was neither deceitful, negligent nor involved in others' wrongdoing; software caused the discrepancies.
items.para: Software caused the discrepancies; investigators established that the shopkeeper was neither dishonest, careless nor complicit and was not guilty of altering records.
items.note: 指未实施篡改记录的行为，对此无罪。

items.src: Stored apples may rot in damp conditions, while others mature, develop pressure marks, or become shrunken and wrinkled without actually decomposing.
items.para: Some stored apples ripen, bruise, or shrivel without decomposing, whereas damp conditions may cause others to decay.
items.note: 此处指苹果因自然分解而腐烂。

items.src: Visiting astronomers receive unlimited archive access, but equipment use is short-term and monitored, with one telescope reserved solely for staff.
items.para: Equipment use is temporary and supervised, and one telescope is exclusive to staff, but visiting astronomers enjoy unrestricted access to the archive.
items.note: 此处均表示档案使用权限不受限制。

items.src: Costume makers assist young designers with fabric selection, while tutors watch them, evaluate their work, and give directions about cutting techniques.
items.para: Tutors observe young designers, assess their work, and instruct them in cutting techniques, while costume makers help them select fabrics.
items.note: 此处均指帮助年轻设计师选择布料。

items.src: Runners' gains stem from breathing exercises, boost confidence, occur alongside dietary changes, and contrast with last year's results, the coach says.
items.para: The coach says runners' gains contribute to confidence, coincide with dietary changes, and differ from last year's results, but result from breathing exercises.
items.note: 此处均表示进步源于呼吸训练。

items.src: Clinic editors aim to simplify patient guidance through plainer wording, verify its facts, improve its layout and supply illustrative cases.
items.para: Clinic editors aim to check accuracy, improve layout and add examples, while using plainer wording to reduce complexity in patient guidance.
items.note: 此处指通过通俗措辞降低理解难度。

items.src: Survey interviewers displayed bias against tower-block residents, while those residents expressed suspicion towards officials, disinterest in the survey, and antagonism towards developers.
items.para: Tower-block residents expressed distrust towards officials, indifference to the survey, and hostility towards developers, while survey interviewers showed prejudice against them.
items.note: 此处指针对某类居民的偏见。

items.src: Before tomorrow's client meeting, the assistant must examine and reproduce the floor plan, preserving every measurement rather than modifying or magnifying it.
items.para: The assistant must inspect and copy the floor plan before tomorrow's client meeting, retaining every measurement, and must not revise or enlarge it.
items.note: 此处指保留原图信息进行复制。

items.src: Following website failure, the council extended the garden grant deadline to Friday without changing when applications opened, reviews occurred, or payments arrived.
items.para: Website failure prompted the council to postpone the garden grant closing date until Friday, leaving the opening date, review date, and payment date unchanged.
items.note: 此处均指申请提交的截止日期。

items.src: The family found that unfamiliar ingredients helped stimulate dinner conversation, whereas questions could steer it, phone calls disrupt it, and arguments stop it.
items.para: The family found questions could direct dinner conversation, phone calls interrupt it, and arguments end it, whereas unfamiliar ingredients helped encourage it.
items.note: 此处均指促进餐桌上的交谈。

items.src: After repeated delays, the robotics workshop changed its component supplier, retaining three separate firms responsible for production, distribution, and retail sales.
items.para: The robotics workshop retained its separate component manufacturer, distributor, and retailer, but selected a different provider after repeated delays.
items.note: 此处均指向车间提供零件的供应方。

items.src: The museum team's finding confirmed its initial theory about the pigment's origin, supported the available evidence, and contradicted its forecast about its age.
items.para: Supporting the existing evidence but contradicting the age prediction, the museum team's conclusion confirmed its original hypothesis about the pigment's origin.
items.note: 此处指研究得出的结论，而非假设或证据。

items.src: Unexpected clues prompted encouragement for puzzle participants to modify and assess their strategy rather than discard it or simply use it again.
items.para: Puzzle participants were encouraged not to abandon or simply repeat their strategy, but to adjust and evaluate it in response to unexpected clues.
items.note: 此处指调整现有策略，不是放弃或重复。

items.src: Researchers dismissed the proposed cause of the fish disappearance as speculation, saying it lacked observational support, systematic examination, and conclusive supporting evidence.
items.para: Without observation, analysis, or proof behind it, the proposed cause of the fish disappearance was dismissed by researchers as guesswork.
items.note: 指缺少充分证据的猜测，而非分析或证明。

items.src: Passengers asked questions regarding luggage storage on their companions' behalf, responding to an announcement but opposing a proposed fee.
items.para: Passengers asked about luggage storage on behalf of companions, in response to an announcement and in opposition to a proposed fee.
items.note: 此处表示问题涉及的话题，即关于。

items.src: Engineering students will compare an automobile engine with engines from a motorbike, a passenger coach, and a goods vehicle in our workshop.
items.para: Our workshop will host engineering students comparing motorcycle, bus, and truck engines with a car engine.
items.note: 此处指汽车，修饰后面的发动机。

items.src: Residents considered the choir's final performance superb, although they had described earlier shows as ordinary, inconsistent, or below expectations.
items.para: Although earlier shows were judged average, uneven, or disappointing, residents thought the choir's final performance was excellent.
items.note: 表示表现极好，赞美程度很高。

items.src: Despite current rain, the ranger warned before birds migrated that, supposing spring became dry, nesting sites would decline owing to falling water levels.
items.para: Although rain continued, before birds migrated the ranger warned that nesting sites would decline if spring became dry because water levels would fall.
items.note: 引出假设条件，相当于如果。

items.src: Workshop owners guarantee payment for compulsory training; they do not merely talk about it, advise that it happen, or forecast it.
items.para: Rather than merely discuss, recommend, or predict payment for compulsory training, workshop owners firmly promise it.
items.note: 此处指明确承诺付款，而非建议或预测。

items.src: The producer called Tuesday's matching interview topics a coincidence, denying that they reflected shared planning, copying, or mistaken communication between stations.
items.para: The producer denied Tuesday's matching interview topics reflected a joint decision, an imitation, or a misunderstanding between stations, calling the match a chance occurrence.
items.note: 指偶然出现的吻合，并非策划或模仿。

items.src: Working with timber calmed the sculptor after hospital shifts more than modelling clay, carving stone, or shaping metal, she said in her interview.
items.para: In her interview, the sculptor said modelling clay, carving stone, or shaping metal calmed her less after hospital shifts than working with wood.
items.note: 此处指用于加工创作的木材。

items.src: Although the seawater was expensive and in short supply, tests showed that contamination made it unfit for experiments involving young coral colonies.
items.para: Tests showed that being polluted made the seawater unsuitable for experiments on juvenile coral colonies, although it was costly and scarce.
items.note: 此处指不适合用于特定实验。

items.src: To explain colour variations, the painter recorded each viewpoint's altitude and direction, while her guide assessed the slope and ease of access.
items.para: The guide assessed each viewpoint's gradient and accessibility, while the painter recorded its elevation and orientation to explain variations in colour.
items.note: 两者均指海拔，即高于海平面的高度。

items.src: The swimming coach began with an outline of breathing techniques, then demonstrated them, explained them thoroughly, and finally evaluated the swimmers' performance.
items.para: A brief overview of breathing techniques opened the coach's session, followed by a practical demonstration, a detailed explanation, and a final assessment of swimmers' performance.
items.note: 此处指仅介绍要点的简要概述。

items.src: Our sleep clinic's systematic approach to recording bedtime habits over several weeks is adaptable, but neither quick nor inexpensive.
items.para: Neither rapid nor economical, our sleep clinic's methodical approach to documenting bedtime habits over several weeks is nevertheless flexible.
items.note: 两者均指按照明确步骤、有条理地进行。

items.src: After settling his debts and household costs, the merchant used his fortune rather than charitable contributions to build a public library.
items.para: The merchant financed a public library with his riches, not donations, after paying his debts and household expenses.
items.note: 此处指拥有的巨额财富，而非运气。

items.src: Chemistry pupils watched footage showing a vehicle crash starting a fire, followed by an explosion that caused an empty laboratory to fall down.
items.para: Footage watched by chemistry pupils showed an empty laboratory's collapse caused by a blast, preceded by a fire started by a vehicle collision.
items.note: 两者均指能量突然猛烈释放造成的爆炸。

items.src: Disputes over fishing rights replaced mutual confidence and close collaboration with tension between the two administrations, although neither side became openly hostile.
items.para: The two administrations developed strained relations over fishing rights, losing mutual trust and close cooperation without descending into open hostility.
items.note: 此处指双方关系紧张，未必公开敌对。

items.src: Our nearby factory uses automated machines to manufacture thousands of reusable lunch boxes weekly, before workers check, pack, and deliver them.
items.para: Workers inspect, package, and distribute thousands of reusable lunch boxes each week after automated machines produce them at our nearby factory.
items.note: 此处均指通过工业加工生产物品。

items.src: Despite modest funding, tiny storage needs, and restricted staffing, processing the telescope's images required tremendous computing power because each contained billions of data points.
items.para: Billions of data points per telescope image demanded enormous computing power for processing, despite moderate funding, minimal storage needs, and limited staffing.
items.note: 此处均强调所需计算能力极其庞大。

items.src: The sailor in the radio drama believes the stars fix his destiny, regardless of his aspirations, plans, or predictions about his future.
items.para: Regardless of his ambitions, intentions, or expectations, the sailor in the broadcast drama believes his fate is determined by the stars.
items.note: 两者均指被认为预先注定的人生轨迹。

items.src: Chess training can improve the stability of attention without increasing its strength or scope, although adapting it to changing situations remains important.
items.para: Although flexibility remains important, chess practice can improve attention's steadiness without increasing its intensity or breadth.
items.note: 此处指注意力保持稳定的性质。

items.src: Volunteers must grip the pole firmly before raising it from the river, then turn it to empty the net before letting go.
items.para: Before volunteers lift the pole from the river, they must grasp it firmly, then rotate it to empty the net before they release it.
items.note: 此处指用手抓牢杆子。

items.src: The guesthouse had a vacancy that evening; another room was reserved, one housed hikers, and one needed repairs.
items.para: Besides a booked room, an occupied room housing hikers and a damaged room needing repairs, the guesthouse had an available room that evening.
items.note: 此处指当晚可供客人入住的空房。

items.src: River travel was the preferred mode of grain transport, but merchants also considered the journey's path, departure times, and maximum load.
items.para: Merchants considered the route, schedule and capacity of grain shipments, although travelling by river remained their preferred method of transport.
items.note: 此处指运输粮食所采用的方式。

items.src: The chair will summarize the kitchen proposals before the committee assesses them carefully, grants official approval, and makes extensive revisions.
items.para: Before the committee proceeds to carefully evaluate, formally approve and thoroughly revise the kitchen proposals, the chair will briefly outline them.
items.note: 指简要概述提案的主要内容。

items.src: The presenter remained neutral about returning wolves, while conservationists favoured the proposal, farmers opposed it, and several viewers had not decided.
items.para: Conservationists were supportive, farmers were opposed, and several viewers were undecided about bringing wolves back, but the presenter remained impartial.
items.note: 指不偏向争论中的任何一方。

items.src: Amira was hired primarily to repair costumes, initially sewed often, and occasionally helped with designs for theatrical productions.
items.para: Although Amira occasionally assisted with theatre costume designs and initially sewed frequently, she was employed mainly to repair costumes.
items.note: 指受雇的主要目的是修补戏服。

items.src: Recently divorced adults receive weekly emotional support from a counselor, while an adviser on legal matters, a financial planner, and a social worker handle practicalities.
items.para: A legal adviser, financial planner and social worker handle practical concerns for recently divorced adults, while a talking therapist provides weekly emotional support.
items.note: 此处指通过谈话提供情绪支持的咨询师。

items.src: The experiment asks observers to distinguish a living being from a mechanical automaton, a projected three-dimensional image, and a carved figure.
items.para: Observers must distinguish a creature from a robot, a hologram and a sculpture for the experiment.
items.note: 指真实的生命个体，而非机器或形象。

items.src: Only our balloon drifted westward at sunset on the equinox; the others separated, heading towards northern hills, southern farmland and the eastern town.
items.para: Balloons diverged on the equinox at sunset: ours went towards the setting sun, others towards northern hills, towards southern farmland and towards the eastern town.
items.note: 春分或秋分日，朝落日方向即向西。

items.src: Curators preserve delicate watercolours with special glass, repair damaged examples before exhibiting them, and examine every painting regularly.
items.para: Before curators display damaged watercolours, they restore them; special glass helps protect delicate examples, and the curators inspect every painting regularly.
items.note: 此处指保护水彩画，防止损坏或变质。

items.src: The coach will assess individual sprinting abilities before documenting them and identifying differences between runners, then work to develop those abilities.
items.para: Before trying to improve individual sprinting abilities, the coach will evaluate them, then record them and compare runners.
items.note: 指对跑者的能力作出评估。

items.src: Interviews revealed extensive support for the festival overall, with particularly eager backing from teenagers but short-lived, narrowly based support among shopkeepers.
items.para: Although shopkeepers offered only temporary, limited backing, interviews showed widespread support for the festival overall, with teenagers especially enthusiastic.
items.note: 指支持覆盖面广，而非热情高或持续久。

items.src: Canal markets tempt workers to stay after work; vendors greet them warmly, musicians provide amusement, and visible patrols make them feel safe.
items.para: Vendors welcome workers at canal markets, where musicians entertain them and visible patrols reassure them; these markets entice workers to stay after work.
items.note: 指以吸引力诱使下班后的工人留下。

items.src: Although checking historical quotations is time-consuming and intellectually taxing, the tutor says it involves neither significant expense nor technical complexity.
items.para: The tutor describes checking historical quotations as mentally demanding and lengthy, but neither financially costly nor technically difficult.
items.note: 此处指核查引文耗费很多时间。

items.src: The minister stressed the necessity of bridge inspections after discussing their expense, how often they occur, and their practical value.
items.para: After discussing the cost, frequency and usefulness of bridge inspections, the minister emphasised the need for them.
items.note: 指桥梁检查的必要性，而非费用或价值。

items.src: Participants described an endless stream of thoughts despite occasional distractions, short breaks and lengthy periods of silence in the puzzle experiment.
items.para: Despite intermittent distractions, brief breaks and prolonged silences, participants in the puzzle experiment described a perpetual stream of thoughts.
items.note: 指思绪仿佛永无止境，不只是持续较久。

items.src: Accuracy is our prime concern for the translation device, while speed ranks second, appearance matters little, and packaging barely matters at all.
items.para: Speed is a secondary concern for our translation device, appearance a minor one, and packaging a negligible one; our main concern remains accuracy.
items.note: 指准确性是首要考虑的问题。

items.src: The novelist was capable and self-assured but unwilling to discuss her manuscript on air, although she keenly wanted to discuss her travels there.
items.para: Although eager to discuss her travels on air, the novelist remained reluctant to discuss her manuscript, despite being able and confident.
items.note: 此处指不愿谈论手稿，而非没有能力。

items.src: Brief pauses help participants maintain concentration during reasoning tasks, rather than recover or strengthen it, whereas sudden noises interrupt their focus.
items.para: Sudden noises disrupt participants' concentration during reasoning tasks, whereas brief pauses help sustain it rather than restore or increase it.
items.note: 指保持已有的注意力，而非恢复或增强。

items.src: Our clinic welcomes elderly and middle-aged patients to balance classes, while young patients attend only if they are physically weak.
items.para: Balance classes at our clinic welcome patients who are advanced in years or middle-aged; young patients attend only if they are frail.
items.note: 此处指年事已高，强调老年而非体弱。

items.src: Ship doctors examine sick passengers before they isolate contagious patients; they then provide treatment and allow recovered passengers to leave.
items.para: Before they quarantine infectious passengers, ship doctors examine sick passengers; they subsequently treat the infectious patients and discharge those who have recovered.
items.note: 此处指为防止疾病传播而隔离病人。

items.src: Unable to move forward without supplies, the defenders had to retreat into nearby mountains and reorganise rather than give themselves up.
items.para: The defenders lacked supplies to advance, so they had to withdraw into nearby mountains and regroup rather than surrender.
items.note: 此处指军队撤离阵地，而非投降。

items.src: Organisers expect attendance to swell when new families arrive, then remain steady, though rain could reduce numbers or make them vary daily.
items.para: When new families arrive, organisers expect attendance to increase, then stabilise, although rain could cause numbers to drop or fluctuate daily.
items.note: 此处指参加人数增加。

items.src: Ravi's fantasy of island life is neither a recollection nor a practical scheme, and he makes no forecast about its likelihood.
items.para: Rather than a memory or a practical plan, Ravi's imagined island life is a daydream, and he offers no prediction about its likelihood.
items.note: 此处指对另一种生活的白日梦。

items.src: The workshop report explains the context of falling output—two experienced technicians absent throughout the busiest month—before assessing consequences, proposing solutions, and forecasting recovery.
items.para: After outlining background circumstances—two experienced technicians absent throughout the busiest month—the workshop’s declining-output report evaluates production impacts, recommends corrective measures, and offers recovery forecasts.
items.note: 此处指帮助理解产量下降的背景情况。

items.src: Copper discoveries offered the town a golden opportunity for recovery, unlike hazardous tourism schemes, expensive factory projects, and restricted farming prospects.
items.para: Unlike risky tourism schemes, costly factory projects, and limited farming prospects, copper discoveries gave the town an excellent opportunity to recover.
items.note: 修饰机会时，表示绝佳、非常有利。

items.src: Survey results showed a majority of participants became calmer, a small number became anxious, everyone stayed awake, and nobody reported feeling angry.
items.para: Survey results showed all respondents stayed awake; most respondents became calmer, a few respondents became anxious, and no respondents reported anger.
items.note: 指参与调查的受访者中超过半数。

items.src: Our documentary's narrator explains the danger to turtles without appearing onscreen, whereas its director, host, and interviewed expert all appear.
items.para: Our documentary shows its director, presenter, and expert interviewee onscreen, but its voice-over speaker explains the threat to turtles without appearing.
items.note: 此处指纪录片中不出镜的旁白解说者。

items.src: Although artists were split over funding, unsure about timing, and unconcerned about publicity, they remained united in opposing the gallery's demolition.
items.para: The artists remained in agreement against demolishing the gallery, despite being divided over funding, uncertain about timing, and indifferent to publicity.
items.note: 此处指反对拆除画廊的立场一致。

items.src: Her improvement remained a riddle: the coaches had no explanation, had not predicted it, and refused to dismiss it as a coincidence.
items.para: Without an explanation or prior prediction, her progress remained a mystery to the coaches, who would not dismiss it as a coincidence.
items.note: 此处指无法解释的谜团。

items.src: Clinic records linked skipped breakfasts to more frequent afternoon sleepiness, but not to increased feelings of hunger, dizziness, or irritability.
items.para: More frequent afternoon drowsiness, rather than increased dizziness, hunger, or irritability, was associated with missing breakfast in the clinic's records.
items.note: 两者都指想睡觉的困倦感。

items.src: Visitors felt mildly curious before the tower ride, a thrill as the skyline appeared, and profound disappointment afterward, but no lasting worry.
items.para: The skyline brought visitors intense excitement during the tower ride, between mild curiosity beforehand and deep disappointment afterward, with no lingering anxiety.
items.note: 此处指景色出现时产生的强烈兴奋感。
