items.src: Ravi would blush and avert his gaze whenever his tutor praised him publicly, rather than give a shy smile or a small bow.
items.para: Public praise from his tutor made Ravi turn red and look away, rather than smile shyly or bow slightly.
items.note: 此处指受到公开表扬时因害羞而脸红。

items.src: Each contestant must explain their business proposal to the person judging it, while the event's financial backer and coordinator listen without commenting.
items.para: While the sponsor and organiser listen silently, every competitor must explain their business proposal to the judge.
items.note: 两者都指参加比赛的人。

items.src: The family agreed to restrict evening screen time to thirty minutes and track usage, rather than lengthen the allowance or ban access entirely.
items.para: Rather than extend evening screen time or prohibit it altogether, the family agreed to limit it to thirty minutes and monitor usage.
items.note: 此处指限定时长，而非完全禁止。

items.src: Every inhabitant receives an entry wristband, whereas visiting guests need passes, and the building's landlord and caretaker retain keys.
items.para: The landlord and caretaker keep keys, but each resident receives an entry wristband, while every visitor needs a pass.
items.note: 两者都指居住在某处的人。

items.src: Amira's liking for documentaries contrasted with her annoyance at adverts, lack of interest in quizzes, and desire to learn more about dramas.
items.para: Amira showed curiosity about dramas, indifference toward quizzes, and irritation at adverts, whereas documentaries inspired fondness.
items.note: 两者都表示对某类事物的喜爱。

items.src: The philosopher called the library a paradise, not merely somewhere to shelter briefly, work amid bustle, or withdraw from other people.
items.para: More than a temporary refuge, busy workplace, or isolated retreat, the library was an ideal haven in the philosopher's eyes.
items.note: 此处比喻令人无比满足的理想场所。

items.src: To dry the wet nets, workers spread the heap into a single thickness rather than arranging them linearly or tying them together.
items.para: Workers spread the pile of wet nets into a layer to dry them, rather than arranging a row or tying a bundle.
items.note: 两者都指东西堆积形成的一堆。

items.src: Visitors become conscious of the thin mountain air and concerned about breathlessness, while guides are used to the altitude and undisturbed by it.
items.para: Although guides are accustomed to the altitude and untroubled by it, visitors become aware of the thin mountain air and worried about breathlessness.
items.note: 此处指察觉到某种情况，不等于担忧或习惯。

items.src: Thousands left homeless by London's 1666 fire also lacked employment and sufficient food, so they relied on charitable support.
items.para: London's 1666 fire left thousands dependent on charity because they were without permanent accommodation, without paid work, and short of food.
items.note: 指没有固定住所，而非失业或缺少食物。

items.src: Fireworks can startle children, while prolonged whistles slowly annoy parents; clowns provide momentary amusement for both before staff gently reassure them.
items.para: Clowns briefly amuse children and parents before staff gently reassure them, while fireworks can suddenly frighten children and prolonged whistles gradually irritate parents.
items.note: 指突然使人受到惊吓，强调突发性。

items.src: The charity will reserve donations for repairs and repay its loan, but must request a grant before using its savings.
items.para: Before it can draw on its savings, the charity must apply for a grant; it will set aside donations for repairs and pay back its loan.
items.note: 指归还先前借入的钱。

items.src: The bereaved manager's grief mingled with worry about returning, remorse over neglected duties, and relief from knowing her colleagues understood.
items.para: Knowing her colleagues understood brought the bereaved manager relief, alongside sorrow, anxiety about returning, and guilt over neglected duties.
items.note: 此处指丧亲后的悲痛，不同于焦虑或内疚。

items.src: The economics host will briefly present the topic, then clarify the definition rather than simply restating it or publicly questioning its validity.
items.para: The economics host will briefly introduce the topic before proceeding to elucidate its definition, not merely repeat or publicly challenge it.
items.note: 此处指阐明定义，使其更容易理解。

items.src: Rivalry caused disputes among the actors, but mutual concessions enabled collaboration on difficult scenes, reducing their anxiety about mistakes.
items.para: Actors became less anxious about mistakes when compromise enabled teamwork on difficult scenes, despite the disagreement that competition had caused.
items.note: 指为共同任务协作，不等于竞争或妥协。

items.src: Long memory sessions fatigue volunteers, so researchers praise them for encouragement and avoid ambiguous instructions that bewilder them and flashing lights that distract them.
items.para: Researchers encourage volunteers because long memory sessions tire them, using praise while avoiding ambiguous instructions that confuse them and flashing lights that sidetrack them.
items.note: 此处指使参与者偏离任务、转移注意力。

items.src: Photographs of kitesurfing dominate the summer exhibition, while smaller sections feature sailboard riders, people paddling boards, and riders towed behind boats.
items.para: Smaller sections feature windsurfing, paddleboarding, and wakeboarding behind boats, but kiteboarding photographs occupy most of the summer exhibition.
items.note: 两者均指借助风筝牵引在水面滑板的运动。

items.src: The tennis coach allows players to voice dissatisfaction but tells them not to quarrel or curse, and to express regret for insults.
items.para: Players may complain, their tennis coach says, but must not argue or swear and must apologise for any insults.
items.note: 此处指说脏话，不等于抱怨或争论。

items.src: This soup recipe makes one batch, and each bowl contains two servings, although a single serving requires several mouthfuls to finish.
items.para: Several mouthfuls make up each portion of this soup; a bowlful contains two portions, and the recipe produces one batch.
items.note: 此处指供一人食用的一份食物。

items.src: Mature trees shade the square better than recent plantings, rapidly growing saplings, or badly injured trees beside the fountain.
items.para: Compared with newly planted trees, fast-growing saplings, or badly damaged trees beside the fountain, fully grown trees provide better shade in the square.
items.note: 此处表示树木已充分长成，而非生长速度快。

items.src: Pupils hoarded tokens through greed rather than anxiety about losing them, care for classmates, or a wish to distribute them fairly.
items.para: Excessive desire for more, rather than fear of loss, concern for others, or desire for fairness, drove pupils to hoard tokens.
items.note: 指过度占有的欲望，即贪心。

items.src: River safety concerns prompted the council's refusal to approve the festival, rather than permission, a delayed decision, or another review.
items.para: Instead of approval, postponement, or reconsideration, the festival application received a rejection from the council because of concerns about safety beside the river.
items.note: 拒绝批准申请，即驳回申请。

items.src: Leila's daring cooking contrasts with her sister's avoidance of culinary risks, her father's traditional cooking methods, and her brother's difficulty choosing ingredients.
items.para: Regarding cooking, Leila is adventurous, whereas her sister is cautious about risks, her father is conventional in his methods, and her brother is indecisive about ingredients.
items.note: 此处指敢于冒险尝试新口味。

items.src: His robot's unmatched parcel-sorting speed made the engineer prefer to brag about it rather than express dissatisfaction, make guesses, or ask questions.
items.para: Because his robot sorted parcels faster than any other, the engineer preferred to boast about its speed rather than complain, speculate, or inquire.
items.note: 指得意地夸耀自己的成就或拥有的事物。

items.src: The editor remained optimistic about attracting young readers online, unlike her uncertain deputy, her defeatist accountant, and her unconcerned assistant.
items.para: Unlike her doubtful deputy, resigned accountant, and indifferent assistant, the editor stayed hopeful about attracting young readers through the online edition.
items.note: 指对未来取得好结果抱有希望。

items.src: A charity supplied the research team's financing, while its accounts recorded spending, earnings from training courses, and money owed to suppliers.
items.para: The research team's accounts listed expenditure, revenue from training courses, and debt to suppliers, while a charity provided its funding.
items.note: 此处指支持研究项目的资金。

items.src: The guide distinguished the island's environmental heritage from its species diversity, visible scenery, and system of organisms interacting with their physical surroundings.
items.para: The island's biodiversity, landscape, and ecosystem were distinguished from its environmental legacy by the guide.
items.note: 此处指前代传承下来的自然环境遗产。

items.src: Each laborer carried stones uphill while the supervisor coordinated construction, the engineer prepared drawings, and the inspector checked safety conditions.
items.para: While the site manager coordinated construction, the design engineer prepared drawings, and the safety inspector checked conditions, each manual worker carried stones uphill.
items.note: 指从事体力劳动的工人。

items.src: Parents voiced objection to replacing laboratory lessons with videos, while teachers welcomed the proposal, pupils showed curiosity, and governors remained unconcerned.
items.para: Teachers expressed approval of replacing laboratory lessons with videos, but parents voiced opposition; pupils showed interest, whereas governors displayed indifference.
items.note: 此处指对提议持反对态度。

items.src: Maya remembers the kitchen restoration distinctly, although she recalls the flood only hazily, remembers the volunteers affectionately, and discusses the damage unwillingly.
items.para: Although Maya remembers the flood vaguely, she recalls the kitchen restoration clearly, remembers the volunteers fondly, and recounts the damage reluctantly.
items.note: 此处表示记忆清晰，而非情感或意愿。

items.src: Examining the river finds, Lina identified a blue gem beside a rounded stone, a wooden necklace bead, and a fragment of window glass.
items.para: Among the river finds, a pebble, a wooden necklace bead, and a piece of window glass lay beside the blue jewel Lina identified.
items.note: 此处指宝石，不是普通石子或仿似材料。

items.src: Amina's manager called her storage system splendid, judged the lighting merely sufficient and the shelving unsatisfactory, but saw potential in the new trolley.
items.para: Judging the lighting merely adequate and the shelving disappointing, Amina's manager described her storage system as excellent but the new trolley as promising.
items.note: 表示极好的，赞赏程度高于仅够用或有潜力。

items.src: We selected an appropriate cartoon for young children, rejecting an enjoyable comedy, an instructive documentary, and a widely liked drama for adults.
items.para: Rejecting an entertaining comedy, an educational documentary, and a popular drama intended for adults, we chose a cartoon suitable for young children.
items.note: 指适合儿童，不等于有趣、有教育性或受欢迎。

items.src: My anxiety became pleasant expectancy before my sister sang, then relief when she finished safely, and finally pride when the audience applauded.
items.para: Before my sister sang, pleasant anticipation replaced my anxiety; her safe finish brought relief, followed by pride as the audience applauded.
items.note: 指事情发生前的期待，不是焦虑、宽慰或自豪。

items.src: Researchers valued the portable microscope's convenience for fieldwork over sharp images, precise measurements, and rapid operation because it eliminated sample transportation.
items.para: By eliminating sample transportation, the portable microscope offered researchers practical ease in fieldwork, which they valued over image clarity, measurement precision, and operating speed.
items.note: 此处指便于实地研究，无须运送样本。

items.src: Visitors preferred functional bowls for daily cooking to ornamental plates, easily broken cups, and lavish serving dishes displayed nearby.
items.para: For everyday cooking, visitors preferred practical bowls over the decorative plates, fragile cups, and luxurious serving dishes displayed nearby.
items.note: 指适合实际使用的，强调实用而非装饰。

items.src: Visiting nobles attended the wedding service, a welcoming gathering, and a feast of roasted meats inside the castle before an evening of dancing.
items.para: Inside the castle, a wedding ceremony and reception preceded a banquet of roasted meats for visiting nobles, who later attended a dance.
items.note: 指丰盛的宴席，不是仪式、迎宾会或舞会。

items.src: The therapist asked me to plump the cushion, not press it flat or double it over, then reverse it before supporting my back.
items.para: Before supporting my back, I was asked by the therapist to fluff up the cushion, not flatten or fold it, then turn over the cushion.
items.note: 指把垫子拍松鼓起，不是压平、折叠或翻面。

items.src: Each applicant seeking a market stall must send the organiser photographs for the inspector, whereas existing traders need not submit them.
items.para: Unlike an existing stallholder, every candidate seeking a market stall must send photographs to the organiser for the inspector.
items.note: 此处都指申请市场摊位的人。

items.src: A disagreement over teaching notation first led the two music tutors to debate the issue, find middle ground, and resume working together.
items.para: A dispute about teaching notation first prompted the two music tutors to reach a compromise through discussion and resume cooperation.
items.note: 此处都指教学意见上的分歧。

items.src: Although discussions lasted longer than scheduled, prompted worries, and stayed casual, they were productive, establishing a loan scheme for small businesses.
items.para: Discussions yielded useful results by establishing a small-business loan scheme, although they ran overtime, raised concerns, and remained informal.
items.note: 都表示取得了有用的成果。

items.src: Weeks of upstairs noise turned Hana's initial annoyance and worry into misery, but she felt relieved when the noise finally stopped.
items.para: Hana felt relief when the upstairs noise finally ceased, after weeks in which her initial irritation and anxiety developed into deep unhappiness.
items.note: 都指深重的精神痛苦或不快乐。

items.src: Ravi's elder sister is not as tall as he is, while his little brother is already greater in height than both siblings.
items.para: Although Ravi's younger brother is already taller than both siblings, his older sister is shorter than Ravi.
items.note: 修饰兄弟姐妹时，都表示年龄较大的。

items.src: Higher club membership was an unexpected consequence of the gardening broadcasts, not their intended aim, a forecast, or the reason they began.
items.para: Rather than an objective, a prediction, or a cause of the gardening broadcasts, higher club membership was their unexpected outcome.
items.note: 都指某件事所带来的结果。

items.src: A silver ornament shaped like a skate stands beside the club's championship cup, victory medallion, and membership pin in its entrance hall.
items.para: The club's entrance hall displays its championship trophy, victory medal, and membership badge beside a silver decoration shaped like a skate.
items.note: 此处都指用于陈设的装饰品。

items.src: Our morning was a letdown and lunch was unremarkable, but butterfly watching made the afternoon fabulous rather than merely enjoyable.
items.para: Butterfly watching made our afternoon wonderful, not just pleasant, after a disappointing morning and an ordinary lunch.
items.note: 都表示极好、令人非常愉快。

items.src: An inscription honours a medieval warrior who defended the valley, naming his military leader, the message carrier, and the sentry who assisted him.
items.para: Honouring a medieval soldier who defended the valley, an inscription names his commander, the messenger, and the guard who assisted him.
items.note: 此处都指保卫山谷的中世纪战士。

items.src: The detection of buried monastery walls preceded digging them out, protecting them from damage, and eventually repairing their damaged sections.
items.para: Following discovery of the buried monastery walls, excavation and preservation took place, followed eventually by restoration of their damaged sections.
items.note: 此处都指发现原先隐藏的墙体。

items.src: Friday's shipment of donated blankets fulfilled the island shelter's request and replenished its supplies without leaving any excess.
items.para: The island shelter's order was fulfilled on Friday when a consignment of donated blankets replenished its stock without creating a surplus.
items.note: 此处指作为一批运送的货物。

items.src: Breaking waves produced foam beside the rocks and airborne droplets, while fine haze hung above small undulations farther offshore.
items.para: Mist lingered above ripples farther offshore, while waves breaking beside the rocks created froth and spray.
items.note: 此处均指水面上聚集的泡沫。

items.src: Adjustable benches helped potters enormously, whereas new lamps offered minor benefits, ventilation delivered middling improvements, and repainting made almost no difference.
items.para: New lamps helped potters slightly, ventilation moderately, and repainting barely, whereas adjustable benches benefited them greatly.
items.note: 均表示程度很大，此处指帮助极大。

items.src: The retailers' viewpoint shaped their forecast about rents, their liking for shorter leases, and their untested belief that demand would remain stable.
items.para: Their prediction about rents, preference for shorter leases and assumption of stable demand were shaped by the retailers' perspective.
items.note: 均指看待和判断问题的角度。

items.src: Mina's damp coat contrasted with her utterly drenched scarf and entirely dry gloves, which she had kept inside a waterproof bag.
items.para: A waterproof bag had kept Mina's gloves completely dry, whereas her coat was slightly wet and her scarf thoroughly soaked.
items.note: 指微湿，不是全干或湿透。

items.src: The tutor wanted a concise telescope explanation, rejecting lengthy detail, unclear wording, and repetitive digressions as unsuitable for the laboratory presentation.
items.para: For the laboratory presentation, the tutor preferred telescope explanations that were brief and clear, rejecting anything long and detailed, vague and confusing, or repetitive and rambling.
items.note: 指表达简短清楚，没有多余内容。

items.src: The exhibition presents diverse textile traditions with consistent stitching, comparable patterns and exactly matching borders, showing that shared features can coexist with variety.
items.para: Despite uniform stitching, similar patterns and identical borders, the textile traditions presented in the exhibition are varied, showing that shared features can coexist with variety.
items.note: 均指包含不同种类，具有多样性。

items.src: Sunday mornings at the climbing centre are for family recreation, not preparing for contests, teaching safety rules, or evaluating physical fitness.
items.para: The climbing centre excludes competitive training, safety instruction and fitness assessment on Sunday mornings, reserving that time for families' leisure activities.
items.note: 均指以放松和享受为目的的休闲活动。

items.src: Sleep diaries gave patients insight into night waking, replacing uncertain guesses, lasting bewilderment, and misplaced confidence about its causes.
items.para: Patients' vague speculation, persistent confusion and false certainty about night waking gave way to deep understanding of its causes through sleep diaries.
items.note: 此处指对夜间醒来原因的深入理解。

items.src: I will cite the old market hall as evidence of industrial prosperity, then portray its architecture, examine its history and challenge its significance.
items.para: I will describe the old market hall's architecture, discuss its history and question its significance after I mention it as evidence of industrial prosperity.
items.note: 结合后文，指提及市场大厅作为证据。

items.src: Pupils sampled soil from the riverside, not the lake's edge or the coast, and avoided the bottom of the stream.
items.para: Avoiding the streambed, pupils gathered soil from the riverbank rather than the lakeshore or the seashore.
items.note: 两者都指河流岸边的土地。

items.src: Leila's brave deed earned public praise, although she sought no credit for her intended course, her pledge or her good reputation.
items.para: Although Leila wanted no credit for her intention, promise or good reputation, her courageous action received public praise.
items.note: 此处指实际做出的行为，而非意图或承诺。

items.src: Arun allowed relatives to watch his violin practice but asked them not to disturb him, offer encouragement or point out mistakes.
items.para: Relatives could observe Arun practising the violin, but he asked them not to interrupt, encourage or correct him.
items.note: 此处指打断别人正在进行的活动。

items.src: The engineer designed this device to boost signal strength rather than assess it, keep it constant or make it weaker.
items.para: This device was designed by the engineer to increase signal strength, not measure, stabilise or reduce it.
items.note: 此处指提高信号强度。

items.src: These surveys indicate that younger listeners prefer brief news, but neither account for this preference, forecast its development nor question it.
items.para: These surveys neither explain younger listeners' preference for brief news, predict its development nor challenge it, but show that it exists.
items.note: 此处指调查结果表明某种偏好存在。

items.src: The psychologist called Noura's reasoning exceptional on unfamiliar puzzles but merely satisfactory on routine tasks, uneven under pressure, and defective when based on guesses.
items.para: For the psychologist, Noura's reasoning was adequate on routine tasks, inconsistent under pressure and flawed when based on guesses, but outstanding on unfamiliar puzzles.
items.note: 两者都指表现极为出色，远超一般水平。

items.src: Researchers judged chemical storage beside the marsh risky rather than secure, though they considered it neither expensive nor unworkable.
items.para: Researchers considered chemical storage beside the marsh neither costly nor impractical, but judged it hazardous rather than safe.
items.note: 两者都指存在造成危害的风险。

items.src: Entrance fees fund the preservation of ancient cliff paintings against dampness and sunlight, not repairs, copying or moving them elsewhere.
items.para: Entrance revenue supports the protection of ancient cliff paintings from moisture and sunlight, rather than financing restoration, reproduction or relocation.
items.note: 此处均指保护古画，使其免受潮气和阳光损害。

items.src: Sailors used an oar to steer, sails to accelerate, water resistance to decelerate and an anchor to keep the boat still.
items.para: To gain speed, sailors used sails; they relied on water resistance to slow down, an anchor to remain stationary and an oar to control direction.
items.note: 此处指控制船的行进方向。

items.src: The caretaker was the fire's only casualty, suffering minor burns, while his uninjured colleagues respectively witnessed events, rescued others and were evacuated.
items.para: His uninjured colleagues were respectively a witness, rescuer and evacuee, whereas the caretaker, with minor burns, was the fire's sole victim.
items.note: 此处指火灾中受伤的人。

items.src: The volunteers joined the reef survey out of curiosity, not anxiety about failure, competitive ambition, or a wish to gain others' approval.
items.para: A desire to learn motivated volunteers to join the reef survey, rather than fear of failure, an urge to compete, or a need for approval.
items.note: 此处指想了解事物、获取知识的欲望。

items.src: The owner's withdrawal of permission forced us to abandon the renovation, rather than pause it, reduce its scope, or create entirely new plans.
items.para: We had to permanently give up the renovation, not temporarily suspend, scale down, or completely redesign it, because the owner withdrew permission.
items.note: 此处指彻底放弃未完成的工程，而非暂停。

items.src: Island fishing families considered interest on loans alien before the bank opened, although they did not judge it unjust, unworkable, or needless.
items.para: Before the bank opened, interest on loans seemed unfamiliar to island fishing families, but they did not consider it unfair, impractical, or unnecessary.
items.note: 此处表示陌生、此前不了解，并非不合理。

items.src: A psychologist tracked climbers' anxiety weakening and vanishing, then recorded a blend of pride and relief rather than tension between them.
items.para: After tracking climbers' anxiety through decline and disappearance, the psychologist recorded a mixture of pride and relief, not conflict between them.
items.note: 此处指骄傲与如释重负两种情绪的融合。

items.src: A shortage of liquid nitrogen delayed the laboratory's trials until next month; investigators ruled out excess supply, impurities, and escape from storage tanks.
items.para: Investigators excluded surplus, contamination, and leakage as causes; a lack of liquid nitrogen postponed the laboratory's trials until next month.
items.note: 此处指液氮供应不足，导致实验延期。

items.src: The sculptor explained that visitors' advice was unwelcome while she worked, even when it contained no errors, caused no offence, and concerned her task.
items.para: Even when visitors' advice was neither inaccurate, offensive, nor irrelevant, it was unwanted while the sculptor worked, she explained.
items.note: 此处指不想接受建议，并非建议有误或冒犯。

items.src: Coaches aim to maximize power, not merely maintain its current level, reduce it gradually, or restore it after exhaustion.
items.para: Power is what coaches aim to increase as far as possible, not keep at its present level, gradually reduce over time, or restore after exhaustion.
items.note: 指将力量提高到所能达到的最高水平。

items.src: The nurse instructed participants to pinch the nose's soft part to stop bleeding, rather than massage it gently, pat it repeatedly, or caress it.
items.para: To stop bleeding, participants should squeeze with their fingers, not gently rub, repeatedly tap, or lightly stroke, the nose's soft part, the nurse explained.
items.note: 此处指用手指捏紧鼻子的柔软部位以止血。

items.src: Engineers reported that the flood barriers performed satisfactorily in heavy rain, neither achieving perfection or outstanding results nor falling below the required standard.
items.para: Heavy rain tested the flood barriers, which worked adequately, engineers reported: they performed neither flawlessly nor exceptionally, but certainly not poorly.
items.note: 此处指表现达到要求，但并非完美或出众。

items.src: Our tutor's enthusiasm was catching rather than overstated, insincere, or short-term, so even quiet pupils soon volunteered for the play.
items.para: Even quiet pupils soon offered to perform in the play because our tutor's enthusiasm was infectious, rather than exaggerated, artificial, or temporary.
items.note: 此处指热情能感染他人，带动他人参与。

items.src: Before final approval, managers can design, delay, or block restructuring, but passport offices must undergo any changes that receive final approval.
items.para: Passport offices must experience approved restructuring, although their managers can plan, postpone, or prevent changes before final approval.
items.note: 此处指经历获批的调整，而非策划或阻止。

items.src: Leila stopped climbing because of a sudden calf cramp, not stiff joints, tired muscles, or a sprained ankle.
items.para: Neither joint stiffness, muscle fatigue, nor an ankle sprain caused Leila to stop climbing; a sudden painful muscle spasm in her calf did.
items.note: 指肌肉突然不自主收缩并伴随疼痛。

items.src: Interested in the designer's motive for creating the translation app, the interviewer asked about that rather than his approach, difficulty, or result.
items.para: Instead of asking about the method, obstacle or outcome, the interested interviewer asked about the designer's reason for creating the translation app.
items.note: 指促使某人采取行动的原因。

items.src: Our documentary must satisfy the accuracy rule, while editors may determine its meaning, dispute its validity, or amend it.
items.para: Editors may interpret, challenge, or revise the accuracy rule, but our documentary must meet it.
items.note: 此处指符合准确性规定的要求。

items.src: Hana's correction fixed the calculation error; merely checking, repeating, or removing the calculation would not have repaired the mistake.
items.para: Neither inspection, repetition, nor deletion would have repaired the mistake, but Hana's amendment fixed the error in the calculation.
items.note: 结合修复计算错误的语境，此处指修正。

items.src: Ecologists inspected and charted the damaged wetland before they assessed its condition, but they never repaired the site.
items.para: Having surveyed and mapped the damaged marsh, ecologists evaluated its condition, although they never restored the site.
items.note: 指根据调查对湿地状况作出评估。

items.src: Visitors can capture the sunrise on camera from the lodge balcony, or simply watch it, draw it, or describe it aloud.
items.para: From the lodge balcony, visitors can observe or sketch the sunrise, describe it aloud, or use a camera to photograph it.
items.note: 结合相机语境，此处指拍摄日出。

items.src: Our history course ends with a module on medieval spice trading, which contains one talk and a written task.
items.para: A lecture and a written assignment form the final unit of our history programme, devoted to medieval spice trading.
items.note: 指整门课程中相对独立的教学单元。

items.src: Families try to form, preserve, and reinforce neighbourhood ties, but frequent moves can weaken these bonds by reducing time together.
items.para: Frequent moves can undermine neighbourhood bonds by reducing time together, despite families' efforts to establish, maintain, and strengthen these ties.
items.note: 指使原有的邻里联系变得不牢固。

items.src: These desert beetles typically emerge after sunset, sometimes appear at dawn, seldom venture out at noon, and never feed underwater.
items.para: These desert beetles never feed underwater and rarely venture out at noon; they usually emerge after sunset but occasionally appear at dawn.
items.note: 此处表示通常如此，而非偶尔或从不。

items.src: Hotel servers need speed when delivering meals, accuracy when placing dishes, and care around obstacles, but guests particularly admire their grace.
items.para: Guests especially admire hotel servers' elegance, although delivering meals requires speed, placing dishes demands precision, and moving around obstacles calls for caution.
items.note: 此处指服务员动作的优雅，而非速度或谨慎。

items.src: The unstable price of imported wheat complicates small bakeries' budgeting, unlike butter's steep price, salt's manageable price, and sugar's contractually constant price.
items.para: Small bakeries struggle to budget because imported wheat prices remain volatile, while butter prices are high, salt is affordable, and sugar prices are contractually fixed.
items.note: 此处指价格波动不定，而非单纯难以预测。

items.src: Leila valued her neighbours' useful guidance, respect for privacy, and patient attention, but their generosity in providing free meals and childcare moved her most.
items.para: Free meals and childcare reflected her neighbours' giving spirit, which moved Leila more than their valued helpful advice, careful discretion, or attentive listening.
items.note: 此处指乐于无偿给予饭食和照料的慷慨。

items.src: A youngster correctly predicted the magnet's effect while a nearby grown-up watched, a retired visitor took notes, and an elderly observer asked questions.
items.para: While a nearby adult watched, a retired visitor made notes, and an elderly observer asked questions, a child correctly predicted the magnet's effect.
items.note: 此处指孩子，与成年或年长的人相区别。

items.src: The composer's fascination with birdsong contrasted with her slight inquisitiveness about insects, profound esteem for forests, and total lack of interest in gardening.
items.para: Unlike her mild curiosity about insects, deep respect for forests, and complete indifference to gardening, the composer felt intense interest in birdsong.
items.note: 指强烈的兴趣，不是轻微好奇或敬重。

items.src: The coach prioritises balance in the first training phase, schedules each meeting before lunch, allows a short pause, and sets a completion date.
items.para: Each session precedes lunch, a short break is allowed, and a deadline is set by the coach, who prioritises balance in the initial training stage.
items.note: 指训练过程中的阶段，不是单次训练或期限。

items.src: Doctors marvel at the scanner's detailed images, while technicians still doubt its reliability, managers express disappointment about costs, and patients gain confidence from safety tests.
items.para: Technicians remain doubtful about reliability, managers express disappointment about costs, and patients feel reassured by safety tests, while doctors are amazed at the scanner's detailed images.
items.note: 指感到惊叹，不是怀疑、失望或安心。

items.src: Before taking office, councillors swear to disclose financial interests, outline their motives, ask courteously for guidance, and acknowledge their inexperience without concealment.
items.para: Before assuming office, councillors briefly explain their motives, politely request guidance, and openly admit their inexperience; they also solemnly promise to disclose financial interests.
items.note: 此处指郑重承诺履行某事，而非承认或请求。

items.src: The opening chapter offers an overview of bilingual education before later chapters examine it closely, demonstrate classroom methods, and assess its strengths and weaknesses.
items.para: Before later chapters offer detailed analysis, practical demonstration of classroom methods, and critical evaluation, the opening chapter presents a brief summary of bilingual education.
items.note: 指主要内容的简要概述，而非深入分析或评价。

items.src: The laboratory postponed recruitment until spring but continued teaching existing staff new skills, advancing deserving employees, and removing workers guilty of serious misconduct.
items.para: Although hiring was delayed until spring, the laboratory continued staff training, promotion of deserving employees, and dismissal of workers guilty of serious misconduct.
items.note: 此处指招聘人员，不是培训、晋升或解雇。

items.src: Amina found the cupboard's damage minor rather than serious; although noticeable, it was not lasting, so she chose to repair it herself.
items.para: Because the cupboard's damage was slight rather than severe, Amina decided to fix it herself; it was visible but not permanent.
items.note: 两者都表示损坏程度轻微。

items.src: Engineers will investigate the robot's connection failures after documenting them, hoping that understanding their cause will help them anticipate and stop future failures.
items.para: Engineers will first record the robot's connection failures, then examine them to understand their cause, hoping to predict and prevent future failures.
items.note: 两者都指研究故障以查明原因。

items.src: The artist will illustrate lighting effects using three portraits, then ask students to characterize those effects, anticipate changes, and judge the results.
items.para: Using three portraits, the artist will demonstrate lighting effects before asking students to describe those effects, predict changes, and evaluate the results.
items.note: 两者都指借助实例展示并说明。

items.src: Imagining a glorious future motivates me through hardship, although I expect a routine life of comfort rather than anything beyond the usual.
items.para: Although I expect a predictable, comfortable, ordinary life, picturing a splendid future keeps me motivated through difficult times.
items.note: 两者都形容未来极其美好。

items.src: Residents find the composting instructions straightforward; brevity permits rapid reading but hinders retention, while cramped kitchens make practical implementation challenging.
items.para: Brevity makes composting instructions quick to read but hard to remember; residents find them easy to understand, though cramped kitchens make them difficult to apply.
items.note: 两者都表示说明容易理解。

items.src: Our tour passes the seedling area and gardening shed before tea in the citrus building, ending at the Victorian greenhouse protecting tropical orchids.
items.para: Tropical orchids are protected in the Victorian glasshouse where our tour ends, after passing the nursery and potting shed and having tea in the orangery.
items.note: 两者都指种植和保护植物的温室。

items.src: Our tutor said the class, previously marked by intense rivalry, academic success, and social divisions, became cohesive after students recorded childhood stories together.
items.para: Previously highly competitive, academically strong, and socially divided, the class became closely united after jointly recording childhood stories, our tutor said.
items.note: 两者都形容群体成员紧密团结。

items.src: Our town introduced coeducation in the sixties instead of teaching genders separately, while expanding job preparation courses and keeping residential schooling optional.
items.para: Single-sex schooling gave way to mixed-sex education in our town in the sixties, while vocational training expanded and boarding education remained optional.
items.note: 两者都指男女学生共同接受教育。

items.src: Researchers recorded concurrent rather than sequential flowering in three alpine species after a warm week, although this yearly spring event occurred late.
items.para: Researchers described three alpine species' delayed annual spring flowering after a warm week as simultaneous rather than successive.
items.note: 两者都表示同时发生的。

items.src: The supervisor tends to meddle uninvited in designers' fabric decisions instead of merely watching their selections to express approval or disapproval.
items.para: The supervisor tends not to simply observe designers' fabric choices to approve or criticize them, but to interfere uninvited in their decisions.
items.note: 两者都指未经邀请擅自干涉。

items.src: The bakery owner's private contemplation followed financial calculations and discussions with staff, but did not involve speculation about competitors.
items.para: After financial calculation and discussion with employees, the bakery owner engaged in private reflection without speculation about rival businesses.
items.note: 此处指独自深入思考，与反思同义。

items.src: Sleep loss lowered participants' anger threshold without changing the maximum or average strength of their anger or the time needed to recover.
items.para: Although peak intensity, average level and recovery time remained unchanged, participants' anger had a lower tipping point following sleep loss.
items.note: 此处指开始触发愤怒的临界点。

items.src: Tiny algae constitute most living material in these waters, while animals consume them and bacteria decompose dead organisms to release nutrients.
items.para: Animals feed on tiny algae and bacteria break down dead organisms to release nutrients, while algae make up most living material in these waters.
items.note: 此处表示构成某种物质的主要部分。

items.src: Nurses documented preoperative care separately from care provided while surgery proceeded, following surgery, and immediately before patients left the hospital.
items.para: Care during surgery, after surgery and immediately before discharge was documented separately by nurses from care before surgery.
items.note: 此处作护理的时间修饰语，表示手术前。

items.src: The coach described climbing's uncertainty as inherent, unlike short-lived fatigue, avoidable equipment faults, and dangers originating outside the sport itself.
items.para: Unlike temporary fatigue, preventable equipment faults and external dangers, climbing's uncertainty was described by the coach as intrinsic.
items.note: 表示事物本身固有的，而非外加的。

items.src: The clinic will redistribute existing nurses between two departments next month rather than hire additional staff, train nurses again, or advance their rank.
items.para: Next month, instead of choosing to recruit additional staff or retrain or promote nurses, the clinic will reallocate existing nurses between two departments.
items.note: 表示把现有人员重新分配到不同部门。

items.src: Inspectors distinguished restaurants' compliance with noise rules from their knowledge and acceptance of those rules, stressing that making restaurants obey remained necessary.
items.para: Inspectors distinguished restaurants' adherence to noise rules from awareness and approval of them, stressing that enforcement remained necessary.
items.note: 指实际遵守规定，而非仅知晓或赞同。

items.src: The admissions tutor rejected phony certificates and separately flagged genuine documents that were out of date, missing information, or lacking official status.
items.para: Genuine documents that were expired, incomplete or unofficial were flagged separately by the admissions tutor, who rejected fake certificates.
items.note: 指伪造的，不只是过期、不完整或非官方。

items.src: The baker meticulously checked accounts that his assistant had compiled hastily, presented hesitantly, and discussed without much interest.
items.para: Accounts compiled with great haste, presented with some hesitation and discussed with little interest by his assistant were checked with painstaking care by the baker.
items.note: 表示极其细致认真地，不放过细节。

items.src: The chef selected spherical dough pieces for this batch, setting aside pieces shaped like cubes, rings and discs for later baking.
items.para: Cube-shaped, ring-shaped and disc-shaped dough pieces were reserved for later baking, while the chef chose ball-shaped pieces for this batch.
items.note: 指立体球形，而非环形或扁平圆盘形。

items.src: Engineers described the sensor shortage as acute and longstanding, not short-lived or slight, explaining why underwater pipeline inspections remained delayed.
items.para: Engineers explained that the sensor shortage, severe and persistent rather than temporary or minor, kept underwater pipeline inspections delayed.
items.note: 这里指短缺程度严重，而非持续时间长。

items.src: Residents were invited to ventilate their concerns about festival coverage before producers documented them privately, evaluated them carefully, and eventually settled them.
items.para: Before producers went on to privately record, carefully assess, and finally resolve concerns about festival coverage, residents were invited to openly express them.
items.note: 这里指公开表达心中的担忧。

items.src: In retrospect, our coach regretted extra training, although he initially approved it, temporarily tolerates it, and plans future reductions.
items.para: Looking back, our coach regretted extra training: he approved it at first and tolerates it for now, but plans reductions looking ahead.
items.note: 指回顾过去后作出判断。

items.src: Canal ramps facilitate hedgehogs' escape, while barriers stop entry, cameras track movements, and signs discourage visitors from feeding the animals.
items.para: While barriers prevent entry, cameras monitor movements, and signs deter visitors from feeding the animals, canal ramps ease hedgehogs' escape.
items.note: 这里指使刺猬逃离水中更加容易。

items.src: Border delays recur every winter, intensify during storms, continue through spring, and end only when crews clear the mountain road.
items.para: Border delays grow worse during storms and happen repeatedly each winter; they persist through spring and disappear only when crews clear the mountain road.
items.note: 指延误每到冬季都会再次发生。

items.src: Merchants initially resisted the king, then sought to limit him, but ultimately helped overthrow him and install his brother in his place.
items.para: After initially choosing to oppose the king and then seeking to restrain him, merchants ultimately helped depose him and replace him with his brother.
items.note: 指推翻君主，使其失去统治权。

items.src: Forecasters described a freak summer snowstorm as extremely powerful but brief, not reasonably foreseeable; it closed council offices for three days.
items.para: Council offices shut for three days after a summer snowstorm that forecasters called highly unusual, exceptionally powerful but brief, and not reasonably foreseeable.
items.note: 指天气异常罕见且出乎意料。

items.src: Harbour inspectors identified the orchid permit as a forgery, rejecting the seller's claims that it was the original, a copied document, or an unfinished version.
items.para: The seller called the orchid permit an original, a duplicate, or a draft, but harbour inspectors identified it as a fake.
items.note: 这里指冒充真实许可证的伪造文件。

items.src: Workshop staff will examine and package the handmade desks on Friday, keep them over the weekend, and dispatch them on Monday.
items.para: Before they send the handmade desks on Monday, workshop staff will inspect and wrap them on Friday, then store them over the weekend.
items.note: 这里指将制作好的书桌发运出去。

items.src: The economist attributed the shopkeeper's false rumours about his rival to malice, rejecting explanations involving customer welfare, envy, or anxiety about competition.
items.para: Concern for customers, jealousy, and fear of competition were explanations the economist rejected; he attributed the shopkeeper's false rumours about his rival to spite.
items.note: 这里指怀着伤害竞争对手的恶意。

items.src: Our tutor called careful thought requisite for fair comparison, background reading useful, written notes discretionary, and personal preferences unrelated to the task.
items.para: For fair comparison, our tutor considered background reading helpful and written notes optional, but careful thought necessary and personal preferences irrelevant.
items.note: 两者都表示公平比较所必需的。

items.src: Participants criticised the researcher's sloppy work, excessive confidentiality, and conceited manner, but his deceit about the experiment's purpose made them uncomfortable.
items.para: Although participants criticised the researcher's carelessness, excessive secrecy, and arrogance, they felt uncomfortable because of his dishonesty about the experiment's purpose.
items.note: 两者在此都指故意欺骗的不诚实行为。

items.src: Geometric abstraction became the prevailing style in the colony, although newcomers considered it innovative, collectors found it uncommon, and critics thought it old-fashioned.
items.para: Despite newcomers calling it novel, collectors finding it rare, and critics judging it outdated, geometric abstraction became the colony's dominant style.
items.note: 两者都指某种风格占据主导地位。

items.src: The referee tolerated passionate cheering, innocent jokes, and distracting whistles, but judged personal insults obnoxious and suspended play.
items.para: Play was suspended after the referee deemed personal insults offensive, despite tolerating enthusiastic cheering, harmless jokes, and disruptive whistles.
items.note: 两者在此都形容人身侮辱令人反感。

items.src: Volunteers felt their shoulders briefly lift, tighten under heavy loads, and tremble from cold before postfestival fatigue made them droop.
items.para: Postfestival fatigue made volunteers' shoulders hang down; previously, volunteers felt them rise up briefly, tense up under heavy loads, and shake from cold.
items.note: 两者都指肩膀因疲惫而向下垂落。

items.src: Workers planned the signs meticulously and unhurriedly but installed them in haste, so several pointed the wrong way accidentally rather than deliberately.
items.para: Because workers installed signs in a rush despite planning with great care at a leisurely pace, several pointed incorrectly, though not on purpose.
items.note: 两者都表示做事匆忙、仓促。

items.src: Running to geography class made pupils perspire and breathe heavily; arriving late made them redden with embarrassment, and classroom cold made them tremble.
items.para: Pupils began to sweat and pant from running to geography class; their embarrassing late arrival made them blush, while the cold classroom made them shiver.
items.note: 两者都表示身体出汗。

items.src: Before deciding whom to designate as inspection leader, the ministry will question candidates, prepare recruits for work, and remove the current supervisor.
items.para: The ministry will interview candidates, train recruits, and dismiss the current supervisor before deciding whom to appoint as inspection leader.
items.note: 两者在此都指正式指派某人担任职务。

items.src: Leila expected her anxiety to continue, vary, or worsen, but it began to diminish after she discussed her worries with a close friend.
items.para: After discussing her worries with a close friend, Leila's anxiety began to lessen, although she had expected it to persist, fluctuate, or intensify.
items.note: 两者都表示焦虑的程度减轻。

items.src: Museum software lets visitors explore the entire cosmos, then examine our planetary system, our home galaxy, or an individual cluster of stars.
items.para: Visitors using museum software can explore the entire universe before examining our solar system, our galaxy, or an individual star cluster.
items.note: 两者都指宇宙整体，而非其中的局部。

items.src: False claims can lurk within reliable reports, seem believable, circulate quickly, and confuse readers who struggle to distinguish them from accurate information.
items.para: Readers struggle to distinguish accurate information from false claims that can appear credible, spread rapidly, cause confusion, and lie hidden within reliable reports.
items.note: 指虚假信息暗藏其中，不易被察觉。

items.src: Workshop leaders formulate an evidence rule and clarify its meaning, while assistants enforce it and periodically assess whether it needs revision.
items.para: Assistants ensure compliance with the evidence rule and review regularly whether it needs revision; workshop leaders draw up the rule and explain clearly its meaning.
items.note: 指确保规则得到遵守，而非仅制定或解释。

items.src: Farmers considered the restoration plan's water-access promise implicit, unlike its clearly stated, legally obligatory compensation offer dependent on documented losses.
items.para: Unlike the restoration plan's explicit, binding compensation offer, conditional on documented losses, its water-access promise was indirectly expressed in the farmers' view.
items.note: 指承诺并未明说，而是通过内容间接传达。

items.src: The guide became a mediator in the accommodation dispute, not a partisan representative, an appointed decision-maker, or someone merely observing events.
items.para: An advocate, arbitrator, or witness was not the guide's role in the accommodation dispute; instead, the guide served as a go-between.
items.note: 此处指帮助争议双方达成一致的调解人。

items.src: A cloth middleman bought goods from their maker and resold them to a shopkeeper, who then sold them to the final buyer.
items.para: Before reaching the consumer through a retailer, the cloth passed from its manufacturer to an intermediary who bought it for resale to the shopkeeper.
items.note: 指从生产者购入商品再转售的中间商。

items.src: Although hopeful confidence, willingness to wait, and adaptability helped, the association's persistence after repeated funding refusals finally secured a permanent meeting room.
items.para: Perseverance following repeated funding refusals finally won the association a permanent meeting room, although optimism, patience, and flexibility also helped.
items.note: 指遭遇反复挫折后仍继续努力的毅力。

items.src: Desert beetles ordinarily hide beneath stones by day, sometimes use cracks, invariably emerge after sunset, and avoid feeding in daylight entirely.
items.para: Desert beetles always emerge after sunset and never feed by day; they normally shelter under stones in daylight but occasionally use cracks.
items.note: 指通常如此的习性，并非毫无例外。

items.src: Our workshop's emergency button causes an instantaneous shutdown of every cutter, unlike the progressive slowdown, postponed restart, and brief pause used in routine operation.
items.para: Routine operation involves a gradual slowdown, delayed restart, and temporary pause, whereas our workshop's emergency button triggers an immediate shutdown of every cutter.
items.note: 指停机立即发生，没有明显延迟。

items.src: Economists expect software export revenue to eclipse manufacturing earnings within five years, not merely near them, equal them, or remain below them.
items.para: Within five years, economists expect software export revenue not to lag behind manufacturing earnings or merely approach or match them, but to surpass them.
items.note: 此处指软件出口收入超过制造业收入。

items.src: The psychologist found the youngest musicians' sleep diaries pertinent to their rehearsal anxiety, although these trustworthy, thorough records were old.
items.para: Although reliable and detailed rather than recent, the youngest musicians' sleep records were relevant to their rehearsal anxiety, the psychologist concluded.
items.note: 指睡眠记录与所研究的排练焦虑有关。

items.src: Researchers found gullible volunteers accepted the planetary claims, while doubting participants requested evidence and wary colleagues distrusted the unusually confident presenter.
items.para: Researchers found sceptical participants requested proof and cautious colleagues were suspicious of the unusually confident presenter, but credulous volunteers accepted planetary claims.
items.note: 两者均指缺乏判断、容易相信他人的。

items.src: Technicians quantify and track rehearsal noise while musicians use padded drumsticks to curb it and avoid electronically increasing the sound.
items.para: Musicians use padded drumsticks to limit rehearsal noise and avoid using electronics to amplify it, while technicians measure and monitor the sound.
items.note: 此处均指限制、抑制噪声。

items.src: The lecturer distinguished infinity from a large quantity, a maximum value, and a final boundary using a number line.
items.para: Using a number line, the lecturer contrasted endless extent with a large amount, an upper limit, and an ultimate endpoint.
items.note: 此处指没有尽头的无限延伸。

items.src: Clinicians note and document dark urine and dizziness, then infer dehydration, although further tests may be needed to establish the diagnosis.
items.para: Although further tests may be needed to confirm the diagnosis, clinicians observe and record dark urine and dizziness, then deduce dehydration.
items.note: 两者均指根据已知证据推断结论。

items.src: Residents initially feared delays, then felt let down and accepted postponement, but were elated when the riverside square reopened for weekly chess.
items.para: When the riverside square reopened for weekly chess, residents were overjoyed, having previously been anxious about delays, then disappointed and resigned to postponement.
items.note: 两者均表示非常高兴、欣喜万分。

items.src: After placing a purchase request for microscopes, the college received a consignment with a bill on Tuesday and later obtained proof of payment.
items.para: Tuesday brought the college a shipment of microscopes and an invoice following its order; a receipt arrived later.
items.note: 两者均指一起发送或运达的一批货物。

items.src: The council's consultation process is reminiscent of village assemblies but neither duplicates nor originates from them, and operates separately from party committees.
items.para: Independent of party committees, the council's consultation process is evocative of village assemblies without being identical to or derived from them.
items.note: 两者均指具有某种特点而使人联想到。

items.src: Maya found occasional gratitude exercises produced minor, brief, surface-level changes, whereas keeping a daily diary had a profound effect on her outlook.
items.para: Keeping a daily gratitude diary had a very deep effect on Maya's outlook, unlike the slight, short-lived, superficial changes produced by occasional exercises.
items.note: 此处均强调对思想观念的影响很深。

items.src: Engineers described their navigation software as a variant of the original, not an identical copy, total substitute, or independently created product.
items.para: Rejecting the labels separate invention, complete replacement and exact duplicate, engineers described their navigation software as a modified version of the original.
items.note: 两者均指在原有事物基础上改变的版本。

items.src: Photographs previously lacked credits, but our editor announced that henceforth credits are compulsory, not merely for seven days or beginning next year.
items.para: Our editor announced credits are compulsory from now on—not from next year or just for one week—whereas photographs had lacked credits until now.
items.note: 两者均指从现在开始，今后一直如此。

items.src: Unlike inadequately supplied walkers and travellers carrying little, the cyclists reached camp laden with equipment and utterly tired.
items.para: The cyclists arrived at camp heavily loaded with equipment and completely exhausted, unlike the poorly equipped walkers and lightly packed travellers.
items.note: 此处指携带大量装备、负载沉重。

items.src: Vaccine technicians must exercise the utmost care even when contamination risk is low, because moderate precautions provide insufficient protection.
items.para: Even with low contamination risk, vaccine technicians must take the greatest care because moderate precautions provide inadequate protection.
items.note: 表示程度最高，此处指最大程度的谨慎。

items.src: If the primary motor fails, the vessel's auxiliary engine provides propulsion, while its steering mechanism controls direction and its drainage pump removes water.
items.para: The vessel's steering gear controls direction and its bilge pump removes water; a backup motor provides propulsion if the main engine fails.
items.note: 此处指主发动机故障时提供动力的备用发动机。

items.src: Fortress visitors use the tower to orientate themselves before choosing a route, returning along their previous path, or arriving at their destination.
items.para: Before visitors plan their route, retrace their steps or reach their destination, they use the fortress tower to find their bearings.
items.note: 两者都指确定自己所处的位置和方向。

items.src: Judges praised the weavers' craftsmanship and creative vision, but questioned their business achievements and understanding of the past.
items.para: Although judges questioned the weavers' commercial success and historical knowledge, they praised their weaving skill and artistic imagination.
items.note: 此处指织工制作织物的精湛手艺。

items.src: Researchers kept the measuring line slack near fragile branches, stretched the support rope tight, wound the spare cord, and tied knots in damaged sections.
items.para: Near fragile branches, researchers kept the measuring line loose and the support rope taut, while spare cord was coiled and damaged sections were knotted.
items.note: 指绳线松弛，没有被拉紧。

items.src: Supervisors contend that task rotation improves concentration; workers reject this claim, question its practicality, but reluctantly admit that it reduces boredom.
items.para: Workers deny the claim and doubt its practicality, but concede that rotation reduces boredom; supervisors argue that it improves concentration.
items.note: 此处指提出并坚持某种观点。

items.src: The cooperative appointed Leila custodian of its historical records, although she neither owned nor wrote them and was not their auditor.
items.para: Although Leila was neither their owner, author nor auditor, the cooperative appointed her guardian of its historical records.
items.note: 此处指受托保管和保护档案的人。

items.src: Restorers found a subtle colour change near the portrait's mouth, an obvious one above its eyes, none below, and crisp outlines throughout.
items.para: Restorers found the portrait's outlines sharply defined throughout, with colour changes barely noticeable near its mouth, clearly visible above its eyes and entirely absent below.
items.note: 表示变化细微、不容易察觉。

items.src: After bacteria entered the tank, oxygen levels plummeted within minutes, acidity increased quickly, temperature decreased slowly, and pressure stayed constant.
items.para: After bacteria entered the tank, pressure remained stable while acidity rose rapidly and temperature declined gradually; oxygen levels dropped sharply within minutes.
items.note: 指在短时间内快速、大幅下降。

items.src: Persistent damp, rather than sporadic leaks, short temperature spikes or seasonally recurring heat, has damaged several oil paintings in the gallery's storerooms.
items.para: Several oil paintings in the gallery's storage rooms suffered damage from continuing damp, not occasional leaks, brief temperature spikes or seasonal heat.
items.note: 此处指潮湿持续存在，而非偶发或短暂。

items.src: I relish racing faster runners because they challenge me, although I merely endure training, deliberately escape interviews and privately fear injuries.
items.para: Although I merely tolerate training, actively avoid interviews and secretly dread injuries, I greatly enjoy racing quicker runners because they challenge me.
items.note: 表示非常享受，而不只是接受或容忍。

items.src: Researchers tested whether evening light could inhibit hormone release, promote it or keep it steady, using sensors to track the process.
items.para: Using sensors to monitor hormone release, researchers tested whether evening light could stimulate it, maintain it or suppress it.
items.note: 此处表示抑制激素释放，而非促进或监测。

items.src: The new towers dwarf the riverside cottages but look much like the warehouses, partly hide the workshops and stand directly opposite the station.
items.para: The new towers closely resemble the warehouses, partly conceal the workshops and directly face the station, yet they vastly outsize the riverside cottages.
items.note: 指尺寸远超，使旁边的建筑相形见小。

items.src: The concerto earned an ovation, whereas the host's jokes prompted courteous chuckles, his mistake caused uncomfortable quiet and his insult provoked furious cries.
items.para: Enthusiastic applause greeted the concerto; the host's jokes, mistake and insult prompted polite laughter, awkward silence and angry shouting respectively.
items.note: 指观众以热烈掌声表达赞赏。

items.src: The planner distinguished the district's vulnerability to floods from its capacity to withstand them, readiness for emergencies and ability to recover afterwards.
items.para: Resistance to floods, preparedness for emergencies and resilience afterwards were capacities the planner distinguished from the district's susceptibility to flooding.
items.note: 指易受洪灾影响的性质，而非防灾或恢复能力。

items.src: Leila found the zip repair demonstration instructive rather than amusing, comforting or motivating because she learned a practical skill.
items.para: Because Leila learned a practical skill, she considered the demonstration of zip repair informative rather than entertaining, reassuring or inspiring.
items.note: 此处指传授实用知识、让人有所收获。

items.src: Engineers installed wireless leak sensors in every dwelling but excluded the building storing goods, the repair premises and the administrative building.
items.para: The warehouse, workshop and office were excluded when engineers fitted every home with wireless sensors for detecting leaks.
items.note: 指供人居住的住宅，而非工作或储货场所。

items.src: Next month, the editor plans to merge science and technology, enlarge sports, rearrange business and eliminate travel from the newspaper.
items.para: The editor's plans for next month are to expand sports, reorganize business, remove travel and combine the newspaper's science and technology sections.
items.note: 指把两个版块合为一体，而非扩充或删除。

items.src: Exposure of fabricated evidence brought the psychologist notoriety, destroying colleagues' esteem and society's confidence while ending his previously little-known status.
items.para: The psychologist lost professional respect, public trust and relative anonymity when exposure of fabricated evidence brought him widespread infamy.
items.note: 指因坏事而广为人知，即恶名远扬。

items.src: Researchers saw a glimmer from plankton, not a brilliant burst or a constant ray, before the shore became completely dark.
items.para: Before total darkness covered the shore, researchers observed a faint glow from plankton rather than a bright flash or a steady beam.
items.note: 此处指微弱的光，而非强光或光束。

items.src: Although carrying identification was mandatory and printed maps were helpful, the guide called paper tickets needless rather than troublesome because booking codes sufficed.
items.para: Because booking codes sufficed, the guide considered paper tickets unnecessary, not inconvenient, although carrying identification was compulsory and printed maps were useful.
items.note: 表示没有必要，不等于不方便或没有用。

items.src: Analysts expected mining rents to skyrocket after the discovery, rather than become steady, vary unpredictably, or fall sharply as some investors predicted.
items.para: Following the discovery, some investors predicted mining rents would stabilise, fluctuate, or plummet, but analysts expected them to soar instead.
items.note: 指价格等迅速大幅上涨。

items.src: Volunteers received a memorandum explaining equipment collection, not a public bulletin or individual invitation, and used its instructions to revise their equipment inventory.
items.para: Using an internal notice about equipment collection, volunteers revised their equipment inventory; they had received neither a public announcement nor a personal invitation.
items.note: 此处指向内部人员传达事项的书面通知。

items.src: The charity chose to commend farmers for protecting pollinators, instead of rewarding them, giving them guidance, or expressing disapproval of their methods.
items.para: For protecting pollinators, the charity decided to praise farmers, not reward them, advise them, or criticise their methods.
items.note: 指因值得肯定的行为而表扬某人。

items.src: The manager observed indifference among technicians towards tool sharing, whereas apprentices welcomed it enthusiastically and supervisors opposed it firmly despite substantial doubts.
items.para: Despite considerable uncertainty, supervisors showed strong opposition to tool sharing; apprentices expressed genuine enthusiasm, while the manager observed technicians' lack of interest.
items.note: 指缺乏兴趣，并非反对或犹豫不决。

items.src: These household surveys contradict the bank's spending claim, although its economists endorse it, expand upon it, and mention it in their reports.
items.para: Although bank economists agree with their bank's spending claim, elaborate on it, and refer to it in reports, these household surveys conflict with it.
items.note: 指调查结果与该说法相矛盾。

items.src: Leila will narrate her stage debut before peers assess her performance and actors reproduce it, after which the tutor will briefly review their discussion.
items.para: Before peers evaluate her performance and actors recreate it, Leila will recount her stage debut; afterwards, the tutor will summarise their discussion.
items.note: 指按经历讲述事情，而非评价或重演。

items.src: Researchers envisage harmless sensors inside plants and study that possibility, while critics question it and investors reject it outright.
items.para: While critics doubt the possibility of harmless sensors inside plants and investors dismiss it outright, researchers imagine it and investigate it.
items.note: 此处指在脑海中设想未来的可能情景。

items.src: Musicians hold the composer in high esteem for her precision, while friends love her dearly, journalists find her fascinating, and rivals resent her deeply.
items.para: Friends feel deep affection for the composer, journalists intense curiosity, and rivals bitter resentment, while musicians have great respect for her because of her precision.
items.note: 表示高度敬重，不等于喜爱或好奇。

items.src: The coach will shorten sessions, schedule them more frequently, and delay races, but confine Lina's exercise to swimming while she recovers.
items.para: While Lina recovers, her coach will restrict exercise to swimming, reduce session length, increase session frequency, and postpone races.
items.note: 指将活动限制在指定范围内。

items.src: Tests revealed an iron deficiency rather than an excessive amount, while ruling out unequal mineral proportions and changes in vitamin levels over time.
items.para: Tests excluded mineral imbalance and vitamin fluctuation, but showed a lack of iron rather than an excess.
items.note: 指必需物质含量不足，而非过量或波动。

items.src: Direct sunlight can warm seedlings gently, dry their soil quickly, and scorch their leaves, whereas afternoon shade can lower their temperature gradually.
items.para: Afternoon shade can gradually cool seedlings, whereas direct sunlight can gently warm them, quickly dry their soil, and slightly burn their leaves.
items.note: 指热量使表面轻度烧伤。

items.src: College leaders called the destructive library flood a calamity, not merely an annoyance, a reversal of progress, or a situation requiring urgent action.
items.para: Rejecting nuisance, emergency, and setback as inadequate descriptions, college leaders called the destructive library flood a disaster.
items.note: 指造成严重破坏或损失的灾难。

items.src: The exporter introduced insulated containers for cheese during transit, not while it was being made, kept in warehouses, or checked for quality.
items.para: Shipment was the stage for which the exporter introduced insulated cheese containers, not production, storage, or inspection.
items.note: 此处指货物从一地运往另一地的过程。

items.src: Marta classified the kitchen purchase payment as reimbursement of expenses, not money provided beforehand, an extra reward, or borrowed funds.
items.para: For Marta, the kitchen purchase payment constituted repayment of expenses, not an advance, a bonus or a loan.
items.note: 指偿还他人已经垫付的费用。

items.src: Early mechanical clocks were costly, so the aristocracy owned most, while religious officials, commercial traders, and ordinary farm workers possessed relatively few.
items.para: Because early mechanical clocks cost so much, few belonged to clergy, merchants, or peasants; most were owned by the nobility.
items.note: 指拥有世袭贵族身份的社会阶层。

items.src: The archive offers an array of accents, not a small selection or one example, although its coverage falls short of an exhaustive catalogue.
items.para: Although not a complete catalogue, the archive offers a wide range of accents rather than a limited selection or a single example.
items.note: 此处指种类丰富的一系列事物。

items.src: The psychologist planned the puzzle as a prelude to discussion, not a disruption, a closing activity, or a review of its content.
items.para: The puzzle was intended by the psychologist as an introduction to discussion, not as a summary, conclusion, or interruption.
items.note: 指主要活动开始前的引入环节。

items.src: Frog losses continue to perplex researchers and alarm conservationists, while equipment failures annoy assistants, although recent funding news comforts sponsors.
items.para: Funding updates reassure sponsors, although equipment failures frustrate assistants; meanwhile, frog losses still puzzle researchers and alarm conservationists.
items.note: 指使人困惑，无法理解或解释。

items.src: Cave visitors moved inward after looking up at the ceiling, while guides headed for the entrance and departing tourists walked towards the exit.
items.para: While guides headed towards the entrance and departing tourists walked towards the exit, cave visitors moved towards the centre after looking towards the ceiling.
items.note: 此处指朝向中心，而非入口、上方或出口。

items.src: Floods continued to hinder rather than stop excavation, while engineers planned to restart drainage and speed up repairs.
items.para: Engineers intended to resume drainage and accelerate repairs, although floods continued to obstruct excavation rather than halt it.
items.note: 指阻碍进展，并不一定使工作完全停止。

items.src: The ministry's quest for fairer land allocation followed a preliminary review and public discussions but preceded the eventual choice of a system.
items.para: Between an initial assessment with public consultation and the final selection of a system, the ministry conducted a persistent search for fairer land allocation.
items.note: 指为实现目标而持续进行的探索或寻求。

items.src: Researchers documented the valley's transformation into a lake, followed by its slow enlargement, brief shrinkage, and ultimate disappearance.
items.para: Researchers recorded a complete change from valley to lake before documenting its gradual expansion, temporary contraction, and eventual disappearance.
items.note: 指形态或性质的彻底改变，而非大小变化。

items.src: The chef looked sheepish about his printing mistake, whereas his annoyed assistant, confused manager, and untroubled apprentice reacted differently.
items.para: Unlike his irritated assistant, bewildered manager, and unconcerned apprentice, the chef looked embarrassed about his printing error.
items.note: 指因自己犯错而感到窘迫、不好意思。

items.src: The lecturer distinguished the mythical golden city from historically recorded settlements, newly found ruins, and real towns that explorers had not yet located.
items.para: Historically documented settlements, recently discovered ruins, and still undiscovered real towns were distinguished by the lecturer from the purely imaginary golden city.
items.note: 指传说中虚构的，并非真实存在但尚未发现的。

items.src: Students compared the nucleus with the cell's outer membrane, its internal fluid, and its mitochondria, which produce cellular energy.
items.para: Students contrasted the compartment containing most cellular DNA with the membrane surrounding the cell, the fluid filling the cell, and the structures producing cellular energy.
items.note: 细胞核是容纳细胞大部分遗传物质的结构。

items.src: Our magnetic disc will glide along the laboratory track, unlike the other discs, which will sway sideways, rotate quickly, or halt suddenly.
items.para: Other discs will wobble sideways, spin rapidly, or stop abruptly, whereas our magnetic disc will move smoothly along the laboratory track.
items.note: 此处指沿轨道平稳滑行，而非摇晃或旋转。

items.src: The sculptor made a vow to reuse stone; colleagues hoped demand would fall, warned of shortages, and proposed recycling rubble.
items.para: Colleagues expressed hope for lower demand, warned about shortages, and suggested recycling rubble; the sculptor solemnly promised to reuse stone.
items.note: 指郑重承诺去做某事，而非表达愿望或建议。

items.src: Opinions about the shirts' appearance varied: the runners were indifferent, their coach showed enthusiasm, the designer felt let down, and sponsors remained undecided.
items.para: Regarding the shirts' appearance, the coach was enthusiastic, the designer was disappointed, and sponsors were uncertain, but the runners were uninterested.
items.note: 指对外观不感兴趣，而非失望或犹豫不决。

items.src: Surgeons identified a remnant of damaged knee tissue, distinguishing it from the extracted fragment, newly developed tissue, and scarring.
items.para: Neither scar tissue, new growth, nor the removed fragment matched what surgeons identified: the remaining piece of damaged knee tissue.
items.note: 指大部分被移除后留下的一部分。

items.src: Gardeners aim for eradication of the invasive weed, rather than briefly suppressing it, reducing its numbers, or preventing its spread.
items.para: For the invasive weed, spread prevention, population reduction, and temporary suppression fall short of the gardeners' goal, which is complete elimination.
items.note: 指彻底清除，而非仅减少或限制蔓延。

items.src: Teachers attributed Leila's reassuring influence to her calm temperament, not her temporary cheerfulness, positive outlook, or polite conduct.
items.para: Leila reassured others because of her calm disposition, teachers thought, rather than her cheerful mood, positive attitude, or polite behaviour.
items.note: 指较稳定的性情，而非情绪、态度或行为。

items.src: Officials described and publicised the consultation room before they dubbed it the Listening Post; residents later suggested it to friends.
items.para: After officials described and advertised the consultation room, they nicknamed it the Listening Post, and residents subsequently recommended it to friends.
items.note: 指给某人或某处起一个别称。

items.src: Meena acknowledged fault, said she was sorry, and asked to be forgiven, but only made amends when she replaced her neighbour's broken flowerpot.
items.para: Only replacing her neighbour's broken flowerpot provided compensation; previously, Meena had admitted responsibility, expressed regret, and requested forgiveness.
items.note: 指以实际行动补偿自己造成的损失。

items.src: This cooker uses a valve to let gas through, a dial to adjust its flow, a spark to ignite it, and a switch to halt it.
items.para: Gas passes through a cooker whose valve can release it, dial can regulate it, spark can light it, and switch can stop it.
items.note: 指点燃燃料，使其开始燃烧。

items.src: Listeners preferred the host's witty shopping remarks to his lucid, informative explanations, warmly supportive advice, and pointed criticism of retailers.
items.para: Listeners preferred clever and amusing shopping remarks over the host's warm and encouraging advice, sharp and critical retailer assessments, and clear and informative explanations.
items.note: 指既机智又有趣，而非仅清晰或尖锐。

items.src: Because the plan relied on an untested assumption, the chair decided to veto it rather than grant conditional approval, delay it, or criticise it publicly.
items.para: The chair chose to formally reject, not provisionally approve, temporarily postpone, or publicly criticise the plan because it depended on an untested assumption.
items.note: 指运用职权正式否决，而非仅批评或推迟。

items.src: Volunteers heard stranded goats wail, rather than bleat hungrily, summon other goats, or snort angrily, as floodwater surrounded the farm.
items.para: As flooding surrounded the farm, volunteers heard stranded goats cry loudly in distress, not bleat for food, call to companions, or snort in anger.
items.note: 指因痛苦或困境而大声哀号。

items.src: Ferry passengers can converse with the island guide after supper, though she prefers hearing them out to formally addressing them or disputing their views.
items.para: The island guide prefers to listen rather than lecture or argue, but ferry passengers can chat with her after supper.
items.note: 此处指与他人轻松交谈。

items.src: Although officials handled preparation, consent and assessment, execution of the canal restoration plan in 1820 depended on skilled masons from neighbouring villages.
items.para: The implementation of the canal restoration plan in 1820 depended on skilled masons from nearby villages, while officials managed planning, approval and evaluation.
items.note: 两者均指将计划付诸实施。

items.src: The community kitchen will doubtless attract pensioners, is likely to recruit volunteers, might serve lunches, and could conceivably expand later.
items.para: Besides almost certainly attracting pensioners, the community kitchen will probably recruit volunteers, perhaps serve lunches, and conceivably expand later.
items.note: 两者均表示几乎可以肯定的预期。

items.src: Researchers distinguished their observation of fresh otter tracks from their inference of a return, an unsupported assumption of breeding, and a prediction of population growth.
items.para: Researchers separated their conclusion that otters had returned from an observation of fresh tracks, an unsupported assumption about breeding, and a prediction of population growth.
items.note: 两者均指根据证据得出的判断。

items.src: Adjustable pottery benches alleviate existing back pain but cannot stop its onset or remove it completely, whereas poorly fitted benches can aggravate it.
items.para: Although adjustable pottery benches cannot prevent or eliminate back pain, they ease existing discomfort; poorly fitted benches, however, can worsen it.
items.note: 两者均指减轻疼痛，而非完全消除。

items.src: Renewed grain trading gave a semblance of stability, but officials denied it demonstrated recovery and offered neither predictions of growth nor assurances of supplies.
items.para: Officials offered neither a forecast of growth nor a guarantee of supplies, saying renewed grain trading created an appearance of stability, not proof of recovery.
items.note: 两者均指表面呈现的样子，未必属实。

items.src: Fidgeting was indicative of anxiety rather than causing it; reassurance helped the participant, while embarrassment hindered disclosure.
items.para: Reassurance was beneficial for the participant, while embarrassment was obstructive to disclosure; fidgeting was suggestive of anxiety, not responsible for it.
items.note: 两者均表示是某种情况的迹象。

items.src: Laboratory directors must carefully examine proposed experiments before they authorize or formally refuse them, and may pause ongoing work if safety concerns arise.
items.para: Before directors officially approve or formally reject proposed experiments, they must carefully review them; safety concerns may lead them to temporarily suspend ongoing work.
items.note: 两者均指正式批准或许可。

items.src: With rain forecast, waterproof exhibition labels were prudent; choosing paper ones was foolhardy, gold lettering wasted money, and duplicate signs served no purpose.
items.para: Forecast rain made paper exhibition labels reckless and waterproof ones sensible, while gold lettering was extravagant and duplicate signs were unnecessary.
items.note: 两者均指考虑风险后作出的明智选择。

items.src: The rowing club expects junior membership to treble next season, adult numbers to increase twofold, fees to fall by half, and staffing to stay constant.
items.para: Next season, the rowing club expects fees to halve and staffing to remain unchanged, while junior membership will triple and adult numbers will double.
items.note: 两者均指增至原来的三倍。

items.src: Unlike unnecessarily complex alternatives, the clinic's cunning reminder system linked alerts to routines without being beautiful or using sophisticated technology.
items.para: Alternatives were needlessly complicated; the clinic's cleverly designed reminder system linked alerts to routines but was neither visually attractive nor technically advanced.
items.note: 此处指设计巧妙，并非狡猾。

items.src: Independent bakeries flourish beside pedestrian squares, while suburban branches face difficulties, station outlets merely stay open, and shops near factories lose business.
