items.para: Suburban bakeries struggle, station outlets merely survive, and shops near factories decline, whereas independent bakeries beside pedestrian squares thrive.
items.note: 此处指生意兴旺，而非仅维持经营。

items.src: Our pottery tutor requested coarse sand rather than finely textured sand or dusty clay, because the intended finish was rough, not even.
items.para: To produce a rough rather than smooth finish, our pottery tutor requested large-grained sand, rejecting fine-grained sand and powdery clay.
items.note: 形容沙子时，指颗粒较大的。

items.src: Analysts found an inverse relationship between inspections and violations, not a positive association, a causal link, or a chance connection.
items.para: Rejecting a causal connection, a coincidental association, and a positive correlation, analysts concluded that inspections and violations showed a negative correlation.
items.note: 指负相关，即一方增加时另一方减少。

items.src: Teams were halfway through repairs, finishing inspections, and far from starting construction, while negotiations were on the brink of collapse.
items.para: Negotiations were on the verge of collapse; teams were in the middle of repairs, at the end of inspections, and a long way from construction.
items.note: 表示某事即将发生，此处指谈判即将破裂。

items.src: Laboratories rely solely on fingerprints, whereas offices mainly use cards, warehouses sometimes require passwords, and workshops regularly check signatures.
items.para: Offices primarily use cards, warehouses occasionally require passwords, and workshops routinely check signatures, but laboratories rely exclusively on fingerprints.
items.note: 表示仅用这一种方式，不采用其他方式。

items.src: Teenagers shun advertisement-heavy broadcasts but look for uninterrupted music, put up with brief announcements, and publicly complain about repetitive playlists.
items.para: Teenagers actively seek uninterrupted music, merely tolerate brief announcements, and openly criticise repetitive playlists, but deliberately avoid advertisement-heavy broadcasts.
items.note: 指有意回避，不只是容忍或批评。

items.src: Planners subdivide some sections and combine others into larger units; they either preserve the remaining sections without changes or remove them completely.
items.para: Some sections planners split into smaller parts, others they merge into larger units; the rest they retain unchanged or exclude entirely.
items.note: 指把现有部分进一步拆分成更小部分。

items.src: Volunteers disentangle seabirds from discarded nets, check them for injuries, provide necessary medical care, and finally return them to the wild.
items.para: Before volunteers examine seabirds, treat any injuries, and release them into the wild, they free the birds from discarded nets.
items.note: 此处指使海鸟摆脱渔网的缠困。

items.src: Passengers were indignant about unfair refund refusals, but were neither let down by delays, worried about connections, nor accepting of the cancellation.
items.para: Neither disappointed by delays, anxious about connections, nor resigned to the cancellation, passengers were angry at unfair refund refusals.
items.note: 指因受到不公平待遇而愤怒。

items.src: Sailors' meals were deficient in fresh vegetables but contained plentiful salt, no fruit, and enough grain to meet their needs.
items.para: Although rich in salt and completely devoid of fruit, sailors' meals were adequately supplied with grain but short of fresh vegetables.
items.note: 表示所需数量不足，不一定完全没有。

items.src: Mara was finicky about presentation and strongly disapproved of high prices, unlike diners who tolerated slow service or were readily satisfied by simple dishes.
items.para: Unlike diners fairly tolerant of slow service or easily pleased by simple dishes, Mara was highly critical of prices and excessively particular about presentation.
items.note: 指对细节过分挑剔，此处针对菜品摆盘。

items.src: Some documentaries misrepresent wolves as solitary hunters, briefly outlining their diet and studying their movements carefully while intentionally excluding their cooperative behaviour.
items.para: Some documentaries briefly describe wolves' diet and closely examine their movements, yet inaccurately portray them as solitary hunters and deliberately omit their cooperative behaviour.
items.note: 指不准确地描述，此处误写狼的捕猎习性。

items.src: Relatives called the workshop owner a miser, unlike his extravagant brother, his betting cousin, and his sister who gave generously to charity.
items.para: His brother was a spendthrift, his cousin a gambler, and his sister a philanthropist; relatives called the workshop owner a penny-pincher.
items.note: 指吝啬鬼，即极不愿花钱的人。

items.src: Loan officers first approximate a shop's profit, then compute it from sales and expenses before checking the result and entering it in their records.
items.para: After they estimate a shop's profit, loan officers calculate it from sales and expenses, then verify and record the result.
items.note: 指根据数据计算出数值，而非估算或核查。

items.src: Photographs of abandoned pets aim to rouse compassion and expose feelings visitors usually repress, encouraging them to communicate those emotions through letters.
items.para: Encouraging visitors to express emotions through letters, photographs of abandoned pets aim to stir compassion and reveal feelings people usually suppress.
items.note: 指激起情感，此处为唤起同情心。

items.src: Although teachers arrange laboratory visits and parents authorize them, a research charity will subsidize the trips unless the laboratories call them off.
items.para: A research charity will help fund laboratory trips that teachers organize and parents approve, unless the laboratories cancel them.
items.note: 指提供经费支持，承担活动的部分费用。

items.src: Gallery contracts permit public displays, promote educational talks, and offer borrowers conservation workshops; they also obligate borrowers to regulate humidity.
items.para: Besides provisions that allow public displays, encourage educational talks, and invite borrowers to conservation workshops, gallery contracts legally require borrowers to regulate humidity.
items.note: 指使某人承担义务，此处为合同的强制要求。

items.src: Her chronic shoulder pain differed from the captain's intense headaches, the coxswain's abrupt cramps, and the beginner's slight soreness after training.
items.para: Her shoulder pain was persistent; by contrast, the captain's headaches were severe, the coxswain's cramps sudden, and the beginner's soreness after training mild.
items.note: 指长期持续的，不表示疼痛程度严重。

items.src: Recovering patients can choose a secluded courtyard rather than the readily reachable terrace, the centrally situated lobby, or the frequently occupied lounge.
items.para: Instead of the easily accessible terrace, centrally located lobby, or heavily used lounge, recovering patients can choose a courtyard tucked away from others.
items.note: 指位置隐蔽、远离他人活动而不受打扰。

items.src: The plaza's paving may earn admiration and lighting ease worries, while signs may bewilder residents and inadequate seating dissatisfy them.
items.para: Although inadequate seating may displease residents and signs confuse them, the plaza's paving may impress them and lighting reassure them.
items.note: 指未达到人们的需求或期望，使其不满。

items.src: Equal loads brought the beam into equilibrium, ending its turning and shaking and removing the unsteadiness observed earlier.
items.para: The beam's rotation and vibration ceased when identical weights established balance, eliminating its earlier instability.
items.note: 此处指梁两端受力达到平衡。

items.src: Unlike ordinary indexing, time-sensitive repairs, or easily handled enquiries, digitising the census was a monumental task occupying the ministry's team for six years.
items.para: The ministry's team spent six years digitising the census, an enormous task unlike routine indexing, urgent repairs, or manageable enquiries.
items.note: 此处形容任务规模极其庞大。

items.src: These compact speakers offer remarkable fidelity rather than high loudness, a warm tone, or strong resonance, despite their relatively modest price.
items.para: Despite a relatively modest price, these small speakers deliver exceptional accuracy rather than high volume, tonal warmth, or strong resonance.
items.note: 此处指声音还原的准确程度。

items.src: Software testers judged the assistant's replies curt rather than merely brief, ceremonious, or restrained, since their shortness sounded impolite.
items.para: Because their brevity seemed rude, the assistant's responses struck software testers as brusque, not simply concise, formal, or reserved.
items.note: 此处指回复简短生硬且失礼。

items.src: A cock crowed beside the barn while a female chicken, a farmyard goose, and a domestic duck fed nearby during the morning broadcast.
items.para: While a hen, a goose, and a duck fed nearby during the morning broadcast, a rooster crowed beside the farm building.
items.note: 两词在此都指公鸡。

items.src: Our workshop examined how jokes cause a deflection of attention from difficult questions rather than greater focus, divided attention, or renewed attention.
items.para: Our workshop explored how jokes produce a shift of attention away from difficult questions rather than its concentration, division, or restoration.
items.note: 此处指注意力偏离原问题的转移。

items.src: Planting thirsty trees was a blunder, not a small omission, deliberate gamble, or sensible choice, because their water consumption dried wetland pools.
items.para: Because thirsty trees dried wetland pools, planting them constituted neither a sound decision nor a calculated risk, but a serious mistake rather than a minor oversight.
items.note: 此处指造成严重后果的错误。

items.src: Passengers observed lamps oscillate safely as waves rocked the ferry, rather than stay motionless, rotate, or slide vertically downwards.
items.para: Waves rocked the ferry as passengers observed lamps safely swing back and forth, not remain completely still, spin in circles, or slide straight down.
items.note: 此处指悬挂的灯来回摆动。

items.src: Archaeological evidence suggests irrigation canals were integral to desert settlements' survival, not merely beneficial, practical, or dispensable features of farming life.
items.para: For desert settlements to survive, irrigation channels were essential rather than merely helpful, convenient, or optional features of farming life, archaeological findings suggest.
items.note: 此处指对聚落生存不可或缺。

items.src: Rising rents prompted several families to contemplate sharing homes with elderly relatives, without dismissing, delaying, or advocating the arrangement.
items.para: Several families began to consider sharing homes with elderly relatives because rents rose, but did not reject, postpone, or recommend the arrangement.
items.note: 此处指考虑尚未决定的居住安排。

items.src: Missing seabirds continue to baffle researchers and frighten wardens, while successful rescues ease volunteers' fears and encourage donors to contribute.
items.para: Successful rescues reassure volunteers and motivate donors to contribute, but missing seabirds still puzzle researchers and alarm wardens.
items.note: 此处均指使人困惑、无法理解。

items.src: Leila's longing for company eventually replaced her quiet contentment with solitude, rather than developing into increasing anxiety or persistent bitterness.
items.para: Eventually, quiet satisfaction with solitude gave way to Leila's intense desire for company, which became neither growing apprehension nor lingering resentment.
items.note: 均指对未得到之物的强烈渴望。

items.src: Broadcast interviews helped mobilize volunteers for the beach cleanup, while team leaders taught participants, oversaw their work, and expressed gratitude afterward.
items.para: Team leaders did instruct participants, supervise their work, and thank them afterward; broadcast interviews helped rally volunteers for the beach cleanup.
items.note: 均指动员人员参与集体行动。

items.src: The venue cancellation created a snag, but renting a smaller hall resolved it, requiring a concession on capacity while improving accessibility.
items.para: Renting a smaller hall offered a solution to the obstacle created by cancellation, with a compromise on capacity but an improvement in accessibility.
items.note: 均指妨碍事情推进的困难。

items.src: Researchers took an oath to protect identities after receiving an official caution; neither a request in writing nor casual advice could replace that commitment.
items.para: Following a formal warning, researchers made a solemn pledge to protect identities, a commitment neither a written request nor an informal suggestion could replace.
items.note: 均指具有约束意义的庄严承诺。

items.src: Gallery attendance showed a sharp drop-off after the exhibition changed, contradicting forecasts of growth, and subsequently neither rebounded nor varied irregularly.
items.para: Despite forecasts of an increase, gallery attendance underwent a steep decline after the exhibition changed, followed by neither recovery nor fluctuation.
items.note: 此处均指参观人数的下降。

items.src: Despite failed harvests, settlers sent rosy letters about farming overseas, whereas their diaries expressed bleak expectations, guarded hopes, or unconcerned attitudes.
items.para: Settlers' diaries sounded pessimistic, cautious, or indifferent, yet their letters gave optimistic accounts of farming overseas despite harvest failures.
items.note: 此处均指对前景持乐观、美好的看法。

items.src: Arun tolerated criticism from his trainer, but ridicule from gym members discouraged attendance despite encouragement from friends and compliments from his family.
items.para: Friends offered encouragement and family provided praise, yet gym members' mockery deterred Arun from attending, although he accepted his trainer's criticism.
items.note: 均指使人难堪或显得可笑的嘲弄。

items.src: Parking permits require bona fide residency, whether applicants live there indefinitely or briefly; officially recording their residency alone does not establish eligibility.
items.para: Residency must be genuine for parking permits, whether permanent or temporary; being registered alone does not establish eligibility.
items.note: 均指真实的，而非虚假声称的。

items.src: Withdrawal of exchange funding initially shocked language staff, then provoked anger, before gloom settled over the department; nobody felt relieved.
items.para: Nobody felt relief when exchange funding ended; language staff experienced shock, followed by anger, before despondency spread throughout the department.
items.note: 此处均指弥漫的低落、悲观情绪。

items.src: Residents felt bewilderment at the announcement, anxiety about research access, displeasure over the archive closure, and relief when reopening was promised.
items.para: Although promised reopening brought relief, residents experienced confusion about the announcement, dissatisfaction with the archive closure, and anxiety about access for research.
items.note: 此处都指对档案馆关闭感到不满。

items.src: Rain can reduce cleaning chemicals' concentration; these chemicals can contaminate river water, while some change sediment's colour or bring minerals into solution.
items.para: Rain can dilute cleaning chemicals, which can pollute river water, while some discolour sediment or dissolve minerals.
items.note: 此处都指化学物质使河水受到污染。

items.src: Engineers envision robots inspecting turbines independently, although they question their reliability, anticipate expensive repairs, and recall earlier failures.
items.para: Although engineers doubt reliability, expect costly repairs, and remember past failures, they imagine robots checking turbines without assistance.
items.note: 此处都指想象机器人未来独立工作的情景。

items.src: Analysts use advertising trends to foretell spending changes, interviews to establish their causes, surveys to quantify them, and official figures to verify them.
items.para: Analysts use interviews to explain spending changes, advertising trends to predict them, surveys to measure them, and official figures to confirm them.
items.note: 此处都指提前预测消费支出的变化。

items.src: Children's explanations testify to logical ability, while errors undermine confidence in their accuracy, highlight learning needs, and explain their low scores.
items.para: Errors cast doubt on accuracy, draw attention to learning needs, and offer explanations for low scores, whereas children's explanations provide evidence of logical ability.
items.note: 此处都指为儿童的逻辑能力提供证据。

items.src: Nia is communicative with wetland visitors, receptive to their concerns, unwilling to quarrel, and keen to assist anyone needing directions.
items.para: While willing to talk with wetland visitors and ready to listen to their concerns, Nia remains reluctant to argue and eager to help anyone needing directions.
items.note: 此处指乐于交谈和交流信息。

items.src: The signed agreement is null because the operator lacks a licence; the others remain enforceable, tentative, or contested, depending on their terms.
items.para: Depending on their terms, the other agreements remain binding, provisional, or disputed, but the signed one is invalid because its operator lacks a licence.
items.note: 此处都指协议不具有法律效力。

items.src: Silk trading was lawful after customs duties were paid, but its profitability and customary status did not make participation obligatory.
items.para: Although silk trading was profitable and customary, it was not compulsory; it became legal once the required customs payments had been made.
items.note: 此处都指缴纳关税后获法律允许。

items.src: Applicants considered members snobbish, not merely socially withdrawn or careful about friendships, because they disparaged poorer people and were antagonistic toward critics.
items.para: Members' disparagement of poorer people and hostile attitude toward critics led applicants to consider them elitist, not merely reserved or cautious about friendships.
items.note: 此处都指自视地位优越而轻视穷人。

items.src: Some volunteers intend to protect orchids but hesitate to confront visitors, whereas others endeavor to enforce access restrictions and refuse to ignore violations.
items.para: While some volunteers try hard to enforce access restrictions and refuse to overlook violations, others intend to safeguard orchids but hesitate to challenge visitors.
items.note: 此处都指努力实施通行限制。

items.src: The keeper is solitary on most shifts, but regular telephone conversations keep him outgoing and prevent him from feeling lonely or socially disconnected.
items.para: Regular phone calls keep the keeper sociable and prevent him from feeling lonely or isolated, although he is alone on most shifts.
items.note: 此处表示独自一人，并非感到寂寞。

items.src: Despite lower funding than anticipated, the cooperative has ample money for boats but only just adequate maintenance funding and severely inadequate training funding.
items.para: The cooperative has more than enough money for boats, barely sufficient maintenance funding, and far too little training funding despite receiving less than expected support.
items.note: 表示超过实际所需，十分充足。

items.src: Participants interpreted the scripted insult as provocation rather than an attempt at reconciliation, an indication of danger, or an appeal for assistance.
items.para: Participants considered the scripted insult a trigger for anger rather than a peace offering, a warning sign, or a cry for help.
items.note: 此处指激起他人愤怒的言语刺激。

items.src: Before laboratory work begins, I will reiterate the safety rule, not clarify its meaning, dispute its validity, or revoke it.
items.para: I will neither explain nor challenge nor cancel the safety rule; before laboratory work starts, I will simply state again what it requires.
items.note: 表示把已经说过的要求再次陈述。

items.src: Notwithstanding limited funds, the troupe staged its folk tale after rehearsals ended but ahead of winter, thanks to unpaid assistance.
items.para: The troupe staged its folk tale because of volunteer help, before winter but after rehearsals ended, despite limited funds.
items.note: 表示尽管如此，引出未能阻止结果的条件。

items.src: The referee called distracting opponents dishonorable despite its legality, rejecting the coach's description of the tactic as smart and innocuous.
items.para: Although distracting opponents was lawful, the referee considered it shameful rather than clever and harmless, as the coach had claimed.
items.note: 表示道德上不光彩、令人不齿的。

items.src: The clinic requires meticulous equipment inspections, not merely standard ones, and values attention to detail above automation or speed.
items.para: The clinic prioritises attention to detail over automated or swift checks, demanding painstaking equipment inspections rather than merely routine ones.
items.note: 表示极其仔细，认真关注每一处细节。

items.src: Both architects concur that trees would improve the street, although they doubt the cost estimates, advocate gradual planting, and oppose widening the pavement.
items.para: Both architects question the cost estimates, recommend gradual planting, and reject pavement widening, but agree that trees would improve the street.
items.note: 表示双方对某事持相同意见。

items.src: The protracted negotiations delayed the centre's opening, unlike earlier talks that were short, temporarily disrupted halfway through, or deferred before they began.
items.para: Earlier talks were brief, interrupted halfway through, or postponed before starting; this time, drawn-out negotiations delayed the centre's opening.
items.note: 表示过程持续很久、拖延过久。

items.src: Staff shortages still afflict the passport office without completely disabling it, although reforms bolster it and volunteers ease its difficulties.
items.para: Reforms strengthen the passport office and volunteers relieve it, yet staff shortages continue to plague it without completely managing to paralyse it.
items.note: 表示持续造成严重困扰，但不一定使其瘫痪。

items.src: Teaching children songs brings me fulfillment rather than excitement, although their progress makes me proud and their safe arrival eases my worries.
items.para: I feel pride at the children's progress and relief at their safe arrival, but teaching them songs brings satisfaction rather than excitement.
items.note: 此处指从教孩子唱歌中获得的内心满足。

items.src: Using magnification, researchers identified the moving speck as a microbe, not a grain of mineral, trapped air, or broken plant material.
items.para: Under magnification, the moving speck proved to be a microscopic organism rather than a mineral particle, an air bubble, or a plant fragment.
items.note: 指需借助显微镜观察的微小生物。

items.src: Every entrant must send a recording to the person judging the contest, while its coordinator reserves seats for anyone coming to watch.
items.para: The organiser reserves seats for each spectator, while every participant must submit a recording to the contest's judge.
items.note: 此处指提交录音参加比赛的人。

items.src: Separating evidence from opinion is a cardinal rule, so tutors reject proposals to make it discretionary, subordinate to presentation, or merely tentative.
items.para: Tutors reject making evidence separation optional, secondary to presentation, or provisional, because distinguishing evidence from opinion is a fundamental rule.
items.note: 此处表示规则具有根本的重要性。

items.src: The tutor called instant decomposition a fallacy, explaining that this forecast lacked both a plausible proposed explanation and an inference supported by evidence.
items.para: Without a plausible hypothesis or an evidence-based conclusion to support the prediction of instant decomposition, it was a misconception, the tutor explained.
items.note: 此处指把立即分解当成事实的错误观念。

items.src: I must procure permits from the district office before checking their details, making duplicates, and giving them back after our monastery visit.
items.para: Before I check the details, copy the permits, and return them after our monastery visit, I must obtain them from the district office.
items.note: 此处指从办事处取得所需许可证。

items.src: The kingdom's defensive posture shaped its diplomatic planning, its promise to protect allies, and its reaction to threats from neighbouring states.
items.para: The kingdom's diplomatic strategy, commitment to protecting allies, and response to neighbouring states' threats were all shaped by its defensive stance.
items.note: 此处指国家在外交上采取的防御立场。

items.src: Residents found the developer's explanation feeble despite its detail, relevance, and assured tone, because it ignored their fears of losing the garden.
items.para: Because their fears of losing the garden went unanswered, residents considered the developer's detailed, relevant, confident explanation unconvincing.
items.note: 此处指解释缺乏说服力，而非身体虚弱。

items.src: A dispute over nesting sites produced a deadlock between researchers and farmers, making mutual concessions necessary before they could reach a settlement.
items.para: Researchers and farmers needed a compromise before reaching an agreement because their dispute over nesting sites had produced an impasse.
items.note: 指双方无法达成一致、事情无法推进的僵局。

items.src: Our manager is liberal about clothing but enforces punctuality firmly, approaches spending carefully, and favours traditional office layouts.
items.para: Although strict about punctuality, cautious about spending, and conservative about office layouts, our manager is tolerant of employees' clothing choices.
items.note: 此处指对员工的着装选择持宽容态度。

items.src: The cooperative conceived a winter delivery scheme for small farms, which members subsequently endorsed, tried out, and put into operation.
items.para: After the cooperative devised a winter distribution plan for small farms, its members approved, tested, and implemented it.
items.note: 两者都指构思并设计出方案。

items.src: Although her failed audition was disheartening and her friends' support reassuring, rebuilding her confidence was laborious but ultimately satisfying.
items.para: Restoring her confidence proved arduous but ultimately rewarding, although the unsuccessful audition was discouraging and her friends' support comforting.
items.note: 两者都形容过程费时费力、艰苦。

items.src: Visitors praised the clarity of the astronomer's explanation, while the judges valued how correct, concise, and original it was.
items.para: Judges valued the accuracy, brevity, and originality of the astronomer's explanation, whereas visitors praised its intelligibility.
items.note: 此处都指讲解清晰、容易理解的性质。

items.src: Initially worried about recreating historical costumes, I felt indebted to my adviser, proud of my work, and optimistic about the exhibition.
items.para: I was proud of my work, hopeful about the exhibition, and grateful to my adviser after initially feeling anxious about reproducing historical costumes.
items.note: 此处指因受到帮助而心怀感激。

items.src: Quiet talk, gentle music, and subdued clapping remained audible until the spectators' din drowned out every other sound in the hall.
items.para: Every other sound in the hall—quiet conversation, soft music, and faint applause—was drowned out by the spectators' loud racket.
items.note: 指响亮、嘈杂且令人不适的声音。

items.src: The clinic's expenditure fell after waste controls began, while its earnings and reserves remained steady and it took out no loans.
items.para: Following new waste controls, the clinic maintained its income and savings without any borrowing, while its spending declined.
items.note: 两者都指花费的钱款或金钱支出。

items.src: Automatic sweepers eliminated the drudgery of daily manual cleaning, leaving crews time for expert repairs, imaginative design, and thorough safety checks.
items.para: Crews gained time for skilled repair work, creative design work, and detailed safety inspections when automatic sweepers eliminated tedious, repetitive labour from daily manual cleaning.
items.note: 指单调、反复且辛苦的劳动。

items.src: I felt regretful about quitting language classes but relieved to have free evenings, proud of my progress, and positive about future learning.
items.para: Although relieved to have free evenings, proud of my progress, and optimistic about future learning, I felt sorry about abandoning language classes.
items.note: 两者都表示对过去的决定感到遗憾。

items.src: The new training policy covers every convict but excludes people arrested on suspicion, defendants awaiting trial in custody, and witnesses for the prosecution.
items.para: Every arrested suspect, remanded defendant, and prosecution witness is excluded from the new training policy, which covers every sentenced prisoner.
items.note: 此处指已被判刑的服刑人员。

items.src: My neighbour kept hounding me about his ladder rather than simply prompting me, calming my worries, or expressing gratitude for my help.
items.para: Instead of merely reminding me, reassuring me, or thanking me for my help, my neighbour kept persistently pestering me about his ladder.
items.note: 指持续纠缠、反复烦扰某人。

items.src: Wireless sensors owe their predominance in greenhouses to widespread approval, dependable performance and low prices, rather than any single technical breakthrough.
items.para: Popularity, reliability and affordability, rather than a single technical breakthrough, explain the dominance of wireless sensors in greenhouses.
items.note: 两者都指占据主导地位。

items.src: Mira's thrift enabled her generosity, but her brother's excessive desire for wealth and lavish spending left him unable to help others.
items.para: While greed and extravagance left her brother unable to help others, Mira's frugality made her generosity possible.
items.note: 两者都指节俭，避免不必要的花费。

items.src: Anxiety made Leo's fingers quiver before they became rigid and bent inward, but slow breathing eventually helped them loosen.
items.para: Leo's fingers began to tremble with anxiety, then stiffen and curl, before slow breathing eventually helped them relax.
items.note: 两者都指轻微而快速地颤抖。

items.src: The drilling platform's perpetual hum contrasted with alarms sounding at intervals, short whistles, and bells ringing only occasionally.
items.para: Intermittent alarms, brief whistles and occasional bells contrasted with the constant hum of the drilling platform.
items.note: 此处两者都表示持续不断的。

items.src: Although tourists echo the guidebook's claim and historians doubt it, ferry records refute it, while no official documents provide evidence for it.
items.para: Ferry records disprove the guidebook's claim, which tourists repeat and historians question, while no official documents support it.
items.note: 两者都指用证据证明某说法错误。

items.src: Although innumerable merchants crossed the desert city, only a handful kept diaries; few diaries survived, and just one reached our museum.
items.para: Only several merchants kept diaries; few diaries survived and a single diary reached our museum, although countless merchants passed through the desert city.
items.note: 两者都表示数量极多，数不清。

items.src: Villagers sought divine protection for their harvest, rather than protection provided by ancestors, rulers or priests, as their annual ceremony demonstrated.
items.para: Their annual ceremony showed that villagers sought harvest protection from a god, not from ancestors, from rulers or from priests.
items.note: 此处指来自神的保护，而非人的保护。

items.src: Nadia is permissive about bedtimes but firm about homework, while her husband guards their children against danger and expects considerable sporting effort.
items.para: Nadia's husband is protective of their children and demanding about sporting effort, whereas she is lenient about bedtimes but strict about homework.
items.note: 两者都指管束宽松，限制较少。

items.src: Previously anxious workers could rejoice over guaranteed jobs without further worry, while temporary staff felt slight relief and rejected applicants felt bitter disappointment.
items.para: Previously worried workers could feel great joy over guaranteed jobs, not feel anxiety; temporary staff did feel mild relief and rejected applicants did feel bitter disappointment.
items.note: 两者都指感到非常高兴，不只是如释重负。

items.src: Bakeries postponed purchases at the recession's onset, cut staff when it was worst, resumed hiring when it ended, and rebuilt savings afterwards.
items.para: The recession's peak brought bakery staff cuts; its end brought renewed hiring, its aftermath renewed saving, but its start had already delayed purchases.
items.note: 两者都指开始，此处为经济衰退的开端。

items.src: Retired dancers' interviews illuminate their emotional difficulties without hiding or overstating them, but cannot solve the problems caused by retirement.
items.para: Although interviews with retired dancers clarify their emotional difficulties, they cannot resolve these retirement problems and neither conceal nor exaggerate them.
items.note: 此处指使情绪上的困难更清楚易懂。

items.src: Public funding required marine researchers to relinquish recording rights to an archive, rather than keep or divide them, without later recovering them.
items.para: Marine researchers could neither retain nor share recording rights: public funding required them to surrender these to an archive, and they did not regain them.
items.note: 此处指交出权利，不再自行掌握。

items.src: Leila struggled to muster courage before her exhibition, although she could show and maintain it once speaking and rarely let it fade.
items.para: Once speaking, Leila could display and sustain courage and rarely lose it, but before her exhibition she struggled to summon it.
items.note: 此处指鼓起勇气，而非表现或维持勇气。

items.src: The coach dismissed the players' petty disagreements as unimportant, despite their hostility and persistence, and urged attention to genuinely significant problems.
items.para: Despite the players' bitter, persistent disputes, the coach considered them trivial and urged attention to serious problems instead.
items.note: 此处指争执琐碎、不值得重视。

items.src: The clinic's justification for evening exercise was better sleep; its goal was fitness, its prerequisite medical clearance, and its eventual result increased attendance.
items.para: With fitness its objective and medical clearance a condition, the clinic introduced evening exercise: better sleep was its rationale; increased attendance, its eventual consequence.
items.note: 此处指支持某项做法的理由或依据。

items.src: Some souvenir sellers pester tourists for purchases after politely approaching and briefly questioning them, while others merely follow them silently.
items.para: Some souvenir sellers politely approach and briefly question tourists before they repeatedly bother them to buy, whereas others merely silently follow them.
items.note: 此处指为促成购买而反复烦扰游客。

items.src: History pupils compile village accounts from diaries and interviews, then check their accuracy and condense their contents before making the collection public.
items.para: Before they publish their collection, history pupils assemble village accounts from diaries and interviews, then verify their accuracy and summarize their contents.
items.note: 此处指将不同来源的资料汇集起来。

items.src: Basement residents remain vulnerable to flooding despite thorough preparations, while barriers give upstairs residents full protection, though nobody is entirely safe from fire.
items.para: Although well prepared, basement residents remain at risk from floods; barriers keep upstairs residents fully protected, but nobody is completely safe from fire.
items.note: 此处指容易受到洪水伤害，处于风险中。

items.src: Omar decided to classify and fold his camping gear before trying to cram it into a tiny backpack, removing nothing beforehand.
items.para: Rather than remove any camping gear first, Omar decided to sort and fold it before attempting to stuff it into a tiny backpack.
items.note: 此处指把东西硬塞进狭小空间。

items.src: Engineers replaced their limited target with a lofty goal of connecting every island, judging it achievable rather than unworkable.
items.para: Connecting every island became the engineers' ambitious goal, replacing a modest target; they considered the new goal realistic rather than impractical.
items.note: 此处指目标宏大、志向远大。

items.src: The conservator separated the ragged flags from those with faded colours, creases, or stains, since only the torn fabric needed immediate repair.
items.para: Only tattered flags required urgent repairs, so the conservator set them apart from the faded, wrinkled, or stained ones.
items.note: 此处两者都指布料破烂、边缘撕裂的。

items.src: Once widely admired, the institute became notorious after falsifying results, while its little-known director remained a divisive figure.
items.para: Fabricated findings made the formerly widely respected institute infamous, although its obscure director remained controversial.
items.note: 两者都指因坏事而声名狼藉的。

items.src: The ecologist found beetle movements aimless rather than slow, although ants moved together and spiders repeatedly followed the same paths.
items.para: Unlike the ants' coordinated movements and spiders' repetitive routes, beetle movements were directionless rather than sluggish, the ecologist observed.
items.note: 此处两者都指运动没有明确方向或目的地。

items.src: The guide explained that some jellyfish stings are harmless, others cause pain or disability, and a few can be lethal.
items.para: Jellyfish stings range from harmless to painful or disabling, the guide explained, with a few capable of being deadly.
items.note: 两者都指能够导致死亡的。

items.src: Our librarian meets her counterpart from another university monthly, but consults her previous manager, recently appointed assistant, and departmental leader every week.
items.para: Unlike weekly consultations with her former supervisor, new assistant, and department head, our librarian's meetings with her opposite number from another university occur monthly.
items.note: 此处指另一所大学中担任相应职务的人。

items.src: Amina said complicated forms impede childcare applicants, while volunteers offer help and strict eligibility rules deny some families access and deter others.
items.para: Volunteers assist childcare applicants, but complicated forms hinder them, Amina said, while strict eligibility rules exclude some families and discourage others.
items.note: 两者都指阻碍进展，使事情更难进行。

items.src: The presenter seemed pompous rather than merely sure of himself, whereas his usually quiet assistant became forceful when defending the researchers.
items.para: While his normally reserved assistant grew assertive in the researchers' defence, the presenter appeared self-important rather than simply confident.
items.note: 此处两者都指自命不凡、过分自视重要的。

items.src: The designers' proposition prompted opposition from the manager and a forecast from the accountant, but the committee made no final choice.
items.para: An objection from the manager and a prediction from the accountant resulted from the designers' suggestion, but the committee reached no decision.
items.note: 此处两者都指供讨论和考虑的建议。

items.src: The analyst judged criticism of retailers uncalled-for, not simply severe, while finding comments on suppliers helpful but too early.
items.para: Comments on suppliers seemed constructive but premature to the analyst, who considered criticism of retailers unjustified rather than merely harsh.
items.note: 此处两者都指没有正当理由、不应有的。

items.src: Bridge worries continued to preoccupy the engineer over dinner, while colleagues tried to calm her, spark ideas, and encourage action.
items.para: Colleagues tried to reassure, inspire, and motivate the engineer over dinner, but concerns about the bridge continued to engross her.
items.note: 两者都指占据某人的心思，使其无暇旁顾。

items.src: The biologist could vouch for the survey's accuracy, while colleagues could question it, examine it further, or accept responsibility for it.
items.para: Colleagues could investigate the survey's accuracy further, cast doubt on it, or take responsibility for it, whereas the biologist could attest to it.
items.note: 都指凭自己的了解为其准确性作证。

items.src: Rather than merely organise joint activities, the director hopes to unify three choirs, without increasing their membership or dissolving them.
items.para: The director hopes to merge three choirs rather than simply coordinate them, with no intention to expand or disband them.
items.note: 都指把原本独立的团体合为一体。

items.src: Coaches favour periodic fitness checks over uninterrupted monitoring, sporadic assessments, or a single examination before the rowing season.
items.para: Instead of continuous monitoring, occasional assessments, or a one-off examination before the rowing season, coaches prefer regular fitness checks.
items.note: 此处都指按一定间隔反复进行的。

items.src: Our clinic finds complaints about repeated waking commonplace among shift workers, but cannot establish whether they continue long term or become more severe.
items.para: Our clinic finds shift workers' complaints about repeated waking widespread rather than rare, though whether these are persistent or worsening remains unknown.
items.note: 此处都指这类抱怨很普遍，并不罕见。

items.src: Bakery owners find nearby flour suppliers advantageous, not indispensable; they consider unreliable deliveries damaging and suppliers' office decor unrelated to purchasing decisions.
items.para: Bakery owners consider unreliable deliveries harmful and suppliers' office decor irrelevant to purchasing decisions, but nearby flour suppliers beneficial rather than essential.
items.note: 都指能带来实际好处的。

items.src: Despite firm rules, the headteacher was merciful rather than unconcerned or revengeful, granting late submitters another day without punishment.
items.para: Granting late submitters an extra day without punishment, the headteacher was lenient despite strict rules, neither indifferent nor vindictive.
items.note: 此处都指宽大处理，不施以严厉惩罚。

items.src: Inspectors require movable farm vehicles to remain stationary during checks, even those with low speeds, and reject any vehicle that lacks stability.
items.para: Even slow farm vehicles must stay motionless during checks if they are mobile; inspectors reject any unstable vehicle.
items.note: 都指静止不动，而非失去移动能力。

items.src: Amina is inclined to help neighbours unprompted, whereas Ben declines, Cara consents when asked, and Dan must help under his contract.
items.para: Unlike Ben, who refuses to help neighbours, Amina tends to assist unprompted; Cara agrees to help when asked, while Dan is obliged to by contract.
items.note: 都指有做某事的倾向，而非必须如此。

items.src: Engineers simulate desert conditions in a chamber to test drones' endurance, rather than merely quantify those conditions or forecast them.
items.para: Rather than simply measure or predict desert conditions, engineers recreate them inside a chamber to test whether drones can withstand them.
items.note: 此处都指人为重现环境条件以进行测试。

items.src: Facing stronger winter storms, the broadcaster plans to fortify its coastal tower after examining it, rather than move it or install a replacement.
items.para: With winter storms intensifying, the broadcaster plans to inspect its coastal tower and then reinforce it, rather than relocate or replace it.
items.note: 都指加固现有结构，使其更能抵御损坏。

items.src: Volunteers planning a safe field crossing had to avoid a trench, follow a raised bank, and pass between a crest and a depression.
items.para: A safe route across the field required volunteers to follow an embankment, avoid a ditch, and pass between a ridge and a hollow.
items.note: 这里指地面上挖出的狭长沟渠。

items.src: Cleanup volunteers had restricted, short-term powers, while the coordinator held supreme authority over waste disposal rather than exercising joint control.
items.para: Unlike volunteers with limited, temporary powers, the coordinator exercised the highest authority over waste disposal, not shared control.
items.note: 这里表示权力层级最高，而非受限或共享。

items.src: Amina's guide praised her boldness in attempting an unfamiliar route, but attributed her safe return to carefulness, inquisitiveness, and willingness to wait.
items.para: Although caution, curiosity, and patience explained Amina's safe return, her guide praised the courage she showed in attempting an unfamiliar route.
items.note: 这里指敢于尝试陌生路线的勇气。

items.src: The historian chose an analytic method for studying village taxes, rejecting approaches driven by instinct, traditional assumptions, or general impressions.
items.para: For village taxes, the historian rejected methods based on personal intuition, grounded in inherited assumptions, or focused on broad impressions, choosing one involving detailed examination.
items.note: 这里指以细致审查各项细节为基础的。

items.src: Reviewers found no missing entries, repeated records, or shared coverage, but a discrepancy between published housing figures and survey results required clarification.
items.para: Clarification was needed for a mismatch between released housing figures and survey findings, although reviewers found no omission, duplication, or overlap.
items.note: 指本应一致的数据之间出现不符。

items.src: Seabird protection takes precedence over tourism, requires monitoring, clashes with fishing, and gains from research on this island.
items.para: On this island, seabird conservation depends on monitoring, conflicts with fishing, and benefits from research, but has priority over tourism.
items.note: 表示比另一事项更应优先考虑。

items.src: The architect sounded apologetic about delivering plans late, rather than trying to justify herself, showing unconcern, or expressing bitterness toward her colleagues.
items.para: When discussing her late delivery of plans, the architect sounded sorry, not defensive, indifferent, or resentful toward her colleagues.
items.note: 这里表示为自己的过失感到并表达歉意。

items.src: Inspectors certify that coffee meets export standards, whereas traders accept this provisionally, researchers examine it independently, and campaigners challenge it publicly.
items.para: Traders provisionally accept, researchers independently investigate, and campaigners publicly dispute the claim that coffee meets export standards, while inspectors officially confirm it.
items.note: 指以正式身份确认某项说法属实。

items.src: The director used silence to heighten anxiety, jokes to ease it, uncertainty to maintain it, and smiles to hide it.
items.para: Jokes served to relieve anxiety, uncertainty to sustain it, and smiles to conceal it, while the director used silence to intensify it.
items.note: 这里指使已有的焦虑情绪更强烈。

items.src: Marine biologists advocate unrestricted data sharing, which sponsors openly resist, managers consider cautiously, and vessel owners put up with temporarily.
items.para: Sponsors openly oppose unrestricted data sharing, managers cautiously consider it, and vessel owners temporarily tolerate it, whereas marine biologists publicly support it.
items.note: 指公开支持并提倡某种做法。

items.src: Leila's interest in sculpture and persistence impressed her tutor, but her aptitude, rather than her increasing self-confidence, explained her unusually rapid progress.
items.para: Her unusually rapid progress reflected natural talent rather than growing confidence, although Leila also impressed her tutor with strong interest in sculpture and steady determination.
items.note: 两者都指从事某项活动的天生才能。

items.src: The coach warned that public criticism could humiliate players, not merely disturb them slightly, even when intended to enforce firm discipline or greatly increase motivation.
items.para: Public criticism could deeply embarrass players rather than slightly unsettle them, the coach warned, even if meant to firmly discipline or strongly motivate them.
items.note: 此处都指使人深感羞耻、丢脸。

items.src: After classifying coastal grant applications, the ministry required scrutiny of each one, ruling out both approval without review and rejection on receipt.
items.para: Neither automatic approval nor immediate rejection was permitted: the ministry required careful examination of every coastal grant application following initial sorting.
items.note: 两者都指仔细、严格的审查。

items.src: The engineer recommended reinforcement of the canal wall against stronger waves from heavier boats, rejecting replacement, demolition or an increase in height.
items.para: Stronger waves from heavier boats prompted the engineer to recommend strengthening of the canal wall, rejecting its replacement, demolition or heightening.
items.note: 此处都指增强墙体强度的加固。

items.src: Research trainees were taught to gather survey data, examine it and report its main points, but warned never to fabricate results to support predictions.
items.para: To support predictions, research trainees must never invent results; they were taught instead to collect survey data, analyse it and summarise it.
items.note: 此处都指凭空捏造研究结果。

items.src: Reporting the historic chamber's destruction by fire, the council leader sounded sorrowful; residents felt anger, worry or relief at the absence of deaths.
items.para: Residents were angry or anxious, or relieved that nobody had died, while the council leader sounded mournful reporting the historic chamber's destruction by fire.
items.note: 两者都形容流露悲伤的情绪。

items.src: Counselling helped Mei realise volunteers should regulate their effort and attempt demanding tasks, rather than overextend themselves or hold themselves back through fear.
items.para: Mei realised through counselling that volunteers should pace themselves and challenge themselves, but neither overstretch themselves nor restrain themselves out of fear.
items.note: 两者都指承担超出自身承受能力的任务。

items.src: The gaming platform awards bonus points for sportsmanship, including respect for opponents, rather than technical ability, strategic understanding or determination to win.
items.para: On this gaming platform, technical skill, tactical awareness and competitive drive earn no bonus points; fair play, including respect for opponents, does.
items.note: 此处都指公平竞赛并尊重对手的精神。

items.src: Critics called the channel's focus on ordinary families a deviation from political interviews, not a continuation, broadening or return to that established practice.
items.para: By focusing on ordinary families, the channel made a departure from political interviews; critics saw neither an expansion nor a revival nor a continuation.
items.note: 此处都指偏离原有的惯常做法。

items.src: Before lighting the camping lamp, the instructor selected kerosene and explained why petrol, diesel and alcohol were unsuitable for this particular model.
items.para: Petrol, diesel and alcohol were unsuitable for this camping lamp; before lighting it, the instructor explained why and selected paraffin.
items.note: 英式英语中两者都可指液体燃料煤油。

items.src: Refill stations made disposable bottles redundant rather than unusable at the reserve, although these bottles remained costly and environmentally damaging.
items.para: Although disposable bottles remained expensive and environmentally harmful at the reserve, refill points made them unnecessary, not unusable.
items.note: 此处指不再需要，而非无法使用。

items.src: Our guide described the innkeeper as righteous, not merely devout, self-assured or popular, because he sheltered stranded travellers without payment.
items.para: Providing stranded travellers free shelter showed that the innkeeper was morally upright, not merely deeply religious, highly confident or widely admired, our guide explained.
items.note: 指品行正直，不只是虔诚、自信或受欢迎。

items.src: Guild records suggest its masters were lenient about missed meetings, despite being exacting about workmanship, consistent in judgement and concerned about apprentices.
items.para: Records suggest guild masters were demanding about workmanship but not strict about meeting absences, neither inconsistent in judgement nor indifferent to apprentices.
items.note: 指执行纪律时不严厉，而非漠不关心。

items.src: Designers chose an oblong table instead of alternatives that were perfectly circular, approximately triangular, or oval for the meeting room.
items.para: For the meeting room, designers rejected perfectly round, roughly triangular, and oval tables, selecting an elongated rectangular model instead.
items.note: 此处指非正方形的长方形。

items.src: Rangers monitor beetle colonies and restrain invasive shrubs to safeguard them, but removing fallen timber could jeopardise these colonies.
items.para: Removing fallen timber could put at risk beetle colonies that rangers keep under observation and give protection to as they bring under control invasive shrubs.
items.note: 指使面临危险，并不表示已经造成损害。

items.src: Bakery working hours fluctuate weekly, while rent remains unchanged, equipment costs rise continuously and loan repayments fall steadily.
items.para: Rent payments stay the same, equipment costs increase without interruption and loan repayments decline without interruption, whereas bakery working hours rise and fall weekly.
items.note: 指上下波动，而非不变或持续单向变化。

items.src: The credit union prioritised strict observance of lending rules over interpreting, amending or policing them to reduce default risks.
items.para: To reduce default risks, the credit union gave strict compliance with lending rules priority over their interpretation, revision or enforcement.
items.note: 此处指遵守规则，而非解释、修改或执法。

items.src: Mira's praise of her failed memory was ironical rather than heartfelt, directly disapproving or intended to offer gentle reassurance.
items.para: Neither meant in earnest nor explicitly critical of herself or intended as gentle reassurance, Mira's praise of her failed memory was contrary to her real opinion.
items.note: 此处指用称赞的反话表达相反的意思。

items.src: Heated gas showed outward movement rather than movement inwards, along the walls or straight upwards.
items.para: Movement of heated gas was directed away from the centre, not directed towards the centre, parallel to the walls, or directed vertically upwards.
items.note: 指方向由中心向外，而非向内或向上。

items.src: Performers assemble for the finale, then disperse across gallery rooms while visitors remain stationary; afterwards, everyone returns to the entrance.
items.para: After performers come together for the finale, visitors stay put as performers spread out across gallery rooms, before everyone heads back to the entrance.
items.note: 指从聚集状态分散到各处。

items.src: The coach treated shorter sessions improving concentration as a premise, not a forecast, while seeking proof before reaching a final judgment.
items.para: Improved concentration through shorter sessions was the coach's assumption, not a prediction; the coach sought evidence before drawing a conclusion.
items.note: 此处指作为推理或方案基础的假定。

items.src: Clinic nurses gained autonomy in scheduling alongside greater duties, with less managerial oversight but continued teamwork with doctors.
items.para: With reduced managerial supervision but continued cooperation with doctors, clinic nurses gained independence in arranging appointments alongside greater responsibility.
items.note: 此处指自行决定预约安排的自主权。

items.src: Bridge restoration requires know-how as well as theory, and apprentices' self-assurance and intellectual inquisitiveness cannot replace either.
items.para: Neither personal confidence nor intellectual curiosity can substitute for the practical expertise and theoretical knowledge that apprentices need for bridge restoration.
items.note: 指完成实际工作的实用技能。

items.src: Digital maps will supersede printed atlases next September, rather than complement them, although teachers will revise and retain a few atlases for reference.
items.para: Teachers will update and preserve a few atlases for reference, although digital maps will replace rather than supplement printed atlases next September.
items.note: 指由新事物取代原有事物。

items.src: Election officials classified displaying posters inside polling stations as an infringement, rejecting claims of exemption, a right, or a duty.
items.para: Claims that displaying posters inside polling stations constituted an exception, an entitlement or an obligation were rejected by election officials, who considered it a violation.
items.note: 此处指违反选举规则的行为。

items.src: Shared storytelling can enrich family life without making it simpler, disturbing it, or taking it over, provided everyone gets a turn.
items.para: Provided everyone gets a turn, shared storytelling can improve family life and need not simplify, disrupt or dominate it.
items.note: 此处指使家庭生活更加美好。

items.src: Our laboratory rejected the disreputable supplier for its dishonest reputation, not because it was inexperienced, lacked money or frequently delivered late.
items.para: Our laboratory rejected the supplier as ill-regarded for dishonesty, not for being short of experience, short of funds or prone to delays.
items.note: 此处指因不诚实而名声不佳。

items.src: The novelist described the comments as vicious, distinguishing them from simple criticism, gentle sarcasm, and overt expressions of dismissal.
items.para: Distinguishing the comments from merely critical, mildly sarcastic or openly dismissive remarks, the novelist described them as deliberately cruel.
items.note: 此处指评论带有残酷伤人的恶意。

items.src: Mina continued to agonize over the overseas job instead of considering it calmly, making a swift decision, or seeking anyone's advice.
items.para: Mina continued to worry intensely about whether to accept the overseas job instead of choosing to reflect calmly, decide quickly or consult others.
items.note: 指为是否接受工作而焦虑苦恼。

items.src: Nurses described their relationships as harmonious rather than stiffly remote, competitively strained, or intimate yet unbalanced when researchers interviewed them.
items.para: Interviewed by researchers, nurses described their relationships as friendly and peaceful, not formal and distant, tense and competitive, or close but unequal.
items.note: 指人际关系友好融洽、没有冲突。

items.src: Amina chose generic detergent rather than perfumed or foreign varieties, although a branded alternative was available at a reduced price.
items.para: Although a branded alternative was discounted, Amina bought unbranded detergent instead of scented or imported varieties.
items.note: 此处指没有品牌名称的商品。

items.src: The tutor introduced aural exercises before speaking practice, while retaining activities involving sight and touch for learners who needed additional support.
items.para: Keeping visual and tactile activities for learners needing extra support, the tutor introduced auditory exercises before oral practice.
items.note: 两者都表示与听觉有关的。

items.src: The mine acquired a locomotive to pull goods wagons rather than passenger carriages, replacing the lorries previously used for coal deliveries.
items.para: Replacing delivery trucks previously used for coal, the mine acquired a railway engine to pull freight wagons rather than passenger coaches.
items.note: 指牵引列车的铁路机车。

items.src: Rangers use wooden animals in mock rescues overseen by instructors, preparing for real emergencies that occur without warning.
items.para: To prepare for unexpected, genuine emergencies, rangers practise supervised, simulated rescues with wooden animals under their instructors' oversight.
items.note: 此处指为训练而模拟的，并非真实的。

items.src: Powered lifting frames reduce physical exertion and resulting muscle tiredness for warehouse workers, without reducing their need to concentrate or their emotional strain.
items.para: Warehouse workers' mental concentration requirements and emotional stress remain unchanged, but powered lifting frames reduce bodily effort and the resulting muscular fatigue.
items.note: 指活动中付出的体力，而非疲劳的结果。

items.src: Even veteran economic forecasters who show no bias remain fallible, although they are not necessarily too certain of their own predictions.
items.para: Economic forecasters can be highly experienced and entirely impartial yet still capable of mistakes, without necessarily being overly confident about their predictions.
items.note: 指有可能犯错，不等于缺乏经验或能力。

items.src: Coaches can evaluate athletes' confidence through interviews, but recalling successes may consolidate it, whereas criticism can weaken it even when athletes outwardly seem confident.
items.para: Although athletes may display confidence, criticism can undermine it; interviews help coaches assess it, while recalling successes may strengthen it.
items.note: 此处指巩固、增强已有的信心。

items.src: Researchers believe they are on the verge of identifying an antibiotic but nowhere near testing it, despite intending to and remaining dedicated to securing approval.
items.para: Researchers believe they are close to identifying an antibiotic but far from testing it, although intent on doing so and committed to securing approval.
items.note: 表示某事即将发生，已接近实现。

items.src: The conservator judged cool storage optimal for paintings, ordinary rooms merely sufficient, damp cellars inappropriate, and direct sunlight damaging.
items.para: For paintings, the conservator considered direct sunlight harmful and damp cellars unsuitable, while ordinary rooms were merely adequate and cool storage ideal.
items.note: 指最适合某种目的，而不只是足够好。

items.src: Maya initially accepted coaching unwillingly and practised uncertainly, sometimes neglecting details, but after early defeats she resolutely followed the training plan throughout winter.
items.para: After early defeats, Maya followed her winter training plan determinedly throughout the season, having initially accepted coaching reluctantly and practised hesitantly, sometimes carelessly.
items.note: 指坚定地坚持，不因困难而放弃。

items.src: The clinic reserves a quarter of its equipment budget for upkeep, leaving the remainder for fitting new machines, replacing old ones and checking condition.
items.para: Installation, replacement and inspection share the remainder of the clinic's equipment budget after a quarter is set aside for maintenance.
items.note: 此处指使设备保持良好状态的维护保养。

items.src: The district will comprise three housing blocks and a garden; planners will expand the garden, separate it from roads and split it into sections.
items.para: Planners will expand the garden, isolate it from roads and subdivide it; the district will consist of three housing blocks and that garden.
items.note: 此处指整体包含所列的组成部分。

items.src: Seedlings without water began to droop and then perish, while watered plants regained their health and continued developing in the school greenhouse.
items.para: Watered seedlings managed to recover and continued to grow in the school greenhouse, whereas those without water started to wilt and then die.
items.note: 此处指幼苗死亡，不只是枯萎。

items.src: Officials can currently offer encouragement, use persuasion or issue reminders, but the proposed rule would let them compel factory owners to publish water-use figures.
items.para: The proposed rule would let officials force factory owners to publish water-use figures; currently they can encourage, persuade or remind them.
items.note: 此处指强制要求，而非劝说或提醒。

items.src: Bread aromas lure shoppers inside the bakery, where staff greet them warmly and provide prompt service, hoping to keep them as regular customers.
items.para: Bakery staff welcome shoppers warmly and serve them promptly, hoping to retain them as regular customers after bread aromas entice them inside.
items.note: 此处指利用面包香气吸引顾客进入。

items.src: Engineers blamed overheating on dust accumulation inside the cabinet and recommended extracting the dust rather than scattering it or pressing it together.
items.para: Recommending dust removal rather than dispersal or compression, engineers identified buildup inside the cabinet as the cause of overheating.
items.note: 此处指灰尘逐渐聚积形成的堆积。

items.src: The ancient oracle's prophecy foretold the settlement's destruction by flooding, rather than recalling an earlier disaster, explaining its causes or directing an evacuation.
items.para: Neither a recollection of an earlier disaster, an explanation of its causes nor an evacuation instruction, the ancient oracle's prediction foretold the settlement's destruction by flooding.
items.note: 此处指神谕者对未来灾难作出的预言。

items.src: Familiar patterns enabled participants to make swift puzzle decisions, although their choices were not always correct, assured or stable across repeated attempts.
items.para: Participants' puzzle choices were not always accurate, confident or consistent across repeated attempts, even though familiar patterns allowed rapid decisions.
items.note: 此处形容决策速度快，不涉及准确性。

items.src: Minimal woodland intervention is the group's doctrine, not a short-term tactic, an obligation imposed by law or a matter of individual taste.
items.para: The group's guiding principle is minimal woodland intervention, which represents neither a temporary strategy nor a legal requirement or personal preference.
items.note: 此处指团体共同遵循的指导信条。

items.src: Crew members open out the folded platform and lengthen it before they elevate it to the entrance, then bring it down after boarding.
items.para: Before boarding, crew members unfold the platform, extend it and raise it to the entrance; afterward, they lower it.
items.note: 此处指将平台向上抬高到入口处。

items.src: Scribes preferred the tranquil garden to the isolated courtyard, visually charming orchard, and roomy hall when resting after hours of copying manuscripts.
items.para: After hours of manuscript copying, scribes preferred the peaceful garden over the secluded courtyard, picturesque orchard, and spacious hall for their rest.
items.note: 两者都指环境宁静、不受纷扰。

items.src: Regular bread purchases help neighbourhood bakeries thrive rather than merely stay open, but do not necessarily make them grow larger or move premises.
items.para: Neighbourhood bakeries are helped to prosper, not merely survive, by regular bread purchases, which do not necessarily make them expand or relocate.
items.note: 两者都指生意兴旺，而非仅仅维持经营。

items.src: Researchers identified cooling as the stimulus for flowering, adequate moisture as a necessary condition, seed production as an outcome, and drought as a barrier.
items.para: Researchers classified adequate moisture as a prerequisite, cooling as the trigger for flowering, seed production as a consequence, and drought as an obstacle.
items.note: 两者都指引发开花反应的因素。

items.src: Hana's supervisor praised her deft handling of watch parts, contrasting it with her earlier hesitant movements and her colleagues' rushed or awkward techniques.
items.para: Unlike her formerly hesitant movements and colleagues' hurried or clumsy techniques, Hana's skilful handling of watch parts earned praise from her supervisor.
items.note: 两者都指操作熟练、动作灵巧。

items.src: Bakery partners considered profit sharing touchy, equipment repairs pressing, tax calculations complex, and stock checks ordinary, so they discussed earnings privately.
items.para: Bakery partners discussed earnings privately because profit sharing was sensitive; they regarded equipment repairs as urgent, tax calculations as complicated, and stock checks as routine.
items.note: 两者都指话题容易引起不快或冒犯。

items.src: My grandmother's cabinet impressed me with its fine workmanship rather than its unusual design, resistance to wear, or documented genuineness.
items.para: What impressed me about my grandmother's cabinet was its fine craftsmanship, not its unusual design, durability, or documented authenticity.
items.note: 两者都指物品制作中体现的工艺水平。

items.src: Repeated telescope failures made the survey's prospects decidedly bleak; earlier forecasts had been positive, its funding remained unsettled, and its workload was still controllable.
items.para: Earlier forecasts were favourable, funding remained uncertain, and the workload was still manageable, but repeated telescope failures made the survey's prospects decidedly unpromising.
items.note: 两者都指前景暗淡、缺乏希望。

items.src: Six hours of rehearsal left the violinists weary rather than anxious, uninterested, or needing food, so they asked the conductor to postpone recording.
items.para: The violinists asked the conductor to postpone recording because six hours of rehearsal had left them tired, not nervous, bored, or hungry.
items.note: 两者都指长时间活动后感到疲倦。

items.src: Before racing began, a fresh mantle of snow concealed the course's hardened icy surface, a nearby heap, and a shallow depression.
items.para: The course's icy crust, a nearby mound, and a shallow hollow disappeared beneath a fresh covering of snow before racing began.
items.note: 两者都指铺在表面的一层覆盖物。

items.src: Elders carried ceremonial bowls through the village, leaving vessels intended for display, household use, or sale inside the meeting house.
items.para: Decorative, domestic, and commercial vessels stayed inside the meeting house while elders carried ritual bowls through the village.
items.note: 两者都表示用于正式礼仪活动的。

items.src: A charity will administer the rooftop gardens and provide their funding, while council staff check their condition and residents keep them in good repair.
items.para: Council staff will inspect the rooftop gardens and residents will maintain them, while a charity will finance and manage them.
items.note: 此处指负责管理，而非出资、检查或维护。

items.src: Pupils distinguished combustion from the melting and vaporisation of candle wax, then watched the liquid wax lose heat after extinguishing the flame.
items.para: After distinguishing burning from wax melting and evaporation, pupils extinguished the candle flame and observed the cooling of the liquid wax.
items.note: 指燃烧过程，不是熔化、蒸发或冷却。

items.src: After a nameless donor funded the bakery's winter operations, staff recognised her accent and thought she avoided attention rather than kept secrets.
items.para: The anonymous donor's accent was recognisable to bakery staff, who considered her publicity-shy rather than secretive after she funded their winter operations.
items.note: 此处指捐赠者未透露身份。

items.src: The burst pipe caused a catastrophe, destroying our kitchen rather than merely disrupting routines or delaying repairs, and required immediate action.
items.para: Requiring immediate action, the burst pipe created an emergency and a disaster that destroyed our kitchen, not merely an inconvenience or a setback.
items.note: 指造成严重破坏的灾祸，强调损失程度。

items.src: Although the faded handwriting remained indistinct when magnified, the scanner's software made it legible by increasing the contrast between ink and paper.
items.para: By boosting ink–paper contrast, the scanning program made faint handwriting readable, although it had remained blurred even when enlarged.
items.note: 指字迹可辨认，不单指放大或颜色变化。

items.src: The gracious novelist reassured an impatient, defensive presenter while a calm, confident producer guided a distant, formal assistant through the interview.
items.para: A calm and confident producer guided a distant and formal assistant through the interview while the kind and polite novelist reassured the impatient and defensive presenter.
items.note: 此处指待人亲切且有礼貌。

items.src: Karim spent nearly ten years as a seaman on cargo ships, unlike relatives who unloaded vessels, built ships or caught fish professionally.
items.para: Unlike his relatives, a dockworker, a shipbuilder and a fisherman, Karim worked aboard cargo vessels as a sailor for almost a decade.
items.note: 指在船上工作的水手，此处服务于货船。

items.src: Volunteers found pulling deeply rooted wetland plants arduous and monotonous, although the work involved neither danger nor complicated procedures.
items.para: Neither dangerous nor complicated, removing deeply rooted wetland plants was nevertheless physically demanding and repetitive for the volunteers.
items.note: 此处指拔除植物需要付出大量体力。

items.src: Designers intentionally sheltered a deck designed expressly for birdwatchers, though not solely for them; its roof unintentionally shaded the crew.
items.para: Designed specifically but not exclusively for birdwatchers, the deck was deliberately sheltered by designers, while its roof shaded the crew incidentally.
items.note: 此处指专为某一特定目的。

items.src: Without occupant records, the historian classified the fortress's royal-prisoner claim as supposition rather than established truth, a research finding, or a witness's account.
items.para: The historian considered the fortress's royal-prisoner claim an assumption, not a fact, discovery or testimony, because records identifying its occupants were unavailable.
items.note: 指缺乏充分证据的假定，并非已证实的事实。

items.src: Researchers differentiate between unpaid carers and paid workers before comparing these groups, counting their members and sorting individuals by task.
items.para: Before they compare groups, count members and classify individuals by task, researchers distinguish between unpaid carers and paid workers.
items.note: 两者均指辨别并区分不同群体。

items.src: Cool air makes these lizards sluggish but neither paralysed nor unbalanced, whereas warmer conditions restore their rapid responses.
items.para: These lizards become quick to react in warmth; cool air leaves them slow to move, not unable to move, and still steady on their feet.
items.note: 此处均指低温下行动迟缓。

items.src: Shared training made the workshop team homogeneous, but its members still needed greater expertise, stronger unity and more flexibility.
items.para: Although the workshop team needed to become more skilled, cohesive and adaptable, its shared training made it uniform in background.
items.note: 此处均指团队成员的培训背景一致。

items.src: Despite potential profits, the economist questioned the morality of raising water prices during shortages after confirming the policy was lawful and workable.
items.para: Having confirmed its legality and practicality, the economist questioned the ethics of raising water prices during shortages despite the policy's potential profitability.
items.note: 此处均指行为是否合乎道德。

items.src: A provisional recommendation sparked fierce debate, but the choir eventually reached a consensus on the programme rather than accepting one member's personal view.
items.para: The choir's general agreement on the programme emerged from heated disagreement over a tentative suggestion, not from simply accepting an individual opinion.
items.note: 两者均指群体形成普遍一致的意见。

items.src: The chemist found the initially faint, readily recognisable smell hideous as the experiment progressed, although it remained only mildly irritating.
items.para: The smell remained only slightly irritating, but the chemist found it extremely unpleasant as experimentation continued, despite its initially barely noticeable, easily recognisable character.
items.note: 形容气味时，均指极其令人不快。

items.src: After the design stage, erection of the steel frame took three weeks, followed by safety checks before repairs to the old sculpture began.
items.para: Following planning, construction of the steel frame lasted three weeks; inspection then preceded restoration of the old sculpture.
items.note: 此处均指将框架搭建起来的过程。

items.src: Fans renewed memberships to maintain allegiance to the club despite fading excitement, less respect for its achievements and lost confidence in its manager.
items.para: Despite fading enthusiasm, diminished admiration for its achievements and lost trust in its manager, supporters maintained loyalty to the club by renewing memberships.
items.note: 两者均指对团体持续的忠诚。

items.src: Recovering patients often reported fatigue after housework, even after their lingering lightheadedness, aching muscles and trouble breathing had disappeared.
items.para: Although persistent dizziness, muscle pain and breathing difficulties had disappeared, recovering patients often reported extreme tiredness after doing housework.
items.note: 此处均指做家务后明显疲惫。

items.src: Residents considered the mushroom-shaped library outlandish despite its reasonable cost and useful layout, preferring a design closer to traditional styles.
items.para: Although residents found the mushroom-shaped library affordable and practical, they called it bizarre and preferred a more conventional design.
items.note: 此处均指建筑造型稀奇古怪。

items.src: Unlike the ornamental cover and advertising inserts, the workbook's explanatory diagrams clarify angle rules, while its specialist appendix addresses advanced mathematical notation.
items.para: Angle rules become clearer through the workbook's clarifying diagrams; its decorative cover and promotional inserts contrast with a technical appendix covering advanced mathematical notation.
items.note: 此处都指起说明作用、帮助理解的。

items.src: Coastal law consultations will commence in September after the scientific report appears, pause in October, restart in November, and finish in December.
items.para: Following publication of the scientific report, coastal law discussions will begin in September, pause in October, resume in November, and end in December.
items.note: 都指活动开始，而非暂停、恢复或结束。

items.src: Ravi used a missing recipe as a pretext to visit his neighbour for company, despite neither being asked nor being duty-bound to visit.
items.para: Company was Ravi's motive for visiting his neighbour; a missing recipe supplied an excuse, although he had neither an invitation nor an obligation to visit.
items.note: 此处指用来掩盖真实目的的借口。

items.src: Our laboratory's pioneering crack detector introduced new technology, but making it dependable, easy to carry, and inexpensive required another year of development.
items.para: Another year of development made our laboratory's groundbreaking crack detector reliable, portable, and affordable after it had introduced new technology.
items.note: 都指开创新技术、具有突破性的。

items.src: Digitising the archive began as a suggestion, became a contractual duty, and proved a substantial undertaking whose completion was the team's proudest accomplishment.
items.para: The team's proudest achievement was completing the substantial archive digitisation project, which had developed from a proposal into a contractual obligation.
items.note: 此处指需要投入精力完成的重大项目。

items.src: Workshop participants learn to recognise and assess initial impressions, then neutralize their influence with contradictory evidence rather than strengthen it through selective reading.
items.para: Participants learn to identify and assess initial impressions, then use contradictory evidence to cancel out their influence instead of selective reading to reinforce it.
items.note: 此处指抵消影响，使其不再起作用。

items.src: Restoring mangroves was the islanders' aspiration, not something they anticipated or were required to do, while they worried that further storms would destroy seedlings.
items.para: Despite their fear of further storms destroying seedlings, the islanders' ambition was mangrove restoration, though this was neither an expectation nor an obligation.
items.note: 都指渴望实现的愿望或志向。

items.src: Mina's conception of the unfamiliar route combined photographs with recollections of earlier rides, shaping her forecast of riding time and liking for flatter alternatives.
items.para: Photographs and memory of earlier rides shaped Mina's mental picture of the unfamiliar route, informing her riding-time prediction and preference for flatter alternatives.
items.note: 此处指头脑中对某事物形成的认识。

items.src: Although some scribes accepted assignments unwillingly, copied hastily, or worked without thinking, the librarian conscientiously checked every manuscript against its source.
items.para: Every manuscript was diligently checked against its source by the librarian, although some scribes accepted assignments reluctantly, copied hurriedly, or worked mechanically.
items.note: 此处都指认真负责、尽心细致地。

items.src: The association's governing committee approved the festival, but a faction opposed it, while ordinary members remained undecided and external witnesses merely watched the debate.
items.para: Festival approval came from the association's executive committee; a dissenting group opposed it, ordinary members remained undecided, and outside observers simply watched the debate.
items.note: 此处指组织内部持反对意见的派别。

items.src: The survey contrasted aboriginal communities with foreign-born settlers, noting that seasonally wandering families in both groups avoided city settlements.
items.para: Indigenous communities and immigrant settlers were compared in the survey, which found that nomadic families from both groups avoided urban settlements during seasonal travels.
items.note: 此处指当地原住民的，而非后来迁入的。

items.src: Bakery owners can offset higher wages through energy savings, but cutting staff lowers costs, expansion raises them, and deferred repairs delay spending.
items.para: Energy savings can counterbalance higher bakery wages; staff cuts reduce costs, expansions increase them, and deferred repairs postpone spending.
items.note: 指用节省的开支抵消增加的费用。

items.src: The island's arable land bordered livestock pastures, while sites designated for residential development lay beside woodland set aside for animal conservation.
items.para: Land suitable for growing crops bordered pastures available for grazing livestock, while plots reserved for new housing adjoined woodland protected for wildlife.
items.note: 指适合耕种农作物的土地。

items.src: The quarrelling musicians accepted a truce for rehearsals, not a lasting resolution, and rejected both an official apology and further conflict.
items.para: For rehearsals, the quarrelling musicians accepted a temporary ceasefire rather than a permanent settlement, rejecting both a formal apology and renewed confrontation.
items.note: 此处比喻双方约定暂时停止争吵。

items.src: Astronomers became exuberant rather than anxious after detecting a planet; technicians stayed composed and detached, while unsuccessful rivals felt weary and disappointed.
