items.para: Neither a replacement, a replica nor a prototype of their filter, the wetland was considered its natural equivalent by engineers.
items.note: 指功能相似的对应物，并非替代品。

items.src: The distracted pianist played mechanically rather than expressively yesterday, then practised slowly before performing with increasing assurance.
items.para: Yesterday's distracted pianist played without conscious thought, not with real feeling, then practised at reduced speed before performing with increasing confidence.
items.note: 指未加思考、下意识地演奏。

items.src: Despite initially concentrating better, the cyclist experienced uneven attention and then a brief lapse in concentration, missing the turn before his focus returned.
items.para: Following initial improvement and subsequent fluctuation in concentration, the cyclist missed the turn through a brief failure of attention before its recovery.
items.note: 此处指注意力短暂失效。

items.src: Researchers established the utility of illustrated medicine labels for poor readers, but did not assess their visual appeal, resistance to wear, or design originality.
items.para: Although attractiveness, durability and originality remained unassessed, researchers confirmed the usefulness of picture-based medicine labels for people with limited reading skills.
items.note: 指实际用途或实用价值。

items.src: Gardeners recorded premature flowering in apples, late flowering in pears, and short flowering in cherries, while plum flowering lasted unusually long.
items.para: Gardeners found cherry flowering brief and plum flowering prolonged, whereas apple flowering was unseasonably early and pear flowering delayed.
items.note: 此处指开花时间早于正常季节。

items.src: Our geology class will examine a cavern on Thursday after passing a narrow crack in rock, a shallow ground depression and a deep ravine.
items.para: Thursday's geology class will pass a narrow rock fissure, a shallow surface hollow and a deep open gorge before examining a large natural cave.
items.note: 指大型天然洞穴。

items.src: Builders installed a wooden partition between interview spaces after widening the entrance opening, repairing the overhead surface and levelling the surface underfoot.
items.para: After widening the doorway, repairing the ceiling and levelling the floor, builders separated the interview spaces with a wooden divider.
items.note: 此处指分隔室内空间的隔板。

items.src: Engineers found the current mixer quieter than its predecessor, but postponed testing a competing mixer and a planned later design.
items.para: Testing of a rival product and future design was postponed, but engineers found the current version quieter than the previous model.
items.note: 此处指当前产品的上一代型号。

items.src: Saltwater can corrode metal connectors, whereas tools can leave scratches on their surfaces, make them shiny, or force them out of shape.
items.para: Tools can scratch, polish, or bend metal connectors, whereas seawater can chemically wear away the metal.
items.note: 此处指通过化学作用逐渐侵蚀金属。

items.src: The producer's contentment became worry as equipment faltered, then dismay when the recording vanished, and finally reassurance when technicians recovered it.
items.para: Technicians' recovery of the recording brought relief after its loss caused shock and disappointment; equipment trouble had earlier turned the producer's satisfaction into anxiety.
items.note: 指意外损失带来的惊愕与沮丧。

items.src: Leila would examine each argument, rearrange its structure, and compress it without losing key points, rather than add further detail.
items.para: Before she would condense each argument without losing key points, Leila would analyse and reorganise it, rather than expand it.
items.note: 指保留要点并精简论述。

items.src: Researchers record oxygen declines and ascribe them to fertiliser runoff, while forecasting further losses and challenging explanations based on warmer water.
items.para: Researchers predict further oxygen losses and dispute warming explanations; they document existing declines and attribute them to fertiliser runoff.
items.note: 指把氧含量下降归因于肥料径流。

items.src: Amara's brief bout of nausea was her only symptom, and she recovered before the village doctor could identify the illness.
items.para: Before the village doctor could make a diagnosis, Amara completed her recovery from a short episode of nausea, her sole symptom.
items.note: 此处指恶心的一次短暂发作。

items.src: Pottery production suffered decline and then stagnation, but renewed coastal trade brought a renaissance rather than the complete collapse merchants feared.
items.para: Renewed coastal trade brought pottery production a revival after decline and stagnation, averting the complete collapse that merchants had feared.
items.note: 指陶器生产衰落后的重新兴盛。

items.src: Ceremonial leadership is hereditary on this island, while council seats are elected, clerical posts require competitive examinations, and festival roles are assigned by lottery.
items.para: Island council seats are filled by election, clerical posts awarded through competitive examinations, festival roles allocated by random draw; ceremonial leadership is passed down through families.
items.note: 此处指礼仪领袖职位在家族内世袭。

items.src: The historian called industrialisation a new epoch, defining it by social transformation rather than a season, a ten-year span, or a hundred-year span.
items.para: For the historian, industrialisation marked a new era defined by social transformation, not a season, decade, or century.
items.note: 指以重大社会变化为特征的时代。

items.src: The supervisor considered the employee sly rather than merely eager for success, careless about risks, or unsophisticated after discovering his secret bonus fraud.
items.para: Discovering the employee's secret bonus fraud convinced the supervisor that he was cunning, not simply ambitious, reckless, or naive.
items.note: 指为谋利而暗中算计、耍手段的狡猾。

items.src: Training investment reversed regional deterioration, enabling the region's ascent as a manufacturing centre instead of continued inactivity or the breakdown economists feared.
items.para: Training investment reversed the region's decline, enabling its rise as a manufacturing centre rather than continued stagnation or the collapse economists feared.
items.note: 此处指地区作为制造业中心的地位崛起。

items.src: Mira remained youthful in spirit and socially assured, whereas her sister was composed under stress but wary of change.
items.para: Unlike her sister, who was calm under pressure but cautious about change, Mira remained young at heart and confident in company.
items.note: 此处指心态年轻，而非实际年龄小。

items.src: Scientists from twelve countries form the marine station's cosmopolitan staff, studying coral growth alongside countrywide research groups, area-based monitoring teams and village volunteers.
items.para: Coral growth is studied by the marine station's international staff from twelve countries alongside nationwide research groups, regional monitoring teams and local village volunteers.
items.note: 此处指科研人员来自多个国家。

items.src: The musicians quicken the rhythm as the dancers advance, then reduce its pace and volume before playing the final phrase again.
items.para: As the dancers move forward, the players speed up the rhythm, then slow down and soften it before they repeat the final phrase.
items.note: 此处指加快节奏，而非改变音量。

items.src: Amina hoped for pool access but could not secure it; she rejected cancelling training and contrived to maintain fitness through land exercises.
items.para: Amina hoped to obtain pool access but failed to secure it; she refused to cancel training and managed to maintain fitness through land exercises.
items.note: 指虽有困难，仍设法成功做到。

items.src: Beside my daily goal, weekly sum and monthly mean, the wrist monitor displays an approximation of calories burned on this run.
items.para: For this run, the wrist device shows an estimate of calories burned alongside my daily target, weekly total and monthly average.
items.note: 指接近实际值但不精确的估计值。

items.src: Previously, traders opposed pedestrianisation while cafés prepared; the square eventually closed to traffic in June, and thereafter cafés reported steadily rising afternoon trade.
items.para: Traders had previously opposed pedestrianisation; meanwhile, cafés prepared, and traffic was eventually banned from the square in June; subsequently, cafés reported steadily increasing afternoon business.
items.note: 指前述事件发生之后，即此后。

items.src: Students compared water from the estuary with samples from a spring in the mountains, a lake inland and the sea beyond the coast.
items.para: Samples from a mountain spring, an inland lake and the open sea were compared by students with water from the tidal river mouth.
items.note: 指受潮汐影响、海水与河水交汇的河口。

items.src: The consultation booklet explains its purpose in the preface, summarises recommendations at the end, supplies tables in an appendix and includes an alphabetical topic guide.
items.para: Besides a conclusion summarising recommendations, an appendix containing tables and an index listing topics alphabetically, the consultation booklet has an introduction explaining its purpose.
items.note: 此处指说明册子编写目的的前言。

items.src: Ravi returned the kettle because its defective switch prevented automatic shutoff, although the casing was undamaged, unlike the worn handle and loose lid.
items.para: Despite its intact casing, Ravi returned the kettle with its worn handle and loose lid because a faulty switch prevented automatic shutoff.
items.note: 指部件有故障，无法正常工作。

items.src: New imaging software helped archivists decipher faded entries in shipping records before transcribing them, voicing them for colleagues and storing the documents.
items.para: Before archivists could copy down entries, read aloud for colleagues and file away shipping records, new imaging software helped them make out the faded writing.
items.note: 此处指辨认出模糊难读的字迹。

items.src: Unlike the speculative introduction, the authoritative account of coral bleaching draws on expert research while remaining thorough and easy to understand.
items.para: Expert research makes the coral bleaching account reliable, detailed and accessible, whereas its introduction is speculative.
items.note: 此处指有专业依据、值得信赖的。

items.src: Mina was reticent about her reasoning but keen to describe the puzzle, willing to hear suggestions, and hesitant to accept them.
items.para: Though eager to explain the puzzle and ready to listen to suggestions, Mina was reluctant to agree and unwilling to speak about her reasoning.
items.note: 指不愿谈论，此处是不愿透露推理过程。

items.src: Female turtles abandon their offspring after laying eggs, returning to waters where their partners and competitors remain rather than providing parental care.
items.para: Instead of caring for their young, turtle mothers leave after laying eggs and return to waters occupied by their mates and rivals.
items.note: 指动物的后代，此处为海龟的幼崽。

items.src: Despite understanding the travellers' worries and frustration with delays, the guide showed firmness by refusing to cross the flooded valley.
items.para: The guide's resolve in refusing the flooded valley crossing coexisted with sympathy for the travellers' anxiety and impatience over delays.
items.note: 此处指坚持决定、不肯动摇的坚定。

items.src: Officials hoped to avert protests, but historians argue the tax helped provoke them, forcing officials to track demonstrations and attempt to quell them.
items.para: Historians argue the tax helped trigger protests officials hoped to prevent, forcing them to monitor demonstrations and try to suppress them.
items.note: 此处指引发抗议，使其发生。

items.src: Organisers hoped to ease volunteers' worries, but repeated schedule changes began to exasperate them, not merely bewilder them or let them down.
items.para: Although organisers hoped to reassure volunteers, repeated timetable alterations began to intensely annoy them rather than merely confuse or disappoint them.
items.note: 指使人极为恼怒或不耐烦。

items.src: The wetland's official designation as a sanctuary replaced its informal name, while its published profile and position on the conservation list remained unchanged.
items.para: Although its published description and conservation ranking stayed unchanged, the wetland received the official title of sanctuary, replacing its nickname.
items.note: 此处指正式授予的称号。

items.src: Workers must clear vegetation blocking the hillside pipe before repairs, but can leave the unstable earth, dislodged stones and construction waste nearby.
items.para: Before repairing the hillside pipe, workers must remove obstructing plant life but may leave nearby loose soil, fallen rocks and building debris.
items.note: 指某处生长的植物的总称。

items.src: The drama's wardrobe team will clothe every actor in medieval replicas, while other crews provide meals, arrange travel and supply lodging.
items.para: Other crews will feed, transport and accommodate every actor in the drama, while the wardrobe team will dress them in medieval replicas.
items.note: 此处指给演员穿上衣物。

items.src: Researchers predicted substantial, enduring benefits, but listeners reported only a marginal, immediate mood improvement after ten minutes of cheerful music.
items.para: After ten minutes of cheerful music, listeners reported only a slight but immediate mood improvement, contrary to researchers' predictions of substantial, lasting benefits.
items.note: 此处表示改善幅度很小。

items.src: Researchers found that intellect mattered more for solving new puzzles than remembering facts, having previous practice, or being eager to succeed.
items.para: Success with unfamiliar puzzles depended more on intelligence than on memory, experience, or motivation, the researchers found.
items.note: 此处两者都指理解和推理的智力。

items.src: The violinist expected enjoyment from auditioning, considered preparation an everyday task, and dismissed waiting as a slight inconvenience before the wait became an ordeal.
items.para: Expecting auditioning to be a pleasant experience, the violinist considered preparation a routine task and waiting a minor inconvenience; waiting became a harrowing experience.
items.note: 两者都指令人痛苦、难以熬过的经历。

items.src: The coach called timing errors surface problems and fatigue less important, identifying distrust as the underlying problem requiring urgent attention.
items.para: Distrust was the team's fundamental problem needing immediate attention, the coach explained, while timing errors were superficial and fatigue secondary.
items.note: 此处两者都表示问题是根本性的。

items.src: Engineers found deformation after bending the panel, colour changes after sunlight exposure, cracks after impact, and reduced hardness after heating.
items.para: Sunlight caused discoloration, impact caused cracking, and heat caused softening, while bending produced distortion of the panel, the engineers found.
items.note: 两者都指原有形状发生改变或扭曲。

items.src: Square maintenance falls within the conservation team's domain; architectural history attracts their curiosity and forms their research specialism, while masonry restoration requires their expertise.
items.para: Architectural history is the team's area of interest and field of study; masonry restoration requires specialist knowledge, while square maintenance is their responsibility.
items.note: 此处指团队负责的事务范围。

items.src: Pupils watched coloured water advance directly, ascend to the surface, descend to the bottom, and finally swirl inside a transparent bowl.
items.para: Inside a clear bowl, pupils saw tinted water flow straight ahead, rise towards the surface, sink towards the bottom, and finally move in circles.
items.note: 此处都指液体围绕中心打旋。

items.src: Councillors used surveys to elicit residents' opinions before recording them, summarising their content, and forwarding them to the planning team.
items.para: Before proceeding to write down, sum up, and pass on residents' opinions to the planning team, councillors used surveys to draw out those views.
items.note: 两者都指设法引出他人的意见。

items.src: My woollen hat emerged from the hot wash as a shapeless mass, not merely squashed, elongated, or marked with folds.
items.para: Rather than merely flattened, stretched, or creased, my woollen hat was a formless lump after being washed in hot water.
items.note: 两者都指没有清晰、确定的外形。

items.src: Sensors must conform to corrosion standards before installation; although manufacturers may cite these requirements or challenge them, their products cannot deviate from them.
items.para: Manufacturers may refer to corrosion standards or object to them, but sensors must comply with these requirements before installation and cannot depart from them.
items.note: 此处两者都指符合并遵守标准。

items.src: Following the music programme's launch, evening audiences grew appreciably, morning audiences rose a little, afternoon audiences increased consistently, and weekend audiences expanded briefly.
items.para: Following the music programme's launch, audiences grew slightly in mornings, steadily in afternoons, and temporarily on weekends, but noticeably in evenings.
items.note: 两者都表示变化达到明显可察觉的程度。

items.src: Researchers compared motion by letting a pendant dangle, rest horizontally, stand vertically, or roll without obstruction, filming each condition.
items.para: To compare motion, researchers filmed each condition as they let a pendant lie flat, stand upright, roll freely, or hang loosely.
items.note: 指从支点松松地悬垂。

items.src: Following yesterday's escape, rescuers plan to find the mink, recapture them, inspect them, and free them inside a secure enclosure.
items.para: The mink that escaped yesterday are animals rescuers plan to locate and catch again, then examine and release inside a secure enclosure.
items.note: 指再次捕获已经逃脱的动物。

items.src: Hostel guests receive maps gratis, buy discounted snacks and meals without discounts, and can borrow bicycles with payment deferred.
items.para: Hostel guests can borrow bicycles on credit and buy snacks at reduced prices and meals at full price, but receive maps free of charge.
items.note: 指无需支付任何费用，而非打折或赊账。

items.src: The historian attributed the pottery industry's slowdown, increased expenses, and poorer standards to scarce kiln fuel, but found no evidence that production stopped.
items.para: The historian linked pottery's reduction in pace, rise in costs, and drop in quality to scarce fuel, finding no evidence of a halt in production.
items.note: 指生产速度放缓，并非完全停产。

items.src: Volunteers gather and classify donated books before they despatch them every Friday to isolated villages, keeping any surplus in storage.
items.para: Every Friday, volunteers send donated books to isolated villages after they collect and sort them, while they store any surplus.
items.note: 此处指把物品发送到目的地。

items.src: The island's restrictive visitor rules are short-lived and disliked, but not useless, allowing only one walking route while seabirds breed.
items.para: While seabirds breed, visitors have only one walking route under the island's limiting rules, which are temporary and unpopular but not ineffective.
items.note: 指限制活动自由或选择范围的。

items.src: Before each shift, technicians wash and check the cutter's moving parts, lubricate them using oil, and exchange any damaged components for new ones.
items.para: Technicians replace damaged components before each shift, but first clean and inspect the cutter's moving parts and oil them.
items.note: 此处指给活动部件加油以减少摩擦。

items.src: A shipping magnate financed the terminal after its supervisor presented the proposal, an investor endorsed it, and an intermediary arranged the deal.
items.para: After the terminal's manager presented its proposal, an investor endorsed it and a broker arranged the deal; a shipping tycoon then provided funding.
items.note: 指富有且在商界有影响力的大亨。

items.src: Counsellors report that emotional benefits accrue as grief eases, although attendance eventually stabilizes and members' moods continue to vary.
items.para: Counsellors report that attendance eventually starts to level off and moods still fluctuate, while emotional benefits build up as feelings of grief fade away.
items.note: 指好处随时间逐渐积累。

items.src: Our experiment used intense heat to eradicate harmful bacteria from milk without preservatives, rather than merely identify them, reduce their numbers, or prevent spread.
items.para: To completely eliminate harmful bacteria from milk without preservatives, we used intense heat experimentally, not merely to detect, reduce, or contain them.
items.note: 指彻底清除，而非仅减少数量或控制扩散。

items.src: Infrared images let historians discern hidden sketches in the portrait, but not copy them, explain their meaning, or repair them.
items.para: Historians cannot reproduce, interpret, or restore the portrait's concealed drawings using infrared photographs alone, although these images let them detect them.
items.note: 此处指发现或看出难以察觉的图像。

items.src: Organisers established the annual race to commemorate their deceased founder, not to fund current athletes, publicly applaud sponsors, or formally thank volunteers.
items.para: Established to honour the memory of its deceased founder, the annual race was not intended to financially support current athletes, publicly praise sponsors, or formally thank volunteers.
items.note: 指纪念逝者，表达对其的敬意。

items.src: The earthquake devastated the hospital, but merely jolted the school briefly, cut off the clinic temporarily, and caused minor damage to the library.
items.para: Although it briefly shook the school, temporarily isolated the clinic, and slightly damaged the library, the earthquake severely damaged the hospital.
items.note: 指造成严重破坏，而非轻微损伤。

items.src: Shopkeepers expected interest to increase, then settle, but parking charges made enthusiasm wane, leaving them hoping it would revive.
items.para: Shopkeepers expected interest to grow and then stabilise; instead, parking fees caused enthusiasm to decline, leaving them hoping it would recover.
items.note: 指兴趣逐渐减弱或下降。

items.src: Free childcare is an inducement for parents to enrol, rather than something compulsory, a prize for achievement, or repayment for lost earnings.
items.para: Parents receive free childcare as an incentive to enrol, not as a requirement, a reward for achievement, or compensation for lost earnings.
items.note: 指为鼓励参与而提供的激励。

items.src: The report explains the finance committee's standpoint on renovation without forecasting its decision, identifying its preferred option, or offering advice.
items.para: Without a prediction of the finance committee's decision, identification of its preference, or any recommendation, the report explains its perspective on renovation.
items.note: 指看待或考虑问题的角度与立场。

items.src: Hot washing can have adverse rather than helpful effects on wool, even when the changes are short-lived and can be undone.
items.para: Even when changes are temporary and reversible, washing wool in hot water can have harmful rather than beneficial effects.
items.note: 指产生有害或不利的影响。

items.src: The technician keeps spare cables orderly, although the storage area is difficult to reach, poorly protected against theft, and covered in dust.
items.para: Spare cables remain organised thanks to the technician, even though their dusty storage area is hardly accessible, insufficiently secure against theft, and far from clean.
items.note: 指物品排列有条理，而非杂乱无章。

items.src: The historian's tone remained cordial, although she spoke without ceremony or excitement and firmly refused to consider the presenter's views.
items.para: Neither formal nor enthusiastic, the historian maintained a friendly tone but was not receptive to the presenter's views, firmly refusing to consider them.
items.note: 指语气友好，不代表赞同对方观点。

items.src: Interruptions can degrade reasoning quality during complex planning, whereas structured breaks may enhance it and checklists can maintain or evaluate it.
items.para: Structured breaks may improve reasoning quality during complex planning, and checklists can preserve or assess it, whereas interruptions can impair it.
items.note: 指损害推理质量，使其下降。

items.src: Volunteers must let cables down, attach them to abandoned nets, and hoist the nets aboard before pulling them across the deck and fastening them.
items.para: Volunteers must lower cables, attach them to abandoned nets, then lift the nets aboard, drag them across the deck and secure them.
items.note: 此处指用吊索将渔网吊起。

items.src: Visitors enter the palace through an asymmetric gateway whose rounded top and elaborate decoration contrast with its narrow overall shape.
items.para: An ornate, round-topped gateway admits visitors to the palace; its elaborate appearance contrasts with its narrow shape, which is also lopsided.
items.note: 此处指门楼两侧不等，形状不对称。

items.src: Guild rules made workshop ownership permissible for widows but required registration, recommended training, and banned employing children under ten.
items.para: For widows, registration was compulsory and training advisable under guild rules; workshop ownership was allowed, but employing children under ten was forbidden.
items.note: 指规章允许，并非强制要求或建议。

items.src: Residents hope to revive the discontinued street festival that brings them together, not reduce its scale, delay its return, or substitute a concert.
items.para: Bringing residents together, the discontinued street festival is an event they hope to bring back, not scale down, put off, or replace with a concert.
items.note: 指恢复已经停办的活动。

items.src: Gardeners lightly dampen seed trays but drench mature plants, then wash loose soil from the benches and remove water from the containers.
items.para: After gardeners moisten seed trays and soak mature plants, they rinse loose soil from the benches and drain the containers.
items.note: 指使植物湿透，程度强于稍微润湿。

items.src: Observatory staff collect keys for their living quarters before receiving access to administrative rooms, experimental facilities and spaces used for storing supplies.
items.para: Before gaining access to offices, laboratories and storerooms, observatory staff collect the keys to their accommodation.
items.note: 指供工作人员居住的住所。

items.src: The analyst alluded to a recession, described inflation directly, rejected bankruptcy fears emphatically and forecast recovery with confidence in her annual report.
items.para: Her annual report explicitly described inflation, firmly dismissed bankruptcy fears and confidently predicted recovery, while the analyst indirectly mentioned a recession.
items.note: 指间接提及，而非明确说出。

items.src: After debating possible outings and seeking members' advice, the club chose a secret ballot rather than random selection to make its decision.
items.para: Following discussion and consultation, the club selected a secret vote rather than a draw as its method for choosing outings.
items.note: 指通过投票作出集体决定。

items.src: Following relocation, laboratory records were in disarray; some lacked entries, others contained obsolete information, and several had handwriting nobody could read.
items.para: Some laboratory records were incomplete, others outdated and several illegible; following relocation, the collection as a whole was disorganised.
items.note: 指记录整体杂乱无序，而非缺失或过时。

items.src: Visitors gave the sculpture a lukewarm reception, remaining openly opposed to the abstract paintings but admiring the landscapes and feeling unsure about the portraits.
items.para: Although hostile to the abstract paintings, appreciative of the landscapes and uncertain about the portraits, visitors remained unenthusiastic about the sculpture.
items.note: 此处指反应冷淡、缺乏热情，并非敌对或拿不准。

items.src: The captain arrogantly rejected a junior's challenge, although the junior asked courteously, the coach intervened uncertainly, and spectators protested with anger.
items.para: Spectators protested angrily as the captain haughtily rejected the junior's challenge, despite the junior asking politely and the coach intervening hesitantly.
items.note: 两者都表示以自高自大的傲慢态度行事。

items.src: The pharmacist compressed powder into a tiny pellet rather than filling a capsule, then dissolved it slowly to produce a solution.
items.para: Instead of filling a capsule, the pharmacist made a tiny granule by compressing powder, then slowly dissolved it to obtain a solution.
items.note: 此处两者都指压制而成的小颗粒。

items.src: Rooftop gardeners may dispute weight limits, request information, or campaign for changes, but must adhere to these restrictions while they remain in force.
items.para: While weight restrictions remain effective, rooftop gardeners must comply with them, although they may argue against them, ask about them, or campaign for changes.
items.note: 两者在此都表示遵守现行限制。

items.src: Tomorrow our geology class will compare the stony slope behind college with the sand-covered bank, mud-covered path, and grass-covered field nearby.
items.para: Our geology class will tomorrow compare the nearby sandy bank, muddy path, and grassy field with the rocky slope behind college.
items.note: 两者修饰地面时都表示多石的。

items.src: A network failure could paralyze the licensing service, not merely delay or briefly disrupt it, without necessarily causing permanent damage.
items.para: Without necessarily doing anything to permanently damage the licensing service, a network failure could completely disable it rather than merely slow down or temporarily disrupt it.
items.note: 此处指使服务完全停止运作，而非仅受干扰。

items.src: The buyer rejected the bulky vacuum, preferring a compact portable model over either a slender streamlined one or a lightweight folding version.
items.para: Rejecting the large and unwieldy vacuum, the buyer chose a small and portable model over the slim and streamlined or light and foldable alternatives.
items.note: 此处指体积大且不便搬动。

items.src: The fashion show's glamour attracted visitors to the illuminated fabrics, while their advanced engineering and utility convinced investors of their market prospects.
items.para: Investors saw commercial potential in the illuminated fabrics' technical sophistication and practical usefulness, while the fashion show's dazzling appeal attracted visitors to those textiles.
items.note: 此处指时装秀令人向往的耀眼魅力。

items.src: Mina's apprehension before her first live broadcast contrasted with her producer's enthusiasm and her colleague's self-assurance, but afterwards she felt relieved.
items.para: After her first live broadcast Mina felt relief, but beforehand her anxiety had contrasted with her producer's excitement and her colleague's confidence.
items.note: 两者在此都指首次直播前的忧虑不安。

items.src: Supervisors can alert researchers to bias, restore their confidence, or convince them to change procedures; recording predictions before viewing results can safeguard them against bias.
items.para: Recording predictions before viewing results can protect researchers against bias; supervisors can warn them about it, reassure them, or persuade them to change procedures.
items.note: 两者在此都指保护研究人员免受偏见影响。

items.src: Despite earlier growth and subsequent reorganisation aimed at restoring its fortunes, repeated quota violations caused the fishing cooperative's downfall and cost it every licence.
items.para: Repeated quota breaches caused the fishing cooperative's collapse and loss of all licences, despite previous expansion and later restructuring intended to bring recovery.
items.note: 两者在此都指合作社的败落瓦解。

items.src: Passengers' initial astonishment and mounting worry became outrage when refunds were refused, while the cancelled excursions themselves had caused profound disappointment.
items.para: Although cancelled trips caused deep disappointment, denied refunds turned passengers' initial surprise and growing anxiety into intense anger.
items.note: 此处指因不公待遇而产生的强烈愤慨。

items.src: The villagers' plea for winter food followed their formal protest and the castle's firm commitment to help, but preceded their receipt of its official warning.
items.para: After their formal complaint and the castle's firm promise of help, villagers sent an urgent appeal for winter food before receiving its official warning.
items.note: 此处指为获得帮助而发出的迫切请求。

items.src: New legislation will outlaw renewal fees, limit deposits, allow electronic signatures and introduce controls on inspections of rented homes.
items.para: For rented homes, new legislation will restrict deposits and permit electronic signatures, but prohibit renewal fees and regulate inspections.
items.note: 此处都表示通过法律禁止某项行为。

items.src: Although beautiful, vines are troublesome rather than helpful to young trees because they block essential sunlight, despite gardeners initially considering them harmless.
items.para: Gardeners initially considered vines harmless, but these attractive climbers are problematic rather than beneficial to young trees because they block essential sunlight.
items.note: 此处指藤蔓给幼树生长造成问题。

items.src: Restorers found intermittent drilling more disruptive than regularly patterned tapping or barely audible humming, although the workshop's alarm was painfully loud.
items.para: Despite a deafening workshop alarm, restorers found on-and-off drilling more disruptive than either rhythmic tapping or faint humming.
items.note: 此处指钻孔声断断续续，并非持续不断。

items.src: The cooperative chose an impartial adviser whose experience and risk-averse approach reassured applicants, although some wanted someone more ready to decide.
items.para: Some applicants preferred a more decisive consultant, but the cooperative's unbiased adviser reassured them by being experienced and cautious.
items.note: 此处指评审时不偏袒任何申请人。

items.src: Interviews revealed parental indecision about costs, shared views on safety, and a divergence over separate holidays that no mutual concession had resolved.
items.para: No compromise had resolved the difference over separate holidays; interviews also revealed parents' uncertainty about costs and agreement on safety.
items.note: 此处指对分开度假持有不同意见。

items.src: Researchers light tiny crystals and turn them before using lenses to magnify them, then take pictures to document their internal structures.
items.para: Before lenses optically enlarge tiny crystals, researchers illuminate and rotate them; afterwards, they photograph them to document their internal structures.
items.note: 此处指通过镜片使晶体看起来更大。

items.src: The sculptor's candid interview account of her exhibition mistakes was thorough rather than self-justifying, though the editor had requested something brief.
items.para: Despite the editor's request for a concise interview account, the sculptor's description of her exhibition mistakes was detailed and frank, not defensive.
items.note: 此处指坦率讲述错误，不加隐瞒。

items.src: After their longtime coach died, rowers cancelled their victory dinner to grieve together rather than rejoice or mingle that evening, without losing hope.
items.para: Rowers cancelled their victory dinner following their longtime coach's death to mourn together, not celebrate or socialise that evening, without letting themselves despair.
items.note: 此处指因教练去世而悲痛、哀悼。

items.src: Members value the walking club's intangible benefits alongside quantifiable fitness gains, although membership offers neither monetary rewards nor assured improvements.
items.para: Alongside measurable fitness gains, members value nonphysical benefits from the walking club, which offers neither financial rewards nor guaranteed improvements.
items.note: 指非物质层面的益处，不仅是难以量化。

items.src: Photographs can evoke childhood memories that residents then record and compare, rather than deliberately suppress, at the restored market's exhibition.
items.para: Pictures at the renovated market's exhibition can bring back childhood memories that residents then write down and compare rather than deliberately suppress.
items.note: 指唤起回忆，使往事重新浮现在脑海中。

items.src: Friday's bakery workshop lets prospective employees meet existing staff, while previous workers explain how short-term recruits help during holidays.
items.para: Current staff can meet potential employees at Friday's bakery workshop, where former workers explain how temporary recruits provide holiday assistance.
items.note: 指将来可能成为员工的人，尚未确定入职。

items.src: The emergency office serves the whole metropolitan area, not merely downtown, but excludes distant rural settlements and the adjacent province.
items.para: Beyond the city centre, the emergency office covers the city and surrounding communities, but neither remote villages nor the neighbouring province.
items.note: 指城市及其周边相联系的社区构成的都市区。

items.src: Amira's balcony reading chair stands amidst potted plants, next to the railing and across from the door, under a striped awning.
items.para: Beneath a striped awning on Amira's balcony, her reading chair stands opposite the door, beside the railing and among potted plants.
items.note: 此处指位于多盆植物之间，周围有植物。

items.src: Technicians who handle repairs and rely on manuals must be conversant with drone software, even when anxious about failures.
items.para: Even when worried about failures, technicians responsible for repairs and dependent on manuals must be familiar with drone software.
items.note: 指熟悉并了解某事物，不是仅承担相关职责。

items.src: Expedition leaders resolved their early dispute through lengthy deliberation, then selected the northern route by ballot before announcing their decision publicly.
items.para: Lengthy careful discussion resolved expedition leaders' initial disagreement; a formal vote then selected the northern route before their public announcement.
items.note: 指作出决定前的审慎商议，不是投票或宣布结果。

items.src: Our puzzle experiment used prizes as motivation and diagrams as aids, with originality as its goal and time as the main constraint.
items.para: Originality was our puzzle experiment's objective; prizes provided an incentive and diagrams a resource, while time remained the main restriction.
items.note: 指限制行动或发挥的因素，此处是时间限制。

items.src: Summer beach notices deter visitors from approaching turtle eggs, explain breeding habits, direct walkers along safe paths and ease concerns about restrictions.
items.para: Summer beach notices inform visitors about turtle breeding, guide walkers along safe paths, reassure them about restrictions and discourage approaches to eggs.
items.note: 指使人打消做某事的念头，此处是不靠近龟卵。

items.src: The operator will shelve winter island plans until harbour repairs finish, prepare spring alternatives, implement mainland tours and reject night crossings.
items.para: The operator will draw up spring alternatives, carry out mainland tours and rule out night crossings, but put aside winter island plans pending harbour repairs.
items.note: 指暂时搁置计划，并非彻底否决或开始实施。

items.src: Rats may approach a storehouse, go inside, and eventually infest it, forcing workers to leave the building entirely.
items.para: Rats may approach a storehouse, enter it, and eventually overrun it, at which point workers are forced to abandon the building entirely.
items.note: 两者均指害兽大量侵入并占据某处。

items.src: Residents characterize the festival as a reunion, although they neither promote nor assess it, and some complain about its cost.
items.para: Although residents neither advertise nor evaluate the festival and some criticize its cost, they describe it as a reunion.
items.note: 此处均表示将某事描述为某种性质。

items.src: Bats hunt in the vicinity of the waterfall, roost deep within caves, and avoid fields far from the waterfall and cliffs directly above it.
items.para: Avoiding fields far from the waterfall and cliffs directly above it, bats hunt close to it and roost deep inside caves.
items.note: 两者都表示在某地点附近。

items.src: New glassblowers received scant training despite lengthy manuals; the instruction was very practical but not sophisticated in technical content.
items.para: Despite extensive manuals, new glassblowers received very limited instruction, which was highly practical rather than technically advanced.
items.note: 此处都指培训量很少。

items.src: Although highly lucrative, the pottery business remained precarious because dependence on one hotel prevented financial independence and complete security.
items.para: Dependence on one hotel left the pottery business dangerously unstable rather than financially independent or fully secure, although it was highly profitable.
items.note: 两者都指处境不稳且面临风险。

items.src: I recollect my cat's return rather than merely picturing it, cannot foresee another disappearance, and hope never to lose that memory.
items.para: Although I cannot predict another disappearance, I remember my cat's return, rather than merely imagine it, and hope never to forget it.
items.note: 两者都表示记起真实的过去经历。

items.src: Bereaved participants valued messages of condolence more than practical guidance, offers of money, or invitations to gatherings during their first month of grief.
items.para: During their first month of grief, bereaved participants preferred sympathy notes to practical advice, financial offers, or social invitations.
items.note: 丧亲语境中，两者均指表达哀悼的慰问信息。

items.src: The theatre company was dormant for five years, not dissolved forever or insolvent, before volunteers restored it to full operation.
items.para: Volunteers made the theatre company fully operational after five years of being temporarily inactive, rather than permanently disbanded or financially bankrupt.
items.note: 两者均指暂时停止活动但仍可恢复。

items.src: Helping a nervous swimmer convinced Leila that coaching was her vocation, not a pastime, a duty, or merely paid employment.
items.para: Leila saw coaching as her calling rather than a hobby, an obligation, or simply a paid job after helping an anxious swimmer.
items.note: 两者都指内心认定、愿意投身的志业。

items.src: Tomorrow, the therapist will invert the exercise sequence rather than run it again unchanged, reduce its length, or arrange it randomly.
items.para: Rather than repeat, shorten, or randomize the exercise sequence, the therapist will reverse it tomorrow.
items.note: 此处两者都指颠倒原有顺序。

items.src: Engineers can forecast a collapse, but excavation could precipitate one, while reinforcement might avert it or postpone it.
items.para: Although engineers can predict a collapse, digging could trigger one; strengthening the structure might prevent it or delay it.
items.note: 两者在此均指引发倒塌。

items.src: Tutors assess and document learners' progress, while daily pronunciation practice aims to hasten it and regular revision helps maintain it.
items.para: Daily pronunciation practice aims to accelerate learners' progress, which tutors measure and record, while regular revision helps sustain it.
items.note: 两者均指加快进步的速度。

items.src: The commissioner's dogged investigation continued despite refusals, unlike his deputy's tentative approach, his assistant's rash enquiries, and his lawyer's guarded advice.
items.para: Despite refusals, the commissioner's persistent investigation continued, contrasting with his deputy's hesitant approach, his assistant's impulsive enquiries, and his lawyer's cautious advice.
items.note: 两者均形容遇到阻碍仍坚持不懈。

items.src: Cooks should submerge the tray completely in soapy water before scouring it, then wash away the suds and wipe it dry.
items.para: Cooks should first immerse the tray completely in soapy water, then scrub it, rinse away the suds, and finally dry it by wiping.
items.note: 两者在此均指将托盘浸入水中。

items.src: The robotics laboratory gained prestige and media coverage after winning the award, but neither its financial support nor its political leverage increased.
items.para: Winning the award brought the robotics laboratory respect and publicity, without increasing either its funding or its political influence.
items.note: 两者在此均指成就带来的声望与尊重。

items.src: The producer opened the newsletter with a friendly salutation, apologised for delays, invited listeners to a concert, and ended with a goodbye.
items.para: Listeners found a friendly greeting at the newsletter's start, followed by the producer's apology for delays, a concert invitation, and a closing farewell.
items.note: 两者均指开头向读者致意的问候语。

items.src: Unlike earlier rushed checks, shallow summaries, and selective comparisons, the researcher's painstaking review explained how expectations had changed witnesses' memories.
items.para: The researcher's meticulous review explained how expectations had altered witnesses' memories, unlike previous hasty checks, superficial summaries, and selective comparisons.
items.note: 两者在此均形容工作极其认真细致。

items.src: Sleep research gained prominence in health policy and became more publicly favoured, although its scientific trustworthiness and commercial profitability remained unchanged.
items.para: Despite unchanged scientific credibility and commercial profitability, sleep research gained importance in health policy and popularity among the public.
items.note: 两者在此均指议题在政策中的重要地位。

items.src: Visitors found the island's trail instructions explicit but wordy, while the ranger's courteous reminder sounded less emphatic than the brochure's warning.
items.para: The ranger's polite reminder was less forceful than the brochure's warning, while visitors found the island's trail instructions unambiguous but not concise.
items.note: 两者在此均指指示表述明确、不含糊。

items.src: The fortress had finite grain reserves but ample water; both were within reach, yet neither could be replenished during a siege.
items.para: Although grain and water were accessible inside the fortress, neither was replenishable under siege, and grain was limited while water was plentiful.
items.note: 两者在此均指粮食储备数量有限。

items.src: Organisers hoped storytelling would arouse interest in newcomers' lives, while later workshops would maintain that interest rather than divert or stifle it.
items.para: Storytelling was intended to spark interest in newcomers' lives; organisers hoped subsequent workshops would sustain that interest rather than redirect or suppress it.
items.note: 此处都指激起对某事的兴趣。

items.src: The heron lifts its beak slowly, lowers it gently, then thrusts it into the water before pulling it back quickly.
items.para: After the heron slowly raises its beak and gently lowers it, it suddenly jabs it into the water, then quickly withdraws it.
items.note: 此处都指突然用力将喙插入水中。

items.src: The workshop's wealthy patron funded apprentices without expecting repayment or ownership, unlike its creditor and shareholder; a buyer simply purchased finished furniture.
items.para: Unlike its lender and shareholder, the workshop's rich sponsor supported apprentices without seeking repayment or ownership, while a customer merely bought finished furniture.
items.note: 此处都指提供资金支持的资助者。

items.src: The economist judged the tax discount fitting but unaffordable, although voters liked it and nobody yet knew whether it would work.
items.para: Although popular with voters, the tax discount was judged appropriate but not affordable by the economist, and nobody yet knew whether it would be effective.
items.note: 此处都指措施适合当前情况、恰当。

items.src: A village prophet predicted a harsh winter, prompting an elder to prepare, a priest to pray, and a healer to gather herbs.
items.para: Because a village seer foretold a severe winter, the priest prayed, the healer gathered herbs, and the elder made preparations.
items.note: 此处都指能够预言未来的预言者。

items.src: Researchers may determine laboratory rules' meaning, but only managers can ensure compliance or amend them; removing samples without permission would violate those rules.
items.para: Unauthorised sample removal would breach laboratory rules, which researchers may interpret but only managers can enforce or revise.
items.note: 此处都指违反已有的规则。

items.src: The pottery teacher uses repeated practice to cultivate patience, not judge it, encouraging apprentices to show genuine calm rather than hide their frustration.
items.para: Encouraging apprentices to demonstrate genuine calm rather than conceal frustration, the pottery teacher uses repeated practice to develop patience, not assess it.
items.note: 此处都指通过练习逐渐培养耐心。

items.src: After a short overview and a physical demonstration, the rowing coach offered further elaboration of breathing technique, not an oral correction.
items.para: The rowing coach followed a brief summary and a practical demonstration of breathing technique with a more detailed explanation, not a verbal correction.
items.note: 此处都指在原有说明上进一步补充细节。

items.src: For prolonged sitting, the therapist recommended a slender lumbar cushion with firm support rather than the broad, yielding cushion already on my chair.
items.para: The therapist recommended a thin lumbar cushion providing firm support for prolonged sitting, instead of the wide, soft cushion already on my chair.
items.note: 此处都指腰靠厚度小、外形薄。

items.src: The architect's antagonist challenged the redevelopment plan while her supporter defended it, her consultant offered advice, and a neutral negotiator sought agreement.
items.para: While her ally defended the redevelopment plan and her adviser offered guidance, the architect's opponent challenged it; a neutral mediator sought agreement.
items.note: 此处都指在争论中持对立立场的人。

items.src: College rules permit officials to nullify scholarship contracts for plagiarism, but only revise, extend, or temporarily halt them for other reasons.
items.para: For reasons other than plagiarism, college officials may only amend, extend, or suspend scholarship contracts; plagiarism allows them to invalidate these agreements.
items.note: 指使合同失去法律效力，而非暂时中止。

items.src: The council discussed the parking fee for a short time, revised it unwillingly, and eventually rejected it outright.
items.para: Having briefly debated the parking charge and reluctantly amended it, the council eventually rejected it completely.
items.note: 表示完全否决，而非部分接受。

items.src: Mei considered moving abroad unthinkable, although it was financially manageable, legally permissible, and professionally advantageous, because she could not bear leaving her sister.
items.para: Unable to bear leaving her sister, Mei found relocation abroad impossible to imagine, despite its being financially feasible, legally acceptable, and professionally beneficial.
items.note: 指情感上无法想象或接受这种选择。

items.src: Engineers judged solar charging viable with four daily sunlight hours, while describing the tracking device as inexpensive, easy to carry, and resistant to wear.
items.para: Engineers described the tracker as affordable, portable, and durable, and judged solar charging workable provided it received four hours of sunlight daily.
items.note: 指在所述条件下实际能够运作。

items.src: While recruiting a lasting replacement, the station appointed an interim science editor whose position required normal full working hours but offered no salary.
items.para: The station's search for a permanent science editor continued after it appointed a temporary replacement to a full-time but unpaid position.
items.note: 指正式接任者到位前的临时任职。

items.src: Although energetic, prolonged, and well organised, the design discussion proved barren because participants merely repeated old suggestions instead of producing new ideas.
items.para: Repeating familiar proposals rather than generating fresh ideas made the design discussion unproductive, despite its being lively, lengthy, and orderly.
items.note: 此处比喻讨论没有产生有用的新成果。

items.src: The clinic treats persistent anxiety following an assault, but refers people distressed by spoken threats, bullying at work, or traffic accidents elsewhere.
items.para: People distressed by verbal threats, workplace bullying, or road accidents are referred elsewhere; the clinic treats persistent anxiety following a physical attack.
items.note: 指对他人实施的身体暴力袭击。

items.src: Our guide used humorous anecdotes to animate her harbour history talk, not to reduce its length, make it simpler, or remedy factual errors.
items.para: To enliven her account of the harbour's past, our guide used amusing stories, not to shorten, simplify, or correct it.
items.note: 指使讲述更生动有趣。

items.src: Archaeologists offered a tentative fortress date pending timber tests; although exact and credible, their estimate was already being challenged by other researchers.
items.para: Although precise and plausible, the archaeologists' disputed estimate of the fortress's age remained provisional until tests on its timber were complete.
items.note: 指暂时提出、仍待验证和修改。

items.src: Residents commissioned an independent probe into unfair garden exclusions, choosing fact-finding over mediated reconciliation, a binding third-party ruling, or direct bargaining.
items.para: Residents commissioned an independent investigation to establish the facts about unfair garden exclusions, rejecting mediation, arbitration, and negotiation.
items.note: 指为查明事实而开展的调查。

items.src: Researchers distinguish whale populations by a nuance in their calls, rather than a recurring pattern, a sudden alteration, or a general resemblance.
items.para: A repeated pattern, an abrupt change, and an overall similarity are not what distinguishes whale populations; researchers rely instead on a subtle difference in calls.
items.note: 此处指鲸鸣中可用于区分种群的细微差别。

items.src: Sensor voltage is directly proportional to pressure, inversely related to volume, independent of temperature, and weakly linked to humidity.
items.para: Sensor voltage is inversely related to volume and entirely independent of temperature, but loosely linked to humidity and in a fixed ratio to pressure.
items.note: 正比关系表示两个量的比值保持恒定。

items.src: The regional survey found bi entrepreneurs paid identical interest rates to heterosexual, homosexual, and asexual entrepreneurs.
items.para: Regionally surveyed entrepreneurs attracted to multiple genders paid identical interest rates to those attracted only to another gender, attracted only to their gender, or sexually attracted to nobody.
items.note: 此处指会被不止一种性别吸引。

items.src: Visitors said the garden's esthetic appeal comforted them, although they attached little importance to its history, usefulness, or monetary worth.
items.para: Although its historical significance, practical usefulness, and financial value mattered little to visitors, they reported finding comfort in the garden's visual beauty.
items.note: 此处指花园在视觉上呈现的美感。

items.src: Scientists will plan the volcanic gas study now, embark on it after equipment arrives, continue through summer, and finish in autumn.
items.para: After equipment arrives, scientists will begin the volcanic gas study; they will plan it now, continue through summer, and complete it in autumn.
items.note: 此处表示开始开展研究，而非筹划或完成。

items.src: Weekly meals strengthened cohesion within our choir, whereas rehearsals developed self-belief and self-control, and competitions increased the singers' desire to succeed.
items.para: Rehearsals built our choir's confidence and discipline, while competitions increased ambition; eating together each week strengthened unity among the singers.
items.note: 此处指合唱团成员之间的团结。

items.src: Rivalry drove the rowing clubs to train harder, although joint projects, friendly relations, and mutual admiration continued between their members.
items.para: Cooperation, friendship, and respect persisted between members of the rowing clubs, but competition motivated the clubs to intensify their training.
items.note: 此处指赛艇俱乐部之间争取胜利的竞争。

items.src: After disrupted sleep, the patient was in a daze rather than fully attentive, intensely worried, or quick to become annoyed.
items.para: The patient was not fully alert, deeply anxious, or easily irritated; after interrupted sleep, they were mentally confused.
items.note: 此处表示神志恍惚、思路不清。

items.src: For playground resurfacing, the report separated its safety objective, selection criterion, testing procedure, and final recommendation to use rubber.
items.para: Rubber was the report's final recommendation for playground resurfacing; its safety objective, selection standard, and testing procedure were presented separately.
items.note: 此处指选择材料时采用的评判标准。

items.src: The pottery tutor said beginners found the illustrated guide exceedingly helpful, the videos fairly helpful, the diagrams somewhat helpful, and the glossary hardly helpful.
items.para: Beginners rated the videos moderately useful, diagrams slightly useful, and glossary barely useful, but found the illustrated guide extremely useful, the pottery tutor reported.
items.note: 两者都表示程度极高，相当于“极其”。

items.src: The minister's pledge to disclose expenditure was neither a tentative suggestion nor an assured forecast, and followed an official appeal for transparency.
items.para: Following a formal request for transparency, the minister gave a firm promise to disclose spending, not a tentative proposal or a confident prediction.
items.note: 指郑重作出的承诺，而非建议或预测。

items.src: Amira wanted a conspicuous suitcase rather than a beautiful or oversized one, although she also needed something easy to carry.
items.para: Amira needed an easily portable suitcase, but wanted it easily noticeable rather than visually attractive or unusually large.
items.note: 指容易被注意到，不等于美观或体积大。

items.src: A museum display distinguishes gunpowder from its three separate ingredients, identifying these as carbonised wood, elemental sulfur and potassium nitrate.
items.para: Charcoal, sulphur and saltpetre are identified as separate ingredients in a museum display that distinguishes them from the complete mixture, black powder.
items.note: 此处指黑火药这一混合物，而非单独原料。

items.src: Technicians had to examine the flooded recordings before deciding which to salvage, which to list in the catalogue and which to throw away.
items.para: Before deciding which flooded recordings to save, catalogue or discard, technicians had to inspect them.
items.note: 指从水灾造成的损坏或损失中抢救出来。

items.src: The tutor let participants' minds roam before asking them to concentrate on an image, consider its meaning, and devise a story.
items.para: Before asking participants to focus on an image, reflect on its meaning and plan a story, the tutor allowed their minds to wander.
items.note: 形容思绪不受固定目标限制地自由游走。

items.src: Besides a book for classroom study, a folded information pamphlet and a book of maps, the conservation centre publishes a quarterly periodical featuring wetland bird research.
items.para: Wetland bird research appears in the conservation centre's quarterly journal; its other publications include a textbook, a leaflet and an atlas.
items.note: 此处指每季度出版、刊载研究的期刊。

items.src: Visitors may explore the former gaol near the harbour, but the old law courts, soldiers' quarters and fortified stronghold remain closed.
items.para: Although the old courthouse, barracks and fortress remain closed, the former prison near the port is open for visitors to explore.
items.note: 指关押犯人的监狱，与另一拼写形式同义。

items.src: Although widely anticipated, the pottery academy's spring application total was unprecedented, unlike earlier totals that had been documented or surpassed several times.
items.para: Unlike earlier totals previously recorded or repeatedly exceeded, the pottery academy's spring application total was never seen before, although widely expected.
items.note: 指此前从未出现过，并非仅仅超出预期。

items.src: Despite becoming affluent, the fishing families remained willing to give and stayed frugal rather than spending lavishly as their neighbours did.
items.para: Unlike their extravagant neighbours, the fishing families remained thrifty and generous even after becoming wealthy.
items.note: 指节俭、避免浪费，与财富多少无关。

items.src: Farmers raise calves, immunise the herd and trade some animals, but slaughter selected cattle for food each autumn.
items.para: Each autumn, farmers kill selected cattle for food; they also rear calves, vaccinate the herd and sell some animals.
items.note: 在明确为食用的语境中，指宰杀牲畜。

items.src: Supervisors expect packaging pressure to intensify before launch, stay unchanged on launch day, decrease slightly afterwards, and eventually vanish.
items.para: Packaging pressure should remain constant on launch day, then ease slightly and eventually disappear entirely, but supervisors expect it to grow stronger beforehand.
items.note: 都指压力程度增强、加剧。

items.src: An eminent economist will debate a novice researcher tonight, while a divisive commentator interviews an analyst whom nobody knows.
items.para: Tonight, a controversial commentator will interview an unknown analyst, while a distinguished economist debates an inexperienced researcher.
items.note: 都指在专业领域杰出且受尊敬的。

items.src: Each explorer received a smaller daily ration because food was scarce; the emergency stock remained untouched, and no excess food remained.
items.para: A food shortage reduced each explorer's daily allocation; the emergency reserve was untouched, and there was no surplus.
items.note: 这里都指每日分配给个人的食物定量。

items.src: Nurses recorded insomnia after evening light exposure, distinguishing it from daytime sleepiness, general exhaustion, and an inability to remain still.
items.para: After evening light exposure, nurses distinguished daytime drowsiness, general fatigue, and restlessness from the sleeplessness they recorded.
items.note: 都指无法入睡或维持睡眠的失眠状态。

items.src: Both galleries signed an accord after revising their initial plan and resolving a written protest, then issued a statement to the public.
items.para: Following revisions to a preliminary proposal and resolution of a written objection, both galleries signed a formal agreement before issuing a public announcement.
items.note: 都指双方达成的正式协议。

items.src: This swimming drill's chief virtue is affordability, although repetition makes it dull; it aims to improve balance and requires supervision.
items.para: Better balance is this drill's purpose and supervision its requirement; affordability is its chief advantage, but repetitive practice is a drawback.
items.note: 这里都指事物的优点或有利之处。

items.src: Despite unchanged medication, patients' blood pressure showed considerable fluctuation throughout the day, rather than sustained increases, sustained decreases, or consistent levels.
items.para: Considerable oscillation, not sustained growth, sustained decline, or stability, characterised patients' blood pressure throughout the day despite unchanged medication.
items.note: 都指数值反复上升和下降的波动。

items.src: Investigators described the landlords' false advertisements as deliberate deception, rejecting explanations involving inattentiveness or misunderstanding and distinguishing the conduct from honest attempts to persuade.
items.para: Rejecting carelessness and confusion as explanations, investigators called the landlords' false advertisements deliberate trickery rather than honest persuasion.
items.note: 都指故意误导他人的欺骗行为。

items.src: Students compare an obscure script with a widely recognised alphabet, discovering that the former is intricate but no longer in use.
items.para: By comparing the little-known script with a famous alphabet, students discover that the former is both complex and obsolete.
items.note: 这里都指鲜为人知，而非难以理解。

items.src: Missing signatures invalidate applications rather than merely postpone processing; clerks may correct the documents, but only managers can authorise acceptance.
items.para: Clerks may amend applications, but only managers can approve them; missing signatures void these documents rather than merely delay processing.
items.note: 都指使申请失去效力，而非仅延迟处理。

items.src: Mina uses rough estimates for planning, but her weekly accounts require computation of expenses, entry of totals, and checks for errors.
items.para: Although estimation supports Mina's planning, her weekly accounts involve calculation of expenses, recording of totals, and verification of their accuracy.
items.note: 两者都指通过运算得出数值。

items.src: Engineers found the new warning tone potent despite its quietness, whereas the old alarm sounded grating and continued without attracting attention.
items.para: The old alarm was harsh and persistent yet attracted no attention; engineers found the new warning tone powerful despite being faint.
items.note: 此处都指警示音效果强，能引起注意。

items.src: Six months of studio training made Leila proficient at editing radio interviews, though she remained unsure of herself, careful, and new to presenting.
items.para: Leila became skilled at editing radio interviews after six months of studio training, but remained cautious, not confident, and inexperienced as a presenter.
items.note: 两者都指掌握技能，做某事很熟练。

items.src: Parents can comfort anxious children without choosing to pamper them, and can also set demanding tasks and enforce rules when necessary.
items.para: Without choosing to indulge anxious children, parents can reassure them and, when necessary, challenge them with demanding tasks and discipline them by enforcing rules.
items.note: 此处都指过分迁就、宠爱孩子。

items.src: Firefighters saw dense smoke and scattered sparks around the blaze in the woodland, where only glowing coals remained after heavy rain.
items.para: Heavy rain left only glowing embers in the woodland where firefighters had seen thick smoke and scattered sparks surrounding a large fire.
items.note: 两者都指猛烈燃烧的大火。

items.src: Hungry after their island hike, the travellers opened and shared their sandwiches beside the harbour, devoured most, and stored the rest.
items.para: Beside the harbour, the hungry travellers unwrapped their sandwiches after hiking across the island, passed around portions, wolfed down most, and packed away the rest.
items.note: 两者都指狼吞虎咽地吃，且均为过去式。

items.src: Families fleeing civil war found a haven in the monastery, which offered short-term lodging rather than a stopover or lasting residence.
items.para: The monastery provided temporary accommodation, not a transit stop or permanent home, and became a safe refuge for families escaping civil war.
items.note: 两者都指供人躲避危险的安全避难所。

items.src: The historian explained that popular opposition ended the ruler's tyranny, allowing nonviolent political change and the establishment of government by elected representatives.
items.para: The historian explained that peaceful reform and democratic government became possible after popular resistance brought the ruler's oppressive rule to an end.
items.note: 两者都指压迫人民的专制统治。

items.src: Young antelopes notice approaching predators and dodge them with sudden sideways leaps rather than face them directly or give chase.
items.para: Rather than confront or pursue approaching predators, young antelopes detect them and evade them by leaping abruptly sideways.
items.note: 此处都指通过突然移动躲开捕食者。

items.src: When cooling fails, the supervisor must summon an engineer, explain the problem before seeking advice, and send the engineer away only after repairs.
items.para: Cooling failure requires the supervisor to call in an engineer, brief them before proceeding to consult them, and dismiss them only once repairs are complete.
items.note: 两者都指叫某人前来。

items.src: Workers felt anxiety before the closure, disappointment when rescue failed, and considerable bitterness over concealed debts, but no relief when compensation arrived.
items.para: Compensation brought workers no relief; failed rescue caused disappointment, anxiety preceded closure, and hidden debts provoked considerable resentment.
items.note: 此处指因隐瞒债务而产生的怨恨。

items.src: Researchers used daily diaries to substantiate reports of gardening benefits, rather than merely condense them, contrast them, or question their accuracy.
items.para: Rather than simply summarize, compare, or challenge reports of gardening benefits, researchers used daily diaries to confirm them.
items.note: 指借助证据证实报告中的说法。

items.src: A short opening preceded the guest's monologue on galaxies, which displaced the vigorous debate and unrestricted discussion planned for the seminar.
items.para: The seminar's planned activities, a lively debate and an open discussion, gave way to the guest's lengthy one-sided speech on galaxies after a brief introduction.
items.note: 指一人持续发言的长篇讲话。

items.src: The catalogue included an acknowledgment of restorers and apologised for damage, while requesting donations to support its commitment to paying them.
items.para: The catalogue's apology for damage accompanied its note of thanks to restorers; an appeal for donations supported a promise of payment.
items.note: 此处指向修复人员表达感谢的书面致谢。

items.src: Race officials require runners to traverse the plateau before reaching the lake, not merely draw near it, go around it, or bypass it.
items.para: Before reaching the lake, runners must cross the plateau rather than merely approach, circle, or avoid it, race officials insist.
items.note: 指从高原的一边横穿到另一边。

items.src: The nurse found an inconsistency between the sleep diary and interview, rather than matching details, missing information, or repeated entries.
items.para: Neither agreement, an omission, nor duplication described what the nurse found: comparison of the sleep diary and interview revealed a discrepancy.
items.note: 指睡眠日记与访谈内容之间的不符。

items.src: Residents could articulate their concerns about the tower's effect on daylight, instead of hinting vaguely, hiding them deliberately, or overstating them greatly.
items.para: Rather than vaguely suggest, deliberately conceal, or greatly exaggerate their daylight concerns, residents could clearly express them in relation to the tower.
items.note: 指把担忧清楚地表达出来。

items.src: Trainees distinguished freight destined for customers from crew baggage, food supplies, and stabilizing weights while inspecting the vessel for their logistics course.
items.para: Inspecting the ship for their logistics course, trainees distinguished customer-bound cargo from crew luggage, provisions for consumption, and ballast for stability.
items.note: 此处指运送给客户的货物。

items.src: Engineers warned that floodwater could engulf the district unless repairs succeeded, rather than threaten it briefly, surround part of it, or scarcely touch it.
items.para: Unless repairs succeeded, engineers warned, floodwater could completely cover the district, not just briefly threaten, partly surround, or barely touch it.
items.note: 指洪水将整个区域完全淹没。

items.src: Anyone seeking the rooftop laundry must ascend the kitchen staircase, not pass it, turn aside, or take the stairs downward.
items.para: To reach the rooftop laundry, you must go up the kitchen staircase rather than walk past it, turn away, or head down the stairs.
items.note: 此处指沿厨房楼梯向上走。

items.src: Tests showed repeated heating caused degradation of the sensor coating, while recording increased size, reduced hardness and unwanted colour changes separately.
items.para: Repeated heat caused deterioration of the sensor coating, tests showed, with expansion, softening and discoloration recorded separately.
items.note: 两者都指涂层状况或质量的恶化。

items.src: Putting ethics above employer allegiance, freedom of professional decision-making and career aspirations, the editor demonstrated integrity by publicly correcting the report.
items.para: The editor's public correction demonstrated principled honesty, prioritising ethical conduct over loyalty to their employer, professional discretion and personal ambition.
items.note: 此处指坚持道德原则的诚实正直。

items.src: Brief alerts break concentration and divert thought, but repeated interruptions hamper complex reasoning without necessarily stopping it altogether.
items.para: Although brief alerts interrupt concentration and redirect thought, repeated disruptions hinder complex reasoning without necessarily managing to prevent it altogether.
items.note: 两者都指阻碍进展，不一定使其完全停止。

items.src: Restoration contracts stipulate native planting, advise mulching, promote volunteering and allow photography, distinguishing compulsory work from suggestions, encouragement and permission.
items.para: Distinguishing obligations from advice, encouragement and permission, restoration agreements explicitly require native planting, merely recommend mulching, actively encourage volunteering and expressly permit photography.
items.note: 两者都指将某事明确规定为必须履行的要求。

items.src: Mountain road closures prompted the guide's pragmatic village route, which followed the usual tourist circuit but was neither risk-averse nor aspirational.
items.para: The guide chose a practical village route because mountain roads were closed; it was neither cautious nor ambitious, though it followed a conventional tourist circuit.
items.note: 两者都指根据现实条件作出切实可行的选择。

items.src: Despite the observatory proposal's potential to attract backing and funding without encountering resistance, the king warned that it might never materialize.
items.para: The king warned that the observatory proposal might never become reality, although it might gain support and attract funding without having to face opposition.
items.note: 两者都指计划成为现实，而非停留在设想阶段。

items.src: The council spokesperson blamed permit errors on clerical inattention during checks, rejecting inadequate instruction, mistaken decisions and intentional wrongdoing as explanations.
items.para: Rejecting insufficient training, poor judgement and deliberate misconduct, the council representative attributed permit mistakes to clerks' lack of concentration during checks.
items.note: 此处指检查工作时不够专心，而非故意犯错。

items.src: Illustrated bird guides are sold at the bazaar beside the reserve entrance, but not at the nearby bookstore, sales booth or food shop.
items.para: The nearby bookshop, kiosk and grocery store do not sell illustrated bird guides; these are available at the market beside the reserve entrance.
items.note: 两者在此都指售卖商品的集市。

items.src: Testers submitted a few reports slowly, then steadily, but developers expected one grouped set rather than the deluge that overwhelmed them after launch.
items.para: A trickle of test reports became a stream, but developers expected a single batch, not the flood that overwhelmed them after launch.
items.note: 两者都比喻大量涌来、令人难以应付的事物。

items.src: Economists warned that payment failures could paralyse trade, not merely reduce its pace, cause brief disturbances or impose limits on it.
items.para: Payment failures could completely halt trade, economists warned, rather than merely slow down, briefly disrupt or restrict it.
items.note: 此处指使贸易完全停止，而非仅减慢或限制。

items.src: Disappointment may linger after an unsuccessful audition, rather than diminish as friends hope, grow stronger, or return after disappearing.
items.para: Friends hope disappointment will fade after a failed audition, but it may persist instead of beginning to intensify or disappearing only to resurface.
items.note: 指失望情绪持续存在，迟迟不消失。

items.src: Engineers improved sensor accuracy through a refinement rather than repairing damage, replacing the entire sensor, or restoring its original settings.
items.para: Greater sensor accuracy came from engineers' small improvement, not from damage repair, complete replacement, or a settings reset.
items.note: 指使原有设备更有效、更精确的小幅改进。

items.src: Her murals preach tolerance by denouncing discrimination and honouring diverse traditions, rather than urging people to discuss disagreements peacefully.
items.para: Through images that condemn discrimination and honour diverse traditions, her murals promote acceptance of others rather than encourage peaceful debate.
items.note: 指积极宣扬接纳他人、包容差异。

items.src: Unlike his rebellious captain and bitter deputy, the new goalkeeper remained meek under criticism, although his coach wanted him to defend himself confidently.
items.para: His coach wanted an assertive response to criticism, but the new goalkeeper remained submissive, unlike his defiant captain and resentful deputy.
items.note: 指面对批评顺从退让，不作反抗。

items.src: Patients reported a perceptible improvement in sleep after six weeks of therapy, but not a large, enduring, or instant benefit.
items.para: After six weeks of treatment, patients described their sleep improvement as detectable, though neither substantial nor lasting, and certainly not immediate.
items.note: 指睡眠改善达到了可以察觉的程度。

items.src: Leila is adept at selecting roadside trees, whereas her assistant merely finds this interesting and handles planting while relying on her advice.
items.para: Merely interested in selecting roadside trees, Leila's assistant is responsible for planting and dependent on her advice; Leila herself is skilled in selection.
items.note: 指在选择行道树方面很擅长。

items.src: The tutor called the essay pretentious, not intellectually advanced, ceremonious, or creative, because its language gave ordinary ideas a false profundity.
items.para: Because its language made ordinary ideas seem falsely profound, the tutor judged the essay affected rather than sophisticated, formal, or imaginative.
items.note: 此处指语言刻意造作，把普通想法包装得高深。

items.src: Reviewers considered leaflet design peripheral to flood planning, evacuation routes indispensable, and repairs pressing, while dismissing ceremonial arrangements as unrelated.
items.para: For flood planning, reviewers deemed evacuation routes essential and repairs urgent; leaflet design was secondary, whereas ceremonial arrangements were irrelevant.
items.note: 指与主要事务有关，但处于次要地位。

items.src: Sunlight caused the sofa's deterioration, so the technician recommended restoring it and caring for it regularly instead of buying another.
items.para: Recommending restoration and regular maintenance rather than replacement, the technician attributed the sofa's worsening condition to sunlight.
items.note: 指沙发的物理状况逐渐变差。

items.src: Remote workers described alienation from colleagues after automated messages replaced daily chats, distinguishing this feeling from autonomy, competition, and suspicion.
items.para: After automated notifications replaced everyday conversations, remote workers reported disconnection from colleagues, distinguishing it from independence, rivalry, and distrust.
items.note: 指与同事在情感上失去联系的疏离感。

items.src: Editors consider independent verification indispensable for emergency reporting, extra photographs merely welcome, background interviews discretionary, and decorative graphics not needed.
items.para: For emergency coverage, editors regard extra photographs as desirable, background interviews as optional, and decorative graphics as unnecessary, but independent verification as essential.
items.note: 两者都表示必不可少，而非仅仅值得拥有。

items.src: The psychologist blamed the reasoning errors on negligence, rejecting misunderstanding, tiredness, and worry as possible explanations for the participants' poor performance.
items.para: Confusion, fatigue, and anxiety were rejected by the psychologist, who attributed the participants' reasoning mistakes to carelessness.
items.note: 此处都指做任务时疏忽大意、不够认真。

items.src: The company drained its wetland headlong, whereas neighbouring farmers proceeded cautiously, council workers acted after extensive discussion, and volunteers worked slowly.
items.para: Neighbouring farmers proceeded with great caution, council workers after lengthy deliberation, and volunteers at a leisurely pace, whereas the company drained its wetland with reckless haste.
items.note: 此处指行动仓促鲁莽，兼有急速与欠考虑之意。

items.src: Our temple guidebook, written by an architectural professional and checked by engineering and history specialists, uses language a layman can understand without training.
items.para: A non-specialist needs no training to understand our temple guidebook, which an architect wrote and an engineer and a historian checked.
items.note: 此处都指没有相关专业知识的普通人。

items.src: Medieval siege messengers would dart between towers when archers paused, while scouts would move stealthily, defenders would withdraw, and attackers would push forward.
items.para: Scouts would creep, defenders retreat, and attackers advance during medieval sieges, while messengers would dash between towers whenever bowmen paused.
items.note: 两者都指突然快速移动。

items.src: Storytelling guests were asked to refrain from interrupting, while hosts were instructed to allow questions, promote discussion, and restrict the length of speeches.
items.para: Hosts were instructed to permit questions, encourage discussion, and limit speeches, while guests at the storytelling event were asked to avoid interrupting.
items.note: 此处都表示有意克制自己，不去打断别人。

items.src: Concrete shelters detract from the cliffs' beauty, although wildflowers make it greater, conservation rules keep it intact, and cleanup projects bring it back.
items.para: Wildflowers enhance the cliffs' beauty, conservation rules preserve it, and cleanup projects restore it, although concrete shelters diminish it.
items.note: 此处都指减损悬崖景色的美感。

items.src: The pottery workshop supplies water to quench thirst, breaks to ease tiredness, fans to stop overheating, and gloves to protect against burns.
items.para: To reduce fatigue, prevent overheating, and prevent burns, the pottery workshop supplies breaks, fans, and gloves respectively, alongside water to satisfy thirst.
items.note: 两者都表示解渴、满足饮水的需要。
