items.src: Island fisheries survived economic adversity by sharing equipment, then gradually regained financial health and steadiness before eventually enjoying considerable wealth.
items.para: Equipment sharing helped island fisheries survive economic hardship, followed by gradual recovery and stability before they eventually achieved prosperity.
items.note: 此处都指经济上的困境与艰难。

items.src: Amira felt wretched after leaving friends, then worried about finding work, optimistic after an interview, and free of anxiety when she received an offer.
items.para: Leaving her friends made Amira miserable; she later felt anxious about finding work, hopeful after an interview, and relieved when she received an offer.
items.note: 此处都表示非常难过、内心痛苦。

items.src: Researchers chose a translucent film rather than a fully transparent sheet or lightproof panel, although its surface also reflected light.
items.para: Although also reflective, the film researchers selected was semitransparent; they rejected both a clear sheet and an opaque panel.
items.note: 均指半透明的，透光但不能清楚看见后方物体。

items.src: Amira painted a gorge cutting through a high plain, with a broad depression beyond it and a narrow crest to the east.
items.para: Amira's painting shows a plateau split by a ravine, with a basin beyond it and a ridge to the east.
items.note: 都指两侧陡峭的深窄峡谷。

items.src: Runners wash their legs briefly, immerse them in cold water for ten minutes, then rub their muscles before removing the moisture with towels.
items.para: After they rinse their legs, runners submerge them in cold water for ten minutes, then massage their muscles and dry their legs with towels.
items.note: 都指将身体部位完全浸入水中。

items.src: Nurses recommend a sterile saline nasal spray rather than one containing medicine or perfume for patients whose noses are dry.
items.para: For patients with dry noses, nurses advise using a salt-containing, sterile nasal spray instead of a medicated or fragranced one.
items.note: 都表示含盐的，此处修饰鼻腔喷雾。

items.src: Engineers insist inspections must precede the bridge opening, not occur simultaneously or afterwards, although repairs could postpone the ceremony.
items.para: Inspections must come before the bridge opening, engineers insist, rather than coincide with or follow it, although repairs could delay the ceremony.
items.note: 都表示在另一事件发生之前进行。

items.src: Teachers replaced separate, occasional book donations with a concerted campaign involving librarians, whose continuing support ensured its success.
items.para: With librarians' sustained support ensuring success, teachers replaced independent, sporadic book donations with a jointly coordinated campaign involving those librarians.
items.note: 指参与各方共同协调开展的。

items.src: Canadian ranchers raise cattle on the prairie rather than in thick forests, stony hills or coastal wetlands because grazing is easier there.
items.para: Easier grazing leads Canadian ranchers to raise cattle on extensive grassland rather than in dense woodland, rocky uplands or coastal marshes.
items.note: 此处指加拿大广阔开敞的草原。

items.src: Our blender's mighty motor crushes ice within seconds, although it is small, makes little noise and uses electricity economically.
items.para: Despite being compact, quiet and energy-efficient, our blender's motor is very powerful, crushing ice within seconds.
items.note: 此处指电机动力十分强劲。

items.src: Researchers praised the software's equitable allocation of computing time according to need, rather than identical shares, while noting its ample, adaptable provision.
items.para: Noting its generous, flexible provision, researchers praised the software for allocating fair rather than equal shares of computing time according to need.
items.note: 指按需求合理分配所体现的公平。

items.src: Critics consider the theatre's widely recognised roof iconic of the city's architecture, but not groundbreaking in engineering, dramatic in appearance or important to history.
items.para: Critics describe the theatre's widely recognised roof as emblematic of the city's architecture, but not innovative in engineering, striking visually, or significant historically.
items.note: 指广为人知且具有象征代表性的。

items.src: Although money motivated Leila and fear hindered her, her grandfather's advice was the catalyst for changing careers, and greater confidence followed.
items.para: Her grandfather's advice provided the trigger for Leila's career change; money was an incentive, fear an obstacle, and greater confidence a consequence.
items.note: 此处指触发职业转变的因素。

items.src: Maya read the documentary's synopsis before its critical assessment, then consulted its written dialogue and finally drafted an opening section for her essay.
items.para: Before consulting the documentary's transcript and drafting her essay's introduction, Maya read its summary followed by a review.
items.note: 两者都指作品主要内容的概要。

items.src: Better lighting brought a revival of harbour markets after years of gradually declining trade, preventing their permanent shutdown without requiring a move elsewhere.
items.para: Following years of gradual decline, harbour markets enjoyed renewed popularity thanks to better lighting, avoiding permanent closure without needing physical relocation.
items.note: 此处指市场重新受到欢迎、恢复兴旺。

items.src: Cloth purchase records abound in the medieval port's archives, whereas shipping contracts are rare, tax registers have vanished, and wage accounts survive only partially.
items.para: Although tax registers are missing and wage accounts are incomplete in the medieval port's archives, cloth purchase records are plentiful; shipping contracts are scarce.
items.note: 指相关记录数量很多、大量存在。

items.src: Parents briefly debate childcare proposals and rapidly reject costly ones, but ponder affordable alternatives before finally agreeing to a shared scheme.
items.para: Before they eventually accept a shared childcare scheme, parents briefly discuss proposals, quickly dismiss costly ones, and carefully consider affordable alternatives.
items.note: 两者都表示认真、仔细地考虑。

items.src: Elite runners surpass the club's distance target, experienced runners equal it, beginners remain below it, and intermediate runners come close to it.
items.para: Beginners trail the club's distance target and intermediate runners approach it, while experienced runners match it and elite runners exceed it.
items.note: 两者都指在距离这一指标上超过。

items.src: Coastal researchers utilize oyster shells for water purification, reserve surplus shells, monitor incoming supplies, and discard contaminated material.
items.para: Researchers on the coast set aside surplus oyster shells and keep track of incoming supplies, but make use of others for water purification and dispose of contaminated material.
items.note: 两者都指为特定目的利用某物。

items.src: Visitors preferred exquisite village bowls to crudely finished examples, although plainly decorated plates and goods manufactured in bulk sold equally well.
items.para: Simply decorated plates sold as well as mass produced goods, but visitors preferred beautifully crafted village bowls to roughly finished examples.
items.note: 此处指陶碗工艺出众、制作精美。

items.src: Engineers completed the embankment beside riverside homes after repairing a watercourse for drainage, a basin for excess water, and a flow-control gate.
items.para: Repairs to a drainage channel, an overflow basin, and a sluice gate preceded engineers' completion of the raised bank beside riverside homes.
items.note: 此处指河边用于阻挡洪水的堤岸。

items.src: Although both claims seemed just as credible and each could be tested separately, researchers found them incompatible rather than supportive of one another.
items.para: Researchers found the claims mutually contradictory rather than mutually supportive, despite their being equally plausible and individually testable.
items.note: 此处指两个主张相互矛盾、不能并存。

items.src: Although her assistant seemed restrained, self-assured, and casual by turns, the gallery director consistently displayed refined manners when greeting visitors.
items.para: Visitors always encountered cultured manners from the gallery director, whereas her assistant alternated between reserved, confident, and informal behaviour.
items.note: 此处均指举止文雅、有教养。

items.src: The coach's coherent explanation of rowing tactics contrasted with his assistant's concise, straightforward instructions, elaborate diagrams, and compelling arguments for a different approach.
items.para: His assistant offered brief and direct instructions, highly detailed diagrams, and strongly persuasive arguments for alternative rowing tactics; the coach's explanation was clear and logical.
items.note: 此处指解释清晰且有逻辑。

items.src: Hospital pharmacists must first detect and record medication errors, then rectify them, while revised procedures aim to stop similar mistakes recurring.
items.para: Revised procedures aim to prevent similar medication mistakes, while hospital pharmacists must identify and document existing errors before they correct them.
items.note: 均指把已有的错误纠正过来。

items.src: Following its district list, the report compares the above-mentioned districts with areas surveyed lately, granted recent protection, or kept under close observation.
items.para: After listing districts, the report compares those previously listed with newly surveyed, recently protected, or closely monitored areas.
items.note: 在列举语境中，指前文已经列出的。

items.src: Unlike its courses in aircraft maintenance, car repairs, and train operations, the college's nautical programme teaches students to navigate ships safely.
items.para: Students learn safe ship navigation through the college's maritime programme, rather than its aeronautical maintenance, automotive repair, or railway operations courses.
items.note: 此处均指与船舶航行有关的。

items.src: Council members will disclose confidential courthouse repair estimates tomorrow, after checking and amending the figures today, rather than keeping them secret.
items.para: Council members will verify and revise confidential courthouse repair estimates today, then reveal them tomorrow rather than conceal them.
items.note: 均指将原本保密的信息公开。

items.src: Repeatedly ignored requests provoked the conductor's exasperation rather than worry, sadness over failure, or social discomfort during the rehearsal.
items.para: The conductor experienced intense frustration, not anxiety, disappointment, or embarrassment, because her requests were repeatedly disregarded while the orchestra rehearsed.
items.note: 指反复受挫或被无视而产生的强烈恼怒。

items.src: Removing accessibility features created discord between developers and designers, replacing their previous teamwork and mutual confidence without producing any accommodation between their positions.
items.para: Disagreement replaced cooperation and trust between developers and designers after accessibility features were removed, and no compromise emerged.
items.note: 此处指双方意见不合、关系失和。

items.src: For her weekly programme, the producer chose an unusual happening rather than an unverified story, a forecast, or an account of its causes.
items.para: An unusual event was the producer's choice for her weekly programme, rather than a rumour, a prediction, or an explanation of its causes.
items.note: 均指实际发生的一件事。

items.src: Workshop participants sometimes gush about their proposals, while reviewers discuss them warily, offer critical responses, or make neutral comments.
items.para: Workshop participants sometimes enthuse excessively about their proposals, whereas reviewers speak cautiously about them, respond critically, or comment neutrally.
items.note: 指谈及某事时表现出过度热情。

items.src: The charity wants to streamline registration rather than broaden or merely assess it, but will substitute a new system if that fails.
items.para: Should its efforts to simplify registration fail, the charity will replace the system; it does not want to expand or merely review registration.
items.note: 此处指简化登记流程，使其更高效。

items.src: Learning weaving was an unexpected facet of our village trip, not its aim, while new friendships were an advantage and expense a disadvantage.
items.para: Our village trip's purpose was not learning weaving, though this was an unexpected aspect; new friendships were a benefit, while expense was a drawback.
items.note: 指村庄旅行体验中的一个方面。

items.src: Visitors preferred to ramble through abbey ruins rather than march rapidly or race along, although they occasionally stood motionless to admire carvings.
items.para: Although visitors would occasionally stand still to admire carvings, they preferred to wander leisurely through abbey ruins rather than march briskly or run quickly.
items.note: 指无固定路线、悠闲地漫步。

items.src: Our cycling study measured velocity rather than changes in pace, while also recording how far each bicycle travelled and how long each journey lasted.
items.para: Besides recording each bicycle's travel distance and journey duration, our cycling study measured speed rather than acceleration.
items.note: 此处指自行车的行驶速度。

items.src: The biologist described migration as intrinsic to this species, not learned or short-lived, while warning that it was not shared by all birds.
items.para: Although migration is not universal among birds, the biologist explained that it is inherent to this species, rather than acquired or temporary.
items.note: 指该物种固有的特征，而非后天习得。

items.src: Trainees learned to ignite and fuel a small fire before the supervisor demonstrated using a blanket to extinguish it rather than merely restrict its spread.
items.para: After trainees learned to light and feed a small fire, the supervisor demonstrated using a blanket to put out, rather than merely contain, it.
items.note: 指将火完全扑灭，而非仅控制火势。

items.src: After imports arrived, workshop orders began to dwindle rather than recover consistently, while retail sales began surging and material costs continued unchanged.
items.para: Retail sales began to rise sharply and material costs continued to remain stable after imports arrived, while workshop orders started to gradually decrease rather than recover steadily.
items.note: 指订单数量逐渐减少。

items.src: Before performances, Leila invariably phones her sister, frequently rehearses alone, occasionally drinks tea, and seldom listens to music while waiting backstage.
items.para: While waiting backstage before shows, Leila often rehearses alone and sometimes drinks tea; she rarely listens to music but always phones her sister.
items.note: 表示每次如此，没有例外。

items.src: Researchers may use the microscope jointly, book sessions, or seek preferential access, but they cannot monopolize this shared instrument.
items.para: Although researchers cannot have exclusive use of the microscope, they may share access to, reserve time on, or request priority on it.
items.note: 指独占仪器的使用权，不让他人使用。

items.src: The curator's tactful reply expressed doubts without offence; unlike her assistant's evasive answer, it was neither harshly direct nor full of enthusiasm.
items.para: Neither blunt nor enthusiastic, the curator's diplomatic reply conveyed doubts without offence, contrasting with her assistant's evasive answer.
items.note: 指表达顾虑时措辞得体，避免冒犯。

items.src: Our demonstration circuit carries one ampere at one volt, producing one watt of power through a resistance of one ohm.
items.para: With resistance measuring one ohm, our demonstration circuit draws one amp at one volt and delivers one watt of power.
items.note: 两者都指电流单位安培，后者为简称。

items.src: Clinic managers must examine and amend the appointment guidelines before authorising them and sending copies to staff on Monday.
items.para: Before they approve and distribute the appointment guidelines to staff on Monday, clinic managers must review and revise them.
items.note: 两者都指修改现有文件的内容。

items.src: Tower regulations make annual lift inspections mandatory, advise monthly checks, leave extra servicing to owners, and ban repairs by unqualified workers.
items.para: Extra servicing is optional under tower regulations, but annual lift inspections are compulsory, monthly checks recommended, and repairs by unqualified workers prohibited.
items.note: 两者都表示规章规定必须执行的。

items.src: The retiring director chose his second-in-command as his successor, rather than the aide who organised rehearsals or the consultant who advised him.
items.para: Neither his rehearsal assistant nor his adviser became the retiring director's replacement; he chose his deputy instead.
items.note: 两者都指接替原任者职位的人。

items.src: The housing survey revealed a broad spectrum of opinions rather than general agreement, with most favouring renovation despite a sharp split over costs.
items.para: Despite a sharp division over costs, a majority favoured renovation; the housing survey revealed a broad range of opinions rather than consensus.
items.note: 此处两者都指不同观点构成的范围。

items.src: Flood victims found refuge in a school after being rescued, while officials arranged their removal from the area and delivered emergency supplies.
items.para: After their rescue, flood victims found shelter in a school; officials organised their evacuation and supplied relief.
items.note: 此处两者都指躲避灾害的庇护。

items.src: Reviewers disliked the tablet's gaudy interface, contrasting it with its graceful casing, restrained logo and elaborately decorated packaging.
items.para: An elegant casing, understated logo and ornate packaging contrasted with the tablet's interface, which reviewers disliked for being garish.
items.note: 两者都指色彩过分鲜艳而俗艳的。

items.src: Leila was a prolific documentary producer who earned little professional admiration, while her films made little money and rarely shaped other filmmakers' work.
items.para: Although highly productive, documentary producer Leila was not highly respected, and her films were neither commercially successful nor widely influential.
items.note: 两者都表示创作数量多、成果丰富。

items.src: Walkers left a valley covered in trees, crossed a stony hillside, and reached a meadow beside a small piece of farmland.
items.para: Beyond a wooded valley and a rocky slope, the walkers reached a grassy field next to a small cultivated plot.
items.note: 两者都指长满草的田野或草地。

items.src: Engineers considered blocked drains the initial cause of flooding, dredging the remedy, flood prevention their primary aim, and erosion a ramification of dredging.
items.para: For engineers, flood prevention was the primary objective, blocked drains the initial cause of flooding, dredging the proposed solution, and erosion its indirect consequence.
items.note: 两者都指某项行动引发的间接后果。

items.src: The guide connected her microphone to an amplifier feeding a speaker, while a separate recording device captured her commentary for later playback.
items.para: While a recorder saved the guide's commentary for later playback, her microphone fed an amp connected to a speaker.
items.note: 两者都指增强音频信号的放大器。

items.src: Chapel artisans would trim glass carefully, embed it in wet plaster, and level the surface, but never cover the glass with paint.
items.para: Chapel artisans would never paint over glass, but would carefully cut it, securely insert it into wet plaster, and smooth down the surface.
items.note: 此处指将玻璃牢固嵌入湿灰泥中。

items.src: The minister called the broadcast a distortion of her coastal proposal, rejecting descriptions of it as a summary, negative assessment, or clarification.
items.para: A summary, criticism, or explanation of her coastal proposal it was not: the minister maintained that the broadcast was a misrepresentation.
items.note: 两者都指对原意的不准确、歪曲呈现。

items.src: The triumphant but thoroughly exhausted stag stayed with the herd after the riverside contest, while its injured opponent withdrew after losing.
items.para: Following the riverside contest, the wounded and defeated rival retreated, leaving the victorious but thoroughly exhausted stag with the herd.
items.note: 此处都指在争斗中获胜的。

items.src: Despite panicking readily and adjusting slowly, the workshop team proved resilient after losing its main customer, showing no willingness to abandon the business.
items.para: Losing its main client revealed a workshop team quick to recover rather than ready to quit, although prone to panic and slow to adapt.
items.note: 此处指团队遭受挫折后能迅速恢复。

items.src: Some retailers request emergency loans and misuse them on holidays, although they must repay them and reserve money for essential business costs.
items.para: Although required to pay back emergency loans and set aside money for essential business costs, some retailers apply for them and improperly spend them on holidays.
items.note: 此处指把贷款资金不当地花在度假上。

items.src: We agreed that uncertainty about the evidence was a legitimate concern, not an overstated or insignificant one, although objections to publication were too early.
items.para: Although objections to publication were premature, we agreed that uncertainty about the evidence was a justified concern, neither exaggerated nor trivial.
items.note: 此处都表示担忧有合理依据。

items.src: Marine biologists collaborate with acoustic engineers on underwater microphones, although they also contest funding, bargain over deadlines, and work separately on unrelated projects.
items.para: Marine biologists and acoustic engineers compete for funding but work together on underwater microphones, negotiate deadlines, and work independently on unrelated projects.
items.note: 两者都指为共同任务一起开展工作。

items.src: The dancer's eloquent gesture conveyed grief without speech, going beyond simple elegance or technical accuracy while remaining intentionally controlled.
items.para: More than merely graceful or technically precise, the dancer's powerfully expressive gesture communicated grief without words while remaining deliberately restrained.
items.note: 此处指动作无需言语也能有力传达情感。

items.src: Athletes store oats in the pantry beside their shared cooking room, while drinks remain in underground storage and plates occupy an enclosed cabinet.
items.para: Beside the communal kitchen, a larder holds the athletes' oats, while drinks stay in the cellar and plates in a cupboard.
items.note: 两者都指存放食品的储藏室。

items.src: Unexpected breathing patterns intrigue researchers but neither frighten them nor increase their confidence, although the findings do divide opinion.
items.para: Unexpected breathing patterns provoke disagreement among researchers and arouse curiosity, but neither cause alarm nor inspire confidence.
items.note: 此处指激起好奇心，而非担忧或信任。

items.src: Our guide is a photography fanatic, unlike his camera-collecting brother, his sister who paints portraits professionally, and his cousin who only takes holiday snapshots.
items.para: Unlike his camera collector brother, professional portrait artist sister, and occasional holiday snapper cousin, our guide is an obsessive picture taker.
items.note: 指痴迷于拍照的人，强调热衷程度。

items.src: Practical problem-solving defines the essence of this design course, rather than merely describing its instructional approach, desired result, or entry condition.
items.para: More than a teaching method, intended outcome, or admission requirement, practical problem-solving defines this design course's fundamental nature.
items.note: 指课程的本质，而非方法、目标或入学条件。

items.src: Applicants found the repeated paperwork tiresome rather than difficult to understand or complete, although staff insisted it served a purpose.
items.para: Although staff denied that repeated paperwork was pointless, applicants described it as irritating, not confusing or demanding.
items.note: 指令人厌烦，不等于难懂、费力或无意义。

items.src: Leaving a spare key with a trusted neighbour is a commonsense precaution, not a requirement, despite critics calling it dangerous and needless.
items.para: Critics call leaving a spare key with a trusted neighbour risky and unnecessary, but it is a sensible precaution, not a compulsory one.
items.note: 指合乎常识、切实明智，而非强制要求。

items.src: The director has authority to overrule the team's decision if privacy risks emerge, rather than merely examine, support, or delay it.
items.para: If privacy risks emerge, the director is empowered to reverse the team's decision, not merely review, endorse, or postpone it.
items.note: 此处指凭借上级职权推翻决定。

items.src: Producing an accurate documentary will entail checking historical claims, not simply allow it, while budget cuts may postpone or even stop such checks.
items.para: Budget cuts may delay or prevent historical checks, but producing an accurate documentary will require checking claims, not merely permit it.
items.note: 指必然需要，并非仅仅允许进行。

items.src: Revising explanations, a hallmark of flexible thinking, offers an occasional advantage in research, where certainty becomes a common barrier and curiosity is a prerequisite.
items.para: Research gains an occasional benefit from revising explanations, a defining feature of flexible thinking; certainty becomes a common obstacle, while curiosity is a necessary condition.
items.note: 指标志性的典型特征。

items.src: Tests identified these trees' genetic predisposition to fungal disease, rather than immunity gained through exposure, short-term weakness, or an established infection.
items.para: An inherited susceptibility to fungal disease was identified in these trees by tests, not acquired immunity, temporary weakness, or an existing infection.
items.note: 指遗传造成的易感倾向，并非已经患病。

items.src: Travellers lament overnight ferry closures but neither react angrily nor question the decision, while airline owners welcome them.
items.para: Airline owners show approval of overnight ferry closures; travellers express regret about them but neither express anger about nor voice doubts about the decision.
items.note: 指对某事表达惋惜或悲伤，而非愤怒或质疑。

items.src: Archaeologists found a decided change in pottery decoration after annexation, although changes in shape were slow, changes in size short-lived, and improvements in quality inconsistent.
items.para: Following annexation, archaeologists identified gradual changes in pottery shape, temporary changes in size and uneven quality improvements, but a clear change in decoration.
items.note: 此处都表示变化明显、确凿。

items.src: Researchers hoped to disprove the gardening myth, examine its origins, challenge earlier survey methods and endorse more community gardens.
items.para: Researchers hoped to investigate the gardening myth's origins and question earlier survey methods, as well as refute the myth and support more community gardens.
items.note: 两者都指用证据证明某种说法错误。

items.src: Before a winter holiday, shutting off water is imperative, checking windows is recommended, covering furniture is voluntary, and emptying bookshelves is not needed.
items.para: For a winter trip, checking windows is advisable and covering furniture optional, whereas emptying bookshelves is unnecessary and shutting off water essential.
items.note: 两者都表示必须做、极其必要。

items.src: Warehouse staff must remove the entrance obstruction before deliveries, then fix the leaking pipe, repair damaged shelving and secure the unstable loading platform.
items.para: Before deliveries, warehouse workers must clear the entrance blockage, then stop pipe leakage, repair shelving damage and correct loading platform instability.
items.note: 此处都指阻碍通行的堵塞物。

items.src: The cooperative plans to inspect the site, excavate a new tunnel, strengthen its walls and close the old entrance next spring.
items.para: Next spring, the cooperative intends to survey the site before workers dig a new tunnel, reinforce its walls and seal the old entrance.
items.note: 此处都指挖掘、开凿隧道。

items.src: Sibling support strengthened Amira's resilience and cooperativeness, but left both her concentration and her tendency to worry unchanged.
items.para: Amira's capacity to concentrate and tendency to worry remained unchanged despite sibling support increasing her ability to recover and willingness to cooperate.
items.note: 此处指遭遇挫折后恢复的能力。

items.src: Native frogs' return brought the wetland project public acclaim, replacing early public doubt, attracting continuing press coverage and securing government funding.
items.para: Once native frogs returned, the wetland scheme gained widespread public praise instead of initial public skepticism, attracting sustained media attention and government financial backing.
items.note: 两者都指广泛而公开的赞扬。

items.src: Our forthcoming exhibition features weaving, unlike the sculpture show now running, the earlier photography display and the painting exhibition delayed until autumn.
items.para: Unlike our ongoing sculpture show, previous photography display and postponed painting exhibition, now scheduled for autumn, our upcoming exhibition will feature weaving.
items.note: 两者都表示即将到来的。

items.src: Hand-painted murals adorn the entrance hall, where lamps provide light, metal panels shield the walls and movable screens separate the space into sections.
items.para: Lamps illuminate the entrance hall, metal panels protect its walls and movable screens divide the space into sections, while hand-painted murals decorate it.
items.note: 两者都指装饰，使某处更美观。

items.src: Following a minister's plan, a physician's advice and residents' request, a royal decree required every town to build a public bathhouse.
items.para: Every town had to build a public bathhouse under a royal order, following a minister's proposal, a physician's recommendation and a request from residents.
items.note: 此处都指君主正式发布的命令。

items.src: Rooftop gardens will augment urban green space, while separate council schemes will safeguard parks, redistribute planting, and substitute native trees for imported varieties.
items.para: Council schemes will protect parks, redistribute planting, and replace imported trees with native varieties, while rooftop gardens will increase urban green space.
items.note: 两者都指增加城市绿地的总量。

items.src: The lecturer blamed oppression rather than poverty for girls' exclusion from school under the former regime, despite demonstrations demanding changes to the political system.
items.para: Despite public protest demanding political reform, girls were excluded from school under the former regime through tyrannical rule, not economic hardship, the lecturer explained.
items.note: 此处两者都指政权对民众的专制压迫。

items.src: Council funding will repair the quay used for unloading fish, rather than the wave barrier, boat launching ramp, or coastal defence wall.
items.para: Instead of repairing the breakwater, slipway, or seawall, the council will fund repairs to the wharf where fishing boats unload their catches.
items.note: 两者都指供船只停靠及装卸的码头。

items.src: Laboratory tests found the cleaner's solvent inflammable but neither very poisonous nor highly corrosive, although it evaporated rapidly.
items.para: Although volatile, the cleaner's solvent proved neither highly toxic nor strongly corrosive in laboratory tests, but it was readily ignitable.
items.note: 两者都表示容易被点燃的。

items.src: Researchers treated tree ring width as a proxy for past summer rainfall, not an actual measurement, an account of causes, or a forecast.
items.para: Tree ring width served researchers as an indirect indicator of past summer rainfall, rather than a direct measurement, causal explanation, or future prediction.
items.note: 两者都指代替直接测量的间接指标。

items.src: The presenter tried to restrain her laughter, but her guest sought to trigger it, conceal his embarrassment, and extend the joke.
items.para: Her guest tried to provoke laughter, disguise his embarrassment, and prolong the joke, while the presenter attempted to hold back her own laughter.
items.note: 此处两者都指克制自己的笑意。

items.src: Participants had to examine the wooden pieces and visualize their arrangement inside a square before assembling them and describing the result aloud.
items.para: Before participants could physically assemble wooden pieces and verbally describe the result, they had to inspect them and mentally picture their arrangement inside a square.
items.note: 两者都指在脑海中形成具体图像。

items.src: Researchers quantify and interpret changes in river pollution, but campaigners condense their findings and distort a small improvement with a truncated graph.
items.para: Campaigners summarize the findings but misrepresent a small improvement through a shortened graph, whereas researchers measure and explain changes in river pollution.
items.note: 两者都指以误导方式歪曲呈现事实。

items.src: Shared guesthouse meals embody island hospitality; some hosts only describe this tradition, others publicly question it, and a few discreetly drop it.
items.para: Some hosts merely describe the island's hospitality, others openly challenge it, and a few quietly abandon it, whereas shared guesthouse meals concretely express it.
items.note: 两者都指通过实际形式具体体现传统。

items.src: Diaries say mechanical birds would enchant guests through lifelike movements, while unexpected whistles startled them, concealed gears bewildered them, and repeated displays bored them.
items.para: Diaries describe how sudden whistles would startle guests, concealed gears puzzle them, and repeated displays bore them, while mechanical birds' lifelike movements would captivate them.
items.note: 两者都指使人着迷并深深吸引其注意。

items.src: After privately discussing the survey and releasing a synopsis, the association published it in its entirety rather than through successive instalments.
items.para: The association published the survey in full rather than in stages, after discussing it in private and presenting it in summary.
items.note: 均指完整呈现，没有删减或遗漏。

items.src: Several island nations formed a bloc against commercial fishing; their representatives negotiated an agreement while a working group reviewed evidence.
items.para: While a committee examined evidence, a delegation negotiated an agreement for several island countries that had formed an alliance against commercial fishing.
items.note: 均指为共同政治目标联合的国家集团。

items.src: Coffee breaks let employees mingle with colleagues rather than seek advice from supervisors, train newcomers or evaluate fellow team members.
items.para: Employees can socialise with fellow workers over coffee breaks instead of using that time to consult their supervisors, coach new recruits or assess their teammates.
items.note: 均指与同事进行非正式的社交互动。

items.src: Although traders have difficulty saving and are reluctant to borrow, they aspire to open permanent shops and reject abandoning that goal.
items.para: Traders aim to open permanent shops and refuse to abandon that goal, although they struggle to save and hesitate to borrow.
items.note: 均表示以实现某事为志向或目标。

items.src: Gardeners distinguished indigenous meadow flowers from foreign imports, deliberately grown varieties and introduced species that had become established in the wild.
items.para: The distinction gardeners drew separated native meadow flowers from imported specimens, cultivated varieties and naturalised species.
items.note: 均指原本自然生长于当地的。

items.src: The supervisor called moving open chemicals reckless because spills could injure others, not excessively careful, unnecessarily time-consuming or simply wasteful of effort.
items.para: Because spills could hurt others, the supervisor judged transporting open chemicals dangerously careless, not overly cautious, needlessly slow or merely inefficient.
items.note: 均指不顾危险、可能造成伤害的鲁莽行为。

items.src: After the opera company's 1982 departure, the revolving stage fell into disuse; lighting was restored, the curtain mechanism stayed operational, and scenery was taken apart.
items.para: Following the troupe's 1982 departure, lighting was repaired, the curtain mechanism remained operational, and scenery was dismantled, while the rotating stage became idle.
items.note: 均指设施不再投入使用而闲置。

items.src: Our club won in three consecutive years after winning every other year previously, but its captain made no predictions about years ahead.
items.para: After victories in alternate years during earlier seasons, our club won in three successive years, but its captain offered no predictions about future seasons.
items.note: 均指时间上接连不断、没有间隔的。

items.src: Researchers found a cluster of asthma cases near the cement factory, but no expansion into surrounding districts, falling numbers or return after recovery.
items.para: Near the cement factory, researchers identified a concentration of asthma cases, without evidence of spread to surrounding districts, decline in numbers or recurrence after recovery.
items.note: 均指病例在有限区域内集中出现。

items.src: Residents found overnight repair noise tolerable after barriers were installed, although it still irritated them, remained audible, and was far from enjoyable.
items.para: Despite remaining annoying rather than pleasant, overnight repair noise became bearable, not inaudible, once barriers were installed, residents reported.
items.note: 均指虽令人不适，但仍能够忍受。

items.src: Laboratory cleaners swept away settled powdery dirt and fine sawing debris before scrubbing off filth, leaving rusted patches on metal for specialists.
items.para: After sweeping up dust and sawdust, laboratory cleaners scrubbed away grime but left rust on metal surfaces for specialists.
items.note: 此处指积累的脏污，与污垢对应。

items.src: Despite pressure to finish, the secretary checked budget figures with studious care, showing neither excited eagerness, calm assurance, nor marked impatience.
items.para: Under pressure to finish, the secretary displayed meticulous attention when checking budget figures, rather than great enthusiasm, quiet confidence or considerable impatience.
items.note: 指认真细致的态度，对应一丝不苟的关注。

items.src: Residents must initially lodge a deposit, can recover it but cannot pass it to others, and must forfeit it if they lose tools.
items.para: Residents can reclaim but not transfer their deposit after they pay it; losing tools means they must give up that money as a penalty.
items.note: 指因违规而失去或交出原有财物。

items.src: Technicians remove cable bends before they coil it around a plastic support, avoiding lengthening it under tension or turning it along its axis.
items.para: Taking care not to stretch or twist cable, technicians first straighten it and then wind it around a plastic support.
items.note: 此处指把线缆绕着支架盘成圈。

items.src: A maritime language programme examines the derivation of nautical expressions after explaining their definitions, spoken forms, and written forms.
items.para: Having explained the meanings, pronunciation, and spelling of nautical expressions, a maritime language programme turns to their origins.
items.note: 此处指表达的历史来源，即起源。

items.src: The psychologist described exposing a friend's secrets as disloyalty, rejecting the speaker's claims that it demonstrated truthfulness, compassion, or bravery.
items.para: Rejecting the speaker's claims of honesty, kindness, or courage, the psychologist characterised the disclosure of a friend's secrets as betrayal.
items.note: 泄露朋友秘密在此指背弃信任的行为。

items.src: The panel judged wetland restoration worthy of funding, formally qualified and reliant on grants, while rejecting a road scheme as inappropriate for support.
items.para: Wetland restoration was deemed eligible for grants, dependent on them, and deserving of funding by the panel, whereas a road scheme was unsuitable for support.
items.note: 表示凭自身价值值得获得，而非仅符合资格。

items.src: A gifted travel voucher's recipient must show a passport, unlike its original vendor, designated dispatcher, or actual purchaser.
items.para: A gifted travel voucher's original seller, designated sender and actual payer need not present passports, but its new owner must show one.
items.note: 此处收礼者收到凭券，成为其新主人。

items.src: Medieval rules would oblige bakers to display prices, permit bargaining, promote competition, and prohibit selling bread below the legal weight.
items.para: Medieval trading rules would encourage competition and allow bargaining, but require bakers to display prices and forbid sales of underweight bread.
items.note: 指法规强制要求，而非鼓励或允许。

items.src: Families traditionally wear a silver leaf as an adornment at the spring festival, not to display rank, ward off harm, or identify themselves.
items.para: Neither a status symbol, a protective charm nor an identity badge, the silver leaf is traditionally worn as a decoration by families at the spring festival.
items.note: 指用于美化外观的装饰物。

items.src: The ranger considered the feeding plan shrewd rather than merely careful, while rejecting another as rash and a third as traditional.
items.para: While rejecting an impulsive feeding proposal and a conventional alternative, the ranger judged another plan astute, not merely cautious.
items.note: 此处都指判断精明、有实际智慧。

items.src: Amira felt disappointed, bitter and embarrassed after missing promotion, but her bakery colleagues' kindness offered consolation without removing those feelings entirely.
items.para: Kindness from her bakery colleagues gave Amira comfort after her missed promotion, although her disappointment, resentment and embarrassment did not disappear completely.
items.note: 此处指失望之后获得的安慰。

items.src: Our astronomy programme aims to nourish children's curiosity, not assess its strength, shift its focus or stifle it through excessive technical detail.
items.para: Children's curiosity is what our astronomy programme aims to foster, not measure, redirect or suppress through excessive technical detail.
items.note: 此处指培养并促进好奇心的发展。

items.src: Leo explained that a minor ailment, rather than severe disease, brief tiredness or bodily injury, had kept him from the family celebration.
items.para: Leo attributed his absence from the family celebration to a slight illness, not a serious disease, temporary fatigue or physical injury.
items.note: 两者都指程度轻微的小病。

items.src: Tests showed the new coating could withstand extreme heat and decrease surface friction, but could neither transfer heat quickly nor retain thermal energy.
items.para: Tests found the new coating unable to conduct heat rapidly or store thermal energy, but able to resist very high temperatures and reduce surface friction.
items.note: 两者都指承受极高温度而不受损。

items.src: The curator's explanation for the unfinished portrait was plausible but neither elaborate nor novel, and it did not settle the matter.
items.para: Although neither detailed nor original, the curator's account of why the portrait remained unfinished was credible without being conclusive.
items.note: 此处指解释看似合理可信，并非确凿。

items.src: The coach credited ingenuity with creating indoor rowing equipment, while attributing regular practice to patience, self-control and belief in the team's abilities.
items.para: The coach explained that patience, discipline and confidence in the team's abilities sustained regular practice, whereas inventiveness enabled indoor rowing equipment to be created.
items.note: 此处均指创造实用解决办法的巧思。

items.src: Weekly meetings for patients recovering from surgery promoted solidarity rather than individual confidence, personal self-reliance or a desire to outperform others.
items.para: For patients recovering from surgery, weekly meetings promoted mutual support rather than individual self-confidence, personal independence or competitive ambition.
items.note: 此处指群体团结一致、相互支持。

items.src: The harbour plan prioritised regeneration through affordable studio conversions, rejecting widespread clearance, outward growth and simply keeping every warehouse unchanged.
items.para: Instead of widespread demolition, outward expansion or preservation of every warehouse unchanged, the harbour plan favoured renewal through affordable warehouse conversions into studios.
items.note: 此处指衰落城区的更新与振兴。

items.src: The headteacher called the club defiant over the meeting rules, not privately bitter or simply uncertain, and contrasted it with willingly obedient groups.
items.para: Contrasting readily compliant groups with the club, the headteacher described its attitude towards meeting rules as openly rebellious, not quietly resentful or merely doubtful.
items.note: 此处指公开反抗、不服从权威的态度。

items.src: Visitors admired the restored palace's majesty, while its gardens impressed them with their graceful design, lack of ornament and mirror-image layout.
items.para: The gardens impressed visitors with their elegance, simplicity and symmetry, whereas the restored palace won admiration for its grandeur.
items.note: 此处指宫殿雄伟壮丽的气势。

items.src: Priya's stirring cleanup speech motivated volunteers, although her earlier talks had merely provided facts, amused listeners or repeated familiar points.
items.para: Unlike her earlier informative, humorous or repetitive talks, Priya's inspiring cleanup speech gave volunteers the motivation to act.
items.note: 此处指讲话振奋人心，激发行动热情。

items.src: The app attracted condemnation from privacy campaigners, slight unease from users, guarded endorsement from investors and wholehearted backing from its developers.
items.para: While users expressed mild concern, investors offered cautious approval and developers gave enthusiastic support, privacy campaigners voiced strong disapproval of the app.
items.note: 此处表示强烈反对与谴责，而非轻微担忧。

items.src: The editor expected debate to ensue after publication, grow fiercer through Monday, die down on Tuesday and restart on Wednesday.
items.para: Following publication, debate was expected by the editor to follow, intensify through Monday, subside on Tuesday and resume on Wednesday.
items.note: 此处指随后发生，不指加剧、平息或恢复。

items.src: The coach traced fencing's origins to martial training, distinguishing this purpose from its later uses in sport, formal ceremonies and stage performances.
items.para: Distinguishing fencing's later athletic, ceremonial and theatrical uses, the coach explained that its origins lay in military training.
items.note: 此处指军事的，与体育、仪式及戏剧用途不同。

items.src: Patients may expect benefits before exercising, reap them through regular walking, retain them by staying active or lose them through inactivity.
items.para: Patients may gain benefits through regular walking, anticipate them before exercising, preserve them by staying active or forfeit them through inactivity.
items.note: 此处比喻获得坚持锻炼带来的益处。

items.src: Steep cliffs encircle the island's interior, where streams separate orchards, paths run across villages and towers command views of the harbour.
items.para: Streams divide orchards, paths cross villages and towers overlook the harbour within the island's interior, which steep cliffs surround.
items.note: 此处表示从四周环绕，而非分隔、横穿或俯瞰。

items.src: When the council dissolved, the bridge dispute remained pending, although the tax disagreement was resolved, the petition retracted and the appeal refused.
items.para: The tax disagreement was settled, the petition withdrawn and the appeal rejected, but the bridge dispute remained unresolved when the council disbanded.
items.note: 此处指争议尚未解决，仍处于未决状态。

items.src: Colleagues stayed to alert flood victims to hazards, explain evacuation and ask about losses, while an officer remained to console them.
items.para: An officer remained to comfort flood victims, while colleagues stayed to warn them about hazards, instruct them on evacuation and question them about losses.
items.note: 此处指安慰受灾后难过的人，缓解其痛苦。

items.src: Cold springs can postpone these freshwater fish’s breeding season and mild autumns prolong it, while pollution can disrupt it and sudden cooling can terminate it.
items.para: Sudden cooling can end these freshwater fish’s breeding season, whereas cold springs can delay it, mild autumns lengthen it and pollution disturb it.
items.note: 此处指使繁殖季结束，而非推迟、延长或扰乱。

items.src: The technician examined each wetland specimen before growing a microbial culture from it and separating an extract from the remaining residue.
items.para: Before growing a microbial culture from each sample collected from the wetland and separating an extract from the remaining residue, the technician examined it.
items.note: 此处指从湿地采集、供科学检验的样本。

items.src: Although cautious about borrowing and eager to expand, the owner was ruthless towards employees despite his reputation for giving generously to charity.
items.para: Known as generous to charities, the owner was nevertheless merciless towards staff, cautious about loans, and ambitious about expansion.
items.note: 此处指对员工冷酷无情，不顾他人感受。

items.src: Interviews revealed a deficit of emotional support for new parents, rather than excess, an adequate match to needs or a complete lack.
items.para: Neither a surplus, a balance between provision and need nor total absence described new parents' emotional support; interviews instead revealed a shortage.
items.note: 此处指新手父母所需的情感支持不足。

items.src: Our report explained our intent to test whether cooling delayed seed germination, then described our procedure, expected findings, and actual results.
items.para: Before describing our method, prediction, and outcome, the report explained our purpose: testing whether chilling seeds delayed germination.
items.note: 此处指进行种子冷却实验的目的。

items.src: The curator admitted that the photograph sequence was arbitrary, with no guidance from dates, subjects or the alphabetical order of titles.
items.para: The photographs had a random arrangement, not a chronological, thematic or alphabetical one, the curator admitted.
items.note: 此处指排列随意，没有系统性的依据。

items.src: Her twisted ankle meant the runner could neither dash nor walk casually towards the medical tent, but she could limp rather than crawl.
items.para: The runner could hobble on her twisted ankle to the medical tent rather than crawl, although she could neither sprint nor stroll.
items.note: 此处指因脚踝受伤而一瘸一拐地走。

items.src: Drink advertisements may educate consumers, ease their worries or encourage purchases, yet also try to delude them into believing vitamin drinks replace balanced meals.
items.para: Besides potentially trying to mislead consumers into believing vitamin beverages replace balanced meals, drink advertisements may inform them, reassure them or persuade them to buy.
items.note: 此处指误导消费者，使其相信错误说法。

items.src: Residents delivered savage criticism of the demolition plan, while traders expressed mild objections, councillors generally supported it, and the chair avoided taking sides.
items.para: Responses to the demolition plan were mildly critical from traders, broadly supportive from councillors, strictly neutral from the chair, and extremely harsh from residents.
items.note: 此处形容批评极其严厉，程度很强。

items.src: Although widely available and much liked, the recordings were unusually costly; nevertheless, adult learners found them invaluable for practising unfamiliar speech sounds.
items.para: Adult learners found the recordings extremely useful for unfamiliar sound practice, despite their being unusually expensive as well as easily accessible and highly popular.
items.note: 此处指录音对学习者练习发音极有帮助。

items.src: The ministry expects paper applications to decline before they cease next spring, while online applications continue and suspended telephone bookings restart.
items.para: Online applications should continue and suspended telephone bookings resume, while paper applications decline before they stop next spring, the ministry expects.
items.note: 此处指纸质申请完全停止，而非仅减少。

items.src: Mina found the unexpected order startling and the deposit comforting; the customer's praise gratified her, but his later cancellation let her down.
items.para: The customer's praise pleased Mina, although his unexpected order surprised her and his deposit reassured her; his subsequent cancellation disappointed her.
items.note: 此处指让人高兴并感到满足。

items.src: While the engineer trusted the device's accuracy, the buyer was dubious, the interpreter wanted to learn more, and the receptionist did not care.
items.para: Regarding the device's accuracy, the buyer was sceptical and the engineer was confident, while the interpreter was curious and the receptionist was indifferent.
items.note: 此处指对说法是否可信持怀疑态度。

items.src: Listeners criticised the evening programme's monotony rather than its overly complicated content, sudden topic changes or inconsistent speed of delivery.
items.para: Tedious sameness, rather than excessive complexity, abrupt transitions or uneven pacing, was the fault listeners identified in the evening programme.
items.note: 指缺少变化、反复重复造成的乏味。

items.src: Researchers examined the variance between predicted and actual scores, not their correspondence, their tendency to rise together, or participants' progress over time.
items.para: Researchers examined the discrepancy between participants' predicted scores and actual results rather than agreement, correlation or improvement over time.
items.note: 此处指预测分数与实际结果之间的差异。

items.src: The clinic needs vegetables consistently, but its garden yields an abundance rather than a small emergency stock, preventing a serious shortfall.
items.para: Meeting a steady demand for vegetables, the clinic garden yields a plentiful supply rather than a limited reserve for emergencies, preventing a severe shortage.
items.note: 指数量充裕、供应丰富。

items.src: Tomorrow's shaded rest stops will mitigate the walkers' discomfort rather than remove it entirely, while pushing onwards would worsen it and extend its duration.
items.para: Pushing onwards would intensify and prolong the walkers' discomfort, whereas tomorrow's shaded rest stops will ease rather than eliminate it.
items.note: 指减轻不适，而非彻底消除。

items.src: Medieval merchants would display fabrics for buyers and organise them before deciding which to deliver and which to stow in chests for sea voyages.
items.para: Before choosing fabrics to hand over or pack away in chests for sea voyages, medieval traders would lay out and sort through them for buyers.
items.note: 指将物品收好，供储存或运输。

items.src: The band's vocalist invited residents to a free choir, while its piano player and drum player helped the orchestra leader arrange rehearsals.
items.para: While the pianist and drummer helped the conductor organise rehearsals, the band's singer invited residents to join a choir without charge.
items.note: 指负责演唱的人，即歌手。

items.src: Maya considered the babysitter lax about bedtime, her husband excessively strict, her sister entirely erratic, and herself both resolute and just.
items.para: Regarding bedtime, Maya considered herself firm but fair, her husband unnecessarily strict and her sister wholly inconsistent, but judged the babysitter overly lenient.
items.note: 此处指执行就寝规定时管束过松。

items.src: Staff on rotating shifts are prone to sleep problems; although everyone recognises the risk, some worry about it while others experience no effects.
items.para: All rotating-shift staff are aware of sleep risks and susceptible to sleep problems, although some are concerned about the risk while others remain unaffected by it.
items.note: 指容易受到睡眠问题的影响。

items.src: Budgeting tutors teach shopkeepers, ready them for financial decisions, and ease their worries, while weekly exercises accustom them to recording expenses.
items.para: Weekly exercises habituate shopkeepers to recording expenses, while budgeting tutors train them, prepare them for financial decisions, and reassure them.
items.note: 此处都指通过反复练习使人习惯。

items.src: Mina found her relatives' requests predictable but scarcely defensible; although some were easily fulfilled, their combined demands became burdensome after months of care.
items.para: After months of family care, Mina found requests easy to anticipate but hard to justify, some simple to fulfil, yet collectively difficult to cope with.
items.note: 都指要求带来负担，令人难以应付。

items.src: Researchers called marble flooring an extravagance, safety equipment indispensable, upgraded microscopes worth funding, and reused desks a small economy.
items.para: Unlike safety equipment, an essential expense, marble flooring was an unnecessary luxury; researchers considered upgraded microscopes a worthwhile investment and reused desks a modest saving.
items.note: 都指并非必要的奢侈开支。

items.src: Repeated painting damage prompted the society to choose expulsion rather than an official caution or brief membership ban; the member had not resigned.
items.para: The society chose forced removal over a formal warning or temporary suspension after repeated painting damage; there had been no voluntary resignation.
items.note: 此处都指被强制逐出组织。

items.src: Club training content is identical irrespective of age; sessions follow national rules, occur indoors due to rain, and vary in duration according to experience.
items.para: Depending on experience, club sessions vary in duration, with identical content regardless of age, held indoors because of rain and in accordance with national rules.
items.note: 都表示不受所提条件影响。

items.src: Clinic researchers sift studies for reliable evidence before concisely outlining their findings and circulating them widely, while software stores every paper automatically.
items.para: Before clinic researchers briefly summarise findings and widely distribute them, they carefully examine studies for reliable evidence; software does automatically archive every paper.
items.note: 此处都指仔细审查以筛出可靠证据。

items.src: Builders use reclaimed lumber for benches in public squares, reinforcing them with steel and choosing concrete instead of natural rock for paths.
items.para: For paths in public squares, builders choose concrete rather than stone, while benches use reclaimed timber reinforced with steel.
items.note: 此处都指用于建造的木材。

items.src: Tomorrow, pupils will slowly tip and gently stir coloured water, measure it carefully, then squirt it through nozzles to compare pressure and distance.
items.para: To compare pressure and distance tomorrow, pupils will slowly pour, gently stir and carefully measure coloured water, then shoot it through nozzles.
items.note: 此处都指使液体从喷嘴射出。

items.src: The council qualifies for grants, must justify expenditure, and dislikes delays; limited tax revenue leaves it reliant on national funding.
items.para: Limited tax revenue leaves the council dependent on national funding; it is eligible for grants, accountable for expenditure, and dissatisfied with delays.
items.note: 都表示需要依靠某种支持。

items.src: Tomas usually reads and understands laundry instructions but tends to disregard them, whereas his sister obeys them when choosing washing temperatures.
items.para: When choosing washing temperatures, his sister will follow laundry instructions, whereas Tomas tends to ignore them although he usually manages to read and understand them.
items.note: 都指对已有要求不予理会。

items.src: Public discourse about facial recognition concerns privacy, while scientific investigation examines accuracy and promotional campaigns encourage adoption before practical training begins.
items.para: Scientific research examines facial recognition accuracy, while public discussion concerns privacy and publicity encourages adoption before practical instruction begins.
items.note: 此处指公众对某个议题的讨论。

items.src: Broadcasting studios adjoin the newsroom for easy access, whereas offices face the courtyard, stand across from reception, and occupy the storey above the cafeteria.
items.para: Offices look directly onto the courtyard, stand directly opposite reception, and occupy the floor above the cafeteria; broadcasting studios are directly beside the newsroom for accessibility.
items.note: 此处都表示房间紧邻另一空间。

items.src: Her first essay showed potential, rejection brought a serious reversal, and her theory became her career's pinnacle, though a review was her last contribution.
items.para: Her theory marked her career's highest achievement after early promise in an essay and a major setback through rejection; a review was her final contribution.
items.note: 此处指职业生涯中达到的最高成就。

items.src: Factory chimneys generate haze, harbour walls make it denser, trucks carry it inland, and coastal winds usually dissipate it before it reaches villages.
items.para: Coastal winds usually disperse haze before it reaches villages, although factory chimneys produce it, harbour walls concentrate it, and trucks transport it inland.
items.note: 此处指使烟霾散开，降低其浓度。

items.src: Novices on hidden ice are in peril, unlike sheltered guides who are fairly safe and closely monitored but too remote for immediate help.
items.para: Sheltered guides are in relative safety and under close supervision but beyond immediate assistance, whereas novices on concealed ice are in serious danger.
items.note: 表示身处严重危险之中。

items.src: Construction records date the commencement to eighteen forty, a temporary halt to winter, renewed work to spring, and the project's conclusion to eighteen forty-two.
items.para: Records place construction's completion in eighteen forty-two, following its start in eighteen forty, an interruption that winter, and a resumption the next spring.
items.note: 指一项活动最初的开始，而非中断后恢复。

items.src: Inspectors judged the centre's childcare first-rate despite merely sufficient meals, uneven cleaning standards, and a maintenance service that fell well below expectations.
items.para: Despite adequate meals, inconsistent cleaning, and poor maintenance, the centre received an excellent childcare rating from inspectors.
items.note: 表示质量极好，而非仅仅合格。

items.src: The frog diagram colours hind legs blue and forelegs green, with the top jaw shown in red and the bottom jaw in yellow.
items.para: Red marks the frog's upper jaw and yellow its lower jaw in the diagram, while rear legs appear blue and front legs green.
items.note: 指动物身体后部的，与前部相对。

items.src: Painting trials found five-minute breaks too short, forty-minute breaks too long, and fifteen-minute breaks satisfactory, but identified twenty minutes as the optimum duration.
items.para: Twenty minutes proved ideal for painting breaks in trials, whereas five minutes was insufficient, forty minutes excessive, and fifteen minutes acceptable.
items.note: 指最适合达到预期效果的，而非仅可接受。

items.src: Shopkeepers are ambivalent about redevelopment, unlike delighted landlords, strongly opposed residents, and mostly unconcerned commuters; they anticipate more customers but fear higher rents.
items.para: Landlords are entirely enthusiastic, residents deeply hostile, and commuters largely indifferent about redevelopment, but shopkeepers are emotionally torn, anticipating more customers yet fearing higher rents.
items.note: 指同时抱有正反两种感受，内心矛盾。

items.src: Leila's confidence remained intact after rejection, although friends expected it to become fragile or diminished rather than more robust.
items.para: Friends expected rejection to leave Leila's confidence fragile or weakened rather than stronger, but it remained undamaged.
items.note: 此处指信心未受损，而非增强或减弱。

items.src: Laboratory tests showed young corals were susceptible to fungal disease in warmer water, though not yet infected, while adults resisted infection without complete immunity.
items.para: Warmer-water laboratory tests found adults resistant but not immune to fungal disease, whereas young corals were vulnerable, though not yet infected.
items.note: 此处指容易受感染，不表示已经患病。

items.src: A fallen prop forced the dancer to swerve rather than halt abruptly or retreat rapidly, although she had intended to proceed straight ahead.
items.para: Intending to continue straight ahead, the dancer had to change direction abruptly, not stop moving suddenly or move backwards quickly, because of a fallen prop.
items.note: 指移动中突然改变方向，不是停下或后退。

items.src: Beginner swimmers give speed lesser importance than technique, not matching or exceeding it in priority, while safety takes precedence over everything.
items.para: Safety has overriding importance for beginner swimmers, who assign speed lower importance than technique, rather than equal or greater importance.
items.note: 此处表示重要性较低，而非相同或更高。

items.src: Patients sometimes err when measuring medicine despite being cautious, so nurses urge them to request guidance and obey the directions.
items.para: Nurses urge patients to seek advice and follow instructions because they sometimes make mistakes measuring medicine even when they take precautions.
items.note: 指犯错，与预防错误、求助或遵照指示不同。

items.src: The subordinate planners need approval from higher-ranking architects, whereas consultants working autonomously have the same status as those architects and need no approval.
items.para: Unlike independent consultants, who have equal status with senior architects and need no approval, junior planners must obtain those architects' permission.
items.note: 两者在此均表示职级较低，而非年龄较小。

items.src: Graduating apprentices offered heartfelt thanks to their tutors, whose support deserved more than courtesy, unwilling appreciation, or inflated expressions of gratitude.
items.para: Their tutors' support deserved deeply sincere thanks, which graduating apprentices offered, rather than merely polite, reluctant, or exaggerated expressions of gratitude.
items.note: 指发自内心、感情真挚，而非客套或夸张。

items.src: Revised rules allow parliament to oust the prime minister with two-thirds support, but not to choose, formally rebuke, or temporarily exclude the officeholder.
items.para: Parliament cannot appoint, reprimand, or suspend the prime minister under revised rules, but a two-thirds majority can dismiss the officeholder.
items.note: 此处指使任职者下台，不是批评或暂时停职。

items.src: Mei requested an appraisal of her grandmother's antique clock before selling it, after experts had verified its authenticity, restored it, and arranged insurance.
items.para: After professional authentication, restoration, and insurance arrangements, Mei sought a valuation of her grandmother's antique clock before putting it up for sale.
items.note: 此处指评估金钱价值，不是鉴真、修复或保险。

items.src: Moisture caused continual sensor failures, not infrequent or exceptional incidents, although recovery between breakdowns showed that the malfunction was not unbroken.
items.para: Recovery between breakdowns ruled out an uninterrupted malfunction, but moisture caused frequently recurring sensor failures rather than occasional or isolated incidents.
items.note: 指频繁反复发生，不一定毫无间断。

items.src: Technicians distinguished residual hiss from newly added clicks and repeated humming, while crackling that had been removed no longer obscured speech.
items.para: With the eliminated crackle no longer obscuring speech, technicians distinguished newly introduced clicks and recurring hum from leftover hiss.
items.note: 两者都指清理之后仍然残留的。

items.src: The expedition was overwhelmed by rampant speculation despite carefully checked reports, publicly challenged claims and rumours that members had firmly dismissed.
items.para: Despite carefully verified reports, openly disputed claims and firmly rejected rumours, the expedition was overwhelmed by widespread and unchecked speculation.
items.note: 此处指猜测广泛蔓延且不受控制。

items.src: Engineers intend to refine the coastal flood model before checking its performance, rather than substitute another model or reduce its complexity.
items.para: Engineers plan to fine-tune the coastal flood model and then test its performance, rather than replace or simplify it.
items.note: 两者都指通过细微调整使模型更完善。

items.src: Our walkers cancelled the crossing because the storm was ferocious, although earlier forecasts described relatively gentle, unusually short and highly unpredictable weather.
items.para: Despite forecasts of relatively mild, unusually brief and highly unpredictable weather, our walkers cancelled the crossing because the storm was extremely violent.
items.note: 形容风暴时，两者都表示极其猛烈。

items.src: Historians describe the kingdom's final decade as turbulent, contrasting it with earlier periods of peace, economic prosperity and widespread poverty.
items.para: Compared with its earlier peaceful, prosperous and impoverished periods, the kingdom's final decade was politically unstable, historians argue.
items.note: 此处指政治局势不稳定、动荡。

items.src: Organisers hoped free activities would enhance community benefits and sustain participation, but warned membership fees could negate those benefits rather than merely diminish them.
items.para: Membership fees could cancel out, not merely reduce, the community benefits organisers hoped free activities would increase while helping preserve participation, they warned.
items.note: 两者都指完全抵消好处，使其失效。

items.src: Campaigners called logging profits obscene, although officials considered them lawful, businesses deemed them financially justified and investors claimed they benefited society.
items.para: Although deemed legally permissible by officials, commercially reasonable by businesses and socially beneficial by investors, logging profits were morally outrageous to campaigners.
items.note: 此处表示道德上令人极为愤慨，并非色情。

items.src: Workers may slide fragile parcels gently, lift them carefully or lower them slowly, but must never fling them because impacts can damage instruments inside.
items.para: Workers must never forcefully throw fragile parcels, since impacts can damage instruments inside, but may gently slide, carefully lift or slowly lower them.
items.note: 两者都表示用力猛扔，不包含被扔的物品。

items.src: Station managers will empower evening presenters to approve urgent updates, while editors prepare them through training, oversee their work and assess their performance.
items.para: Editors will train, supervise and evaluate evening presenters, while station managers will authorize those presenters to approve urgent updates.
items.note: 此处两者都指正式授予处理事务的权限。

items.src: Aisha tried to reserve family time, compensate for missed hours and monitor work calls, which had begun to encroach on her evenings.
items.para: Work calls had begun to eat into Aisha's evenings; she tried to keep track of them, set aside family time and make up for missed hours.
items.note: 此处两者都表示逐渐侵占原有时间。

items.src: Engine clamor drowned out the faint drone of ventilation, regular taps from a loose cable, and low rumbling far away.
items.para: Faint humming from ventilation, rhythmic tapping from a loose cable, and distant rumbling were all drowned out by loud noise from engines.
items.note: 此处指响亮嘈杂、盖过其他声音的噪声。

items.src: The amiable sculptor was rather restrained in company, but her self-assured assistant became easily annoyed when visitors asked about their work.
items.para: Visitors' questions about their work made her confident assistant irritable, whereas the sculptor was friendly but rather reserved.
items.note: 指待人友善、性情亲切，而非自信或拘谨。

items.src: Rain rendered the results illegible, while officials found errors in the backup, gaps in the register, and obsolete information online.
items.para: Officials found the backup inaccurate, the register incomplete, and online information outdated; meanwhile, rain had made the written results unreadable.
items.note: 指字迹无法辨认，不是内容错误、缺失或过时。

items.src: The physiotherapist recommends physical activity as part of recovery treatment, warning that both prolonged idleness and excessive effort can harm patients.
items.para: Both prolonged inactivity and overexertion can harm patients, so the physiotherapist recommends exercise as part of rehabilitation.
items.note: 此处指身体不活动，与过度用力相区别。

items.src: Travellers prefer the coast's temperate but moisture-laden climate to the mountain village, where strong winds and bitter cold dominate winter.
items.para: Winter is windy and freezing in the mountain village, so travellers favour the coast, whose climate is mild but humid.
items.note: 形容气候温和，不严寒也不酷热。

items.src: Children compared herbivorous dinosaurs with species eating meat, insects, or fish, using tooth models in their museum lesson.
items.para: Using tooth models in a museum class, children compared plant-eating dinosaurs with meat-eating, insect-eating, or fish-eating species.
items.note: 指以植物为食，而非以动物为食。

items.src: Residents condemned the absurdity of requiring applicants to hold the permit they were requesting; procedural complexity confused clerks, while applicants protested unequal treatment.
items.para: Requiring applicants to hold the permit they were requesting drew residents' criticism for ridiculousness; procedural complexity caused clerks confusion, while applicants protested unfairness.
items.note: 指要求本身荒谬不合逻辑，而非复杂、困惑或不公。

items.src: Laboratory tests showed the kettle residue was innocuous, despite fears that it might poison users, irritate skin, or corrode metal.
items.para: Although feared to be toxic, irritating to skin, or corrosive to metal, the kettle residue proved harmless in laboratory tests.
items.note: 指不会造成伤害，与有毒、刺激性或腐蚀性相反。

items.src: Engineers kept one sample alight while another merely glowed; a third emitted smoke, and a fourth had been put out.
items.para: With one sample merely glowing, another smoking, and a third already extinguished, engineers kept the remaining sample burning.
items.note: 此处指处于燃烧状态，不是发光或已经熄灭。

items.src: The editor judged the obvious, embarrassing misprint trivial rather than grave because it left the weather report's meaning unchanged.
items.para: Because the weather report still meant the same thing, the editor considered its noticeable, embarrassing misprint insignificant rather than serious.
items.note: 指错误无关紧要，并非不明显或不令人尴尬。

items.src: The researcher's assurance of confidentiality followed a caution about fatigue, an appeal for honesty and an account of the memory test.
items.para: After a warning about fatigue, a request for honesty and an explanation of the memory test, the researcher gave a promise of confidentiality.
items.note: 此处指为消除疑虑而作出的保证。

items.src: Today's survey detected mercury and lead in river sediment downstream from the abandoned mine, but found neither copper nor zinc.
items.para: Neither copper nor zinc appeared in today's river sediment tests downstream from the disused mine, although both lead and quicksilver were detected.
items.note: 两者都是金属元素汞的名称。

items.src: The island was already publicised, famous and easy to reach when a coastal trail revealed its latent appeal to hikers.
items.para: A coastal trail revealed the island's previously hidden appeal to hikers; the island was already widely promoted, widely recognised and easily accessible.
items.note: 指原已存在但此前尚未显现的特质。

items.src: Copper discoveries helped spur Bronze Age settlement growth, prompting rulers to forecast further expansion, track its progress and curb it near farmland.
items.para: Rulers were prompted to predict further expansion, monitor its progress and restrict it near farmland by copper discoveries that helped stimulate Bronze Age settlement growth.
items.note: 此处指刺激或促进聚落发展。

items.src: Families separated during migration experienced initial optimism, mounting frustration and years of torment before reunion finally eased their distress.
items.para: Reunion finally brought relief to families separated during migration, after early hope had given way to growing frustration and years of anguish.
items.note: 此处指持续而强烈的精神痛苦。

items.src: The ranger described the ambiguous streamside tracks as clearly discernible, fresh and exceptionally shallow, possibly belonging to otters or another small mammal.
items.para: The ranger described streamside tracks as clearly visible, recently made and unusually shallow, yet open to different interpretations: otters or another small mammal.
items.note: 指存在多种可能解释，无法确定其含义。

items.src: Workers explained that ringing a bell was a celebratory quirk upon completing difficult orders, not a protective warning, inspection step or demand for payment.
items.para: Workers described bell-ringing after completing difficult orders as an unusual custom of celebration, not a safety signal, quality check or payment request.
items.note: 此处指作坊特有的不同寻常的习惯。

items.src: Analysts sought to identify and explain bakery losses from six weeks of roadworks, then quantify them so grants could compensate for them.
items.para: To enable grants to offset bakery losses from six weeks of roadworks, analysts sought to identify and explain those losses before proceeding to measure them.
items.note: 指用数字确定损失的具体数额。

items.src: Her teacher called the industrious painter eager for success and full of original ideas, but still lacking self-belief before her first exhibition.
items.para: Before her debut exhibition, her teacher described the painter as ambitious and inventive, yet not confident, despite being hardworking.
items.note: 指勤奋工作、不懈付出努力。

items.src: The laboratory introduced weekly discussions to foster cooperation between biologists and chemists, not to evaluate, record or control their joint work.
items.para: Weekly discussions were introduced by the lab to encourage cooperation between biologists and chemists, not to assess, document or regulate their joint work.
items.note: 此处指鼓励并促进合作的发展。

items.src: The violinist reported a slight tremor in her hands before performing, but denied any rigidity, loss of strength, or loss of sensation.
items.para: Before performing, the violinist denied stiffness, weakness, and numbness in her hands, although she reported slight shaking.
items.note: 此处指双手不自主的轻微颤抖。

items.src: A nurse examined the goalkeeper before a physician prescribed medicine, which a pharmacy professional supplied while a physiotherapist planned exercises.
items.para: After a nurse examined the goalkeeper, a doctor prescribed medicine; a pharmacist supplied it while a physiotherapist planned exercises.
items.note: 此处指诊治疾病并开药的医生。

items.src: Stopping antibiotics early can jeopardize recovery, whereas inadequate rest can slow it down and proper nutrition can both assist and hasten it.
items.para: Proper nutrition can support and accelerate recovery, whereas inadequate rest can delay it and stopping antibiotics early can endanger it.
items.note: 指使康复面临危险，不等于已经造成伤害。

items.src: Visitors requested clarification of the confusing parking signs, not conversion into another language, removal of errors, or reduction of linguistic complexity.
items.para: Neither translation nor correction nor simplification of the confusing parking signs was requested by visitors; an explanation of their meaning was wanted instead.
items.note: 此处指解释含义，使令人困惑的标识易懂。

items.src: The pottery tutor praised her adult learners' zeal but said they needed greater tolerance of difficulties, belief in themselves, and interest in discovery.
items.para: Although her adult pottery learners needed more patience, confidence, and curiosity, their tutor praised their enthusiasm.
items.note: 指投入某项活动的强烈热情。

items.src: Residents demanded an inquiry after the revelation of secret spending records, fearing officials might subsequently hide, change, or destroy those documents.
items.para: Following the disclosure of secret spending records, residents demanded an inquiry, fearing subsequent concealment, alteration, or destruction of those documents by officials.
items.note: 此处指将原本保密的信息披露出来。

items.src: Mei looked radiant at her birthday party, unlike her very anxious son, her utterly tired daughter, and her only moderately satisfied husband.
items.para: Unlike her deeply anxious son, completely exhausted daughter, and merely content husband, Mei looked visibly delighted at her birthday celebration.
items.note: 此处形容喜形于色，满脸幸福。

items.src: Engineers compared successive battery tests with tests conducted concurrently, tests occurring at irregular intervals, and individual tests conducted alone.
items.para: Engineers used simultaneous tests, intermittent tests, and isolated tests as comparisons for consecutive battery tests.
items.note: 指一个接一个连续进行的。

items.src: Editors chose three discrete sections for the fishing documentary, rejecting sections with shared content, an uninterrupted narrative, and a unified account.
items.para: Rejecting overlapping sections, a continuous narrative, and an integrated account, editors chose three separate sections for the fishing documentary.
items.note: 指各部分彼此分开、界限明确。

items.src: Some communities persecute dissenters for their beliefs rather than just expressing disapproval, publicly discussing disagreements with them, or paying them no attention.
items.para: Because of their beliefs, dissenters face communities that persistently mistreat them rather than merely criticise them, openly debate them or simply ignore them.
items.note: 指因信仰或观点不同而持续加以迫害。

items.src: Our clinic recommends a fusion of yoga and physiotherapy; researchers compare these treatments to assess keeping them separate or substituting one for another.
items.para: Researchers use comparison to assess separation of yoga and physiotherapy or replacement of one with another, while our clinic recommends a combination of these treatments.
items.note: 两者都指将不同疗法结合在一起。

items.src: Surveyors measured the river's breadth near the old mill as eighty metres, but did not record how deep, long or steep it was.
